hybrid architectures combining linear sequence models with softmax attention provide an effective balance between efficient long-context modeling and precise token retrieval. existing designs such as native hybrid attention nha combine compressed long-term states with sliding-window attention but their exact attention is restricted to a fixed local window. in this work we introduce prefix-state hybrid block attention phba which replaces local sliding-window attention with top-k block-sparse retrieval and couples each retrieved block with a compact prefix state summarizing its preceding context. the prefix states are constructed by a gated linear recurrence at block boundaries and retrieved together with the corresponding token blocks allowing the model to combine precise long-range evidence with compressed historical context within a unified layer. we further develop a hardware-aware triton implementation that streams routed token blocks and prefix states without materializing large intermediate tensors. experiments show that phba improves long-context and retrieval performance over strong linear and hybrid baselines while retaining efficient training and inference.

phba couples top-k block-sparse token retrieval with a compact recurrent prefix state for each retrieved block combining precise long-range evidence and compressed preceding context. a streaming triton implementation avoids large intermediates 760m and 1.3b language-model experiments compare long-context and retrieval performance with linear and hybrid baselines. the architecture suggests a way to combine search and compressed history for recommendation but the paper does not evaluate ctr tasks.
phba 检索top-k稀疏token块 并为每个块带上概括其前文的递归状态 结合精确远程证据与压缩历史。流式triton实现避免较大的中间张量 760m和1.3b语言模型实验比较了线性与混合基线的长上下文和检索表现。可借鉴其把搜索与历史压缩结合的结构 但论文没有评测ctr任务。

training large-scale recommender systems on dynamic industrial platforms such as short-form video sfv services with billions of daily interactions faces critical stability challenges. rapid distribution shifts in user data and increasing model complexity frequently trigger a divergence cascade typically initiating with gradient explosion propagating to weight explosion and culminating in loss explosion. this g-w-l cascade severely impedes model convergence and performance. this paper provides a systematic analysis of this g-w-l cascade within an industrial sfv recommender context. we then propose and evaluate a structured mitigation framework where interventions are explicitly mapped to counteract specific stages of the cascade gradient g control weight/activation w stabilization and loss l shaping. our contribution provides a structured framework for understanding and tackling training divergence offering practical insights for deploying robust continuously updated recommenders in large-scale non-stationary settings. we empirically validate the effectiveness of these strategies on a major industrial sfv recommendation system.

this study analyzes training divergence in an industrial short-video recommender as a coupled gradient–weight–loss cascade and groups interventions into gradient control weight/activation stabilization and loss shaping. industrial experiments support combining these controls to stabilize continuously updated models under distribution shifts. the measurements do not establish the exact temporal cascade for every divergence event the work offers a practical diagnostic framework for scaling rankers rather than a universal causal law.
论文把工业短视频推荐中的训练发散整理为梯度、权重与损失相互影响的过程 并将干预分成梯度控制、权重与激活稳定、损失调整三类。工业实验支持组合这些措施 以稳定分布变化下持续更新的模型。现有测量未逐次证明所有发散事件的先后因果链 它为排序模型扩容提供诊断框架 而非普适因果定律。

large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to llm-based recommenders that generate the semantic id sid of the item to recommend where each sid is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. a single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval content understanding and language and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using sid then how should the model generate the sid traditionally models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively typically using constrained beam search. in contrast an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction mtp where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. we report an industry-scale apples-to-apples comparison of these two generation paradigms single-head autoregressive decoding vs. mtp. we introduce a new auxiliary ranking loss defined over the joint sid score to train the mtp objective. we evaluate the sid training objectives on both quality and training/inference cost inside a multi-task llm that jointly does personalized retrieval content question-answering qa and instruction following over a large streaming-media catalog. our experiments show single-head beam search consistently beats mtp on most product-critical metrics ranking and content qa and trains at roughly 2.6x lower dollar cost on qwen3-8b scale mtp wins only on raw inference throughput. around this finding we detail an efficient training and inference stack and report end-to-end gains over the previous non-sid baseline equipped with an auxiliary ranking head +77% item cold-start ranking +22% content-qa accuracy +2.8x faster training with language metric regression traced to sid vocabulary expansion. we address the language regression by reinforcement learning post training.

in a multitask streaming-media recommender this study compares autoregressive semantic-id beam search with parallel multi-token prediction strengthened by an auxiliary ranking loss. with four-code ids and qwen3 backbones beam search performs better on most ranking and content-qa metrics and costs about 1/2.6 as much to train at 8b scale parallel prediction retains the inference-throughput advantage. the result motivates measuring quality training cost and serving throughput together without assuming the same trade-off for much longer ids or different task mixtures.
论文在多任务流媒体推荐中 对比语义id的自回归束搜索与加入辅助排序损失的并行多token预测。在四码字id和qwen3骨干的设置下 束搜索在大多数排序与内容问答指标上更好 8b规模训练费用约为后者的1/2.6 并行预测仍有推理吞吐优势。它提示应同时比较质量、训练费用与服务吞吐 不能将结论直接推广到更长id或不同任务组合。

generative retrieval is known for its efficient end-to-end indexing and retrieval. in particular numeric document identifiers docids are generally more efficient because they are shorter and generally fixed-length sequences over a small vocabulary requiring fewer decoding steps during beam search. however they tend to generalize poorly to unseen documents and must be learned during indexing-stage training. in this paper we propose a numeric docid design for generative retrieval that enables better adaptation to unseen documents without retraining. our docid design inherits the language model's knowledge each docid is a sequence of tokens factorized into bits and each token is scored as the sum of its bits. unlike existing numeric docids whose tokens carry meaning only through embeddings memorized during indexing training each bit here derives its meaning from the model's representation. therefore the docids of unseen documents remain scorable without retraining. experiments on three benchmarks show that our docid design substantially improves unseen-document retrieval while maintaining comparable performance on seen documents. it achieves over 20 percentage points higher hit@10 on unseen documents and up to 7 times lower inference latency than existing numeric docid designs on nq320k and triviaqa while performing only 3 percentage points below weight-update methods on ms marco without additional training. these results show that an appropriate docid design can heavily reduce retraining costs when adapting generative retrievers to new documents.

this generative-retrieval design factorizes numeric document identifiers into bits whose scores derive from the language model's representations allowing new documents to remain scorable without retraining identifier embeddings. across three benchmarks it improves unseen-document retrieval while maintaining comparable seen-document results reported latency comparisons concern numeric-id baselines. the approach is relevant to reducing index-refresh training costs in dynamic retrieval systems with transfer to recommendation still untested.
该生成式检索方法将数字文档id拆成若干比特 并从语言模型表示计算比特得分 使新文档无需重训id嵌入也能被打分。三个基准中 未见文档检索改善 已见文档效果保持可比 论文的延迟比较针对数字id基线。其可借鉴之处是降低动态检索的索引更新训练成本 向推荐任务迁移仍需验证。

generative recommendation models have shown promising results by representing items as semantic ids and generating these ids autoregressively. we introduce an approach showing that explicitly incorporating hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into generative recommendation can simultaneously improve training efficiency and long-tail recommendation performance. existing approaches typically optimize semantic id prediction with a standard causal cross-entropy objective which does not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure of semantic ids and can require substantial training to learn effective item representations. moreover data-sparse tail items often suffer from poor representations due to limited supervision resulting in weaker long-tail recommendation performance. we address these challenges with haste hierarchical and attribute-aware supervision for generative recommendation a unified training framework that introduces hierarchical and attribute-specific supervision. haste's hierarchical loss explicitly exploits the multi-level structure of semantic ids providing supervision at each level of the item hierarchy and substantially accelerating training convergence. its attribute-specific losses encourage the model to preserve fine-grained item attributes leveraging the language model's inherent semantic knowledge to improve representations and recommendations for tail items. we extensively evaluate haste on a fashion recommendation benchmark and across multiple domains of the amazon dataset. haste improves recommendation performance across datasets and item-frequency regimes. notably the hierarchical loss achieves approximately 2x faster convergence than the standard causal cross-entropy objective substantially improving training efficiency while maintaining strong recommendation quality.

haste adds hierarchical and item-attribute supervision to semantic-id generative recommendation aiming to reduce training effort and improve representations of infrequent items. hierarchical loss supervises each id level while attribute losses preserve fine-grained semantics. fashion and amazon experiments report gains across item-frequency groups the approximately 2x convergence improvement measures training steps to a validation-loss threshold not a demonstrated 2x end-to-end wall-clock speedup.
haste为语义id生成式推荐加入分层监督与商品属性监督 以减少训练开销并改善低频商品的表示。分层损失监督各级id 属性损失保留细粒度语义。时尚推荐及amazon实验报告不同频次商品均有收益 约2倍收敛改善指达到验证损失阈值所需的训练步数 不等于已证明端到端耗时减半。

relevance prediction between user queries and items is a fundamental component of e-commerce search systems. traditionally high-quality relevance labels are obtained through human judgment which is reliable but expensive slow and difficult to scale. recent advances in large language models llms enable automated relevance judgment at scale achieving performance comparable to human annotators. however such systems often rely on large commercial llms with complex prompts resulting in high inference costs and limited throughput. in this work we propose a framework that bridges this gap by distilling a high-performing llm-based relevance judgment system into efficient multimodal student models. we first curate a small high-quality human-annotated dataset to serve as ground truth. using this dataset we develop a reliable llm-as-a-judge pipeline through careful prompt engineering and iterative refinement. this pipeline is then used to generate large-scale relevance labels which serve as training data for compact multimodal models. our distilled models achieve performance close to the teacher system while significantly improving latency cost and scalability. this approach enables practical deployment of high-quality relevance prediction systems in production environments.

this search-relevance framework uses a small human-labeled set to refine an llm judge then distills its large-scale labels into compact multimodal student models. the students approach teacher quality while improving serving cost and throughput offering a route to scale query–item relevance supervision. evaluation distinguishes a test set used during teacher-prompt refinement from a separate cleaner test set this is relevance-label distillation not evidence of an online ctr gain.
该搜索相关性框架先用小规模人工标注集改进大模型评判流程 再用教师生成的大量标签训练紧凑的多模态学生模型。学生在接近教师质量的同时改善服务成本和吞吐 为扩展查询—商品相关性监督提供路径。评测区分了参与教师提示调优的测试集与较独立的测试集 这属于相关性标签蒸馏 并非线上ctr提升证据。

industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth distributed communication overhead and training inefficiency. we introduce \underlinechain \underlinedimension \underlinescaling cds a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. cds repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations so the number of iterations the chain length becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. a lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. cds enables two regimes. in the compression regime shallow blocks with a longer chain match deeper baselines with fewer parameters and faster training in the quality-scaling regime increasing chain length under a fixed parameter budget yields consistent offline and online gains suggesting the chain dimension adds modeling capacity beyond parameter reuse. we evaluate cds in a large-scale multi-task short-video ranking system in production. in the compression regime cds stays within 0.03% of baseline offline quality while reducing trainable parameters by 26.6% and improving training throughput by 6.4% with neutral-to-positive online participation. in the quality-scaling regime quality improves monotonically with chain length. wall-clock analysis shows the efficiency gain comes mainly not from reduced flops but from lower cross-device synchronization overhead and reduced optimizer update cost. these results position parameter-shared iterative computation as a practical communication-efficient scaling axis for industrial ranking systems.

cds scales an industrial recommendation ranker by repeatedly applying a parameter-shared feature-interaction block with an intra-chain residual connection stabilizing optimization. in a production multitask short-video system its compression configuration reduces trainable parameters by 26.6% and raises training throughput by 6.4% while retaining near-baseline offline quality. the online engagement estimate has a confidence interval spanning zero. efficiency gains mainly come from less cross-device synchronization and optimizer-update work not lower flops increasing chain length at fixed parameters also improves quality in the tested setting.
cds通过重复执行共享参数的特征交互模块扩展工业排序模型 并用链内残差稳定优化。在生产环境的多任务短视频系统中 压缩配置减少26.6%的可训练参数、提高6.4%的训练吞吐 离线质量接近基线 线上参与度增益的置信区间跨零。效率主要来自跨设备同步和优化器更新开销下降 并非flops减少 实验还显示 固定参数时增加链长可改善质量。

semantic-id-based generative recommendation unifies retrieval and ranking through autoregressive decoding but differs structurally from discriminative models which can directly access rich target-item side features. the attributes are compressed into a finite codebook during quantization while the target item remains undetermined during decoding and its features cannot be looked up. this target-side feature vacuum weakens generation at each semantic-id level through high conditional entropy and cascading errors and final ranking through missing target-side feature crossing. existing methods interact with candidate representations or generate discrete attribute tokens but none reconstructs a continuous target-side representation inside decoding to support both stepwise generation and ranking. we propose tacgr stepwise target-side feature anticipation and crossing for generative recommendation . before decoding each codeword tacgr anticipates a continuous target-side feature vector and crosses it with the semantic prefix and user behavior sequence inside the decoder. the crossed representation conditions current-level generation and is directly used for ranking. continuous-vector regression risks a learnable target collapsing with its prediction and prediction noise propagating into generation through attention. tacgr addresses these challenges with a semantic-anchoring auxiliary tower and a unidirectional visibility mask respectively. for extremely long industrial behavior histories it introduces gated convolutional denoising to suppress noise and adapts the pyramid memory funnel to reduce inference cost. offline experiments on a large-scale lazada dataset show significant gains over onerec unirec and unisgr. online a/b testing improves ipv order and gmv by 0.79% 5.55% and 3.09% respectively.

unisgr-v2 presents tacgr which predicts a continuous target-side feature vector before each semantic-id codeword and crosses it with the semantic prefix and user history to support generation and ranking. an anchored auxiliary tower and one-way visibility mask limit collapse and prediction-noise propagation gated denoising and a pyramid memory funnel handle long histories. in a lazada homepage a/b test replacing the previous generative recall model ipv orders and gmv rise relatively by 0.79% 5.55% and 3.09% this is not a test replacing the entire ctr ranking stack.
unisgr-v2提出tacgr 在每个语义id码字生成前预测连续目标侧特征 并与语义前缀、用户历史交叉 用于生成和排序。锚定辅助塔与单向可见性掩码缓解坍塌和预测噪声传播 门控去噪及金字塔记忆漏斗处理长历史。在lazada首页替换旧生成式召回模型的a/b测试中 商品详情页浏览量、订单量及成交总额分别相对提升0.79%、5.55%和3.09% 实验并未替换完整ctr精排链路。

summary-token architectures such as kwai summary attention ksa compress distant context into learnable summary token per chunk and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. in such hybrid ksa-full architecture the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. although effective however it also introduce some bottlenecks 1 the different layers summary compression chunk must be same therefore hard to reach a flexible kv cache compression e.g. different layer set different summary compression chunk window. 2 in the full-attention layers the summary token introduced additional computation cost but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling therefore unfriendly to the computation side. motivated by them we developed the ksa v2 which not only achieves a more flexible kv cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in full attention layer. specifically we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles the kv memory and sparse indexer.

kwai summary attention v2 addresses hybrid summary-token/full-attention models whose shared compression granularity restricts kv-cache flexibility and whose full-attention layers still incur quadratic prefill cost. summary tokens serve both as compressed key/value memory and as sparse indexers enabling layer-specific compression and selective access. it offers a possible design direction for long-history compression but the reported experiments concern language models rather than ctr ranking.
kwai summary attention v2处理摘要token与全注意力混合模型的两个瓶颈 共享压缩粒度限制键值缓存的灵活性 全注意力层仍承担二次复杂度的预填充成本。摘要token同时作为压缩记忆和稀疏索引器 支持分层压缩与选择性访问。该思路可供长历史压缩参考 但论文实验针对语言模型 尚未验证ctr排序收益。

generative retrieval gr offers a promising paradigm for industrial search by unifying candidate generation within an autoregressive framework. however effectively leveraging user behaviors in industrial gr remains challenging existing sid tokenization methods struggle to preserve collaborative signals while maintaining balanced codebook utilization whereas reinforcement learning rl for prioritizing high-value candidates suffers from sparse rewards when generated sids fail to match positive items. to address these challenges we propose wegr a unified gr framework with two complementary components. specifically the collaborative and collapse-free tokenizer coco-vae injects query-to-item and item-to-item collaborative signals into continuous representations before quantization preserving behavioral information without disrupting codebook optimization. it further couples first-layer codebook refresh to reactivate underutilized codewords with fidelity anti-collapse regularization which broadens gradient coverage over relevant codewords and penalizes collisions in deeper layers to yield behavior-aware sids with balanced utilization. for preference alignment dynamic horizon policy optimization dhpo progressively expands reward evaluation and policy optimization horizons to alleviate reward sparsity enabling coarse-to-fine preference learning from sid prefixes to complete items without auxiliary reward models. extensive offline experiments validate that wegr improves retrieval and ranking performance. moreover a six-week online a/b test on a large-scale e-commerce search platform achieves relative gains of 2.539% in orders 1.508% in ctr and 1.381% in cvr while reducing cpu and gpu usage by 25.5% and 26.1%. these results highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of wegr in industrial deployment supporting multiple search scenarios and tens of millions of daily page views.

wegr addresses weak collaborative signals and sparse exact-id rewards in generative retrieval. coco-vae injects behavioral information before quantization and combats codebook collapse dhpo progressively expands reward and optimization horizons. a six-week industrial e-commerce a/b test reports relative gains of 2.539% in orders 1.508% in ctr and 1.381% in cvr alongside 25.5% cpu and 26.1% gpu savings. these are system-level deployment results not isolated generator-kernel speedups.
wegr 针对生成式检索中的协同信号不足和精确 id 匹配奖励稀疏 用 coco-vae 在量化前注入行为信息并缓解码本坍塌 用 dhpo 逐步扩大奖励与优化范围。六周工业电商 a/b 测试报告订单、ctr、cvr 分别相对提升 2.539%、1.508%、1.381% 同时节省 25.5% cpu 和 26.1% gpu 用量。这些是系统级部署结果 不能视为生成器内核单独提速。

residual connections propagate information through a network by additively accumulating layer outputs. recently proposed alternatives such as manifold-constrained hyper-connections mhc and attention residuals attnres instead use more expressive depth aggregation mechanisms that improve language modeling performance at scale. in this work we consider the mixing of representations over depth as a problem of storing and retrieving information across layers. formalizing this perspective we introduce depth memory dm a unified framework that describes the standard pre-layer-norm preln transformer mhc and attnres in terms of streams that carry representations through the network. one such stream for example could be an explicit memory stream that is queried to enrich the input to every layer and whose output is subsequently written back into the memory for use by later layers. for attnres this memory stream is a growing cache of explicit layer representations. for mhc it is an expanded residual stream. building on this view we propose linear depth memory ldm which formulates information retrieval across depth as a regression problem solved using recursive least squares. the resulting architecture propagates three streams across depth the standard residual stream a linear associative memory stream and an inverse covariance stream. for high-throughput training and inference we propose a hardware-aware implementation of ldm that reduces peak activation memory and memory traffic. ldm consistently achieves the lowest perplexities among preln mhc and attnres baselines at the 400m and 1.5b parameter scales alongside competitive zero-shot accuracy.

depth memory unifies residual and cross-layer aggregation as memory retrieval. its linear depth memory variant uses recursive least squares and three depth streams with a hardware-aware implementation that reduces overhead relative to its naive implementation. it reports the lowest perplexities among tested preln mhc and attnres baselines at 400m and 1.5b with competitive zero-shot accuracy. this suggests a depth-scaling direction for ranking models but no ctr experiments establish transfer.
depth memory 将残差与跨层聚合统一为记忆检索 ldm 通过递归最小二乘维护三条深度信息流 并以硬件感知实现降低其朴素实现的开销。在 400m 和 1.5b 语言模型比较中 其困惑度优于所测 preln、mhc 和 attnres 零样本准确率具有竞争力。对排序模型的启发是改善深层信息传递 尚无 ctr 迁移验证。

long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks document prefix-lm share-question sliding-window block-sparse with multi-node context parallelism making the mask a dominant bottleneck. flashmask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from o n2 to o n via four query-axis boundary vectors covering broad structured patterns. implemented for ampere gpus it neither exploits flashattention-3's tma/wgmma warp-specialized pipeline on hopper nor supports distribution. the column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication clip--shift--max on the boundary vectors compatible with the single-gpu kernel. flashmask-3 introduces a mask-aware hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop flashattention-3's tma/wgmma pipeline plus a mask-aware distributed extension zero-communication mask localization a sparsity-aware load balancer hcc-ipo and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. on a single h100 across 12 masks at 4k--128k context it improves achieved tflops over flashmask flexattention and magiattention by 45--141% 34--71% and 2--44%. at context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8k sequence per device it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over megatron-core cp ring megatron-core cp all-gather and magiattention by 1.80×--3.71× 1.71×--2.92× and 1.09×--1.46×. in end-to-end training of a 118b-a14b moe at 128k on 128 h100 gpus it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a dual chunk all-gather baseline with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.

flashmask-3 combines a hopper-optimized structured-mask attention kernel with zero-communication mask localization load balancing and communication pruning for context parallelism. in 118b-a14b moe training at 128k context on 128 h100 gpus throughput improves 7.3–11.0% over dual chunk all-gather. the separate kernel and distributed-attention gains are not end-to-end gains. long-sequence ranking may benefit from these systems ideas subject to mask and hardware compatibility ctr transfer is untested.

flashmask-3 将 hopper 优化的结构化掩码注意力核与零通信掩码本地化、负载均衡及通信裁剪结合。在 128 张 h100 上训练 128k 上下文的 118b-a14b moe 时 相比 dual chunk all-gather 端到端吞吐提升 7.3–11.0% 独立核和分布式注意力的更大收益不能混为端到端收益。其对长序列排序仅有系统实现启发 需满足掩码与硬件条件 未验证 ctr。

since scaling laws were introduced for modern llms kaplan et al. 2020 several works have extended them to account for quantization tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on ai accelerators. we develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. to select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components isolating those that most affect loss. our qwen3 experiments under selected 4-bit regimes together with published llama-style experiments show that our law predicts loss with up to 11× lower mse than existing laws as model size and token count scale. finally we extend our law to layer-wise mixed precision and identify the optimal quantized-pretraining recipe i.e. model size training tokens and per-layer forward/backward precision under a hardware-aware compute budget. unlike prior precision scaling laws our law predicts that the optimal precision increases with the compute budget.

this mixed-precision scaling law separates capacity loss from persistent optimization error in forward and backward quantization. selected 4-bit qwen3 experiments and published llama-style results yield up to 11× lower loss-prediction mse than prior laws. a hardware-aware cost model jointly chooses model size tokens and layer-wise precision predicting higher optimal precision at larger budgets. this informs possible ranking-training budget studies not demonstrated ctr gains or measured end-to-end acceleration.
该混合精度缩放律区分量化造成的容量损失与前向、反向持续优化误差。在所选 4-bit qwen3 实验及已发表的 llama 风格实验上 损失预测 mse 相比既有规律最低约为后者的 1/11。其硬件感知成本模型联合选择模型规模、token 数与逐层精度 并预测预算增大时最优精度升高。对排序训练预算研究仅有方法启发 不代表 ctr 收益或端到端实测加速。

dynamic sparse training dst aims to reduce training costs while maintaining accuracy. existing dst methods mask out parameters but keep matrix dimensions unchanged. training speedups therefore depend on specialized support such as sparse kernels. we introduce barter a structured dst framework that reduces training cost using standard dense kernels by keeping training tensors physically compact while dynamically reallocating capacity across layers. unlike existing works that require computing gradients for all parameters barter instead uses statistics collected only from active units during ordinary backpropagation to prune and clone attention heads and feed-forward channels under separate fixed global budgets. at each topology update it resizes the affected parameter tensors and remaps their optimizer states so subsequent training steps operate directly on the compact model. training and fine-tuning experiments with transformer-based vision models on two image classification benchmarks at densities from 0.1 to 0.7 show competitive top-1 accuracy relative to full-tensor dst baselines. on an nvidia l40 barter achieves speedups of up to 6.29× in measured training segments and reduces peak allocated gpu memory by up to 81.3% relative to these implementations. an iphone 13 pro max training benchmark additionally shows a 2.78× speedup over the full-tensor dst baseline.

barter dynamically prunes and clones attention heads and ffn channels while physically resizing tensors and optimizer states allowing standard dense kernels to train compact models. vision-transformer experiments at densities 0.1–0.7 report competitive accuracy up to 6.29× faster measured training segments and 81.3% lower peak allocated gpu memory on l40 versus full-tensor dst implementations. these are segment benchmarks not complete-run speedups ranking transfer remains untested.
barter 动态裁剪与克隆注意力头、ffn 通道 并同步缩小参数张量和映射优化器状态 使标准稠密算子直接训练紧凑模型。在密度 0.1–0.7 的视觉 transformer 实验中 准确率具有竞争力 相对完整张量 dst 实现 l40 上所测训练片段最高加速 6.29 倍、峰值已分配显存最高下降 81.3%。这是片段测速 并非完整训练任务加速 排序迁移尚未验证。

the design of attention mechanisms in long-context large language models faces an ``impossible triangle'' among kv cache size training and prefill flops and model quality. gqa achieves strong quality but incurs high kv cache overhead alternative approaches such as mla and mfa can compress the cache but mla suffers from quality loss while mfa substantially increases training and prefill compute. we propose virtual head attention vha which simultaneously improves all three vertices through two lightweight linear operations q premix applies a near-identity transformation to queries within each kv group to recover virtual head diversity from halved physical query heads and linear postmix fuses inter-head features via a low-rank i + ab\top residual structure. since vha introduces no nonlinear operations premix can be folded into the query projection and postmix into the output projection at inference time reducing the model to a standard gqa-2 architecture that directly reuses all existing gqa inference optimizations. with only two kv heads the group size in large models readily reaches 64 fully exploiting tensor core parallelism during decoding. across four scales with 4k-context 50b-token pretraining vha consistently surpasses the standard gqa baseline at every scale +0.05% to +0.81% while reducing kv cache by 4× vs. gqa-8 at dense scales and 2× vs. gqa-4 at the moe scale and lowering training and prefill flops by 7.9% 1.7b s=4096 . on an industrial 30b-a3b moe model trained on 500b tokens at 8k context vha outperforms both mla and gqa-4 by +0.70 / +2.60 % on a 12-benchmark base-model evaluation suite in a separate matched 10b-a1b moe comparison after long-context mid-training vha attains an average ruler score of 84.4 over 8k--128k versus 73.0 for gqa while using two rather than four kv heads in the full-attention layers.

virtual head attention uses linear query premixing and low-rank head postmixing that fold into standard gqa-2 at inference. across four 50b-token pretraining scales it reports better evaluated quality with smaller kv caches the dense comparisons use gqa-8 and the moe comparison gqa-4. a separate matched long-context moe study reduces kv heads only in full-attention layers. its cache/quality tradeoff suggests ranking-attention designs but no ctr results establish benefit.

virtual head attention 通过线性 query 预混合与低秩头后混合 在推理时折叠为标准 gqa-2。四档规模、50b-token 预训练比较中 其评测质量改善且 kv 缓存更小 稠密模型对照为 gqa-8 moe 对照为 gqa-4。另一组匹配的长上下文 moe 实验仅减少全注意力层的 kv 头 不能推为全模型缓存减半。其缓存与质量权衡可启发排序注意力设计 但未验证 ctr 收益。

softmax attention in transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length making it impractical for long-context applications. linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. among existing linear attention approaches recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. however the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. as a result prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. this introduces a non-negligible approximation error. in this paper we show that from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. we propose learnable low-rank polynomial sketch llops a principled and flexible framework for approximating polynomial kernels with linear attention. our method learns a low-rank polynomial sketch that provably achieves a strictly smaller approximation error than existing approaches. experiment results show that llops achieves the highest performance across extensive benchmarks comparing with various linear attention baselines.

llops learns low-rank polynomial feature sketches for linear attention aiming to reduce approximation error relative to existing polynomial-kernel constructions. it reports strong results against tested linear-attention baselines across language and long-range benchmarks. the language study adapts based checkpoints with matched continued training for the based comparator. the theoretical approximation result is not a guarantee of better task accuracy possible long-history ranking use remains untested.
llops 学习低秩多项式特征映射 以降低既有多项式核线性注意力的近似误差 并在语言与长距离基准上报告对所测线性注意力基线的较强表现。语言实验由 based 检查点继续训练 同时对 based 对照执行匹配的继续训练。核近似理论不等于所有任务准确率必然提高 对长历史排序的用途仍待验证。

recent work leverages large-scale pretrained foundation models fms to transfer generalizable representations to downstream advertising tasks. most existing approaches transfer user representations urs and item representations irs while underutilizing the user-item cross representations crs generated by deeper interaction layers. although a recent work transfers target-aware embeddings taes it requires real-time upstream fm inference alongside the downstream introducing additional engineering complexity and overhead. to address these limitations we propose large foundation model for ads recommendation lfm4ads an efficient pretrain-then-transfer paradigm for cross-domain ad recommendation. lfm4ads jointly exploits urs irs and crs from the upstream fm. it extracts sample-level crs from pretrained interaction layers and aggregates them into user-level crs using a time-aware exponential moving average thereby decoupling upstream inference from downstream online serving. to use crs efficiently we propose three downstream usages at different levels of granularity feature-level gating to fuse crs into downstream embeddings module-level fine-tuning to yield downstream crs and model-level retrieval by matching crs with irs. lfm4ads has been deployed on tencent's advertising platform since q4 2024. it has supported 10+ launches across major scenarios yielding a platform-wide gross merchandise value gmv lift of 2.45% and annual revenue gains in the hundreds of millions of dollars. offline experiments on kuairand-1k further demonstrate our effectiveness. our code is available at this https url.

lfm4ads transfers user item and user–item cross representations from an advertising foundation model. it aggregates sample-level cross representations into user-level states with a time-aware exponential moving average decoupling upstream inference from downstream online serving. feature-level gating module-level fine-tuning and cross-representation/item-representation matching support three reuse granularities. tencent reports more than ten launches since q4 2024 and a 2.45% platform-wide gmv lift an aggregate deployment result rather than a single controlled comparison offline experiments on kuairand-1k provide additional evidence. the scaling lesson is to reuse interaction knowledge without placing upstream inference on every downstream request path.

lfm4ads 同时迁移广告基座模型中的用户、物品及用户—物品交互表示。它用时间感知的指数移动平均 将单样本的交互表示汇聚为用户级状态 使上游推理与下游在线服务解耦 下游可通过特征门控、模块微调 以及交互表示与物品表示匹配完成三个粒度的复用。腾讯报告自 2024 年第四季度以来十余次上线合计带来平台 gmv 提升 2.45% 这是部署汇总而非单次对照实验 kuairand-1k 离线实验提供了补充证据。对扩模可借鉴的是复用交互知识 而不让每个下游请求都实时执行上游模型。

traditional id-based recommender systems often struggle with cold-start and generalization challenges. multimodal recommendation systems which leverage textual and visual data offer a promising solution to mitigate these issues. however existing industrial approaches typically adopt a two-stage training paradigm first pretraining a multimodal model then applying its frozen representations to train the recommendation model. this decoupled framework suffers from misalignment between multimodal learning and recommendation objectives as well as an inability to adapt dynamically to new data. to address these limitations we propose lemur the first large-scale multimodal recommender system trained end-to-end from raw data. by jointly optimizing both the multimodal and recommendation components lemur ensures tighter alignment with downstream objectives while enabling real-time parameter updates. constructing multimodal sequential representations from user history often entails prohibitively high computational costs. to alleviate this bottleneck we propose a novel memory bank mechanism that incrementally accumulates historical multimodal representations throughout the training process. after one month of deployment in douyin search lemur has led to a 0.843% reduction in query change rate decay and a 0.81% improvement in qauc. additionally lemur has shown significant gains across key offline metrics for douyin advertisement. our results validate the superiority of end-to-end multimodal recommendation in real-world industrial scenarios.

lemur jointly trains multimodal content representations and an industrial recommender using a memory bank that incrementally accumulates historical representations to control long-history computation. douyin search reports a 0.81% relative offline qauc improvement and an online query-reformulation reduction douyin ads evidence is offline. it illustrates joint representation–ranking optimization with cached histories whose staleness and incomplete long-tail coverage remain limitations.
lemur联合训练多模态内容表示与工业推荐模型 用逐步积累历史表示的记忆库控制长历史计算成本。抖音搜索报告离线qauc相对提升0.81% 线上查询改写减少 抖音广告证据仅为离线评估。其可借鉴之处是借助历史缓存联合优化表示与排序 缓存过时及长尾覆盖不足仍是限制。

modern recommender systems leverage ultra-long user behavior sequences to capture dynamic preferences but end-to-end modeling is infeasible in production due to latency and memory constraints. while summarizing history via interest centers offers a practical alternative existing methods struggle to 1 identify user-specific centers at appropriate granularity and 2 accurately assign behaviors leading to quantization errors and loss of long-tail preferences. to alleviate these issues we propose hierarchical sparse activation compression hisac an efficient framework for personalized sequence modeling. hisac encodes interactions into multi-level semantic ids and constructs a global hierarchical codebook. a hierarchical voting mechanism sparsely activates personalized interest-agents as fine-grained preference centers. guided by these agents soft-routing attention aggregates historical signals in semantic space weighting by similarity to minimize quantization error and retain long-tail behaviors. deployed on taobao's guess what you like homepage hisac achieves significant compression and cost reduction with online a/b tests showing a consistent 1.65% ctr uplift -- demonstrating its scalability and real-world effectiveness.

hisac compresses ultra-long behavior histories with a hierarchical semantic codebook. sparse hierarchical voting selects personalized interest agents and soft-routing attention aggregates behaviors by semantic similarity to reduce quantization error and retain long-tail preferences. taobao homepage a/b tests report a 1.65% ctr lift. the work offers a structured compression path for long-sequence ranking deployment efficiency also depends on request reuse and caching rather than the compression mechanism alone.
hisac用分层语义码本压缩超长行为历史 通过稀疏分层投票选择个性化兴趣代理 再按语义相似度软路由聚合行为 以降低量化误差、保留长尾偏好。淘宝首页a/b测试报告ctr提升1.65%。它为长序列排序提供结构化压缩路径 实际部署效率还依赖请求复用与缓存 不能全归于压缩机制。

we present dranker disney+ ranker a transformer-based multitask ranking model serving personalized recommendations on the disney+ homepage. we describe the encoder-only architecture over enriched engagement-history sequences paired with a lightweight causal debiasing mechanism and the inference stack that enables transformer-based ranking at scale. through iterative development we systematically evaluated more complex alternatives and found that simpler designs consistently outperformed them on offline metrics qualitative behavioral evaluation and in production. deployed globally dranker drives over 1% lift in our key engagement metric and 0.5% lift in daily active users across all experiences powered by the ranker. we share practical lessons on data engineering debiasing and architectural choices that shaped our ranking system at scale.

dranker uses an encoder-only transformer over enriched engagement histories a lightweight debiasing mechanism and a production inference stack to serve multitask disney+ homepage ranking. the team reports that simpler designs outperform the more complex alternatives they tested with global deployment yielding over 1% improvement in its key engagement metric and 0.5% in daily active users. the lessons connect history representation debiasing and serving efficiency the production-specific comparison does not establish that simpler models always scale better.
dranker以增强的用户互动历史为输入 结合仅编码器transformer、轻量去偏机制与生产推理系统 承担disney+首页多任务排序。团队报告 在其测试范围内较简洁设计优于复杂替代方案 全球部署后关键参与度指标提高超过1% 日活跃用户提高0.5%。其经验连接历史表示、去偏和服务效率 但生产场景内的比较不能证明简单模型总能更好地扩展。

linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. this coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. we challenge this presumed ceiling recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage. we introduce notebank a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. this training-free plug-and-play interface requires no external embedding model separately trained retriever or separate neural reader. at one million tokens it raises gated deltanet's mean accuracy across six ruler retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3% with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4k to 1m tokens. this recovery adds \leqslant0.025% to analytical flops with persistent context storage approximately 1/2 600 that of a transformer's full mha kv cache at matched width depth and precision. experiments extend from three 1.3b recurrent backbones to mamba-2-8b and post-trained qwen3.5-9b demonstrating gains on longbench v1/v2 and memoryagentbench. together these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.

notebank adds a training-free episodic archive to pretrained recurrent models it stores selected text before future queries are known retrieves with native model features and replays evidence through the original backbone. at one million tokens gated deltanet mean accuracy on six ruler retrieval tasks rises from 1.7% to 70.3%. its small analytical-flops overhead is not negligible wall-clock overhead and the storage comparison excludes model weights and transient allocations. long-history ranking is a possible transfer direction not a tested ctr result.
notebank为预训练循环模型加入无需训练的片段档案 在未来查询未知时保存部分文本 利用模型自身特征检索 并把证据重新送入原骨干计算。百万token下 gated deltanet在六项ruler检索任务上的平均准确率由1.7%升至70.3%。较小的理论flops增量不等于实际耗时可忽略 存储比较也不含模型权重和临时分配。长历史排序可借鉴这一结构 但尚无ctr验证。

the sequential recommendation sr task aims to predict the next item based on users' historical interaction sequences. typically trained on historical data sr models often struggle to adapt to real-time preference shifts during inference due to challenges posed by distributional divergence and parameterized constraints. existing approaches to address this issue include test-time training test-time augmentation and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning. however these methods either introduce significant computational overhead rely on random augmentation strategies or require a carefully designed two-stage training paradigm. in this paper we argue that the key to effective test-time adaptation lies in achieving both effective augmentation and efficient adaptation. to this end we propose retrieve-then-adapt read a novel framework that dynamically adapts a deployed sr model to the test distribution through retrieved user preference signals. specifically given a trained sr model read first retrieves collaboratively similar items for a test user from a constructed collaborative memory database. a lightweight retrieval learning module then integrates these items into an informative augmentation embedding that captures both collaborative signals and prediction-refinement cues. finally the initial sr prediction is refined via a fusion mechanism that incorporates this embedding. extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that read consistently outperforms existing sr methods.

read retrieves collaboratively similar items from a memory database and integrates them through a lightweight retrieval module to refine a sequential recommender s predictions. the backbone stays frozen at inference retrieved signals adapt the prediction without online parameter updates. five benchmark datasets show improvements over the tested sequential methods. this offers a retrieval-based route to handle shifted or rare preferences but requires extra retrieval/fusion work and does not establish production ctr or latency gains.
read从协同记忆库检索相似物品 经轻量检索模块整合后修正序列推荐预测。推理时骨干保持冻结 依靠检索信号调整输出 无需在线更新参数。五个基准数据集上优于所测序列方法。该路线可处理变化或稀有偏好 但会增加检索与融合计算 尚未证明生产ctr或延迟收益。

generative recommendation gr reframes retrieval and ranking as autoregressive decoding over semantic ids sids unifying the multi-stage pipeline into a single model. yet a fundamental expressive gap persists discriminative models score items with direct feature access enabling explicit user-item crossing whereas gr decodes over compact sid tokens without item-side signal. we formalize this via bayes' theorem ranking by p y|f u is equivalent to ranking by p f|y u which factorizes autoregressively over item features showing that a generative model with full feature access matches its discriminative counterpart with any practical gap stemming solely from incomplete feature coverage. we propose unirec with chain-of-attribute coa as its core mechanism. coa prefixes each sid sequence with structured attribute tokens category seller brand before decoding the sid recovering the item-side feature crossing that discriminative models exploit. since items sharing identical attributes cluster in adjacent sid regions attribute conditioning yields a measurable per-step entropy reduction h s_k|s<k a < h s_k|s<k narrowing the search space and stabilizing beam search. we further address two deployment challenges capacity-constrained sid introduces exposure-weighted capacity penalties into residual quantization to suppress token collapse and the matthew effect conditional decoding context cdc combines task-conditioned bos with hash-based content summaries to inject scenario signals at each decoding step. a joint rft and dpo framework aligns the model with business objectives beyond distribution matching. experiments show unirec outperforms the strongest baseline by +22.6% hr@50 overall and +15.5% on high-value orders. deployed on shopee's e-commerce platform online a/b tests confirm significant gains in pvctr +5.37% orders +4.76% and gmv +5.60% .

unirec prefixes semantic item ids with category seller and brand tokens to expose item attributes during autoregressive recommendation. exposure-aware capacity penalties and scenario-conditioned decoding address token concentration and multi-scenario deployment while reward-weighted fine-tuning and preference optimization align business objectives. the authors report offline retrieval and online shopee gains. for ctr scaling the useful design is attribute-conditioned generation with explicit scenario signals the abstract s broad expressive-equivalence claim should not be read as an unconditional guarantee of equivalent ranking.
unirec先生成类目、卖家和品牌 再生成物品语义id 让自回归推荐显式利用物品属性。曝光加权的容量惩罚缓解令牌集中 场景条件解码配合奖励加权微调与偏好优化 面向多场景部署。作者报告了离线召回和shopee线上收益。对ctr扩展的借鉴是属性条件生成与显式场景信号 摘要中的表达能力等价论断不应理解为无条件的排序等价保证。

the scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models lms has been extensively studied more recently models are being designed to scale memory use as well. in particular adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use because each pass only processes individual embedding rows which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. however existing methods train embeddings from scratch which needs expensive gpu memory for fast reading and writing. meanwhile the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. to scale on host memory we introduce count counting offline unlocks n-gram transformers which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. we use the corpus frequencies to weight together the lm's own unembeddings of the next tokens most often following the current n-gram history. at a fixed compute budget count can be added as an additional input embedding for pretraining 1b-parameter lms to improve validation loss as much as an lm with 57% more compute. if gpu memory is limited using count to let backbone parameters fill gpu memory gives better performance than splitting memory with additional learned n-gram embeddings. beyond efficiency count allows switching in a different table of n-gram counts from a domain-specific corpus at inference time to adapt to a new task without any training.

count stores precomputed n-gram counts in host memory and uses those frequencies to combine the language model s output embeddings into additional input embeddings without a separately learned n-gram table. in 1b-parameter pretraining the authors report validation-loss gains comparable to spending 57% more estimated training compute on the baseline changing count tables also enables training-free domain adaptation. separating cheap stored statistics from active computation is relevant to memory-heavy recommendation designs but the reported gains are language-model results not ctr measurements.
count把预计算的n元词组计数放在主机内存 用频率加权语言模型的输出嵌入 构造额外输入嵌入 无需另学一张n元词组嵌入表。在10亿参数语言模型预训练中 作者报告的验证损失改善相当于基线多用57%估算训练计算量 替换计数表还能免训练适配领域。把低成本存储统计与实际计算分离 可为推荐的大容量记忆设计提供借鉴 但这些收益来自语言模型 未经ctr验证。

looped mixture-of-experts moe models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. to probe the contributions of different loop visits we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice observing a smaller scale in the first visit. fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. this asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. we propose latentloop which compresses the first visit's sequence retains full resolution in the second and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. we further learn how strongly the first visit updates the full sequence and share moe weights across visits while using separate attention parameters to accommodate their different sequence resolutions. across 15 configurations spanning 1.3b--7b parameters with the largest budget exceeding 1021 flops latentloop consistently lowers validation nll. at a fitted nll of 1.988 predicted compute savings are 19.0% and 7.9% relative to vanilla moe and the looped baseline. it also improves average scores on nine benchmarks at all sizes in 0-shot and 5-shot settings. these results suggest asymmetric compute allocation is a promising direction for looped moe models.

latentloop allocates unequal computation to two visits of a shared moe block the first uses a compressed sequence the second keeps full resolution and saved compute increases model width. it shares expert weights but separates attention parameters and learns writeback strength. across 15 configurations from 1.3b to 7b parameters validation nll improves fitted curves at nll 1.988 predict 19.0% and 7.9% less compute than vanilla and looped moe baselines. these are fitted language-model savings suggesting a budget-allocation hypothesis for recommendation rather than established ctr gains.
latentloop给共享moe模块的两次循环分配不同计算量 首次压缩序列 第二次保留完整分辨率 节省的计算用于加宽模型。专家权重共享 注意力参数分开 并学习写回强度。13亿至70亿参数的15组配置中 验证负对数似然改善 在拟合损失1.988处 相对普通moe和循环moe预测分别省19.0%和7.9%计算。这是语言模型拟合结果 可用于提出推荐计算分配的实验假设 尚非ctr收益。

sparse attention reduces the kv-cache traffic that dominates long-context llm decoding but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. token-level selection offers finer control yet presents two challenges low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. we introduce joint subspace sparse attention jssa to address both challenges. for selection quality jssa learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. we upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. for execution efficiency we develop a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel that supports distinct per-kv-head selections under the standard grouped-query attention gqa kv-cache layout. across standard gqa hybrid sliding-window/global attention and multi-head latent attention mla models jssa consistently remains close to full-kv accuracy while avoiding the substantial generation-length inflation and architecture-dependent failures observed with competing methods. on an nvidia b200 gpu jssa achieves up to 6.43× the decoding throughput of full-kv attention at 128k context. jssa achieves reasoning accuracy comparable to model-native dsa without model training and reaches 96--99% of its decoding throughput even at 700b scale large models.

jssa preserves query–key ranking information in a shared low-dimensional subspace and pairs token selection with an indexed-attention kernel that avoids gathering scattered cache entries. tests across several attention architectures retain accuracy close to full-cache attention on one nvidia b200 at 128k context with a 2 048-token kv budget reported decoding throughput reaches up to 6.43 times the full-cache baseline. the transferable lesson is to optimize selection quality and memory access together for long histories the experiments concern llm decoding and do not establish recommendation serving gains.
jssa在共享低维子空间中保留查询与键的排序信息 并用索引注意力内核直接读取所选令牌 避免先搬运零散缓存。多种注意力架构测试中 准确率接近完整缓存注意力 在单张nvidia b200、128k上下文、2 048令牌kv预算条件下 解码吞吐最高达到完整缓存基线的6.43倍。对长历史建模的借鉴是共同优化筛选质量与内存访问 实验针对语言模型解码 不能直接视为推荐服务收益。

large-scale expert parallelism ep has become the standard deployment configuration for mixture-of-experts moe models in production. meanwhile the highly dynamic nature of llm workloads requires providers to continuously adjust serving capacity to match fluctuating demand. scaling moe serving cannot be efficiently achieved by simply adding or removing serving instances instead it often requires resizing the ep group within an existing instance which we refer to as intra-instance scaling.existing inference engines primarily rely on instance-level scaling which destroys and reconstructs entire serving instances incurring substantial scaling overhead. we present fasteep fast elastic expert parallel a fast intra-instance scaling system for moe serving based on the principle of partial reuse. fasteep reuses existing runtime state across worker execution gpu memory and communication by separating reusable execution structures from the resources activated by the current ep configuration. this separation enables coordinated resource reclamation and reconfiguration while preserving costly-to-reconstruct state allowing fast ep scaling without full instance teardown and reconstruction. our evaluation shows that fasteep achieves 4.5x--11.7x faster scaling than the existing vllm-based approach across different models enabling efficient fine-grained scaling of moe serving.

fasteep resizes expert-parallel groups inside a running moe serving instance by separating reusable execution state from configuration-dependent resources. reusing worker gpu-memory and communication state avoids destroying and rebuilding the whole instance. across the tested models scaling operations are 4.5–11.7 times faster than a vllm-based approach. this is reconfiguration speed not token-generation throughput the design offers a systems reference for elastic sparse-model serving with recommendation-specific workloads still requiring validation.
fasteep在运行中的moe服务实例内调整专家并行组 把可复用执行状态与依赖当前配置的资源分开。复用工作进程、显存和通信状态 减少整实例销毁重建。所测模型中 扩缩容操作比基于vllm的方案快4.5至11.7倍。该数字衡量重配置速度 不是令牌生成吞吐 其状态复用设计可供弹性稀疏模型服务参考 推荐负载仍需单独验证。

linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. however storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes motivating low-bit state quantization. unlike weights and key--value caches a recurrent state is requantized after every update so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. this coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. to preserve these updates we intervene both before and at rounding. before rounding we propose low-rank bypass lrb which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. at rounding we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update and such reversals prove particularly harmful. therefore we propose bounded directional rounding bdr which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. although bdr enlarges the rounding error it improves the model suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. across gated deltanet gla mamba2 and retnet our training-free method substantially outperforms int4 while reducing state memory by up to 5.3× and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9× relative to fp32 states.

the paper targets low-bit recurrent-state quantization where repeated rounding can discard small updates and create correlated errors. a low-rank bypass accumulates these updates while bounded directional rounding prevents harmful update reversals without extra storage for that rounding rule. tests on gated deltanet gla mamba2 and retnet outperform int4 with up to 5.3-fold state-memory reduction and 1.9-fold decoding speedup versus fp32 states. preserving update direction is a useful hypothesis for compressed recommendation histories the evidence remains on the tested recurrent models.
论文处理低比特循环状态量化 反复舍入会丢失小更新 并产生跨步相关误差。低秩旁路先积累小更新 有界方向舍入则避免更新方向反转 后者本身无需额外存储。在gated deltanet、gla、mamba2和retnet上优于普通int4 相对fp32状态 状态内存最低约为fp32的1/5.3、解码最多加速1.9倍。保留更新方向可作为推荐历史压缩的实验思路 证据仍限于所测循环模型。

generative retrieval gr has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. however gr is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval dr in online retail candidate generation. we examine their differences on two amazon toys datasets under different metrics. gr leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover while dr leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. with deep analysis we find that popularity contributes the most to gr's measured value lead. adding the same static item value to dr in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above gr. finally on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with llm-judged relevance we show that a 14b sid-llm still underperforms a 47× smaller dense encoder.

this study compares generative and dense retrieval on two amazon toys datasets using exact-target recall best-item value among jointly covered users and value across the full ranked list. their ordering changes with the metric and adding the same static item-value prior to dense retrieval reverses the generative method s measured best-item-value lead. a separate internal e-commerce test uses llm-judged relevance. for recommendation scaling it motivates matching evaluation populations objectives and simple priors before attributing gains to larger generative models it does not prove universal dense-retrieval superiority.
研究在两套amazon toys数据上比较生成式与稠密检索 分别看精确目标召回、双方都覆盖用户中的最佳物品价值 以及完整列表价值。方法排序随指标改变 给稠密检索加入同一静态物品价值先验后 生成式方法原有的最佳物品价值优势被反转。另有内部电商测试采用语言模型判断相关性。对推荐扩展的启示是先对齐评估人群、目标和简单先验 再归因于生成模型规模 不能推广为稠密检索普遍更强。

a fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries and conventional evaluation on average recall masks these per-query disparities. we introduce qasp query-adaptive robust vector search policy which predicts the complete recall progression curve per query via a single upfront supervised regression from which a search policy is derived for any recall target this avoids iterative model invocations during search or separate predictors per target. by predicting normalized recall values with scale-invariant features and pre-search inference qasp generalizes across recall targets index configurations and datasets. the fine-grained progress predictions further enable a lightweight reactive complement that adjusts search depth based on predicted-versus-observed deviations without additional inference. we prove that qasp requires a finite training sample independent of dataset size and dimensionality that it matches or improves on the best fixed-policy loss up to a vanishing statistical error and that its data access savings over fixed probing grow exponentially in intrinsic dimensionality. experimentally qasp achieves significantly lower recall variance and deviation from target higher query satisfaction rate and scales to large data and hierarchical indices without retraining achieving 99% recall with 80% less data access. our implementation can be found at https //github.com/amazon-science/qasp.

qasp predicts each query s recall-progress curve with one upfront regression then derives search depth for different recall targets. a lightweight reactive step adjusts depth from observed deviations without invoking the predictor again. the authors report lower per-query recall variance and reduced data access including transfer across tested datasets and index configurations. this offers a way to allocate retrieval compute by query difficulty instead of a fixed search budget extrapolation to production recommendation traffic requires calibration and validation.
qasp用一次前置回归预测每个查询的召回进度曲线 再按不同召回目标确定搜索深度 轻量反馈步骤依据实际偏差调整深度 无需再次调用预测器。作者报告了更低的逐查询召回波动和数据访问量 并测试了跨数据集、跨索引配置迁移。其可借鉴点是按查询难度分配检索计算 而非统一搜索预算 迁移到生产推荐流量仍需校准和验证。

sequential user behavior modeling is widely adopted in industrial recommender systems however significant gaps remain in financial services where pre-login web interactions and authenticated in-app experiences differ drastically. specifically pre-login web users typically explore new products whereas logged-in app users focus on account servicing. due to the challenge of cross-channel entity resolution e.g. matching anonymous web sessions to authenticated mobile accounts web-based intent signals remain underutilized for post-authentication personalization. existing methods for capturing web-based intent are often ad-hoc and narrow lacking the flexibility to support both quantitative downstream recommendations and qualitative understanding at scale. in this work we propose a scalable and dual-purpose intent prediction framework for web-based interactions and demonstrate its applicability for personalization. our approach transforms raw web clickstreams into two outputs a self-supervised transformer encodes multi-modal clickstreams into a compact session embedding while an llm-based taxonomy generation and distillation pipeline produces interpretable intent labels. our system demonstrates that self-supervised clickstream representations combined with llm-distilled taxonomies can jointly serve quantitative tasks and qualitative understanding in production on the mobile homepage tile ranking task the session embedding improves macro recall@1 by 1.88% and reduces log loss by 13.38% over production baselines. on the user conversion prediction task the embedding outperforms the llm labels by 4.3% on micro f1 while the distillation layer delivers interpretable labels at ultra-low latency with only a 7% performance drop.

the framework turns web clickstreams into compact self-supervised transformer session embeddings and separately distills an llm-generated intent taxonomy into interpretable labels. in the reported mobile-homepage ranking task session embeddings improve macro recall@1 by 1.88% and reduce log loss by 13.38% against production baselines. the two outputs serve prediction and explanation under different latency constraints. for recommendation scaling the useful separation is dense behavioral representation versus inexpensive intent labeling cross-channel identity resolution and financial-services evaluation limit direct generalization.
该框架用自监督transformer把网页点击流编码为紧凑会话嵌入 另将语言模型生成的意图分类体系蒸馏为可解释标签。在所报告的移动首页排序任务中 会话嵌入相对生产基线提升1.88%的宏平均recall@1、降低13.38%的对数损失。两类输出分别服务预测和不同延迟要求下的解释。对推荐扩展的借鉴是分开建设行为表示与低成本意图标签 跨渠道身份关联和金融服务评估范围限制了直接推广。

looped language models looplms improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared transformer modules yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. existing post-training quantization ptq methods largely designed for feed-forward transformers fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics heterogeneous loop sensitivity and recursive error propagation leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. to address these challenges we propose loopquant a loop-aware ptq framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of looplms. loopquant is built on three core components 1 cross-loop distribution canonicalization cldc learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing 2 interaction-aware loop-wise precision allocation ilpa allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions and 3 loop-conditioned task calibration lctc further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. extensive experiments across looplm architectures demonstrate that loopquant consistently outperforms existing low-bit ptq methods. on ouro-2.6b loopquant under w4a4 surpasses all w4a8 baselines in performance while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive int4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over bf16. these results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy compression and inference efficiency providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit looplm inference. the code is available at https //github.com/kishon-zzx/loopquant .

loopquant adapts post-training quantization to repeated use of shared transformer blocks. it canonicalizes cross-loop activation distributions allocates activation precision by loop sensitivity and interactions and calibrates the resulting low-bit trajectory. on ouro-2.6b the authors report that w4a4 exceeds the tested w4a8 baselines and gives a 1.7-fold decoding speedup versus bf16. this provides a loop-aware compression recipe for parameter-sharing architectures the reported efficiency and accuracy do not establish gains for ctr models or other hardware configurations.
loopquant针对共享transformer模块被反复执行时的量化误差 统一跨循环激活分布 按各轮敏感度与相互作用分配激活精度 再校准低比特循环轨迹。在ouro-2.6b上 作者报告w4a4优于所测w4a8基线 解码速度为bf16的1.7倍。该方法可供共享参数架构的循环感知压缩参考 但未证明ctr模型或其他硬件配置下具有同样收益。

foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet but existing recipes face three obstacles variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling limited hyperparameter hp transfer across model sizes and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. we present \ours an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. one full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. we further introduce \mue an extension of maximal update parameterization \mup to \ours and other elastic architectures. its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously \mui and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells sweeps confirm that hps tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets \mbox\mut . a single \ours run produces sub-networks that outperform matformer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

shellelastic trains nested subnetworks inside one shared transformer by arranging hidden matrices as a dense core with block-lower-triangular shells. a full-width forward pass preserves each smaller network s exact hidden-state prefix enabling a fixed joint-training graph. its maximal-update extension supports simultaneous subnetwork updates and hyperparameter transfer with experiments comparing matformer fully elastic and separately trained models. this is relevant to producing recommendation models for multiple serving budgets without wholly separate pretraining runs recommendation-specific transfer remains untested.
shellelastic把共享transformer组织成密集核心与分块下三角外层 一次完整宽度前向计算即可保留各小子网的精确隐状态前缀 联合训练的计算图因此固定。其最大更新参数化扩展支持各子网同时学习与超参数迁移 并与matformer、全弹性模型和单独训练模型比较。该设计可为一次预训练产出多种服务预算的推荐模型提供参考 推荐场景迁移仍未验证。

hybrid language models interleave gated deltanet gdn layers whose recurrent memory has a fixed size with full-attention layers whose key-value kv cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. in this paper we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. we first show that which gdn heads of qwen3.8-27b keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. next we define the future utility of a kv entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations and find that the write gate decay and write magnitude that gdn layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. because the relation is spread across many gdn heads and layers and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one we propose gatesight which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. finally at serving time gatesight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded kv entries. experimental results on scbench and ruler-4096 with qwen3.8-27b and with the same recipe the sparse-attention model qwen3.8-flash-next up to the 262k-token limit of the models show that with a tenth of the attention kv cache gatesight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads kvzip on all four by 9.5 to 47.2 points. notably it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

gatesight learns per-head predictors from recurrent-layer write decay and magnitude signals to estimate the future usefulness of attention-cache entries before a query arrives. it scores once after prefill sets layer budgets using native attention gates and physically evicts discarded entries. on two qwen3.8 models with scbench and ruler-4096 retaining one tenth of the attention kv cache ranks first among five query-agnostic methods on three of four model–benchmark pairs. it suggests reusing recurrent signals for hybrid long-history memory allocation but requires learned predictors and is not a model-independent guarantee. transfer to recommendation is untested.

gatesight用循环层的写入、衰减和更新幅度信号训练逐头预测器 在查询到来前估计注意力缓存的未来用途。预填充后只评分一次 以模型原生注意力门控分配各层预算 并实际释放淘汰项。在两种qwen3.8模型的scbench和ruler-4096测试中 保留十分之一注意力kv缓存时 四组模型—基准组合中三组在五种查询无关方法中排名第一。其可借鉴点是用循环信号分配混合长历史记忆 但需要训练预测器 并非适用于任意模型的保证。向推荐任务迁移仍未验证。

linear-attention and state-space llms carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. unlike a weight tensor the state is rewritten at every step so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. int4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. the mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. the remainder is resolution-dependent and in our per-step setting every outlier-aware scheme we test loses to plain persistent scaling. allocating bits across layers does help but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. run out to 32k group-wise int4 is worth no more than discarding the state. contain the scale rather than locate outliers and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

this study separates numerical instability from information loss in quantized recurrent states. scale–state feedback can cause norm growth but controlling that scale alone recovers only part of lost performance finer resolution and long decoding horizons still matter. in the tested settings group-wise int4 at 32k decode performs no better than discarding the state and learned layer precision allocation reduces to protecting early layers under article-disjoint evaluation. the useful warning for compressed recommendation histories is to validate error accumulation over the intended horizon rather than certify a bit width from short recall tests. in the tested per-step quantization setting outlier-aware schemes underperform persistent scaling this comparison is specific to those schemes and that setting.

研究把循环状态量化的数值不稳定与信息损失分开检查 量化尺度和状态之间的反馈可能放大范数 但只控制尺度只能恢复部分损失 量化分辨率和持续解码长度仍重要。在所测设置中 分组int4持续解码到32k时不优于丢弃状态 按文章隔离评估后 学习得到的逐层精度分配退化为优先保护前几层。对推荐历史压缩的警示是按实际使用长度检查误差积累 不能只凭短序列召回测试认定某比特宽度可靠。 在所测逐步量化设置中 异常值感知方案不及固定尺度方案 这一比较限定于论文测试的方案和设置。
