recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. controllable multi-objective recommendation cmor enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining adapting to shifting user or system requirements. existing cmor approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. however its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. to address these issues we propose recsoup a lightweight two-stage approach for effective cmor via specialized model merging. recsoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. it then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. theoretically we prove that recsoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency as it can fully navigate the pareto front without smoothness constraints. extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that recsoup achieves improved pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. code is available at https //github.com/35798642/recsoup.git.

recsoup reuses objective-specific recommendation models to adjust serving-time trade-offs without joint retraining. it first prunes parameters using objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance then learns a mapping from desired preferences to merging coefficients. experiments report improved pareto-front quality and substantially lower parameter-construction latency than the evaluated parameter-generating approaches this comparison is not a general speedup over ordinary rankers. for multi-objective ctr systems it offers a model-reuse and deployment option rather than evidence of a recommendation scaling law.
recsoup复用针对不同目标训练的推荐模型 让线上目标权衡可以调整 而无需联合重训。它先结合各目标的参数重要性与跨目标相关性做剪枝 再学习从目标偏好到模型合并系数的映射。实验显示更好的帕累托前沿质量 并比所比较的参数生成方法构建参数更快 这不等于相对普通排序器普遍提速。对多目标ctr系统 可借鉴的是模型复用与部署方式 论文并未建立推荐扩展定律。

while large language models llms offer strong semantic representations their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. neural sparse retrievers such as splade provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. to bridge this gap we propose an llm-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. specifically we introduce a dynamic α-truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of splade representations. this strategy guides the llm to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations without relying on a fixed support budget. subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning knowledge distillation and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. experiments on ms marco and six selected beir datasets demonstrate improvements over splade++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against llm-based sparse retrievers. compared with lion-sp our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

this framework trains an llm-based sparse retriever using input-adaptive supervision from splade. a cumulative-activation threshold selects salient lexical supports for each input instead of imposing a fixed support count contrastive learning distillation and sparsity regularization then refine retrieval. on ms marco and six selected beir datasets the authors report a favorable effectiveness–efficiency trade-off against the evaluated sparse retrievers. the transferable idea for large retrieval stages is to adapt the sparsity budget to the input while measuring index size and end-to-end query cost the evidence concerns text retrieval not ctr prediction.
该框架用splade提供的稀疏表示监督大语言模型检索器 按每个输入的累计激活量选择重要词项 而不固定保留词项数量 再结合对比学习、蒸馏和稀疏正则训练。作者在ms marco及六个选定beir数据集上报告了效果与成本的较好权衡。大规模召回可借鉴按输入分配稀疏预算的做法 同时检查索引体积和端到端查询成本 现有证据来自文本检索 并非ctr预测。

reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. however additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. we propose aura a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. aura further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. on the reasoning-intensive bright benchmark aura-4b achieves 34.7 average ndcg@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. under matched deployment conditions adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. results on ms marco further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

aura supervises intermediate query-reasoning states by their ability to separate relevant documents from hard distractors then uses a lightweight utility estimator to decide when to stop reasoning. on bright the reported 4b model obtains 34.7 average ndcg@10 with 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. under matched deployment conditions adaptive stopping lowers latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. for retrieval and ranking pipelines the useful design principle is to allocate test-time computation according to predicted retrieval utility these results do not establish ctr gains.
aura直接监督查询推理的中间状态 看它们能否区分相关文档与难负例 再用轻量效用估计器决定何时停止推理。其4b模型在bright上取得34.7的平均ndcg@10 每个查询平均推理2.8步、生成96个令牌 在匹配的部署条件下 相对完整推理轨迹 延迟从4.6秒降至0.76秒。检索和排序可借鉴按预测检索效用分配推理计算的原则 但这些结果尚不能说明ctr收益。

key-value kv cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling large language models llms to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. while recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations they typically face a fundamental trade-off the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an np-hard combinatorial problem leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. in this work we propose dropkv a simple principled eviction framework based on decoupled residual-output perturbation. by decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring dropkv circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context llms. to ensure practical viability we provide a high-performance implementation using fused triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. extensive evaluations on the ruler and longbench benchmarks demonstrate that dropkv consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.

dropkv approximates the joint decision of which cached tokens to evict using independent scores based on residual-output perturbations. the approximation bound requires small attention weights and aligned value residuals within a candidate pool empirical checks cover three models not every layer head or query. fused triton kernels accelerate prefill scoring without materializing the complete attention matrix and ruler and longbench evaluations compare quality at equal cache budgets. for compressed recommendation histories the transferable idea is to score the effect of deletion on outputs and assess the implementation cost rather than rely only on attention weights direct ctr transfer remains untested.

dropkv把联合选择待删除缓存令牌的问题 近似为按残差输出扰动独立打分。近似界要求候选集合内被删除项的注意力权重较小、数值残差方向对齐 三个模型上的经验检查并不覆盖每个层、头和查询。融合triton内核在预填充打分时避免显式构造完整注意力矩阵 并在ruler和longbench上按相同缓存预算比较效果。推荐历史压缩可借鉴按删除行为对输出的影响打分 同时计入实现成本 直接用于ctr的收益仍未验证。

speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. hybrid linear attention hla models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. we introduce ready the first speculative decoding method to the best of our knowledge to leverage hla recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ready equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. a lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and i/o overhead low. building on dspark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head ready employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy with reader capacity state sources and residual placement examined through ablation studies. across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics code generation and dialogue ready achieves an average 3.16× decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with qwen3.8-27b on a single nvidia b200 gpu. it outperforms dspark on every benchmark improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. our code is available at https //github.com/startluxlabs/ready.

ready supplies a speculative drafter with position-specific context retrieved from the recurrent states of a hybrid linear-attention target model. learned queries and a lightweight residual state reader complement ordinary hidden features low-rank reads and fused operators limit additional i/o and computation. on seven benchmarks with qwen3.8-27b on one nvidia b200 the authors report higher throughput and more output tokens per verification round than pretrained dspark. this suggests reusing compressed recurrent memory as an active information source for generation not just a passive cache it assumes access to suitable hybrid-model states and does not demonstrate recommendation gains.
ready让推测解码的草稿模型按预测位置 从混合线性注意力模型的循环状态中读取额外上下文。它用可学习查询和轻量残差读取器补充普通隐藏特征 并以低秩读取和融合算子控制额外计算与i/o。在单张nvidia b200上运行qwen3.8-27b的七项测试中 作者报告其吞吐量与每轮验证输出的令牌数均优于预训练dspark。可借鉴的是主动复用压缩循环记忆 但需要可读取的混合模型状态 尚无推荐收益证据。

optimal hyperparameter scaling laws describe how the best hyperparameters for large language model llm training change with model and data scale enabling practitioners to predict optimal configurations at production scales without expensive large-scale tuning. however estimating these scaling laws conventionally requires exhaustive grid searches over thousands of training runs consuming enormous computational resources. we introduce power-law entropy search ples a computational cost-aware acquisition function built on multi-fidelity bayesian optimization that efficiently estimates optimal hyperparameter scaling laws through adaptive experimentation. a key innovation in ples is that it searches for candidates that reduce the overall uncertainty of a scaling law estimate instead of optimizing a single objective function. at each iteration ples selects the candidate configuration that maximally reduces the uncertainty of the scaling law estimates per unit computational cost naturally favoring informative small-scale experiments. we evaluate ples on synthetic benchmarks surrogate models fitted to real llm training data and actual llm pre-training runs. across all settings ples converges to accurate optimal hyperparameter scaling laws using less than one-tenth of the computational budget required by conventional grid search and other baselines.

power-law entropy search chooses training configurations to maximize cost-adjusted uncertainty reduction about optimal-hyperparameter scaling laws. its cost-aware multi-fidelity bayesian optimization targets the law itself rather than the best score at one fixed scale allowing informative small runs to guide larger configurations. the authors evaluate synthetic tasks fitted training-data surrogates and actual llm pretraining reporting substantially lower search budgets than the compared grid-search and other baselines. compute is represented by a parameter-count–token-count proxy. the relevant idea for ctr scaling studies is experimental allocation across scales the assumed law family and cost model still require validation for recommendation workloads.

power-law entropy search按成本调整后的扩展规律不确定性降幅 选择下一组训练配置。它用考虑成本的多保真贝叶斯优化 直接学习最优超参数如何随规模变化 使有信息量的小实验帮助决定更大规模配置。作者在合成任务、训练数据拟合代理和实际语言模型预训练中 报告相对所比较网格搜索及其他基线更低的搜索预算。计算成本以参数量乘训练令牌量为代理。ctr扩展研究可借鉴跨规模实验分配 但规律形式与成本模型仍须在推荐任务上验证。

gated attention is an effective approach to mitigate attention sinks and enhance the representational capacity of attention. to further extend its effectiveness-efficiency pareto frontier we propose a hybrid gated attention hyga framework that contains three types of gating strategies. specifically these gates leverage diverse information from multiple stages of attention and collaboratively build element-wise/head-wise gating from multiple perspectives capturing intra-head and cross-head information interactions. through our hybrid gating components hyga could provide multi-source modulation signals enabling more comprehensive control over information flow and improving the representational capacity of attention. we also introduce low-rank matrix decomposition and learnable attention sink to further enhance training efficiency and stability. in experiments we evaluate hyga on widely-used benchmarks based on different backbones. the experimental results show that our hyga comprehensively improves both training loss and various downstream performances compared with gated attention. hyga has also been verified to achieve the best performance at different computation costs with comprehensive model analyses for better understanding. the proposed hyga sheds light on a more effective efficient and stable attention mechanism.

hybrid gated attention combines three gating strategies using signals from multiple attention stages with element-wise and head-wise modulation of intra-head and cross-head information. low-rank decomposition and a learnable attention sink are added to improve training efficiency and stability. across the evaluated backbones and computation budgets the authors report lower training loss and better downstream results than gated-attention baselines. for scalable ranking transformers the relevant hypothesis is that richer but inexpensive gates can regulate information flow those recommendation benefits have not been directly tested and this is not a linear-time attention replacement.

hybrid gated attention结合三种门控 从注意力的不同阶段获取调节信号 在元素与注意力头层面控制头内、头间信息。低秩分解和可学习的注意力汇 attention sink 用于改善训练效率与稳定性。作者在所测骨干模型和计算预算下 报告了相对门控注意力基线更低的训练损失和更好的下游表现。可扩展排序transformer可考虑低成本多来源门控这一设想 但推荐收益尚未直接验证 它也不是线性复杂度注意力替代方案。

large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. these applications demand the user dimension of llm intelligence inferring a person's preferences intent and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. real-world behavior records already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents offer a natural supervisory signal. we propose user behavior as supervision and introduce vela a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. from the anonymized behavior records of 100 000 users vela generates 100 000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75 000 tasks with selected training trajectories. fine-tuning qwen3.6-35b-a3b on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. these gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of llms.

vela converts anonymized user-behavior records into supervised tasks and training trajectories combining task templates difficulty filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria. fine-tuning a qwen3.6-35b-a3b model improves the evaluated user-related tasks and general benchmarks and the authors report further gains when increasing behavior-training data and adding reinforcement learning. for recommendation research the relevant contribution is a reusable way to turn long-term behavior into user-modeling supervision. its evidence concerns language-model task evaluations not industrial ctr lift or a fitted recommendation scaling law so broader transfer remains to be tested.
vela将匿名用户行为记录转成监督任务与训练轨迹 结合任务模板、难度筛选和轨迹接受条件构造训练数据。微调qwen3.6-35b-a3b后 所测用户相关任务和通用基准有所改善 作者还报告增加行为训练数据及后续强化学习的收益。推荐研究可借鉴的是把长期行为转成用户建模监督的流程。证据来自语言模型任务评估 不能视为工业ctr提升或已拟合的推荐扩展定律 更广泛的迁移仍需验证。

mixture-of-experts moe models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. modern moe architectures increasingly combine two design choices fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. the former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. we identify an exploration dilemma between these designs shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. this conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. consequently the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. mirrormoe is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. mirrormoe consistently improves performance across model scales.

mirrormoe addresses a tension between shared experts and fine-grained routing shared experts can weaken the representation changes needed to distinguish alternative routes. it mixes routing distributions from original and negated logits for expert selection but retains original probabilities for aggregation adaptively suppressing some selected experts. across four language-model scales it improves perplexity and average downstream accuracy. the activated-expert count stays fixed and gains without shared experts are limited. ctr engineering inference inspect effective expert contributions before enlarging a shared-expert ranking model and test routing changes under matched compute. the paper reports language-model experiments not ctr experiments.

mirrormoe 指出 共享专家可能削弱不同路由带来的表示差异 使细粒度专家组合难以充分探索。它结合原始及取反 logits 产生的路由分布选择专家 再用原始概率聚合 自适应压低部分已选专家的实际贡献。四种语言模型规模的困惑度和下游平均准确率均有改善 实际激活专家数仍固定 无共享专家时收益有限。对 ctr 的工程启发是 扩充共享专家排序模型前 先检查专家的有效贡献 并在匹配计算量下验证路由改动。本文没有 ctr 实验。

reducing memory use in large language model llm training is an ongoing challenge. activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation while lossy compression changes the stored activations. the reemergence of sparse \relu and \relu2 activations creates a third opportunity losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. we present bitsparse a gpu-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. compression and reconstruction run in custom triton kernels fused into an autograd function shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. bfloat16 bf16 and fp8 activations are supported. optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. we analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. bitsparse lowers per-token vram by 31% and 30% modded-nanogpt and nemotron-h respectively with overheads of no more than 1% at practical sequence lengths. additionally a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.

bitsparse losslessly compresses sparse relu-family activation caches in their chosen bf16 or fp8 storage format using tile bitmasks compact values and fused triton kernels. a preallocated shared buffer avoids host synchronization for variable-size storage. reported roughly 30% per-token memory reductions come from forward/backward benchmarks without retained optimizer or full-model gradient buffers a separate nanogpt training run preserves validation loss closely. benefits depend on exact zeros and target feed-forward activations not attention or mamba states. ctr engineering inference profile exact-zero sparsity in ranking mlps before testing activation-cache compression against checkpointing. no ctr experiments are reported.

bitsparse 用分块位图、紧凑数值和融合 triton 内核 无损压缩所选 bf16 或 fp8 存储格式中的 relu 系列激活缓存 预分配共享缓冲区避免变长存储导致的主机同步。约 30% 的每 token 显存降幅来自不保留优化器状态和全模型梯度缓冲区的前后向基准 另一次 nanogpt 完整训练的验证损失几乎不变。收益依赖精确零值 仅覆盖前馈激活 不覆盖注意力或 mamba 状态。对 ctr 的工程启发是先测量排序 mlp 的精确零值比例 再比较激活缓存压缩与重计算。本文没有 ctr 实验。

multilingual models share capacity across languages so adding languages can hurt performance on existing ones. mixture-of-experts models expand this capacity with little additional per-token computation. given this extra capacity does adding experts reduce what each additional language costs to answer this question we propose a repetition-aware joint scaling law relating number of active parameters training tokens per language number of experts and language coverage. fitted on 26 300 per-language loss observations from 64 pretrained configurations our law reduces prediction error on held-out configurations by 28% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. at matched number of active parameters and training tokens per language 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared with a dense model. our law further shows that broader language coverage favors more experts across a wider range of compute budgets guiding capacity allocation as multilingual models scale.

this study fits a repetition-aware scaling law linking active parameters per-language training tokens expert count and language coverage. across controlled multilingual pretraining configurations extra experts reduce the penalty of broader coverage when active capacity and tokens per language are matched. broader coverage also shifts the modeled capacity allocation toward experts yet preserving average quality can still leave individual languages worse off. conclusions are bounded by the studied top-1 architecture and training regime logical compute excludes hardware overheads. ctr engineering inference allocate capacity across traffic domains while checking slice-level regressions and data repetition. these are multilingual language-model results not ctr experiments.

研究建立了考虑数据重复的扩展定律 将激活参数量、每种语言的训练 token 数、专家数和语言覆盖范围联系起来。在匹配激活容量及每语言训练量的受控预训练中 增加专家能缓解扩大语言覆盖造成的损失 模型推算的容量分配也更偏向专家。但恢复平均质量并不保证每种语言都不退步。结论受所测 top-1 架构和训练配置限制 逻辑计算量不包含硬件开销。对 ctr 的工程启发是 跨流量域分配容量时 同时检查分域退步和数据重复。本文是多语言建模研究 没有 ctr 实验。

hybrid large language models interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce the cost of long-context inference. this structure complicates prefix caching full-attention key-value caches are token-addressable whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. existing hybrid prefix caching methods address this mismatch by storing recurrent-state checkpoints. as a result token-level matches are directly usable only at positions aligned with stored checkpoints constraining prefix reuse to a discrete set of boundaries. we present tail-replay a prefix caching mechanism that enables unconstrained token-level prefix reuse in hybrid large language models. the key insight is that linear-attention mechanisms such as gated deltanet can be viewed as a structured lossy compression of the input prefix gated recurrent updates progressively attenuate the contributions of earlier inputs. consequently the recurrent state of a matched prefix can be well approximated by replaying only a short recent suffix of that prefix. tail-replay exploits this property by caching the exact full-attention key-value cache while omitting recurrent-state checkpoints. on a cache hit it reconstructs the linear-attention states by replaying a short recent suffix of the matched prefix. as a result the reuse boundary is determined by the shared tokens rather than by recurrent-state checkpoints. we evaluate tail-replay on three gated deltanet-based hybrid models using the longbench and ruler benchmarks. with only a 5--10% replay budget it retains 92.8--99.9% of full-prefill quality on longbench and ruler. for serving efficiency we evaluate time-to-first-token speedups across multiple matched-prefix lengths---8k 16k and 32k. the speedup grows with prefix length reaching 9.1--14.3× over full prefill at 32k.

tail-replay enables prefix reuse at arbitrary matched-token boundaries in hybrid full/linear-attention language models. it caches exact full-attention kv and output hidden states then replays a recent suffix from zero-initialized recurrent states instead of keeping recurrent checkpoints. on three gated deltanet-based models replaying 5–10% of a matched prefix preserves most benchmark-average quality on longbench and ruler and reduces first-token latency on tested long shared prefixes. reconstruction is approximate and quality retention varies by model and task. ctr engineering inference distinguish exact reusable sequence features from approximate state recovery then measure latency and slice-level quality together. no ctr experiments are reported.

tail-replay 让全注意力与线性注意力混合语言模型可在任意已匹配 token 边界复用前缀。它缓存精确的全注意力 kv 及输出隐藏状态 再从零初始化递归状态、回放最近一段前缀 省去递归状态检查点。在三种基于 gated deltanet 的模型上 回放前缀的 5–10% 保留了 longbench 和 ruler 的大部分基准平均质量 并降低所测长共享前缀的首 token 延迟。状态恢复是近似的 质量保留率随模型和任务变化。对 ctr 的工程启发是区分精确序列特征复用与近似状态恢复 同时验证延迟和分域质量。本文没有 ctr 实验。

looped transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same transformer layers. however generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights leading to high decoding latency. recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. we introduce \method a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. a lightweight lookahead drafter lad predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. loopahead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

loopahead accelerates looped language models with a trained lightweight drafter that proposes multiple future tokens from early-loop states. intermediate-loop feedback suspends or resumes speculative branches while full-depth verification retains final acceptance authority and preserves the target distribution. experiments cover ouro and raven models the maximum 7.82× autoregressive-decoding speedup is raven-tinyllama on humaneval under greedy decoding with one request per a40 gpu. drafters and scheduling require model-specific adaptation and concurrent-serving gains remain untested. ctr engineering inference use cheap intermediate signals to budget speculative computation while retaining final-model verification in suitable generative ranking pipelines. no ctr experiments are reported.

loopahead 为循环语言模型训练轻量草稿器 利用早期循环状态一次提出多个未来 token 中间循环反馈控制推测分支暂停或恢复 最终仍由完整深度模型验证 保持目标输出分布。实验覆盖 ouro 和 raven 最高 7.82 倍自回归解码加速来自 raven-tinyllama 的 humaneval 贪心解码 条件为每张 a40 gpu 一个请求。草稿器和调度需按模型适配 并发服务收益尚未验证。对 ctr 的工程启发是 在合适的生成式排序流程中 用低成本中间信号分配推测计算预算 同时保留最终模型验证。本文没有 ctr 实验。

multi-head latent attention mla compresses the content of a key-value cache into a shared latent per token making low-bit storage attractive for long-context inference. at two bits errors in this representation perturb both attention matching and value readout with effects that depend on error direction and reconstruction scale. we introduce rolaq rotation-calibrated latent quantization an offline method for joint rotation and range calibration. rolaq refines a shared rotation within subspaces defined by the frozen key and value projections and jointly learns quantization ranges whose thresholds and reconstruction gains are coupled to control the shared signal's response. prediction matching and attention-output supervision guide calibration with model weights frozen. across three mla models and six benchmarks rolaq achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared 2-bit methods both without and with token protection. on deepseek-v2-lite an sglang implementation provides 3.96 times the bf16 kv capacity under the same memory budget and 2.51 times its decode throughput with 256k input tokens.

rolaq jointly calibrates rotations and quantization ranges for the shared content latent in multi-head latent attention using frozen key/value projections and teacher predictions plus attention outputs. it achieves the highest six-benchmark average among compared 2-bit methods across three mla models. only content latents are quantized positional keys remain bf16 with optional protected tokens. deepseek-v2-lite serving tests improve long-context capacity and throughput but short-context overhead can outweigh savings and measurements cover one a100 setup. ctr engineering inference calibrate compressed shared representations against every downstream consumer and benchmark realistic sequence lengths. the paper evaluates language models not ctr experiments.

rolaq 利用冻结的 key/value 投影 以及教师预测和注意力输出 联合校准多头潜在注意力共享内容表示的旋转与量化范围。在三种 mla 模型中 它取得所比较 2-bit 方法里最高的六项基准平均分。量化仅针对内容表示 位置 key 仍为 bf16 也可保护部分 token。deepseek-v2-lite 服务实验提升了长上下文容量与吞吐 但短上下文的量化开销可能抵消收益 服务测试仅覆盖一种 a100 配置。对 ctr 的工程启发是 共享表示压缩应同时校准所有下游用途 并按实际序列长度测试。本文评估语言模型 没有 ctr 实验。

soft spectral clipping ssc reduces gradient singular values but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold. we introduce cast clipping with adaptive scales and thresholds a history-adaptive extension of ssc. adamw's previous second moment sets row and column scales. an exponential moving average of the clipped output's estimated spectral norm sets each matrix's threshold. cast restores the original coordinates before the adamw update. we train a mixture-of-experts moe model with 19.08b total parameters for 83.89b tokens. cast achieves lower training and mean validation losses than nine gradient-processing baselines with the fewest relative gradient spikes. it reaches the best baseline's final smoothed training loss in 7.2% fewer steps.

cast adapts soft spectral clipping before adamw using two histories the previous second moment sets row/column scales and an exponential moving average of the clipped spectral norm sets each matrix s threshold. it restores original coordinates before the optimizer update. in a single-seed moe pretraining comparison cast lowers training and mean validation losses against nine gradient-processing baselines and reaches the best baseline s final smoothed loss in fewer steps. extra per-step work and hardware-dependent costs remain. ctr engineering inference test history-adaptive gradient processing for unstable large-model training reporting loss-versus-time alongside spike counts. this paper contains no ctr experiments.

cast 在 adamw 更新前自适应执行软谱裁剪 用上一轮二阶矩确定梯度矩阵的行列尺度 用裁剪后谱范数的指数移动平均确定各矩阵阈值 再恢复原坐标后更新优化器。单种子 moe 预训练对比中 其训练损失和平均验证损失低于九种梯度处理基线 并用更少步数达到最佳基线的最终平滑损失 但每步有额外开销 实际成本依赖硬件。对 ctr 的工程启发是测试基于历史的梯度处理能否改善大模型训练稳定性 同时报告损失随时间的变化与梯度尖峰数。本文没有 ctr 实验。

large language models impose substantial memory demands and arithmetic costs during inference. dense-to-mixture-of-experts moe conversion is a model optimization technique that aims to reduce these arithmetic costs. dense-to-moe conversion partitions pretrained feed-forward network ffn neurons into experts and selects a subset for each token. leading methods fall into two categories analytic methods produce a converted model quickly using heuristics while learning methods produce a model much more slowly by optimizing via gradients. both approaches however fix the same active expert count or utilization at every layer. we introduce spectral-moe which learns to allocate a utilization budget heterogeneously across layers. its name draws a metaphor between separating a dense ffn into experts and separating a light beam into its spectrum. spectral-moe consists of two distinct approaches a static approach that uses a single per-layer scalar which is shared across tokens and a dynamic approach which emits a per-token schedule. we demonstrate that both allocators improve performance over uniform on both the analytic-based and learning-based sota dense-to-moe methods. at 25% ffn utilization dynamic allocation reduces wikitext-2 perplexity relative to uniform by 1.04 2.96 and 2.71 points on the learned base for llama-2-7b llama-3-8b and qwen2.5-7b respectively. the corresponding reductions on the analytic base are 2.45 6.26 and 2.17 points. on the learned base dynamic allocation improves six-task mean accuracy over uniform by an average of 1.5 4.2 and 3.6 percentage points across the three models at ffn utilizations of 12.5% 25% and 50% respectively. these results establish per-layer expert utilization as a novel optimization axis in dense-to-moe conversion.

spectral-moe learns unequal expert-activation allocations across layers when converting dense language models into moes. a static allocator shares one layer schedule across tokens a dynamic allocator revises each token s remaining schedule from intermediate states while conserving its total expert budget. across three models and analytic/learned conversion bases heterogeneous allocation improves perplexity with dynamic allocation also improving average task accuracy. serving speedups are not measured and the authors learned-base reproduction underperforms its published baseline. ctr engineering inference test layer-sensitive compute allocation under fixed activation budgets then verify real serving costs. no ctr experiments are reported.

spectral-moe 在稠密语言模型转换为 moe 时 学习跨层不均匀的专家激活分配。静态方案为所有 token 共用一套分层计划 动态方案根据中间状态修订各 token 后续层的计划 同时保持每个 token 的总专家预算不变。在三种模型、解析式与学习式转换基础上 异构分配改善了困惑度 动态方案也提高了任务平均准确率。论文未测量实际服务加速 作者复现的学习式基线低于原论文成绩。对 ctr 的工程启发是在固定激活预算下测试按层分配计算 再验证实际服务成本。本文没有 ctr 实验。

mixture-of-experts moe models scale model capacity efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts for each input while still requiring all parameters to be stored in memory resulting in substantial memory overhead. expert merging techniques have recently emerged as a promising compression paradigm that reduces this overhead by consolidating multiple experts into a smaller set. however existing approaches have two key limitations i direct convex interpolation in parameter space is not generally guaranteed to yield meaningful interpolation of expert functions and ii estimating expert similarity or merging coefficients often relies on calibration data introducing dependence on the calibration distribution. to address these limitations we propose spectrum-aware latent expert merging slem a calibration-free expert merging framework that occurs in a structured latent representation of expert weights using a vae. slem groups experts within and across layers based on latent similarities and derives merging coefficients from expert weight spectra. it then performs geometry-aware latent interpolation and decodes the resulting representations into merged expert weights. compared with existing expert merging methods slem achieves comparable or better performance on general knowledge benchmarks and higher average performance on generation benchmarks involving mathematical reasoning and code generation.

slem compresses moe expert storage by training a variational autoencoder on expert weights pairing experts through latent similarity and merging them within or across layers using spectrum-derived coefficients and latent interpolation. it needs no input calibration dataset but does require vae training and model-dependent rank choices. tests on three language models show competitive knowledge-task results and stronger average math/code generation than compared merging methods higher compression still loses quality versus uncompressed models. ctr engineering inference evaluate weight-only expert consolidation when calibration traffic is unavailable including compression preparation cost and slice-level regression checks. no ctr experiments are reported.

slem 在专家权重上训练变分自编码器 按潜在表示相似度将专家配对 再结合权重谱确定的系数与潜在空间插值 在层内或跨层合并专家以减少存储。它不需要输入校准数据 但仍需训练 vae 并选择与模型相关的谱秩。在三种语言模型中 知识任务表现具有竞争力 数学与代码生成的平均表现优于所比较合并方法 较高压缩率下仍不及未压缩模型。对 ctr 的工程启发是在缺少校准流量时评估仅依赖权重的专家合并 同时计入压缩准备成本并检查分域退步。本文没有 ctr 实验。

distributed training of sparsely activated mixture-of-experts moe models is often bottlenecked by workload imbalance and all-to-all a2a communication induced by dynamic token routing. existing token deduplication expert placement and replication techniques alleviate these bottlenecks but do not jointly capture their distinct load semantics. under hierarchical token deduplication communication counts each token once per destination group at each hierarchy level whereas expert computation processes every token-expert assignment. with replication both costs depend jointly on physical layout and token-to-copy mapping making separate optimization suboptimal. we present placemoe to address this coupling. first we formulate the joint optimization of expert layout and source-aware token-to-copy mapping for e experts distributed across p devices accounting for both hierarchical communication traffic and expert-compute load. second we develop a solver that combines co-selection-aware expert grouping bounded dynamic programming for replica allocation and alternating refinement of layout and mapping. third placemoe overlaps replica-gradient synchronization with attention backward. we evaluate placemoe on a 32-gpu cluster and a 64-npu cluster using qwen3-vl and deepseek-v3. experimental results show that placemoe achieves up to a 6.94x speedup in a2a communication and 1.74-2.33x speedups in end-to-end training over the state-of-the-art training framework veomni.

placemoe jointly plans expert replicas physical placement and source-aware token-to-copy dispatch distinguishing deduplicated communication from token–expert compute load. it also overlaps replica-gradient synchronization with attention backpropagation. gpu/npu-cluster tests show faster steady-state training than the evaluated systems on qwen3-vl and a six-moe-layer deepseek-v3 configuration. initial profiling calibration and planning are excluded from headline step timings and extra replicas consume memory. ctr engineering inference co-optimize placement and dispatch for distributed expert rankers using topology-calibrated costs then include planning amortization and replica memory in end-to-end comparisons. these are language/multimodal-model systems experiments not ctr experiments.

placemoe 联合规划专家副本、物理放置和按 token 来源选择副本的派发映射 分别建模去重后的通信量与 token–专家分配产生的计算量 并将副本梯度同步与注意力反向计算重叠。在 gpu/npu 集群上 qwen3-vl 及仅保留六个 moe 层的 deepseek-v3 配置 其稳态训练速度优于所比较系统。主要单步计时不包含初始采样、校准和规划 额外副本也占用显存。对 ctr 的工程启发是依据拓扑校准的成本联合优化分布式专家排序器的放置与派发 并计入规划摊销和副本内存。本文没有 ctr 实验。

scaling laws predict large-model performance from small experiments but finding a reliable law itself requires costly experiments. sldbench tests whether language-model agents can discover scaling laws when all experimental results are given upfront. we introduce sldbench v2 with two extensions. first we expand the corpus from 8 to 127 scenarios spanning language-model pretraining downstream performance and vision-language transfer and select 30 challenging scenarios on which a reference power-law fit reaches r2 \le 0.8 they represent at least 1.09 × 1023 flops of source-reported training compute. second we introduce active scaling law discovery an agent chooses which experiments to run pays each one's recorded cost e.g. training flops and revises its law as outcomes arrive and is scored on the same hidden extrapolation targets as in the passive setting. across 8 frontier agent systems median r2 drops from 0.72-0.75 passive to 0.24-0.57 active and prediction error rises 1.5-4.7 times depending on the system. agents favor cheap experiments spending 8-44% of the full-pool cost on average low-cost acquisition can yield strong predictions but cheap purchases also leave experimental conditions needed for extrapolation unobserved. experimental planning thus remains a key open challenge for agents that assist model development in the prevailing ai-for-ai study.

sldbench v2 tests experimental planning for scaling-law discovery through historical replay agents buy recorded experiments revise fitted laws and predict hidden larger-scale outcomes. across eight agent systems on 30 screened scenarios active acquisition produces worse extrapolation than receiving all observations upfront favoring cheap experiments can miss informative scale variation. costs and prediction quality are reported separately and prices include estimates/proxies rather than uniformly measured compute. ctr engineering inference replay existing training sweeps to evaluate acquisition policies before funding new runs preserving held-out scales and within-domain coverage. this is an empirical methodology benchmark not a new architecture or ctr result.

sldbench v2 通过历史实验回放评估扩展定律的实验规划 代理付费获取已记录实验的结果 修订拟合规律 再预测隐藏的大规模结果。在筛选出的 30 个场景、八种代理系统中 主动选购数据的外推表现低于预先获得全部观测 偏好便宜实验可能遗漏关键的规模变化。成本与预测质量分开报告 价格含估算和代理指标 并非统一实测计算量。对 ctr 的工程启发是先用历史训练扫描回放评估实验选择策略 再投入新训练 并保留隐藏测试规模和域内覆盖。这是实证方法基准 不是新架构 也没有 ctr 结果。

memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of llm training while preserving optimization performance. previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. to overcome this limitation we adopt a residual correction framework which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. we first integrate this scheme into momentum sgd to develop smrc which attains an $o t^ -1/4 $ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis matching that of full-space momentum sgd. our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. furthermore we extend smrc to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases to track the evolving dominant subspace and retains the same rate. since each basis refresh breaks the consistency of the virtual iterates we devise a boundary correction approach that aligns them across stages. beyond momentum sgd we incorporate our framework into muon and propose pmrc which applies the matrix sign to the projected momentum. through a weighted momentum tracking analysis that accounts for the residual gradient we establish an $o t^ -1/4 $ convergence rate for pmrc which matches the rate of full-space muon. we also design a multi-stage pmrc with periodically refreshed bases which maintains a convergence rate of the same order. extensive experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms.

low-rank optimizer states save memory but noisy gradients can make the retained subspace miss useful update directions. smrc for momentum sgd and pmrc for muon keep states in the subspace and add the orthogonal residual gradient back to the update. the paper proves an o t^ -1/4 convergence rate matching the corresponding full-space methods including variants that periodically refresh the basis and reports experiments supporting effectiveness and efficiency. the abstract provides no quantitative memory or speed gains benefits for ctr training remain unverified.
低秩优化器状态可以节省内存 但梯度噪声可能使保留的子空间遗漏有用的更新方向。smrc 和 pmrc 分别面向动量 sgd 与 muon 将优化器状态留在子空间内 并在参数更新时补回正交残差梯度。论文证明其收敛率达到 o t^ -1/4 与对应全空间方法同阶 周期刷新子空间基的变体也保留这一收敛阶 并报告实验支持其有效性与效率。摘要未给出具体内存或速度收益 ctr 训练中的效果仍待验证。

meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising nvidia gpus amd gpus and proprietary mtia accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. however the extensive history of nvidia-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. this paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators using amd instinct mi350x versus nvidia b200 for recommendation model training as a case study. we propose three reusable principles. first hardware-model co-design is essential rather than directly porting models from nvidia gpus revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths e.g. mi350x's 1.6x hbm capacity relative to b200 . second our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models drastically simplifying tuning. third increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the cuda ecosystem we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. compared to the directly ported baseline these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. to our knowledge this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing amd gpus for large-scale training. our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source pytorch triton and rocm ecosystems.

porting recommendation training from nvidia gpus to amd hardware leaves performance on the table when model structures and software remain unchanged. using mi350x and b200 as a case study the paper combines hardware-model co-design analytical kernel selection without warmup and agent-assisted kernel optimization and shim generation. relative to a directly ported baseline the combined methods improve end-to-end training throughput by up to 1.5x. this is a production recommendation-training result under the evaluated hardware and models not a universal amd-over-nvidia speedup.

推荐模型训练从 nvidia gpu 迁移到 amd 时 沿用原有模型结构和软件方案可能无法发挥新硬件的能力。本文以 mi350x 与 b200 为案例 结合硬件与模型协同设计、无需预热的解析式内核选择 以及代理辅助的内核优化和兼容层生成。相较直接移植的基线 这些方法共同使端到端训练吞吐最高提升至 1.5 倍。该结果限定于所评估的生产推荐模型及硬件配置 不能解读为 amd 对 nvidia 的普遍性能优势。

disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search anns supports retrieval-augmented generation rag search recommendation and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. existing anns research often focuses on vector search at small top-k whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that at large k content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval. we present constore a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. speculative inline content prefetch sicp commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based anns as progressive ssd i/o that refines an in-flight candidate queue. it prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded i/o budget overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-k results. co-retrieval-pattern-aware grouping rpag uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. workload-adaptive segment reorganization wasr adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. group content fetch gcf exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched page-aware i/o requests. sicp works independently of the content layout while rpag and gcf reduce fetch cost even without prefetching. across three multi-hop qa workloads with k from 10 to 1600 constore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on diskann and 25% on spann. separate experiments on 100m- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate sicp's applicability at larger scales.

at large retrieval depth loading the content behind vector-search results can cost as much as the search itself. constore overlaps bounded speculative content prefetch with disk-based anns groups frequently co-retrieved documents adapts the layout to workload changes and batches page-aware reads. across three multi-hop qa workloads with k from 10 to 1600 it reduces end-to-end retrieval latency by up to 48% on diskann and 25% on spann versus the best per-document-read baseline. separate 100m- and billion-vector experiments test prefetch scalability. these are retrieval-system results not measured ctr improvements.

当召回数量较大时 向量搜索后读取对应内容的耗时可能与搜索本身相当。constore 将有预算约束的推测式内容预取与磁盘近邻搜索重叠执行 集中存放经常被共同召回的文档 随负载变化调整布局 并批量合并按页读取。在三个多跳问答负载、k 为 10 至 1600 的测试中 相较最佳逐文档读取基线 diskann 和 spann 的端到端召回延迟分别最多降低 48% 和 25% 另以一亿及十亿向量索引验证预取的扩展性。这些是检索系统指标 不是 ctr 提升。

a recommendation request on reddit draws several replies each naming different titles. when an llm recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning rl which replies should a generated list be rewarded against the state-of-the-art recipe rank-grpo picks one reply per training example so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn 85% of its variance rather than how good the list is. we argue that rl should train on the request not on each answer and propose remark it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. this makes rl cheaper. on seven backbones and three datasets remark reaches the validation recall of 2 000 per-reply rl steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget trained until neither improves it is never significantly behind rank-grpo and in four of seven pairs reaches rank-grpo's best with fewer gpu-hours. the same reward helps on protoqa where about 100 people answer each question which points to a simple rule for rl with several valid human answers reward them jointly.

when a recommendation request has several valid human replies rewarding each generated list against one sampled reply adds responder noise. remark instead scores the list against the union of titles across replies and samples requests uniformly. across seven backbones and three datasets it reaches the validation recall of 2000 per-reply rl steps in 25–53% of those steps. in longer runs it is never significantly behind rank-grpo but only four of seven pairs reach that baseline's best result with fewer gpu-hours. the evidence concerns llm recommendation training not online ctr gains.

一个推荐请求往往有多个人工回答 若每次只随机选一个回答评价生成列表 奖励会混入回答者差异造成的噪声。remark 按请求均匀采样 并以所有回答中的物品名称并集统一评分。在七个基座模型、三个数据集上 达到按回答训练基线 2000 步时的验证召回水平 仅需其 25–53% 的步数。更长训练中 其结果没有显著落后于 rank-grpo 但只有七组对比中的四组以更少 gpu 小时达到该基线的最佳结果。证据针对语言模型推荐训练 不代表线上 ctr 收益。

lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. we introduce losslessly compressed tensors lct a gpu execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. lct exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights activations and optimizer states. highly optimized gpu kernels implement huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead essential for training. our analysis characterizes lct's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. lct achieves a compression ratio of up to 1.455× and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. on a 162m-parameter nanogpt lct reduces memory usage by 24.6% for a 7.2% step-time increase. in qwen3-4b fine-tuning lct saves up to 23.8% of peak memory enabling a 3.5× larger context length in training on the same gpu.

lct makes repeated lossless tensor encoding and decoding practical during gpu training by using precomputed huffman codebooks and optimized kernels to exploit redundancy in floating-point weights activations and optimizer states. on 162m-parameter nanogpt it reduces memory usage by 24.6% at a 7.2% increase in step time. in qwen3-4b fine-tuning it saves up to 23.8% of peak memory and enables 3.5x longer training context on the same gpu. these language-model experiments show a memory–runtime trade-off effectiveness in recommendation training is not established.

lct 利用浮点权重、激活和优化器状态中的冗余 通过预计算 huffman 码本及优化的 gpu 内核 降低训练过程中反复无损编码与解码的开销。在 1.62 亿参数 nanogpt 上 内存用量降低 24.6% 代价是每步耗时增加 7.2% 在 qwen3-4b 微调中 峰值内存最多降低 23.8% 同一 gpu 可支持的训练上下文长度增至 3.5 倍。这些语言模型实验体现的是内存与运行开销之间的取舍 尚未证实推荐训练中的效果。

linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. a fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. alternatively sparse attention with continued pretraining cpt can extend the effective context length. generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging however and cpt can be costly. we introduce freesolo a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. its linear-time variant fs-l learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short cpt. fs-b searches balanced trees with o nlog2 n algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. freesolo demonstrates better zero-shot length extrapolation than the baselines without long-context fine-tuning.

freesolo avoids forcing all long-context information into a fixed recurrent state by combining a sliding-window branch with a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. fs-l learns prefix pruning through short continued pretraining and has linear-time sequence cost fs-b searches balanced trees with o n log^2 n cost including radix-sort construction. the paper reports stronger zero-shot length extrapolation than its baselines without long-context fine-tuning. the variants have different memory and complexity trade-offs and the abstract does not establish gains on recommendation workloads.

freesolo 将滑动窗口注意力与选择关键单元、直接访问原始 token 的长距离分支结合 避免把全部长上下文信息压入固定大小的循环状态。fs-l 通过短期继续预训练学习前缀剪枝 序列计算成本为线性 fs-b 搜索平衡树 计入基数排序建树后复杂度为 o n log^2 n 。论文报告其在不进行长上下文微调的情况下 零样本长度外推优于所比较的基线。两种变体的内存与计算取舍不同 摘要未证实推荐负载上的收益。

long-context decoding in large language models llms is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing key-value kv cache at each autoregressive step. although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. a common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. by revisiting cross-layer sparsity from the perspective of attention dynamics we find that inter-layer salient token shift is highly localized although the exact top-κ indices differ across layers the core high-attention tokens remain stable with changes concentrated near the expanded boundary of previously selected regions. motivated by this we propose prism attention a proposal-refined sparse attention framework. it replaces rigid cross-layer index reuse with a coarse-to-fine strategy preserving layer-wise adaptability while retaining the efficiency benefits of cross-layer sharing. extensive experiments show that prism attention achieves state-of-the-art performance among mainstream sparse attention methods on both reasoning and long-context benchmarks while attaining a 3.4× end-to-end decoding speedup over flashattention at 128k context length.

prism attention reduces repeated sparse-index computation during long-context decoding by refining shared cross-layer proposals instead of reusing fixed indices. the authors report a 3.4x end-to-end decoding speedup over flashattention at 128k context alongside strong results against the evaluated sparse-attention methods. its index-sharing design may inform long-history recommendation but recommendation gains are untested.
长上下文解码中 逐层寻找重要历史词元也会消耗大量计算。prism attention跨层共享候选索引 再按当前层细化选择 作者报告在128k上下文下 相对flashattention实现3.4倍端到端解码加速。该索引复用方法可供长历史推荐研究参考 尚无推荐任务收益验证。

reusing a transformer block across depth increases computation without replicating its parameters but successive passes have no dedicated state through which positions can exchange compact summaries of their causal prefix. we introduce the causal latent workspace transformer an anchored four-round shared-depth architecture in which each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a content-addressed summary before the next shared block application. this path complements causal self-attention while the original input embedding remains accessible at every round. across three byte-level corpora three seeds and two matched parameter budgets the proposed model achieves the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five transformer controls. at 101.71m parameters it leads on wikitext-103 raw enwik8 and tinystories reaching perplexities 2.7820 2.7843 and 1.6823 these improve upon the strongest non-workspace control on each corpus by 1.06% 0.73% and 1.01%. all nine seed-labelled comparisons at this budget favor the workspace. at 0.918m parameters it leads on wikitext-103 and tinystories whereas a conditioned loop is stronger on enwik8. architectural ablations show that adding the workspace improves upon the anchored loop in all six settings and support refreshing its causal summaries at each round. together these results identify a causal content-addressable prefix workspace as an effective structural augmentation of looped transformers.

this looped transformer adds causal latent slots that exchange compact prefix summaries between shared-block applications while retaining the input embedding. across three byte-level corpora three seeds and two matched parameter budgets it gives the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings. the evidence supports a compact recurrent-memory design at the tested scales transfer to recommendation remains untested.
循环transformer复用同一模块 但轮次之间仍需要保存和交换历史信息。该工作加入只读取过去内容的隐状态槽 在每轮计算间传递前缀摘要 并保留输入表示。在三个字节级语料、三个种子和两档匹配参数规模下 六组设置中五组的平均测试困惑度最优 向推荐模型迁移仍待验证。

augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. because such accumulation is monotonic these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older structurally relevant tokens. we propose first passage attention fpa which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. fpa encompasses the forgetting transformer fox as a special case and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. we show that a constant-dimension fpa head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. in synthetic experiments one-layer fpa heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and fox baselines fail on every seed. scaling to a 110m-parameter language model fpa matches fox in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at 8× the training length even with its key--value cache compressed to about 25%.

first passage attention penalizes keys using extrema of a learned scalar field allowing intervening context to be forgotten while older relevant tokens survive. beyond synthetic expressivity tests a 110m-parameter language model matches the forgetting transformer in perplexity and achieves perfect passkey retrieval at eight times the training length with about 25% of the kv cache. these results motivate selective historical-memory mechanisms with recommendation transfer untested.
普通遗忘门容易在丢弃中间内容时一并削弱更早的信息。first passage attention用学习到的标量场极值控制遗忘 允许保留较早但仍相关的词元。在110m语言模型实验中 其困惑度与forgetting transformer相当 在训练长度八倍的口令检索任务上达到完全正确 kv缓存约保留25%。这种历史信息选择机制尚待推荐任务验证。

in a small language model the vocabulary is the single largest part. in gemma 3 270m the embedding table holds 168m of 268m parameters and because quantisation methods leave the embedding in 16-bit it is also most of the file once the rest of the model is compressed. we ask what that table actually buys. we replace it with one frozen table of 512-bit codes 16 mb with no trainable parameters derived once from a pretrained embedding by principal-component projection and sign binarisation and we train the same gemma-shaped body from scratch on the same 2.05b tokens with and without it. the learned table buys 0.20 nats of validation loss for 2.6 times the trainable parameters but on lambada hellaswag and piqa the frozen-table model is better or tied only arc-easy favours the learned table. with a ternary bitnet b1.58 body the whole model is a 46 mb file still ties the float model on lambada and piqa and on a laptop cpu generates 615 to 740 tokens per second in 62 mb of memory five to six times the speed of the float model's 8-bit gguf in llama.cpp at a seventh of the memory. the frozen table wins by 1.7 to 2.3 nats on rare words accepts 10 000 new words after training with a 3% cost where the learned table collapses by 43% and all of it is released with the weights the data and every evaluation answer.

the study replaces a trainable vocabulary embedding table with frozen 512-bit codes derived from pretrained embeddings using 16 mb and no trainable table parameters. at matched 2.05b training tokens downstream results vary by benchmark and the learned table retains a 0.20-nat validation-loss advantage. a ternary-body configuration also reduces storage and cpu decoding cost. frozen compressed embeddings offer a potential design for memory-bound models without established recommendation results.
小模型的词表嵌入可能占据大部分参数。该研究从预训练嵌入提取固定512位编码 以16 mb冻结词表替代可训练表。在相同2.05b训练词元下 下游任务结果因基准而异 可训练表仍有0.20 nat验证损失优势 结合三值网络还可压缩存储并降低cpu解码开销。该方法可供嵌入内存受限的模型参考 推荐效果尚未验证。

reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate and existing systems read item metadata to do so even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact semantic ids sids . ranking from sids alone has two appeals sid prompts are far shorter than the matched item text and although item codes are fixed from content the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. that training targets next-item generation and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from sids alone is untested. we build rerankid a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as sids varying item rendering history length and slate size one at a time. on this testbed such models often copy the input order instead of reranking and readable metadata does not repair the failure. we compare supervised fine-tuning rejection-sampled self-training on-policy distillation and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. the strongest post-trained model the 8b model trained with a graded ranking reward gives the best sid-only ranking and matches strong text-reading llms whose prompts are about 20x longer. it ranks above random with no history at all where a caption-reading reference does not and it keeps its gains at long histories where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. in a paired rationale audit this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. the common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from sids but not faithful item descriptions which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself not only the ranking it produces.

rerankid tests whether reasoning rerankers can rank candidate slates from semantic ids alone. post-training remedies the tendency to copy input order the strongest tested 8b model trained with a graded ranking reward matches strong text-reading llms whose prompts are about 20x longer. it retains gains with long histories but its item descriptions remain less accurate. compact-id ranking therefore needs separate checks of ranking quality and explanation faithfulness.
语义id把物品压成短编码 但能生成下一物品并不保证能重排候选列表。rerankid比较多种后训练方法 缓解模型照抄输入顺序的问题 其中采用分级排序奖励的8b模型 可达到强文本模型的排序水平 而后者提示约长20倍。长历史下收益仍在 但物品描述准确性较差 排序效果与解释真实性需分别评估。

current learned sparse approaches for recommender systems such as star represent a user by concatenating their interaction history into a single query string. for news this creates two bottlenecks concatenation collapses a user's distinct reading interests into one flat query and because news articles are long-form text concatenating several news articles quickly overruns the context window of the language model used as backbone and forces quality-degrading truncation. to address both bottlenecks we introduce learned sparse news recommendations lsnr . lsnr encodes each article independently and constructs a sparse user vector by combining learned attention-based weighting of the per-article sparse representations with a dense-projected expansion at the user level. experiments on the mind and ebnerd datasets show that lsnr significantly outperforms star with these gains holding even in short-history settings where truncation is not a factor. compared to state-of-the-art dense recommenders lsnr is competitive in standard settings and it outperforms them when the user history is short. an ablation of the user encoder confirms that learned attention-based aggregation outperforms simpler pooling alternatives. beyond effectiveness an additional advantage of lsnr is that it serves from an index an order of magnitude smaller than an uncompressed dense baseline.

lsnr separately encodes news articles then combines attention-weighted sparse article vectors with a dense-projected user expansion. this avoids flattening and truncating concatenated histories. on mind and ebnerd it outperforms star remains competitive with dense recommenders in standard settings and performs better with short histories. its serving index is an order of magnitude smaller than the evaluated uncompressed dense baseline.
把新闻历史拼成一条长文本 既容易丢失不同兴趣 也容易超出上下文长度。lsnr先分别编码文章 再用注意力汇总稀疏表示并补充用户级扩展。在mind和ebnerd上优于star 常规设置下与稠密推荐模型相当 短历史下更好 其服务索引比所比较的未压缩稠密基线小一个数量级。

looped language models reuse physical transformer blocks across logical depth but established architectures entangle recurrence placement input injection and recurrent state organization. we isolate these axes in models trained from scratch at matched parameter scale logical depth and token budgets and then test whether the resulting design principles transfer to resident- and active-parameter-matched mixture-of-experts moe models. the prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich architecture consistently improves performance on context extraction and reasoning-intensive tasks. input injection primarily enhances knowledge retrieval and context utilization whereas random initialization and separate h/l recurrent states provide mixed or negative returns. taken together these results favor the huginn-style design at the 730m-parameter and 336b-token scale the complete huginn architecture outperforms ouro across all ten benchmarks. the advantages of huginn over ouro transfer to moe models. at the 8ba0.8b 32ba3b when unrolled scale trained on 500b tokens huginn outperforms ouro on nearly all benchmarks spanning knowledge reasoning and coding while also exhibiting more balanced expert routing. under matched training and inference flops the huginn-style model uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward moe baseline. despite its smaller physical parameters it outperforms the feedforward baseline on drop and gsm8k matches it on math500 and remains competitive on the other benchmarks.

the study separates recurrence placement input injection and recurrent-state organization in looped language models under matched budgets. a huginn-style prelude–recurrent-block–coda design transfers from dense models to moe models. at matched training and inference flops the tested looped moe uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward moe with benchmark-dependent quality. the findings inform parameter-sharing architecture choices not measured recommender improvements.
循环模型的效果取决于循环放在哪里、怎样重新注入输入 以及如何组织隐状态。该研究在匹配预算下拆分这些设计 并将huginn式前置层—循环模块—输出层结构从稠密模型迁移到moe。在相同训练和推理flops下 测试模型比112层前馈moe少75%的常驻参数 任务表现各有差异 对推荐模型的收益仍待验证。

recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. this overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. we systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. based on this insight we introduce ramp recurrent adaptive mixed precision which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. across context lengths up to 4k ramp preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an nvidia h100 corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.

ramp reduces recurrent-depth prefill cost by using low-precision weights and activations in early iterations and restoring high precision for final refinement. matched-budget experiments support greater tolerance of early quantization errors. at contexts up to 4k on an nvidia h100 it preserves near-full-precision prefill quality and achieves up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup. this is a tested prefill result with recommendation transfer unverified.
循环模型反复处理整段输入 预填充开销随循环增加。ramp在早期轮次使用低精度权重和激活 在最终细化阶段恢复高精度 利用后续迭代对早期误差的缓解作用。在h100、最长4k上下文实验中 保持接近全精度的预填充质量 并实现最高1.16倍首次预填充端到端加速 推荐场景尚未验证。

sparse attention visits few keys yet finding them can still require scoring every key with every indexer head. we introduce dosa dots sparse attention a lossless method for making this computation conditional while preserving exact token selection. its central observation is that top-k selection requires sufficient evidence to reject a candidate not necessarily its full score. a seed set supplies a lower bound on the winning threshold. nonnegative head projections and joint residual bounds upper-bound positive contributions while activation-informed aggregation bounds the magnitude subtracted by negative heads. the certificate directs full scoring toward candidates that remain eligible exact-score filtering further reduces writeback and selection work. we establish the certificate and its exact-selection conditions and analyze how geometry and selection margins govern its effectiveness. our gpu implementation accelerates the complete indexer by up to 2.74 times over sglang and 1.69 times over litetopk across english chinese and code workloads. end-to-end evaluation on glm-5.2 and deepseek-v3.2 achieves up to 1.94 times and 1.50 times time-to-first-token speedups over the two baselines respectively.

dosa avoids fully scoring sparse-attention indexer candidates that provable bounds already rule out preserving exact token selection under its stated conditions. the gpu implementation speeds up the full indexer by up to 2.74x over sglang and 1.69x over litetopk. end-to-end tests on glm-5.2 and deepseek-v3.2 report time-to-first-token speedups up to 1.94x and 1.50x against those baselines. transfer to recommendation indexing remains untested.
稀疏注意力只读取少量词元 但筛选这些词元仍可能遍历全部历史。dosa利用得分上下界提前排除不可能进入top-k的候选 在给定条件下保持精确选择。作者报告完整索引器相对sglang和litetopk最高加速2.74倍、1.69倍 所测模型首词元延迟最高改善1.94倍、1.50倍 推荐索引场景尚待验证。

long-context inference makes the key-value kv cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. we propose belt a low-rank kv cache compression framework. its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. a learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. evaluated across three llms and multiple benchmarks belt achieves up to 70% low-rank kv cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on longbench and up to 17.8x overall kv cache reduction when combined with quantization. with triton-based gpu kernels and a quantized cache belt delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.

belt compresses kv caches using an attention-distribution-based low-rank objective and a learned global rank allocator under a component budget. across three llms the authors report up to 70% low-rank cache compression and benchmark-specific gains combining quantization reaches up to 17.8x cache reduction. gpu kernels yield up to 2.7x attention speedup and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput. these maxima describe different evaluated configurations recommendation transfer remains untested.
belt按注意力分布的变化来选择kv缓存的低秩近似 并在固定预算下学习各部分的秩分配。三个语言模型实验报告最高70%的低秩缓存压缩 结合量化最高达到17.8倍缓存缩减 gpu实现最高提升2.7倍注意力速度和3.3倍端到端解码吞吐。这些最大值来自不同测试配置 推荐场景收益尚未验证。

compressing the key-value kv cache is essential for serving long-context large language models llms under memory constraints. while current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. in this work we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration 2-bit keys and 2-bit values can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization vq based on the e8 lattice for kv keys. we show that structured vq exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios sqnr higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. to ensure practical utility we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. across five llm families our e8 k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde6× kv compression roughly 20% smaller than scalar k3v2 3-bit keys and 2-bit values while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. in our full-suite perplexity evaluation e8 improves over scalar k3v2 in 80% of model--dataset--context settings. these results indicate that e8 lattice vq improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for kv-compression stacks. overall our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context llm inference.

e8 lattice vector quantization exploits correlations between key dimensions to support 2-bit keys and values with table-based attention scoring that avoids explicit codebook decompression. across five llm families it provides roughly 6x kv compression about 20% less storage than scalar 3-bit-key/2-bit-value quantization while retaining near-baseline perplexity and throughput parity with scalar baselines. it suggests a memory-efficient primitive whose recommendation applicability is untested.
该研究用e8格点向量量化利用键向量相邻维度的相关性 实现键和值均为2位的kv缓存 并通过查表计算注意力 避免显式解码码本。在五类语言模型中 缓存约压缩六倍 比3位键、2位值的标量方案再小约20% 同时保持接近基线的困惑度和相当的解码吞吐 推荐应用仍待验证。
