mixture-of-experts moe models have emerged as an effective paradigm for scaling large language models yet their massive parameter footprint poses severe memory challenges for deployment. existing compression methods typically treat expert pruning and merging as disjoint operations and rely on greedy heuristics often leading to irreversible information loss or representational pollution. in this paper we propose prime a unified optimization framework for moe compression via adaptive pruning and merging. prime casts the discrete prune-merge assignment step as a global integer linear programming over a frequency-weighted surrogate objective jointly selecting pruning and merging decisions while accounting for expert usage. we motivate the frequency-aware objective through an error-bound analysis under fixed representative assignments and show that the formulation favors high-frequency experts as centroids promoting routing stability. extensive experiments on qwen3-30b-a3b and qwen3.5-122b-a10b demonstrate that prime achieves strong accuracy retention across knowledge coding math and long-context tasks while serving benchmarks of merged models quantify the memory and throughput benefits of expert compression in vllm.

prime jointly chooses expert pruning and merging through a global integer-linear optimization with a frequency-weighted surrogate objective. experiments on qwen3-30b-a3b and qwen3.5-122b-a10b assess retained quality across knowledge coding mathematics and long-context tasks with vllm serving measurements of memory and throughput. the work offers a coordinated expert-compression design gains for recommendation moe models remain untested.
moe压缩若把删除专家与合并专家分开处理 容易损失信息。prime将两种选择放进同一个整数线性优化问题 并按专家使用频率加权。在两种qwen模型上评估知识、代码、数学和长上下文质量 也用vllm测量内存与吞吐收益。该方法可供推荐moe的专家压缩参考 但尚无直接迁移验证。

mixture-of-experts moe language models activate only a few experts per token yet all expert weights must be stored. mixed-precision quantization reduces this storage cost by assigning higher bit-widths to sensitive experts and lower bit-widths to resilient ones but expert rankings alone do not determine how strongly to weight their errors. to address this gap we propose natscale a contrast-calibrated allocation framework for mixed-precision moe quantization. it uses a model-specific power transformation to calibrate gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target while preserving rankings. we jointly evaluate each expert's gate up and down configurations to estimate its output error. we then combine these errors and calibrated weights with an existing prior based on weight spectra variance and precision decay to select configurations under a storage budget. across three models natscale achieves the lowest native-to-quantized kl divergence and the highest top-token agreement in all nine settings against five allocation baselines. it also yields the lowest perplexity in seven settings. these findings highlight the importance of objective-aware precision allocation.

natscale calibrates the contrast of gradient-based expert importance weights while preserving their ordering then allocates mixed precision under a storage budget using joint gate/up/down error estimates. across three moe models and nine settings it gives the lowest native-to-quantized kl divergence and highest top-token agreement against five allocation baselines and the lowest perplexity in seven settings. recommendation-model benefits remain untested.
给专家按重要性排序 还不足以确定不同专家的量化误差应相差多少。natscale在保持排序的同时校准权重差距 联合估计专家各投影的误差 并在存储预算内分配精度。在三个moe模型、九组设置中 相对五种分配基线均取得最低分布偏差和最高首选词元一致率 七组困惑度最低 推荐模型收益尚待验证。

long-running agents retain kv caches across turns and sessions for hours or days. compressing these persistent caches requires reducing storage while controlling reconstruction error. we present alignpred a codec that combines local alignment with predictive coding under a configurable kv reconstruction-error budget. local orthogonal transforms align related heads or layers into a common coordinate frame allowing alignpred to combine token-wise prediction with same-token prediction across heads or layers. residuals are quantized on an error-bounded lattice and entropy-coded without learned predictors encoder-side mode search or large joint transforms. across three attention mechanisms alignpred requires less storage than the evaluated baselines at comparable measured reconstruction error. against the evaluated cpu codec implementations it decodes at least 1.6 times faster while matching or improving encode time. alignpred achieves near-native task scores at substantially compressed operating points on longbench-pro at 128k context. alignpred's sglang hicache integration reduces persistent target-kv storage by 42-72% relative to native hicache with comparable latency.

alignpred compresses persistent kv caches using local orthogonal alignment cross-token/head/layer prediction and error-bounded residual coding. its sglang hicache integration reduces persistent target-kv storage by 42–72% relative to native hicache at comparable latency. it also preserves near-native scores at tested 128k longbench-pro operating points. the result concerns persistent cache storage recommendation transfer remains untested.
长期运行的智能体需要持续保存kv缓存。alignpred先对齐相关头或层 再预测并编码残差 以可配置误差预算控制重建质量。接入sglang hicache后 持久化目标kv存储减少42%—72% 延迟相当 在128k longbench-pro测试配置中也保持接近原生的分数。该结果针对持久缓存 推荐应用尚待验证。

llm-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context such as schemas tool specifications interaction history and intermediate results. although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because kv states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. we present mapflow a system for efficient heterogeneous llm serving via cross-model attention map reuse. instead of reusing kv states mapflow reuses attention maps which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. to enable efficient and accurate reuse we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. to make attention reuse practical for long contexts we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. experiments show that mapflow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. these results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous llm serving especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. our code is available https //github.com/pku-dair/mapflow.

mapflow reuses attention maps across heterogeneous llms processing shared context combining partial recomputation lightweight layer/head translation block-sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. experiments report lower prefill latency and better end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across tested model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. cross-model attention reuse could inform shared-context serving with recommendation gains unverified.
不同模型处理同一段历史时 通常无法直接共享各自的kv状态。mapflow转而复用注意力图 再用部分重算和轻量映射适配不同层与注意力头 并配合块稀疏压缩和融合内核。在所测模型组合及多轮路由任务中 预填充更快、端到端服务效率更高且生成质量保持 推荐服务收益仍待验证。

frontier ai systems are increasingly natively multimodal jointly pretrained on multiple modalities such as text vision and audio. however the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. in this work we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities text vision and audio. multimodal large language models mllms increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts moe architectures as moes scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. we therefore use moes to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457m to 8.3b parameters on up to 150 billion tokens. our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training mllms. first compute optima are modality-specific audio modality is model-heavy favoring scaling parameters over tokens while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. second repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. finally cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric vision strongly interferes with audio whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. overall we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier mllms.

this multimodal scaling study fits data-mixture laws from 268 moe experiments spanning 457m–8.3b parameters and up to 150b tokens. compute-optimal allocation differs by modality audio favors parameters more strongly while text and vision favor balanced model/data growth. repeating vision or audio data beyond twice offers negligible benefits and cross-modal interference is asymmetric. these findings may guide multimodal recommendation budgeting but that transfer is untested.
多模态训练需要决定模型规模、各模态数据量及混合比例。该研究开展268组moe实验 覆盖457m至8.3b参数和最高150b词元 发现音频更偏向扩大参数 文本与视觉更需要模型和数据均衡增长 视觉或音频数据重复超过两遍收益很小 模态间干扰也不对称。这些规律可供多模态推荐预算研究参考 尚不能直接当作推荐系统结论。

scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics a specific initialization and feature-learning criteria. building on l-smoothness framework of xu et al. 2026 we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the lipschitz and l-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth k we show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling α=θ 1/k is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary p\to q geometries. because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its lipschitz and smoothness constants the argument applies to general residual networks including branches of block depth ≥ 2 such as transformer and resnet blocks without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. this provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with adamw muon and moga. learning-rate sweeps on gpt-2 depths 2--128 and cifar-100 resnets 8--32 residual blocks confirm that muon and moga exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

the paper analyzes depth transfer through loss lipschitz and smoothness constants showing that inverse-depth residual scaling can keep these bounds depth-independent at fixed width under its assumptions. learning-rate sweeps on gpt-2 and cifar-100 resnets support stable muon/moga transfer including a common optimal rate across a 64-fold depth increase. this informs deep-model scaling recipes recommender applicability remains untested.
小模型上找到的学习率能否用于更深模型 是扩大训练规模的关键问题。该文从损失函数的平滑性分析残差分支按深度倒数缩放的作用 并在gpt-2和cifar-100 resnet上检验。muon和moga在所测条件下表现出稳定的学习率迁移 包括深度增大64倍时共享最优学习率 对推荐模型的适用性仍待验证。

fine-grained mixture-of-experts moe models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. latentmoe moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. we show that an expert's local jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. we further use layerwise intrinsic dimension id to guide capacity allocation across depth co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count activated flops and communication volume constant. compared with layer-homogeneous baselines our id-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. these results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for moes.

the study treats latent-moe expert input dimension and intermediate width as separate design variables linking their balance to a local jacobian-rank ceiling. controlled sweeps favor near-square experts. layerwise intrinsic-dimension-guided allocation improves validation loss and downstream results while keeping each layer's parameters active flops and communication volume fixed. expert shape is a transferable design hypothesis not a verified recommendation gain.
专家数量增加时 专家本身应做成什么形状也会影响能力。该研究分析潜空间moe的输入维度与中间宽度 实验更支持接近方形的专家 再按各层的内在维度分配专家数量和形状。在逐层参数、激活flops及通信量不变时 验证损失和下游表现改善。推荐moe能否复现这种收益仍待检验。

dynamic vocabularies built on-the-fly via lempel-ziv-welch lzw compression let a language model represent the same text in fewer tokens but prior work shows that this efficiency comes at a cost to reasoning and perplexity. we show that this quality gap is not a fundamental price of compression but can be substantially closed through targeted improvements to the compression layer and lzw codec without modifying the underlying pretrained language model. our analysis reveals four key issues 1 lzw's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve 2 naively applying rope to lzw-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens 3 merging certain tokens notably digits disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy and 4 dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. we address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer size-aware rope positioning and a modified lzw codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. across four models our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. this represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.

zip2zip++ improves dynamic lzw token compression with separate input/output embeddings size-aware rope and selective merges plus alternative segmentations. across four models it improves tested-corpus perplexity and mathematical reasoning closing roughly half the quality gap to uncompressed models at similar general-text compression ratios. it remains lossy in quality transfer to compressed recommendation token streams is untested.
动态合并词元可以缩短序列 但会影响位置表示及输入输出嵌入。zip2zip++分别调整这些环节 并限制不利合并、处理多种切分方式。在四个模型中改善了所测语料困惑度与数学推理 在相近通用文本压缩率下弥合约一半质量差距 仍未完全恢复未压缩模型表现 推荐词元序列上的效果尚待验证。

late-interaction multi-vector models represent documents using a set of token-level vectors providing a middle ground between cross-encoders and dense encoders in terms of quality and cost of embedding. however compared to the latter the indices are costly to store and score. pooling and pruning based compression techniques are deployed widely but deteriorate in quality noticeably with aggressive compression. we investigate whether a lightweight change to the scoring function can recover retrieval quality after document-vector compression. for each combination of encoder compressor and vector budget we learn a global linear correction by distilling the uncompressed model's score distributions over candidate documents. the encoder and compressor remain frozen and the correction can be applied to each query at search time or once offline to the stored vectors. we evaluate the method with colbertv2 and jina v4 on ms marco and beir and with colpali2 on the vidore v3 visual document retrieval benchmark. experiments cover four training-free compression methods multiple vector budgets in-domain adaptation and transfer from ms marco to beir. in the in-domain setting the correction improves over baseline compression in 154 of 160 beir settings while transfer from ms marco is more variable across models and datasets. we also find that matrices trained with synthetic queries can improve over baseline compression on vidore v3. these results show that a small learned correction can recover some of the quality lost to compression without retraining the encoder or recompressing the documents.

a lightweight linear correction distills uncompressed late-interaction retrieval scores after document-vector compression leaving the encoder and compressor frozen. across colbertv2 jina v4 and colpali2 experiments it improves 154 of 160 in-domain beir settings transfer from ms marco is more variable. the correction can be applied at query time or to stored vectors offline recovering some quality without retraining encoders or recompressing documents.
多向量检索压缩文档表示后 相关性评分容易失真。该研究固定编码器和压缩器 仅蒸馏未压缩模型的得分 学习一个线性修正 可在查询时应用 也可离线作用于存储向量。在域内beir测试中 160组设置有154组改善 但从ms marco迁移的效果更不稳定。它提供了无需重训编码器或重新压缩文档的补偿方法。

sparse kv compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. under rotary position embedding rope gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. we study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. to reorganize this geometry we propose roperelay which assigns compact order-preserving rope coordinates relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. it reuses existing k/v without renewed selection historical re-prefill or additional cache budget. across 36 comparisons spanning two models six sparse selectors and three long-term memory tasks roperelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. for llama-3.1-8b-instruct with bm25 on longmemeval-s accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations. these findings establish positional organization as a distinct optimization dimension for sparse kv caches after content selection.

roperelay reorganizes the positions of an already selected sparse kv cache using compact order-preserving coordinates and key phase rotations synchronizing subsequent queries and generation. without reselection historical re-prefill or extra cache budget it improves 32 of 36 tested comparisons one longmemeval-s configuration rises from 23.6% to 35.4% accuracy with roughly 1–3% complete-request overhead. recommendation transfer remains untested.
稀疏缓存删掉词元后 保留词元的位置间隔仍可能影响注意力。roperelay不重新筛选或回放历史 而是压紧有序位置并调整键的旋转相位 同时同步后续查询。在36组比较中32组改善 一组longmemeval-s准确率从23.6%升至35.4% 完整请求时间额外开销约1%—3% 推荐历史压缩应用尚待验证。

tabular foundation models enable in-context learning by predicting unseen observations from a labeled support table without task-specific parameter updates. despite recent advances most existing approaches rely on dense architectures that apply the same transformations across features and datasets. we introduce orionmoe-small-v1.0 a compact tabular foundation model that combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse mixture-of-experts computation. built on a dual-axis transformer architecture orionmoe-small selectively activates experts with routing decisions informed by both individual cell representations and the broader dataset context. this design enables adaptive allocation of computation across heterogeneous tabular problems while retaining a shared computational pathway across tasks. the model is pretrained entirely on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior and performs downstream prediction without gradient-based adaptation. experiments across multiple tabular benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against substantially larger foundation models with particularly strong results on small-context and high-dimensional datasets. further analysis reveals favorable relative performance under class imbalance and highlights the importance of feature composition.

orionmoe-small-v1.0 combines distribution-aware representations with dataset-conditioned sparse expert computation in a dual-axis tabular transformer. the revised abstract describes routing as conditioned on individual cell representations and the wider dataset context removing the earlier feature-axis-only wording. synthetic-task pretraining enables prediction from labeled support tables without task-specific gradient updates with competitive reported results against larger tabular foundation models. the revision corrects the mechanism description it does not establish new recommendation results or new performance gains.
orionmoe-small-v1.0 在双轴表格 transformer 中结合分布感知表示与数据集相关的稀疏专家计算。新版摘要把路由依据明确为单元格表示和整体数据集上下文 删除了原先沿特征轴选择专家的表述。模型通过合成任务预训练 无需任务级梯度更新即可根据带标签的支持表预测 作者报告与更大表格基座模型具有竞争力的结果。本次是机制说明更正 不代表新增推荐实验或新的性能收益。

on-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. we ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. to address this we introduce loopsd which searches over a model's layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. specifically we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat and use the resulting teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. we then alternate search and distillation rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show improvements across models. on gsm8k with a 400-token thinking budget loopsd raises qwen3-1.7b accuracy from 42.30% to 79.61% subsequent distillation rounds yield further gains beyond the first round. together these findings show that by searching layer execution to construct teachers we can turn a model's additional computation into improved student capabilities opening a new avenue for self-distillation to derive supervision from the model's own computation.

loopsd searches for beneficial layer repetitions while holding weights fixed uses the resulting stronger looped teacher to guide on-policy self-distillation then repeats search and distillation. on gsm8k at a 400-token thinking budget qwen3-1.7b accuracy increases from 42.30% to 79.61% later rounds add gains. the method offers a way to distill extra computation into a student with recommendation transfer untested.
自蒸馏需要比学生更有用的教师信号。loopsd保持权重不变 搜索哪些层值得重复执行 形成更强的循环教师 再用学生自己生成的轨迹进行蒸馏 并交替重复这两步。在400词元思考预算的gsm8k实验中 qwen3-1.7b准确率由42.30%升至79.61%。该方法可研究如何把额外计算转移到学生能力中 推荐效果尚未验证。

reinforcement learning rl can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch mini-batch updates and asynchronous training. the resulting mismatch is especially harmful in mixture-of-experts moe models where rollout-training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. rollout routing replay r3 mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. to address this we propose router drift control rdc which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. the sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. experiments show that rdc achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous rl. in asynchronous training rdc combined with truncated importance sampling tis improves the average peak validation accuracy across aime 2024 and aime 2025 by 5.5 points over tis and 4.5 points over r3.

router drift control filters high-drift responses using disagreement between rollout-time and training-time expert routing preserving native routing on retained responses. it targets off-policy mismatch without replaying expert selections. in asynchronous rl combining rdc with truncated importance sampling raises average peak validation accuracy on aime 2024/2025 by 5.5 points over tis and 4.5 over routing replay. recommender-moe training benefits remain untested.
moe强化学习中 采样与训练时选择的专家可能不同 导致路由漂移。rdc用两阶段路由分歧识别并过滤漂移较大的回答 对保留样本仍使用原生专家选择。在异步训练中 rdc结合截断重要性采样后 aime两届验证集的平均峰值准确率比该采样基线高5.5个百分点 比路由重放高4.5个百分点 推荐moe上的作用尚待检验。

spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse binary activations but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. we present the first chinchilla-style isoflop scaling study of a spiking language model sweeping spikegpt-family models rwkv backbone from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from 3×1017 to 1019 flops on fineweb-edu. we report two findings. first the compute-optimal frontier is nopt \propto c0.56 close to the 0.50 that hoffmann et al. report for dense transformers so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. second against non-spiking rwkv and transformer baselines trained the same way the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls steadily with compute from 0.34 to 0.23 nats over our range. these results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

this isoflop study evaluates spikegpt-family language models across widths 384–1536 and compute budgets of 3×10^17–10^19 flops. the compute-optimal parameter exponent is 0.56. matched training comparisons separate an approximately 0.16-nat backbone loss cost from a spiking cost that decreases from 0.34 to 0.23 nats with compute. it quantifies accuracy trade-offs in the tested range it does not measure recommendation performance or hardware energy savings.
该等 flops 研究在宽度 384–1536、计算预算 3×10^17–10^19 flops 范围内评测 spikegpt 系列语言模型 得到计算最优参数规模的指数为 0.56。相同训练条件下 损失差距可分为约 0.16 nat 的骨干成本 以及随计算量增加而从 0.34 降至 0.23 nat 的脉冲化成本。它量化了测试范围内的准确率权衡 没有测量推荐表现或硬件节能。

decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option computed in a single forward pass without generating text. like the fast system 1 of dual-process theory they answer at once but their depth is fixed at training time so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. models that reason in generated text can think longer but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. we present lev a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. lev builds on a language model pretrained as a loop reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. on three looped backbones accuracy rises with depth on the same weights mostly on hard questions and a 2.6b lev goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on jevbench. on-demand depth set per question by a small stopper with a threshold fitted on unlabelled requests saves 15% to 24% of the computation at a cost of under one accuracy point level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths. on a locked test set the 1.4b and 3b models are 5.4 to 8.8 points more accurate than dense non-looped models and cascades of the same latency below 50 ms.

lev adapts looped language-model backbones into decision models that score options after each loop without generating reasoning text. a learned stopper allocates depth per question across tested backbones it saves 15–24% computation at less than one accuracy-point cost. locked-test comparisons also show gains over matched-latency dense models and cascades. adaptive-depth scoring is relevant to ranking design though recommendation results are untested.
固定深度的决策模型对简单和困难问题花费同样计算。lev在循环语言模型每轮后读取选项得分 无需生成推理文本 再用小型停止器决定是否继续。在所测骨干上可节省15%—24%计算 准确率损失不足一个百分点 锁定测试集上也优于匹配延迟的稠密模型和级联。该自适应深度评分方式尚待推荐排序验证。

in this paper we propose data-adaptive mahalanobis cross-head attention damcha a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes multi-head attention mha through the lens of metric learning. standard mha implicitly learns a static head-wise euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. damcha addresses this limitation via two key innovations. first it learns the full cross-head metric matrix inducing a mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of mha. second it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. we further introduce principled regularization strategies most notably stack-wise parameter sharing to ensure computational efficiency and stable optimization. damcha serves as a drop-in replacement for mha and its variants in various transformer architectures delivering superior expressive power and learning performance with comparable or reduced computational overhead. extensive experiments demonstrate that damcha-based transformers consistently outperform competing baselines across a range of benchmark tasks. code is available at https //github.com/erwinmsmith/damcha.

damcha extends multi-head attention with an input-dependent full cross-head metric allowing interactions omitted by independent head-wise similarities. stack-wise parameter sharing and regularization target stable efficient training. the authors report improvements across evaluated transformer tasks with comparable or reduced computational overhead. cross-head feature interactions are a potential recommendation application not an established result of this study.
多头注意力通常分别计算各头的相似性。damcha引入随输入变化的跨头度量 显式建模不同头之间的交互 并用堆叠层之间的参数共享及正则化控制开销和训练稳定性。作者在所测transformer任务上报告性能改善 计算开销相当或更低。将这种跨头交互用于推荐特征建模仍属待验证方向。

we introduce forge fast on-chip rotor generation for experts a procedural weight generation system for sparse mixture-of-experts moe inference. rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from hbm we show how a compact accelerator inside each streaming multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from o log2 d rotor parameters per projection. per replaced layer gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. this addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive sparse moe decode where per-expert ffn operations are hbm-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node expert parallelism ep with all-to-all traffic. we realize the approach as the rotor generation unit rgu a fixed-function datapath that generates ffn weight tiles without competing with tensor core execution. with 30% of the moe ffn layers replaced across five sparse moe models we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched gpu count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. in exchange downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. forge also expands kv cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. it is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored so it can compose with quantization. the rgu is fully implemented/verified in systemverilog at ~0.9% sm area overhead 0.032 mm^2/sm 7nm .

forge proposes a hardware unit that regenerates approximate moe expert weights from compact rotor parameters instead of loading full tensors. with 30% of ffn layers replaced the authors estimate 1.3–2.8x system throughput at matched gpu count and 1.10–1.15x lower short-context per-user decode latency with downstream accuracy losses. the verified systemverilog design is a hardware proposal these system estimates are not measured recommender deployment gains.
moe推理需要保存并搬运大量专家权重。forge设计专用硬件单元 从紧凑参数即时生成近似权重 替换30%的前馈层时 作者估计同gpu数量下系统吞吐提升1.3—2.8倍 短上下文单用户解码延迟改善1.10—1.15倍 但下游准确率下降。其systemverilog设计经过验证 系统收益仍是估计 不能视为推荐部署实测。

dynamic sparse training dst periodically prunes and regrows connections inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. at extreme sparsity \ge 99% this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. we formalize forward backward and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges and show that monte carlo realizations match the theory. guided by this reachability-based structure we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. we introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as reachability-guided in dst referred to as guided dst. on cifar-10/100 and tiny imagenet guided dst recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided dst up to +14.4 points at 99.9% sparsity on cifar-100 and on mlp-mixer guided dst remains trainable at 99.99% sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. these results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. our implementation is publicly available at https //github.com/mzjaworski/ea_dst.

the paper connects extreme dynamic-sparse-training failure to broken input–output pathways and guides pruning/regrowth using functional reachability. on image benchmarks it recovers up to 14.4 accuracy points at 99.9% sparsity an mlp-mixer remains trainable at 99.99% sparsity where unguided regrowth degrades. connectivity-preserving sparse training may inform recommendation architectures but the evidence is from vision tasks.
极端稀疏训练中 剪枝与重新生长可能切断输入到输出的信息通路。该研究按功能可达性引导连接删除和恢复 在图像基准中 99.9%稀疏率下最高恢复14.4个百分点准确率 mlp-mixer在99.99%稀疏率下仍可训练。保持连通性的思路可供稀疏推荐模型参考 目前证据来自视觉任务。

large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich heterogeneous features yet existing generative retrieval gr methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. more fundamentally existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed which feature to select or where it should influence hierarchical semantic id sid generation. we propose agentic generative retrieval agr a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves sid generation with on-demand feature acquisition. conditioned on the request and decoded sid prefix agr decides whether to invoke a tool which feature to acquire and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent sid branches. to supervise this behavior we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the sid hierarchy and train the model through sid pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks together with an online a/b test consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of agr.

agr interleaves semantic-id generation with on-demand feature acquisition. the request and decoded prefix guide when to call a tool which feature to fetch and where to use it training trajectories use feature applicability and information gain. the abstract reports gains on an industrial dataset three public benchmarks and an online a/b test without numerical effect sizes. the work addresses feature-use cost and relevance in generative retrieval.
agr 在生成语义 id 的过程中按需获取特征 根据请求和已生成的前缀 决定何时调用工具、获取哪项特征 以及在哪里使用它。训练轨迹依据特征适用性与信息增益构建。摘要报告了工业数据、三个公开基准和在线 a/b 测试中的效果 但未给出增益数值 其直接价值在于改善生成式检索的特征使用成本与相关性。

click-through rate ctr prediction underpins recommender systems and online advertising where high-dimensional categorical features interact in combinatorially many ways. several recent ctr models such as finalnet and qnn report higher accuracy when a network also learns from its own averaged predictions for example by running the same network under different dropout patterns and training each run toward the average. why this self-distillation helps and whether its random sampling is needed remains unclear. this work shows that as the number of dropout patterns grows without bound the objective reduces exactly to the label loss of the logit-averaged prediction plus a penalty on how much the dropout copies of the network disagree. when dropout does not affect how a network gates its features this penalty can be approximated in closed form and flmnet is designed on this principle and trains without sampling. networks trained from different seeds disagree in the same form and distilling several of them into one network recovers part of their ensemble gain. on five benchmarks against seventeen baselines the resulting models take the top two places in accuracy with a single network at inference and the gains of the penalty and of distillation where measurable largely add up.

flmnet explains dropout self-distillation as a label loss plus a disagreement penalty in the infinite-mask limit. when dropout leaves feature gating unchanged the penalty admits a closed-form approximation enabling sampling-free training distilling models trained from different seeds recovers part of the ensemble gain in one network. on five ctr benchmarks against seventeen baselines the resulting models occupy the top two accuracy positions. the evidence concerns benchmark accuracy with single-network inference not industrial scaling laws.
flmnet 将无限多 dropout 掩码下的自蒸馏目标分解为标签损失与预测分歧惩罚。在 dropout 不改变特征门控的条件下 惩罚项可作闭式近似 从而免去训练时的随机采样 再把不同随机种子训练出的模型蒸馏到单个网络 保留部分集成收益。在五个 ctr 基准、十七个对比方法中 所得模型占据准确率前两名 推理仍只需一个网络。证据限于这些基准 未建立工业扩展规律。

generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier sid and retrieves items by autoregressively generating sid sequences. in dynamic environments such as e-commerce new items arrive continuously requiring periodic updates to the sid-to-item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. each update however can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. we study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. 1 sid semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes mapping updates reduce hitrate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000 as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. 2 the fraction of changed sids is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75% hitrate decreases monotonically dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. 3 the sid topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective fixing old-item sids inserting new-items and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item hitrate by 10% and new-item hitrate by 109% validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. these findings distill into a concise deployment principle insert new-items freeze old-items warm-start when possible otherwise freeze never change sids the model has already learned. a three-week online a/b test on tmallapp shows uctcvr +0.29% and gmv +1.16%.

the study links semantic-id remapping to retrieval degradation using 67 days of e-commerce logs. large beams conceal much of the damage at beam size 1 mapping updates reduce hitrate by 41.78–62.05%. preserving old-item ids inserting new items and warm-starting the model improves old- and new-item hitrate by 10% and 109% across two update cycles. a three-week tmallapp a/b test reports uctcvr +0.29% and gmv +1.16%. these findings support stable identifier topology in the tested dynamic retrieval setting.

研究基于 67 天电商搜索日志 分析语义 id 重映射造成的检索退化。大束宽会掩盖部分损失 束宽为 1 时 映射更新使 hitrate 下降 41.78%–62.05%。固定旧商品 id、插入新商品并热启动模型 在两个更新周期中分别提升旧商品和新商品 hitrate 10% 与 109%。天猫 app 三周 a/b 测试报告 uctcvr 提升 0.29%、gmv 提升 1.16% 支持在该动态检索场景中保持 id 拓扑稳定。

accurate product discovery on the web requires recommendation models that rank catalog candidates within tight inference budgets. in semantic-id recommendation deployment can fuse code probabilities with item similarities making the final ranking depend on their normalization and relative weights. this motivates a direct training principle distill what you rank. we present onechord which uses one learned catalog-normalized fusion for next-item supervision refinement distillation and inference. a shared parallel decoder produces joint sid evidence and item-matching scores. during training a frozen denoiser supplies legal partial sids the student evaluates these states to construct refined fused targets. matching direct and refined predictions on shared hard candidates transfers refinement into one-pass recommendation. we characterize the fusion weights induced by candidate conditioning and establish sufficient conditions for preserving the refined predictor's full-catalog top-k selection. across six amazon datasets onechord achieves the highest recall@5 and ndcg@5 among the compared methods on every dataset with average relative gains of 6.30% and 7.12% over the strongest baseline. it also achieves a 1.04--1.18× full-test generation speedup over the fastest baseline. onechord makes the served ranking distribution the common object of recommendation learning and distillation.

onechord uses the same learned catalog-normalized fusion of semantic-id and item-matching scores for supervision refinement distillation and serving. a parallel decoder learns from refined targets on shared hard candidates so that inference needs one pass. across six amazon datasets average recall@5 and ndcg@5 gains over the strongest baseline are 6.30% and 7.12% full-test generation is 1.04–1.18x faster than the fastest baseline. these are offline recommendation results with no reported production ctr test.

onechord 在监督训练、细化蒸馏与服务时使用同一套经过全目录归一化的分数融合 将语义 id 概率与商品匹配分数对齐。并行解码器在共享困难候选上学习细化目标 把多步细化能力压入单次前向推理。在六个 amazon 数据集上 相对最强基线的 recall@5、ndcg@5 平均提升 6.30%、7.12% 完整测试集生成速度为最快基线的 1.04–1.18 倍。这些是离线推荐结果 未报告生产 ctr 测试。

generative recommendation constructs semantic ids for catalog items and predicts the next id from user interaction histories. however existing methods face limitations in both stages. first conventional quantizers may produce imbalanced code assignments and lack coherent intermediate semantic units between individual tokens and complete items limiting history reconstruction. second recommendation models remain dominated by next-item prediction treating historical interactions mainly as conditioning context and providing limited supervision for recovering persistent preferences across the historical path particularly when relevant preference signals are distributed over distant interactions. to address these limitations structure-aligned history learning sahl reconnects the two stages by using the structure created during quantization directly for history reconstruction. its semantic residual balanced quantization srbq forms a balanced token-subspace-item hierarchy and sahl reconstructs history at these same granularities. predictive entropy prioritizes uncertain transitions while curriculum optimization progressively shifts training to inference-aligned next-item prediction. on four amazon review categories sahl improves ndcg@10 by 18.6%-30.0% over rpg and 2.7%-6.0% over strong method mhl. controlled analyses verify balanced code use the benefit of following quantizer-defined groups during reconstruction and dependence on user history. the relevant code is available at https //github.com/cqu-mm-intelligent-lab/sahl.

sahl aligns history reconstruction with a balanced token–subspace–item hierarchy learned by semantic residual quantization. predictive entropy emphasizes uncertain transitions and a curriculum shifts training toward next-item prediction. on four amazon review categories ndcg@10 improves by 18.6–30.0% over rpg and 2.7–6.0% over mhl. the evidence concerns code utilization and history-dependent offline recommendation without demonstrated industrial latency or ctr gains.
sahl 用语义残差均衡量化建立 token—子空间—商品层次 并沿同一结构重建用户历史 预测熵用于突出不确定的转移 课程训练逐步转向与推理一致的下一商品预测。在四个 amazon review 类别上 ndcg@10 相对 rpg 提升 18.6%–30.0% 相对 mhl 提升 2.7%–6.0%。证据集中于编码利用率与依赖历史的离线推荐 未验证工业延迟或 ctr 收益。

language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content user history and feedback. however evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. we introduce duolm a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. an encoder llm learns compact item representations for offline reuse while a personalized ranker llm combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. we train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. the runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token ids for embedding access shared history computation and cuda graph replay. benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. on a single h100 it delivers approximately 26 400 candidate scores per second about 60× the throughput of the teacher served with vllm and automatic prefix caching.

duolm separates an encoder that produces reusable compact item representations from a personalized llm ranker training both with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. virtual token ids shared history computation and cuda graph replay reduce serving overhead. benchmarks retain quality comparable to the expert teacher on one h100 the system scores about 26 400 candidates per second roughly 60x the teacher throughput with vllm and automatic prefix caching. the throughput comparison is specific to that hardware and serving setup.
duolm 将可离线复用的紧凑商品编码与个性化 llm 排序器分开 并通过推荐监督与教师蒸馏联合训练。运行时利用虚拟 token id 访问嵌入、共享历史计算和 cuda graph 重放降低开销。基准上的质量接近专家教师模型 单张 h100 每秒可打分约 26 400 个候选 约为采用 vllm 与自动前缀缓存的教师模型的 60 倍。该吞吐比较仅对应论文所测硬件与服务配置。

vector search engines built on cloud object storage have drawn growing attention from both academia and industry. these systems typically adopt a disaggregated storage-compute architecture persisting the primary vector payload in object stores e.g. amazon s3 while retaining compact index metadata on compute nodes. however conventional vector indexing structures are not natively tailored to the pronounced network latency and per-request access costs of cloud object stores resulting in network i/o amplification degraded query throughput and higher api expenses. to resolve these challenges we present remoteann a vector search engine explicitly co-designed for cloud object storage across indexing and querying. to mitigate the dominant network i/o bottleneck remoteann couples an inverted file ivf index with rabitq quantization further optimized by inter-cluster and intra-cluster data reordering for improved data locality. building on this tailored data layout remoteann's query engine combines cluster pruning fine-grained range-get requests request merging and local nvme ssd caching dramatically reducing discrete storage requests and network transfer volume without sacrificing accuracy. to address the index construction bottleneck we further develop qgkmeans which substantially reduces construction latency without compromising clustering quality. extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that compared with representative baselines remoteann achieves up to a 5.9× throughput speedup while issuing up to 16.1× fewer object storage requests at 97% target recall.

remoteann co-designs vector indexing and querying for cloud object storage combining ivf and rabitq with locality-aware reordering cluster pruning range-get merging and nvme caching. qgkmeans reduces index construction latency. at 97% target recall evaluations report up to 5.9x throughput and 16.1x fewer object-storage requests than representative baselines. this supports infrastructure choices for large vector retrieval recommendation-quality gains are not established.
remoteann 面向云对象存储协同设计向量索引与查询 将 ivf、rabitq 量化与局部性重排、簇剪枝、range-get 合并及 nvme 缓存结合 并用 qgkmeans 降低建索引延迟。在目标召回率 97% 时 相对所测代表性基线 吞吐最高提升至 5.9 倍 对象存储请求数最多减少至约 1/16.1。该结果可供大规模向量检索基础设施参考 未证明推荐质量提升。

we propose kronlstm a linear attention architecture based on the kronecker delta rule a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. kronlstm extends the xlstm family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. this minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. the resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. hence kronlstm ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. experiments show that kronlstm is competitive with and often outperforms existing linear attention architectures including models of the gated deltanet family with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. these results establish the kronecker delta rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. our code https //github.com/nx-ai/kronlstm and models https //huggingface.co/collections/nx-ai/kronlstm are open-source.

kronlstm introduces the kronecker delta rule which revises associative matrix memory along one matrix-space direction to reduce interference with stored information. its analysis establishes a uniformly bounded expected memory norm and steady-state convergence under the described dynamics. long-context language-model experiments are competitive with and often outperform tested linear-attention baselines including the gated deltanet family. this is a potentially transferable stable-memory design recommendation performance has not been tested.
kronlstm 提出 kronecker delta rule 沿矩阵空间的单一方向修正关联记忆 以减少对已存信息的干扰。论文分析给出了所述动力学下记忆范数期望的一致有界性与稳态收敛性质。长上下文语言模型实验与包括 gated deltanet 在内的线性注意力基线相当 并在多项比较中更好。其稳定记忆机制可作为迁移候选 但尚未验证推荐效果。

looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. they are trained with backpropagation through time bptt . to save training compute bptt is often truncated to the last few loops but truncation yields biased gradients that may weaken the benefit of looping. in this work we study the value of truncation in looped transformer training in a systematic way we jointly vary model size training tokens and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. despite the training-compute savings of truncation our fitted law favors full bptt when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. in matched-compute runs full bptt through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. the law further shows that at fixed model size the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. when model size is also free the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. experimentally this setting achieves lower validation loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

across nearly 600 looped-transformer training runs the study models the joint effects of model size data forward loops and backward loops. when both loop counts are optimized under matched compute full backpropagation through fewer loops outperforms truncation. with model size also variable two fully trained loops achieve lower validation loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model using about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and 8% more training compute. the result informs loop-training budget allocation within the studied language-model regime not validated ctr scaling.
研究通过近 600 次循环 transformer 训练 联合分析模型大小、数据量及前向和反向循环次数。在相同计算预算下同时优化两种循环次数时 较少循环配合完整反向传播优于截断反向传播。允许调整模型大小后 两次完整训练循环相比计算最优的非循环模型 以约少 27% 的非嵌入参数和多 8% 的训练计算获得更低验证损失。结论可用于所研究语言模型范围内的循环训练预算分配 尚未在 ctr 上验证。

micro-expert pruning reduces the capacity of mixture-of-experts moe models by removing coupled channels within routed experts. however finer pruning granularity alone does not guarantee the preservation of downstream capabilities as similar language-modeling perplexity can accompany substantially different task performance. we revisit micro-expert mask construction as two distinct decisions allocating retained capacity across experts and selecting channels within that capacity. we propose uc-ramp a two-stage post-training pruning framework that explicitly separates these decisions. cape uses cross-domain calibration evidence to redistribute expert widths under an exact layer-wise budget while ramp refines channel composition at fixed widths through one-out one-in exchanges guided by a channel-interaction surrogate. across three moe models at 25% and 50% routed-expert channel pruning uc-ramp achieves the highest ten-task mean accuracy among evaluated pruning methods in five of six settings. at 50% pruning it outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 8.19 3.96 and 6.14 percentage points across the three models respectively. in a single-a100 deployment at 25% pruning uc-ramp reduces measured time to first token by 19.7--23.9% and time per output token by 20.2--22.3% relative to the unpruned model. the code is available at https //github.com/xzktx003/uc_ramp.

uc-ramp separates allocation of retained expert widths from channel selection in post-training moe pruning. cape redistributes capacity under an exact layer budget ramp refines channels at fixed widths using interaction-guided exchanges. it has the best ten-task mean accuracy in five of six tested model/pruning settings. at 25% pruning on one a100 time to first token falls 19.7–23.9% and time per output token 20.2–22.3% versus unpruned models. transfer to recommendation remains untested.
uc-ramp 将 moe 训练后剪枝分成专家宽度分配与通道选择两步 cape 在固定层预算内重新分配容量 ramp 再依据通道交互替换通道。它在六种模型与剪枝比例组合中的五种取得最高十任务平均准确率。单张 a100、25% 剪枝时 相对未剪枝模型 首 token 延迟下降 19.7%–23.9% 每输出 token 耗时下降 20.2%–22.3%。这些压缩方法尚未在推荐任务上验证。

fine-grained mixture-of-experts moe is the de facto architecture for scaling large language models. however dynamic expert load imbalance causes severe memory fluctuations that degrade training efficiency. existing systems rely on static memory provisioning they either over-provision leaving gpu memory idle during normal execution or under- provision inviting out-of-memory crashes and costly manual rollbacks when load spikes occur. to address these challenges we propose bagualu-2 a large-scale moe training system that eliminates this dilemma through flexible provisioning. by transforming memory allocation from a static one-time tuning choice into a continuous and fine-grained control. bagualu-2 grants exact activation memory on demand for each training batch. furthermore it offsets any dynamic management overhead through system optimizations. bagualu-2 demonstrates exceptional scalability training a model with 1040 billion parameters across 12 288 gpus while sustaining over 2 eflops at 35% mfu. compared with state-of-the-art systems bagualu-2 delivers 1.14x and 1.13x average throughput improvements over megatron-kuai and adapipe respectively.

bagualu-2 addresses activation-memory fluctuations caused by moe expert-load imbalance through per-batch dynamic provisioning and system optimizations. it trains a 1.04-trillion-parameter model on 12 288 gpus at over 2 eflops and 35% model flops utilization. reported average throughput is 1.14x megatron-kuai and 1.13x adapipe. the system offers a memory-management reference for large sparse-model training with no recommendation-specific evaluation.
bagualu-2 针对 moe 专家负载不均引起的激活显存波动 按训练批次动态分配内存 并用系统优化抵消管理开销。论文在 12 288 张 gpu 上训练 1.04 万亿参数模型 达到超过 2 eflops 和 35% 的模型算力利用率 平均吞吐分别为 megatron-kuai、adapipe 的 1.14 倍和 1.13 倍。它为大型稀疏模型训练提供显存管理参考 未开展推荐专门评测。

modern industrial ranking systems increasingly adopt generative recommendation gr paradigms in which user behavior sequences and non-sequential ns features are tokenized and jointly modeled by transformer-style backbones. this unified formulation provides a scalable interface for modeling long histories and heterogeneous features. however sequence and ns representations often carry asymmetric semantics historical representations may combine environment context with observed-action semantics whereas candidate-side ns representations contain no observed action but incorporate richer supplementary context such as user-item interaction features and recent behavior lists. direct interaction between such representations can make query-key dot products compare different semantic objects limiting meaningful cross-token interaction. to fill this gap we propose easformer an environment-action-state disentangled architecture for industrial app ranking. easformer constructs an explicitly aligned context environment space shared by historical and non-sequence tokens while disentangling user actions from historical token and candidate-specific context form non-sequence tokens. based on this aligned space easformer enables complementary historical action retrieval and state-conditioned action prediction. furthermore the disentangled design supports a cloze-style self-supervised objective by masking historical actions and reusing the candidate prediction pathway. on an offline benchmark from a real-world industrial app marketplace easformer achieves an auc of 0.89411 yielding a 0.88% relative improvement over the deployed baseline. online a/b tests further support this advantage with relative ecpm lifts of 1.26% and 3.94% across two real-world ranking scenarios.

easformer addresses semantic mismatch between historical behavior tokens and candidate-side features by separating environment action and state representations. an aligned environment space supports action retrieval state-conditioned prediction and masked-action self-supervision. on an industrial app-marketplace benchmark auc reaches 0.89411 a 0.88% relative gain over the deployed baseline two online ranking scenarios report relative ecpm gains of 1.26% and 3.94%.
easformer 针对历史行为 token 与候选侧特征的语义不对齐 将环境、动作和状态表示分开。共享环境空间支持动作检索、状态条件预测及掩码动作自监督。在工业应用商店基准上 auc 达到 0.89411 比线上基线相对提升 0.88% 两个在线排序场景的 ecpm 分别相对提升 1.26% 和 3.94%。

evaluating candidate changes hypotheses to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of gpu-hours severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. we introduce predictable scaling ps a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. ps constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. we compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness even the simplest raw proxy achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance the most expressive gaussian process provides an indicative 15% relative mae improvement and calibrated uncertainty. evaluation on two ranking models of increasing complexity---a task-specific model and a foundation model---demonstrates that ps correctly ranks actionable hypotheses across diverse hypothesis types at 79-88% compute reductions.

predictable scaling reduces the cost of testing recommendation-model changes by constructing smaller proxies along resource axes and extrapolating their metrics with calibrated uncertainty. on a task-specific ranking model and a foundation ranking model it correctly ranks actionable hypotheses while reducing compute by 79–88%. these results depend on empirically checked regularity conditions they do not establish universal transfer of proxy rankings.
predictable scaling 为降低推荐模型方案试验的成本 沿资源维度构造小模型代理 再结合校准后的不确定性外推指标。在一个任务专用排序模型和一个基础排序模型上 它正确排列了具有实际价值的改进方案 计算量减少 79%–88%。结果依赖经过实证检查的规律性条件 并不意味着小模型排名能够普遍迁移。

semantic id sid -based generative recommendation retrieves items through successive token-level decisions making personalization at each decoding step essential. however existing methods insufficiently account for prefix-dependent user evidence and imbalanced historical interaction loads among candidate branches. this can cause irreversible branch-selection errors and favor popular paths. we propose spar a generative recommendation framework that jointly improves stepwise personalization and sid construction. its path decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed long-term user memories and combines it with recent behavior user profiles and event context to guide each token decision. its rq-pib module balances historical interaction loads among sibling branches under each parent prefix while preserving semantic structure. experiments on large-scale youku production data show an average relative hitrate improvement of 2.66% over the strongest baseline. spar also increases target-prefix retention by 5.79 percentage points and reduces the traffic-weighted largest child-branch share by 32.84% across sid levels. in a 7-day online a/b test spar serves 10% of youku's production traffic and improves average watch time per user by 3.95% and play conversion rate by 3.38%. these results demonstrate more reliable hierarchical decoding balanced sid branches and improved user engagement in industrial recommendation.

spar addresses irreversible branch errors and popularity-heavy paths in semantic-id generation. its path decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed user memories while rq-pib balances interaction loads among sibling branches. on youku production data relative hitrate improves by 2.66% over the strongest baseline. a seven-day a/b test covering 10% of traffic reports watch time per user +3.95% and play conversion +3.38%.
spar 针对语义 id 生成中的不可逆分支错误和热门路径偏置 用 path 解码器从压缩用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据 并用 rq-pib 平衡同级分支的交互负载。在优酷生产数据上 hitrate 比最强基线相对提升 2.66% 覆盖 10% 流量的七天 a/b 测试报告人均观看时长提升 3.95%、播放转化率提升 3.38%。

generative recommendation predicts items by autoregressively generating semantic identifiers sids whose tokens are shared across semantically related items. with this paradigm gaining adoption the question of how to support unlearning in it has become pressing. if training interactions must later be removed such as injected spam or interactions with items a user no longer wants this sharing lets an unlearning update unintentionally affect the predictions for the interactions' neighbors. we show that this effect is locally structured and hidden by global metrics unlearning can leave recommendation utility on the whole test set nearly unchanged while substantially degrading it on neighborhoods of the forgotten interactions' sids. we propose neighborhood-aware unlearning nau which augments interaction-level unlearning with explicit control over the probability mass assigned to the forgotten items' neighborhoods. across three datasets and four sid tokenizers nau restores spam-induced exposure toward the retrained reference while retaining more than 95% of retrained utility and recovers the neighborhood utility that forget-and-repair unlearning loses at no global cost. we identify local probability redistribution as an important failure mode of unlearning in sid-based generative recommenders and show that explicitly controlling this redistribution can mitigate its effects.

neighborhood-aware unlearning addresses collateral damage when shared semantic-id tokens couple forgotten interactions to neighboring items. it explicitly controls probability mass in those neighborhoods alongside interaction-level unlearning. across three datasets and four tokenizers it moves spam-induced exposure toward a retrained reference while retaining more than 95% of retrained utility and recovers neighborhood utility lost by forget-and-repair unlearning without reducing global utility.
neighborhood-aware unlearning 针对语义 id 共享 token 导致的遗忘连带损伤 在交互级遗忘之外显式控制相邻商品的概率质量。在三个数据集、四种分词器上 它使垃圾交互引起的曝光变化向重新训练的参考模型回归 同时保留超过 95% 的重训效用 还能恢复 遗忘后修复 方法损失的邻域效用 而不降低整体效用。

multi-vector retrieval models such as colbert often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. however retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders limiting their scalability. we introduce flint fixed-budget late interaction an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries flint applies pooling symmetrically to both sides limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. flint achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on beir and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries including browsecomp+ crumb and trec tip-of-the-tongue 2025. we demonstrate that flint's effectiveness-efficiency benefits extend across encoder architectures testing it on two separate backbones bert and modernbert . on long-query corpora flint delivers 1.5-2.8 times faster end-to-end retrieval than constbert the closest baseline. flint also reduces index size by 5.3-9.3 times relative to token-level late-interaction models such as colbertv2.

flint reduces multi-vector retrieval storage and comparison costs by attention-pooling both queries and documents into fixed vector budgets. it retains comparable beir effectiveness and improves several long-query benchmarks across bert and modernbert backbones. on long-query corpora end-to-end retrieval is 1.5–2.8 times faster than constbert index size is 5.3–9.3 times smaller than token-level late-interaction models such as colbertv2.
flint 用注意力池化将查询和文档都压缩到固定数量的向量 降低多向量检索的存储和比较成本。在 bert、modernbert 两种骨干上 它保持相近的 beir 效果 并改善多个长查询基准。长查询语料上的端到端检索速度为 constbert 的 1.5–2.8 倍 索引比 colbertv2 等逐 token 交互模型缩小 5.3–9.3 倍。

dense bi-encoders and late-interaction retrievers are usually treated as alternatives yet they fail on different queries one vector captures what a text is about token-level matching finds its exact entities and phrases. using both today means two models two indexes and a score-fusion step. we present uibk-embedding-v1 a 179m-parameter english encoder that produces both representations in one pass and scores them with one unmodified maxsim. the dense embedding is written into the list of token vectors as three extra vectors and a one-dimensional tag keeps the two kinds of vectors from matching each other so that plain maxsim equals the token-level maxsim plus a weighted dense cosine. the model therefore runs in a standard late-interaction index without changes we test it with plaid. a shared 18-layer trunk with a separate 4-layer top per head and a cross-encoder distilled into the fused score turn the two heads into one retriever. on beir uibk-embedding-v1 reaches 59.79 ndcg@10. this is 2.57 points above lateon the strongest model of its size and 2.10 points above it when both models read documents of the same length uibk-embedding-v1 is ahead on all 15 datasets. on a decontaminated version of beir it stays ahead on average 61.55 against 60.36 and on 8 of 12 datasets. among the 156 models with complete beir results in the mteb results repository only models with at least 1.5b parameters score higher. code model weights and a technical blog post are available at https //github.com/datascienceuibk/uibk-embedding https //huggingface.co/datascience-uibk/uibk-embedding-v1 and https //huggingface.co/blog/abdoelsayed/uibk-embedding-v1 .

uibk-embedding combines dense and token-level retrieval in one 179m-parameter encoder and one unchanged maxsim index. three extra vectors encode the dense representation with a tag preventing cross-type matching shared layers and fused-score distillation train both heads together. beir ndcg@10 reaches 59.79 exceeding lateon by 2.10 points under matched document lengths. on decontaminated beir it leads on average and on eight of twelve datasets.
uibk-embedding 在一个 1.79 亿参数编码器和无需修改的 maxsim 索引中结合稠密检索与 token 级检索。三个额外向量承载稠密表示 类型标记防止跨类型匹配 共享层和融合分数蒸馏联合训练两个分支。beir ndcg@10 达到 59.79 文档长度一致时 比 lateon 高 2.10 点。在去污染版 beir 上 它的平均表现更高 并在十二个数据集中的八个领先。

generative retrieval gr casts search and recommendation as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers sids . sid design largely determines gr quality but its discrete interdependent components sid construction collision handling decoding and training cannot be optimized end-to-end with gradients and remain largely hand-designed. we introduce a framework that improves these components through llm-driven evolutionary program search to our knowledge the first application of this approach to gr. a locally served open-weight 31b model mutates executable gr components so no proprietary llm api is used and a 1m-parameter proxy decoder provides fast feedback in place of repeatedly training the 1b target generator. across 21 sid programs on nq320k proxy and target recall@100 show strong rank correlation spearman $ρ= 0.90$ . guided by this proxy evolution improves the seed gr on nq320k msmarco300k and a multilingual e-commerce dataset under a fixed training recipe. on nq320k jointly evolving sid construction and collision handling improves recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. a component study shows that proxy reliability depends on what is evolved improvements transfer reliably for the semantic index but not for the generator's training objective or the full pipeline. llm-driven evolutionary search is thus a practical tool for gr design provided proxy reliability is established for the chosen search space.

this framework uses a locally served 31b language model to evolve semantic-index programs and a 1m proxy decoder to evaluate designs before training a 1b generator. on nq320k jointly evolving id construction and collision handling raises recall@1 from 55.8% to 59.3% and recall@100 from 85.8% to 90.6%. proxy gains transfer reliably for semantic indexes but not for training objectives or the full pipeline.
该框架用本地部署的 310 亿参数语言模型演化语义索引程序 并用 100 万参数代理解码器评估方案 减少反复训练 10 亿参数生成器的需求。在 nq320k 上 联合优化 id 构建与碰撞处理 使 recall@1 从 55.8% 升至 59.3% recall@100 从 85.8% 升至 90.6%。代理收益能可靠迁移到语义索引 但未能可靠迁移到训练目标或完整流水线。

large language model inference over long contexts is increasingly bottlenecked by the cost of attending to a growing key-value kv cache. sparse attention reduces this cost by accessing only a fraction of the cache but existing methods face a trade-off between deterministic retrieval which captures high-scoring tokens but discards residual attention mass and sampling which improves coverage at the cost of higher variance. hybrid methods combine top-k retrieval with uniform sampling yet still exhibit a substantial gap from dense attention at aggressive sparsity. we introduce stratified sparse attention ssa a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling. ssa deterministically attends to high-scoring tokens while sampling the residual using proxy attention scores and correcting for their inclusion probabilities thereby recovering attention mass beyond the retrieval set. ssa encompasses top-k top-p and hybrid top-k+sampling as special cases. across ruler longbench loft and aime and five models ranging from 3b to 27b parameters ssa consistently improves over the baselines at matched sparsity. on ruler-hard with ministral-3-8b ssa improves accuracy over the strongest practical baseline from 81.8% to 84.2% at 32k and from 63.8% to 69.3% at 128k under 50× attention sparsity recovering 94% and 85% of dense-attention performance respectively. with optimized cuda kernels ssa achieves up to 2.96× decode speedup over flashinfer at 1m context demonstrating that its accuracy gains translate into practical long-context inference acceleration. we open-source our code at https //github.com/skylight-org/ssa-paper-code.

stratified sparse attention combines deterministic retrieval of high-score tokens with score-guided sampling and inclusion-probability correction for residual attention mass. across five language models and four benchmark suites it improves accuracy at matched sparsity. optimized cuda kernels yield up to 2.96 times decode speedup over flashinfer at one-million-token context. the evidence concerns language-model inference recommendation transfer remains untested.
stratified sparse attention 将高分 token 的确定性检索与分数引导的剩余部分采样结合 再按入选概率校正遗漏的注意力质量。在五个语言模型和四组基准上 它在相同稀疏度下改善准确率 优化后的 cuda 内核在百万 token 上下文中实现最高 2.96 倍于 flashinfer 的解码速度。证据来自语言模型推理 尚未验证推荐任务迁移。

head-dimension compression can reduce the memory required by the key-value kv cache but existing methods often reconstruct full-dimensional representations during inference adding significant decoding flops overhead. we formalize the design considerations for converting pretrained attention into a natively reduced-dimensional form that reduces both kv-cache storage and attention computation using a calibration set. specifically we consider reductions that 1 apply a shared projection to queries and keys so that they remain in a common reduced feature space 2 derive this projection jointly from query and key activations to better preserve their interaction and 3 are compatible with the pretrained rope transformation. to obtain a reconstruction-free realization of this reduction we restrict it to coordinate selection and theoretically show that rope compatibility then holds if and only if complete rotary pairs are retained. building on this characterization we introduce race a post-training method that selects rotary pairs using their joint query-key activation energy. we theoretically show that this criterion minimizes a separable calibration-dependent upper bound on post-rope query-key product approximation error. the resulting reductions are folded into the model weights and require neither runtime reconstruction nor specialized kernels. across three model families and different compression levels race outperforms structured pruning and remains competitive with reconstruction-based methods on language-modeling zero-shot and long-context tasks. at 50% kv-cache retention and 256k context race reduces total inference flops by 47.8% yielding 1.79x higher throughput 43.2% lower time-to-first-token ttft and 28.1% lower allocated gpu memory in comparison to an uncompressed model.

race reduces kv-cache dimensions without reconstructing full-dimensional states at inference. it selects complete rope rotary pairs using joint query-key activation energy and folds the selection into model weights. at 50% kv-cache retention and 256k context it reports 47.8% fewer total inference flops 1.79 times throughput 43.2% lower ttft and 28.1% lower allocated gpu memory than the uncompressed model. recommendation transfer is untested.
race 通过保留完整 rope 旋转对来压缩 kv 缓存维度 依据查询与键的联合激活能量选择坐标 并将选择折叠进模型权重 避免推理时重建完整表示。在保留 50% kv 缓存、256k 上下文的设置下 相对未压缩模型 总推理 flops 减少 47.8% 吞吐达到 1.79 倍 首 token 延迟下降 43.2% 已分配 gpu 显存下降 28.1%。推荐任务迁移尚未验证。

as model parameters scale up sparsely activated mixture-of-experts moe approaches have become essential for model scaling. however mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures where experts in different layers although topologically independent exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. compared to the hierarchically arranged local expert in existing mainstream models we hypothesize that inter-layer shared meta expert hold greater potential. to this end we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between local and meta experts and find that models incorporating meta experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. with the activated quantity and the expert granularity held fixed our model matches the performance of vanilla moe using only 70--80% of the experts substantially improving the model's scaling potential. beyond removing inter-layer redundancy among experts and improving information storage efficiency our theoretical analysis further shows that compared with local experts meta experts provide hidden states with more flexible residual pathways thereby improving information retrieval efficiency.

meta expert addresses redundant expert parameters across moe layers by sharing experts between layers. empirical comparisons show lower redundancy lower cross-entropy and higher downstream accuracy with activated expert count and granularity fixed it matches vanilla moe performance using 70–80% of the experts. the analysis attributes additional benefits to more flexible residual paths. these findings concern general model architecture with no recommendation-specific evaluation.
meta expert 通过跨层共享专家 减少 moe 不同层之间的参数冗余。实验显示冗余和交叉熵更低、下游准确率更高 在激活专家数量与专家粒度不变时 使用原始 moe 的 70%–80% 专家即可匹配其表现。分析还将部分收益归因于更灵活的残差路径。证据来自通用模型架构 没有推荐专门评测。
