mixture-of-experts moe models reduce computation through sparse expert activation but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. we study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem given a pretrained moe layer select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern moe models with many experts per layer. we develop optep a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. across multiple moe architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on qwen3-30b-a3b 14.55% on qwen3-235b-a22b 11.06% on glm-4.5-air and 16.20% on mixtral-8x7b. the improvements are particularly pronounced under aggressive pruning demonstrating that reconstruction-driven expert selection and weight adaptation can preserve substantially more of the original model's performance while reducing the number of retained experts.

optep treats post-training moe expert pruning as selecting a fixed-size subset that reconstructs the original layer output. a continuous relaxation optimizes expert selection followed by lightweight updates of retained weights. across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation tasks it outperforms evaluated pruning baselines especially at aggressive pruning. the method targets expert storage costs its abstract does not establish recommendation gains or measured serving acceleration.
optep 将 moe 训练后专家剪枝表述为固定数量的专家子集选择 以重建原层输出为目标。它先用连续松弛优化专家选择 再轻量更新保留的权重。在数学推理和代码生成任务上 它优于所评测的剪枝基线 激进剪枝时优势更明显。该方法针对专家存储成本 摘要没有证明推荐收益或实测服务加速。

looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. however full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation without explicitly distinguishing their roles. we introduce the asymmetric looped transformer asymloop which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. a single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific global key-value kv caches that remain fixed across iterations while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates local kv from its evolving state. joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. for training we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. experiments on fineweb-edu across four model scales from 60m to 1b show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than full loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. at 1b asymloop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets an olmo-style backbone and sparse mixture-of-experts models. these results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.

asymloop separates one-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. a causal encoder supplies fixed global kv caches while a weight-tied decoder attends jointly to them and evolving local states. at matched effective depth and training tokens models from 60m to 1b improve over full-stack looping. at 1b average accuracy on seven commonsense benchmarks rises from 49.58% to 50.85% recommendation transfer is untested.
asymloop 将一次性上下文编码与循环状态更新分开 因果编码器提供固定的全局 kv 缓存 共享权重的解码器联合关注全局缓存和不断变化的局部状态。在有效深度和训练 token 数一致时 6000 万至 10 亿参数模型优于整栈循环 10 亿参数模型的七项常识基准平均准确率从 49.58% 升至 50.85%。推荐任务迁移尚未验证。

sparse attention reduces the computational cost of long-sequence video transformers but three-dimensional token layouts often leave selected blocks partially occupied wasting physical tile capacity. we present kpage a block-sparse attention scheme that packs valid 16-row k/v pages across logical-block boundaries into large tiles directly during loading without materializing compacted tensors in high-bandwidth memory. kpage also routes q blocks between 64x256 and 128x128 tiles to reduce query-side padding. exact masking and k/v-owned page packing preserve the original sparse graph in forward and backward execution. across five representative workloads kpage achieves 1.35x-2.06x bare forward-kernel speedup over nvidia block-sparse attention bsa with a geometric mean of 1.77x. it is near parity for fully occupied blocks 1.03x but achieves 2.29x geometric-mean speedup on 3d layouts with partial blocks. kpage reduces physical query-key pair capacity from 334.1g to 177.5g while preserving 160.6g useful interactions. across eight layouts from open-source ssta sta and vsa systems kpage achieves 1.13x-4.25x forward and 1.02x-2.71x forward-plus-backward speedup over the strongest exact sparse baselines. with independent q/k partitions kpage also achieves 1.49x speedup over the strongest exact sparse baseline and 1.57x over bsa on the svg2 wan 14b/720p configuration. after compliance review we will open-source kpage and submit a pull request to nvidia cudnn frontend.

kpage addresses wasted gpu tile capacity in partially occupied sparse-attention blocks. it packs 16-row kv pages across block boundaries during loading and selects query tile shapes preserving the original sparse graph without materializing compacted tensors in high-bandwidth memory. across eight layouts it reports 1.13–4.25 times forward and 1.02–2.71 times forward-plus-backward speedup over the strongest exact sparse baselines. these are attention-kernel results not recommendation-system gains.
kpage 针对稀疏注意力块未填满造成的 gpu tile 容量浪费 在加载时跨块打包 16 行 kv 页面 并选择查询 tile 形状 它保留原稀疏图 不在高带宽显存中物化压紧后的张量。在八种布局上 前向速度为最强精确稀疏基线的 1.13–4.25 倍 前向加反向为 1.02–2.71 倍。这些是注意力内核结果 并非推荐系统收益。

drugclip places small molecules and protein pockets in one space turning genome-wide drug discovery into large-k retrieval by vector proximity. a campaign fixes over 20k pockets in advance for one library of over 500m molecules. each pocket keeps k = 500k candidates 0.1% of the collection versus 100 in ann benchmarks. missed hits never get tested so mean recall must reach 99% relative to exact search. large answers make ivf probe every list holding a result and graph search track k or more candidates so costs grow with k. on our cpus and gpus neither index family reaches the target without losing most of its edge over scanning. sweepann partitions compressed vectors across gpus and scans each resident partition. one matrix multiplication scores each block for a whole query batch reading it once. several plans perform the k-dependent selection and merging of each query's k answers each returning an exact top-k under compressed scoring. the window plan retains each query's best k from sampled blocks as its seed and only rows above each seed's minimum score shared once across gpus enter the buffers. four blackwell gpus rtx pro 6000 answer all 26 562 pockets with a resident time of about 61 seconds excluding library loading and 99.6% mean recall relative to exact fp32 search. drugclip reports roughly 24 hours with eight a100 gpus in its own campaign. on 500m rows the window plan runs 1.41x faster than sweepann's grouped plan in the same memory. across 25m-500m rows and k of 10k-500k all gpu ivf configurations meeting the recall target take 8.2-24x sweepann's resident time. on deep1b's 1b vectors across eight gpus against sweepann's exact full-score scan of uncompressed fp32 rows the window plan cuts resident time by 5.4x and 3.2x at k = 100k and 500k. it also cuts per-gpu peak memory by 6.0x and 5.3x losing 1.0 and 0.7 mean-recall points.

sweepann targets large-k vector retrieval where conventional ann indexes lose much of their advantage at high recall. it scans compressed gpu-resident partitions with batched matrix multiplication and selective top-k merging. four rtx pro 6000 gpus process 26 562 drug-discovery queries in about 61 seconds at 99.6% mean recall excluding library loading. the application is drug discovery cross-hardware campaign comparisons do not isolate an algorithmic speedup.
sweepann 针对高召回率、大 k 向量检索中常规 ann 索引优势缩小的问题 用批量矩阵乘法扫描 gpu 驻留的压缩分区 并选择性合并 top-k 结果。四张 rtx pro 6000 gpu 约用 61 秒处理 26 562 个药物发现查询 平均召回率为 99.6% 时间不含向量库加载。应用场景是药物发现 跨硬件的整体任务对比不能单独证明算法加速幅度。

multimodal rerankers are usually dedicated models a vision-language model vlm is trained on retrieval data to score the candidates of a query. scoring options is not specific to reranking. system one decision models such as jev map a state and a typed question to one probability per option without generating text and general models can make such decisions with little or no training. reranking is one such decision with the query and its candidates as the state and the candidates as the options. we therefore argue that a general vlm can serve as a multimodal reranker through system one decisions and that decision tuning can improve its reranking. we ask a vlm one choice question over the top 16 candidates of a first-stage retriever and rank the candidates by the probabilities of their labels read from one forward pass. on mmeb-v2 image retrieval this choice scores 5.4 to 7.3 hit@1 above a yes/no question per candidate and the yes/no question falls below the first stage. with the choice zero-shot qwen3.8-27b beats the supervised qwen3-vl-reranker-2b on all three benchmarks and comes within 1.6 points of reranker-8b on each. it matches reranker-8b on mmeb-v2 visual documents 84.79 vs. 84.78 ndcg@5 at 1.1 to 1.5 times its latency. jev-27b-vl the same backbone tuned on text decisions only improves page reranking by 0.6 to 1.1 points with gains on most tasks sign test p <= 0.017 and leaves natural images unchanged. the zero-shot model is larger than the supervised rerankers and of a newer generation so these comparisons are confounded we discuss this and other alternative views and the experiments that would test the position.

this study casts multimodal reranking as one multiple-choice decision over sixteen candidates ranking label probabilities from a single vlm forward pass. it outperforms per-candidate yes/no scoring text-only decision tuning further improves page reranking by 0.6–1.1 points while leaving natural images unchanged. comparisons with supervised rerankers are confounded by model size and generation so they do not isolate the proposed formulation s effect.
该研究将多模态重排转化为对十六个候选的一次多选决策 用视觉语言模型单次前向计算的标签概率排序。它优于逐候选的是非问答打分 仅用文本决策调优后 页面重排再提高 0.6–1.1 点 自然图像效果未变。与监督式重排器的比较受到模型大小和代际差异干扰 不能单独归因于这一决策形式。

retrieval-augmented generation rag is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures where wide-area latency cross-region egress cost and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives inflating tail latency and cost. we formalize the geo-rag selection problem grasp a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps with no retraining. we first settle its complexity the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid solved optimally by an o n log n greedy algorithm rather than np-hard as a knapsack framing suggests with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. on a five-node cloudlab testbed emulating a four-region wan over the natural questions corpus 2.68m passages grasp's benefit is placement-dependent under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost under topical residency-like placement it traces a recall-latency pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only nearest-k and a latency-budgeted baseline. at a moderate latency setting grasp lowers p90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall with sub-millisecond selection overhead stable to 200 queries/s. findings generalize across four public beir benchmarks. in end-to-end question answering grasp reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute em of relevance-only retrieval.

grasp reranks retrieval candidates using relevance network latency and optional transfer cost under regional caps without retraining. its benefit depends on content placement. on a five-node testbed a moderate setting reduces p90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only recall. end-to-end qa reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while staying within 0.062 absolute em of relevance-only retrieval this is a quality-latency trade-off.
grasp 在区域数量约束下结合相关性、网络延迟和可选传输成本重排候选 无需重训 收益取决于内容部署位置。五节点测试平台上的中等延迟设置使 p90 获取延迟下降 41% 保留仅按相关性检索的 78% 召回率。端到端问答的上下文获取延迟下降 43% em 与仅按相关性检索的绝对差距不超过 0.062 这是质量与延迟的权衡。

a growing body of work proposes dynamic expert-skipping methods for mixture-of-experts moe models that adjust the number of experts activated per token during inference aiming to preserve model quality while further reducing the number of active parameters. these methods have added calibrated importance scores inter-expert similarity metrics or learned per-token allocators in order to identify experts to skip. however different calibration regimes different reductions in the effective number of experts and evaluation suites make comparisons difficult. we classify four representative prior methods into a unified taxonomy and benchmark them against a natural simple baseline statically reducing the number of experts $k$ i.e. same reduced $k$ across all layers and tokens . we provide a fair comparison of these methods at matched expert-compute budget on two modern moes gemma4-26b-a4b and qwen3-30b-a3b in a text-only setting and a contemporary vision-language model qwen3-vl in a multimodal setting. surprisingly we find that the simple baseline is hard to outperform consistently across models modalities benchmarks and calibration settings. the methods we benchmark often underperform the baseline and achieved gains when present are minor. we further find that the effective $k$ achieved or optimized for in calibration can diverge from the effective $k$ in testing resulting in over- or under-estimating the compute at inference time. based on these findings we recommend a calibration-free per-modality static $k$ reduction and validate this on a held-out model and modality. we further argue that a static control at matched measured compute is the baseline any dynamic skipping method must beat.

this controlled study compares four dynamic moe expert-skipping methods with simply reducing the same expert count across layers and tokens. at matched expert-compute budgets static reduction is difficult to beat consistently across text and multimodal models. calibration-time effective expert counts can diverge from test-time counts distorting cost comparisons. the contribution is a stronger evaluation baseline not a new recommendation architecture.
该受控研究将四种动态 moe 专家跳过方法 与所有层和 token 使用相同较小专家数的简单方案比较。在专家计算预算一致时 静态减少专家数很难被文本和多模态模型上的动态方法稳定超越 校准与测试时的实际专家数还可能不同 导致成本比较失真。其价值在于建立更可靠的评测基线 并非提出新的推荐架构。

recursive transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies layer-wise repetition where each layer is reused independently and global cyclic reuse where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. we argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. this study proposes block recursive transformers brt which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. this intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions without adding routing modules auxiliary states or extra training objectives. across decoder-only models up to 1.7b parameters with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies brt improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. project website https //aim-skku.github.io/brt/

block recursive transformers partition layers into contiguous blocks and repeatedly apply each block before proceeding to the next. this intermediate sharing pattern balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation without adding routing auxiliary states or objectives. across decoder-only models up to 1.7b parameters with encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies it improves validation loss and downstream accuracy over static recursive-sharing baselines. recommendation transfer is untested.
block recursive transformers 将连续层划分成块 反复执行当前块后再进入下一块。这种中间粒度的共享方式平衡局部细化与不同深度的功能分化 无需新增路由、辅助状态或训练目标。在最高 17 亿参数的仅解码器模型及编码器—解码器、仅编码器实验中 它改善了静态递归共享基线的验证损失和下游准确率。推荐任务迁移尚未验证。

hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. while full-attention layers maintain a kv cache that grows linearly with sequence length efficient layers typically rely on separate fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the kv cache but the theoretical benefits of such access and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. we investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. we first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-κ kv-cache access require ω \sqrtn capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size n. to overcome this limitation we introduce the multi-hop retrieval attention mura hybrid block a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared kv cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. we prove that a single fixed size m-hop mura block can compute m-function composition whereas computing m+1 -function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. synthetic experiments support this hierarchy showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. together our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

mura lets efficient hybrid sequence layers perform multiple retrieval hops over a shared kv cache. for function-composition tasks theory establishes a strict hierarchy in retrieval depth a fixed-size m-hop block computes m-function composition while one more composition requires polynomial size at that depth. synthetic experiments support the hierarchy. this motivates more expressive efficient architectures but does not establish language-model or recommendation production gains.
mura 让高效混合序列层在共享 kv 缓存上执行多跳检索。函数复合任务的理论分析给出严格的检索深度层级 固定大小的 m 跳模块可计算 m 重函数复合 而保持该深度再多复合一层需要多项式规模。合成实验支持这一层级。它为增强高效架构的表达能力提供思路 但没有证明语言模型或推荐生产环境收益。

modeling lifetime user behavior sequences is essential for capturing long-range preferences in industrial recommendation yet sequences containing up to 100k interactions make target-aware ranking prohibitively expensive. search-based methods that retrieve from raw sequences incur candidate-dependent costs that grow with sequence length whereas latent compression methods reduce computation at the expense of item-level addressability. we propose echo efficient cascade with homogeneous operators a framework that balances efficiency and fine-grained retrieval by retaining a subset of original event records per user through a distilled selector ds and retrieving a smaller set of target-relevant records for each candidate through a target-aware fine-grained retriever tfr . ds is supervised by a candidate-aware full-history teacher via per-target distillation enabling target-aware user-level selection without requiring full-history computation for every candidate. the retriever and target-attention scorer share the relevance parameters learned by the teacher ensuring consistent relevance estimation throughout the cascade. at a sequence length of 100k echo reduces online sequence-branch flops by approximately 160 times compared with a representative end-to-end model. three deployment optimizations including common user inputs compact record encoding and key-side projection absorption further reduce memory storage and data-movement overhead. experiments on kuairand-1k and an industrial-scale short-video platform demonstrate relative gauc improvements ranging from 0.113% to 1.520% over state-of-the-art baselines across multiple tasks. furthermore online a/b tests in two production scenarios kuaishou and kuaishou lite show that echo improves app usage time by 0.240% and 0.373% respectively.

echo makes target-aware ranking over 100k user events practical by distilling a teacher into a user-level selector that retains raw records and a candidate-aware retriever with shared operator design. it reports roughly 160 times fewer online sequence-branch flops than a representative end-to-end approach with relative gauc gains of 0.113–1.520% on kuairand and industrial data. online kuaishou and kuaishou lite tests report usage-time gains of 0.240% and 0.373%.
echo 为降低十万条用户行为上的目标感知排序成本 将教师知识蒸馏到保留原始记录的用户级选择器和候选感知检索器 两阶段采用同构算子。相对一个代表性的端到端方案 在线序列分支 flops 约减少至 1/160 kuairand 与工业数据上的 gauc 相对提升 0.113%–1.520%。快手与快手极速版在线测试的使用时长分别提升 0.240% 和 0.373%。

multimodal click-through rate ctr prediction is central to search systems where ranking depends on item content query relevance and user preference. existing approaches incorporate content through dense embeddings or coarse discrete ids yet effectively integrating fine-grained heterogeneous content with id-based predictors remains challenging. we propose finesid a progressive learning framework that unifies content tokenization query--item semantic pretraining and personalized post-training via a shared fine-grained discrete representation. each stage optimizes an explicit objective while preserving token-level access to content. first a pretrained multi-scale visual tokenizer and text tokenizers convert heterogeneous content into fine-grained semantic ids sids explicitly aligning them with the id features. second full-parameter semantic pretraining under query--item relevance supervision establishes a robust matching prior jointly optimizing the interactions of multimodal sids and conventional fields within a shared predictor. third this initialized predictor is directly fine-tuned with user click supervision to capture implicit personalized preferences. extensive offline and online evaluations demonstrate substantial gains in both standard ctr prediction and core business metrics. furthermore finesid improves within-product creative discrimination demonstrating its semantic generalization beyond conventional id memorization.

this progressive ctr framework connects content understanding query relevance and personalization. fine-grained visual and textual semantic ids share a feature-interaction predictor with id features full-parameter query-item semantic pretraining precedes personalized click fine-tuning. offline and online evaluations report improvements in ctr and business metrics alongside within-product creative discrimination. the abstract supplies no numerical effect sizes.
该渐进式 ctr 框架衔接内容理解、查询相关性和个性化 细粒度视觉与文本语义 id 和 id 特征共用交互预测器 先进行全参数查询—商品语义预训练 再以个性化点击任务微调。离线和在线评测报告 ctr 与业务指标改善 并提升同商品创意区分能力。摘要未提供数值增益。

existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. we challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. 1 non-uniform computational need items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. 2 suboptimality of fixed allocation given oracle access to the target item a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. these observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. to this end we propose looprec. looprec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. this design converts the fixed global depth into a learned per-item property without auxiliary depth labels and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that looprec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. further analysis reveals that looprec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. our code is available at https //github.com/elpmis117/looprec.

looprec allocates different amounts of recurrent computation to individual history items. a shared block and binary exit gate learn item-level depth without auxiliary depth labels. across four sequential recommendation backbones on public benchmarks adaptive recursion improves the quality-efficiency trade-off analyses associate deeper computation with rare and recent items. the evidence does not establish industrial serving gains.
looprec 为历史中的不同商品分配不同循环计算量 通过共享模块和二元退出门学习逐商品深度 无需额外深度标签。在公共基准的四种序列推荐骨干上 自适应循环改善了效果与效率的权衡 分析显示低频和近期商品往往获得更深计算。证据尚不能证明工业服务收益。

generative recommenders replace the retrieve-then-rank cascade with a single model beam search over semantic item identifiers performs retrieval and the same likelihood performs ranking. we show that this shared score makes them forget long-tail items twice. in retrieval beam search keeps identifier prefixes by the probability mass of their subtrees so tail items are pruned early and a wider beam admits few more of them. in ranking the likelihood places tail items below head items even when they are admitted so expanding retrieval alone brings little or no gain. both failures reflect missing item-level memorization i.e. direct recall of which items co-occur which collaborative filtering provides and shared-prefix generation lacks. to this end we propose cape co-occurrence-aware pool expansion a training-free plug-in that restores memorization at both stages i a memorization channel retrieves co-occurrence-supported tail items outside the beam and scores them with the frozen generator and ii memorization-calibrated ranking fuses the generator likelihood with co-occurrence evidence while keeping the generator's first item. experiments with two generative backbones on product and music domains show that cape significantly improves long-tail accuracy over the backbones and over re-ranking baselines that share its candidates preserves or improves overall accuracy and adds a small fraction of the latency.

cape addresses long-tail memorization lost by semantic-id generative recommenders. a training-free co-occurrence candidate pool expands beyond beam-search results and memorization-calibrated reranking preserves the generator s top item. experiments with two backbones on product and music recommendation improve tail retrieval and ranking. this complements generative generalization without retraining the generator the abstract gives no numerical effect sizes.
cape 针对语义 id 生成式推荐丢失长尾记忆的问题 用无需训练的共现候选池补充束搜索结果 再以记忆校准重排保留生成器的首位商品。商品和音乐推荐上的两种骨干实验改善了长尾检索与排序。它无需重训生成器即可补充生成式泛化能力 摘要未给出数值增益。

standard implementations of softmax log-softmax and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. the first bug softmax collapse rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. the second bug softmax cancellation occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. we present simple implementations of log-softmax softmax and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. our fix eliminates the previously observed slingshot phenomenon speeds up grokking with weight decay prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation and shows that after memorization logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and adam's $ε$ hyperparameter.

this work identifies floating-point errors in softmax and cross-entropy target gradients can round to zero and near-matching teacher and student distributions can suffer cancellation. revised implementations suppress the slingshot effect and distillation drift in the reported experiments. the contribution improves numerical behavior of common training operators recommendation-specific gains are not established.
该研究指出 softmax 和交叉熵中的浮点误差 目标梯度可能被舍入为零 接近的教师与学生分布也可能出现相消误差。修正实现抑制了所报告实验中的 slingshot 现象和蒸馏漂移。其意义在于改善常用训练算子的数值行为 尚未证明推荐任务上的收益。

sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. we revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. importantly the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. this leads to ttr-compressor a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. we evaluate ttr-compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. on block-wise sparse attention ttr-compressor improves ruler performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. for visual token merging it consistently outperforms the standard mlp merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. these results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.

ttr-compressor treats sequence compression as learned test-time regression computing closed-form coefficients during the forward pass. it supports blockwise attention and visual-token merging. experiments report strong ruler results while a visual merger matches an mlp merger with 55.6% fewer tokens. these results concern long-context and multimodal models with no recommendation-specific evaluation.
ttr-compressor 将序列压缩表述为可学习的测试时回归 在前向过程中求闭式系数 支持分块注意力与视觉 token 合并。实验报告了较强的 ruler 表现 视觉合并器用少 55.6% 的 token 匹配 mlp 合并器效果。结果来自长上下文和多模态模型 没有推荐专门评测。

generative recommendation with semantic ids represents each item as a sequence of discrete codes derived from its semantic representation and predicts these codes to generate recommendations. existing semantic-id recommenders are typically trained with hard labels for the observed next item. although such supervision identifies the target it provides no explicit distributional information about alternative items conditioned on the same user history. sequential recommenders can supply this item-level predictive knowledge but transferring it to semantic-id generation is challenging because the teacher and student operate in item and code spaces respectively. we propose two complementary knowledge-distillation objectives for parallel semantic-id recommenders which predict all code positions simultaneously without autoregressive prefix conditioning. item distribution matching idm reconstructs a catalogue-level item distribution from the student's parallel code predictions and aligns it with the teacher's item distribution. code marginal matching cmm projects the teacher's item probabilities onto each code position using fixed item-to-code assignments then matches the resulting code marginals to the corresponding student heads. both objectives transfer the teacher's soft distributional knowledge while preserving the student's parallel prediction structure. experiments on benchmark datasets show that both methods consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches. on average idm improves recall@10 by 15.39% while cmm improves ndcg@10 by 8.28%. these results demonstrate that distillation in either reconstructed item space or code-marginal space can substantially strengthen hard-label supervision for parallel generative recommendation.

this work distills an item-space teacher into parallel semantic-id generation which avoids conditioning on previously generated codes. item distribution matching reconstructs item probabilities while code marginal matching projects teacher distributions onto code marginals. reported mean gains are 15.39% in recall@10 for the former and 8.28% in ndcg@10 for the latter. the methods connect item-level knowledge with parallel code prediction.
该研究将商品空间教师蒸馏到并行语义 id 生成器 避免依赖已经生成的码。item distribution matching 重建商品概率 code marginal matching 将教师分布投影到码的边缘分布。前者报告 recall@10 平均提升 15.39% 后者报告 ndcg@10 平均提升 8.28% 为商品级知识与并行码预测建立联系。

generative recommenders using semantic identifiers predict items through successive token decisions but beam search may irreversibly prune promising item paths. this limitation is particularly consequential when a few recent interactions signal an emerging interest while earlier behavior favors established preferences. yet an independently trained discriminative recommender may rank the same items highly from the same interaction history. such complementary scores are available at test time offering a way to adapt a frozen generator without retraining either model. the challenge is to use these scores before pruning combining completed recommendation lists cannot alter earlier beam decisions while scores over complete items cannot directly inform choices among semantic prefixes shared by multiple items. we propose test-time collaborative beam search adaptation tcbsa a training-free method that incorporates collaborative information into semantic decoding. tcbsa transforms discriminative score margins into potentials over shared semantic edges and uses a confidence gate to regulate their contributions to cumulative path scores before beam selection. we establish a sufficient condition for target prefix survival under global beam competition and bound score perturbations under low discriminative confidence. full-catalog experiments show consistent improvements over strong baselines across datasets and different generative and discriminative recommenders. analyses of emerging interests and decoding behavior demonstrate gains in recommendation accuracy and target path survival while targeted interventions support the contribution of shared prefix corrections. tcbsa also offers a favorable balance between recommendation accuracy and inference latency compared with simply widening the native beam.

tcbsa adapts generative retrieval at test time using a frozen discriminative recommender. it projects item scores onto shared semantic-id edges and applies confidence-gated potentials before beam pruning. full-catalog experiments improve retrieval with a favorable latency trade-off compared with widening the beam. the method adds collaborative evidence without retraining the generator the abstract gives no numerical effect sizes.
tcbsa 在测试时用冻结的判别式推荐器适配生成式检索 将商品分数投影到共享语义 id 边 并在束剪枝前加入置信度门控势值。全商品库实验改善了检索效果 相比扩大束宽具有较好的延迟权衡。它无需重训生成器即可引入协同证据 摘要未提供数值增益。

generative retrieval gr typically relies on item-level beam search to retrieve candidates leaving cross-item dependencies unmodeled and limiting direct optimization of list-level objectives. a natural alternative is to generate the entire list within a single autoregressive trajectory. however greedy decoding with directly trained list-wise models substantially underperforms beam search. we identify two contributing factors the broader search space explored by beam search and the positional bias of scarce positive signals which deprives later positions of adequate supervision. to address these challenges we propose slide a search-to-list item distillation framework that decouples offline search from online list generation. a teacher model retrieves high-quality candidates through offline item-level beam search providing additional conversion-relevant supervision beyond sparse behavioral labels. their semantic ids sids are then concatenated in beam-score order to form list-wise distillation targets. this search-to-list conversion transforms candidates retrieved along separate search paths into sequential item-generation targets within a single trajectory. trained on these targets the student generates the top-k list in a single greedy pass also decoupling teacher scaling from online deployment. experiments on forge and taobao search show that slide substantially improves retrieval quality under single greedy decoding and with stronger offline teachers surpasses the beam-search reference. supplementary rl experiments support the effectiveness of list-level generation.

slide addresses weak greedy list generation by distilling offline item-level beam search into a single online trajectory. teacher candidates are ordered by beam score and their semantic ids concatenated as list-wise targets. on forge and taobao search this improves single-pass retrieval and stronger offline teachers exceed the beam-search reference. it separates teacher scaling from online deployment without claiming measured production speedups.
slide 针对贪心列表生成效果不足 将离线逐商品束搜索蒸馏到单条在线轨迹 按束分数排列教师候选 并将语义 id 拼接成列表监督目标。在 forge 和淘宝搜索上 它改善了单次贪心检索 更强的离线教师还能超过束搜索参考。该方法将教师扩展与在线部署分开 摘要未报告实测生产加速。

generative recommendation formulates item recommendation as autoregressive generation rather than a discriminative scoring problem. although empirical studies exhibit favorable scaling behavior in recommendation unleashing the benefits of scaling remains challenging under the strict model size and inference cost constraints of real-world systems. a central challenge is to combine expressive modeling of user-item interaction histories with flexible computational depth without proportionally increasing model size. we introduce loopgr a parameter-efficient scaling framework for generative recommendation via recurrent depth. loopgr employs a tailored hierarchical recurrent depth mechanism that alternates between a shared generative decoder and a lightweight context updater. for efficient inference we further develop recurrent trajectory self-distillation that distills a low-budget student from a high-budget teacher by aligning both predictive distributions and evolution directions. extensive experiments show that loopgr consistently outperforms strong generative recommendation baselines. compared with a representative encoder-decoder baseline loopgr achieves superior performance while reducing model size by up to 52%. these results establish recurrent depth as a new scaling dimension offering a flexible and resource-efficient scaling path for generative recommendation.

loopgr increases generative recommendation depth without proportionally increasing parameters. a shared generative decoder alternates with a lightweight context updater while recurrent trajectory self-distillation aligns predictions and evolution directions between high- and low-budget runs. experiments outperform strong baselines and reduce model size by up to 52% relative to a representative encoder-decoder. the result concerns parameter-efficient scaling not a quantified production latency gain.
loopgr 在不同比增加参数的情况下加深生成式推荐计算 共享生成解码器与轻量上下文更新器交替执行 再用循环轨迹自蒸馏对齐高、低预算运行的预测与演化方向。实验优于强基线 相对一个代表性的编码器—解码器 模型大小最多减少 52%。结果支持参数高效扩展 并未量化生产延迟收益。

generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with token-by-token decoding of an item's semantic id sid . but existing sid-based methods primarily use l levels of tokens sequentially to represent each item in the input history. as a result a fixed context window holds l times fewer items than it would with one embedding per item. we present pinger a generative retriever deployed at pinterest that retains sid outputs while making input histories compact built on three ideas. 1 an asymmetric attention mask over interleaved sid and dense tokens lets later items attend only to the dense ones so the model is supervised at every sid position in training yet serves one token per item while computing the same function. 2 generation is controllable through goal-conditioned outputs reinforcement learning and a prefix-diversity penalty which together steer retrieval toward surface-specific goals and diverse candidates. 3 a serving stack built for efficient wide-beam generation is paired with decoding constrained to valid identifiers and candidate resolution from a host-local index. deployed in related pins pinger lifts saves of fresh pins by 3.60% and overall saves by 0.62% while reducing the surface's end-to-end latency by 0.7% and eliminating the cost of the nearest-neighbor search it replaces.

pinger retains semantic-id outputs while serving one token per history item. an asymmetric mask preserves the training function goal-conditioned generation and diversity controls steer retrieval and wide-beam serving resolves valid ids through a local index. deployment in pinterest related pins increases fresh-pin saves by 3.60% and overall saves by 0.62% reduces end-to-end surface latency by 0.7% and removes the replaced nearest-neighbor search cost.
pinger 保留语义 id 输出 同时在服务时将每条历史商品压缩为一个 token。非对称掩码保持训练函数一致 目标条件生成和多样性控制引导检索 宽束服务通过本地索引解析有效 id。在 pinterest related pins 部署中 新鲜 pin 保存量提升 3.60%、整体保存量提升 0.62% 页面端到端延迟降低 0.7% 并消除了被替代近邻搜索的成本。

general-purpose embeddings trained on profile similarity often misrank candidates in professional networks where relevance is inherently complementary rather than symmetric. for example job seekers usually engage with recruiters rather than peers with similar credentials. current user recommendation systems are often built on profile similarity or social signals such as shared connections which are effective in friend-oriented social networks where users tend to connect with similar people or within existing social circles. however this does not hold in professional platforms like linkedin where interactions are often goal-driven and cross-role interactions requiring matching based on complementary intents rather than similarity or social proximity. in this paper we propose preference-aligned intent retrieval a retrieval framework that is designed to model user intent preference instead of profile similarity. our approach is inspired by the preference-learning perspective of direct preference optimization but instantiates preference learning as an exposure-conditioned multi-negative contrastive objective over embeddings. this formulation simplifies training and scales efficiently to large candidate sets without requiring an explicit reference model. furthermore we incorporate user interaction history by aggregating click histories with positional encoding to capture temporal order which enables constant-cost updates of user representations over a fixed history window allowing new interactions to be incorporated without re-encoding history. as a result personalization can be updated efficiently using lightweight cpu operations without repeated llm inference during serving. we evaluate pair on linkedin's premium retrieval task. a 0.6b parameter model achieves a mar@100 of 0.45.

pair models complementary professional intent rather than profile similarity for people retrieval. an exposure-conditioned multi-negative contrastive objective learns preferences while position-aware click-history aggregation permits constant-cost updates within a fixed history window. a 0.6b-parameter model reaches mar@100 of 0.45 on linkedin premium retrieval. lightweight cpu updates avoid repeated language-model inference during personalization the abstract reports no online business lift.
pair 在人员检索中建模互补职业意图 而非仅匹配档案相似度。曝光条件下的多负例对比目标学习偏好 带位置编码的点击历史聚合支持固定历史窗口内的常数成本更新。6 亿参数模型在 linkedin premium 检索任务上达到 mar@100 0.45 轻量 cpu 更新避免个性化时反复调用语言模型 摘要未报告在线业务增益。

large-scale industrial ranking models must jointly capture heterogeneous feature interactions long-term user behaviors and multi-scenario dependencies under stringent online serving constraints. existing architectures typically process sequential and non-sequential features with separate modules limiting bidirectional information exchange. directly applying homogeneous self-attention to all semantic tokens can also be inefficient when sequential and non-sequential signals exhibit different effective-ranks eranks . meanwhile shared representations can overlook scenario-specific patterns and induce negative transfer between scenarios. in this paper we propose hirank a unified framework for multi-scenario recommendation that jointly models heterogeneous feature interactions via effective-rank scaling. hirank integrates gated sequential attention with heterogeneous feature interaction within a unified backbone enabling bidirectional fusion between sequential and non-sequential representations. hirank further uses scenario-aware aggregation to compress heterogeneous low-order tokens into a compact representation. distinct learned projections transform the full compact representation into scenario-aware composite tokens with complementary global feature views and more uniform information density enabling more effective high-order self-attention. extensive experiments on industrial-scale datasets demonstrate favorable performance scaling with parameter count and consistent improvements over competitive baselines. online a/b tests further show a 2.27% increase in orders per user.

hirank addresses industrial ranking with heterogeneous features long user histories and multiple scenarios. a unified backbone combines gated sequence attention with bidirectional feature interaction then compresses low-order tokens into scenario-aware composite tokens for high-order attention. industrial experiments report favorable parameter scaling and an online 2.27% increase in orders per user. the contribution is unified ranking architecture rather than a general scaling law.
hirank 面向同时包含异构特征、长行为历史和多场景的工业排序。它在统一骨干中结合门控序列注意力与双向特征交互 再将低阶令牌压缩为场景感知的组合令牌 用于高阶注意力。工业实验显示随参数增长的效果改善 线上 a/b 测试报告人均订单量提升 2.27%。主要贡献是统一排序架构 而非通用缩放定律。

navigational search aims to find a single target page among hundreds of millions of web pages. click tables work well for queries seen before but cannot generalise to new formulations while embedding retrievers generalise across content but often rank navigational targets poorly. we introduce octen-webgr a generative retrieval framework that stores web pages in the parameters of a language model given a query the model generates a two-token semantic identifier constrained to a table of real urls. we develop octen-webgr-4b which indexes 201 million web pages and evaluate it on real navigational traffic from the month after training. generative retrieval is most effective on new ways of asking for familiar pages for unseen queries targeting pages with substantial interaction history it ranks the correct page first 30.9% of the time against 17.2% for a dense retriever trained on the same clicks 21.4% with a click prior . embedding retrieval keeps an advantage on rarely visited pages so the two approaches generalise on complementary sides the query and the page. over all navigational traffic octen-webgr reaches 59.6% top-1 accuracy against 46.5% for a click-enhanced dense retriever and up to 37.5% for frontier llms answering from memory which cost at least 40 times as much per query. the 4b model runs on a single gpu with 10 gb of memory compared with 412 gb for exact dense retrieval. scaling experiments with up to 32 million urls show that when every query-page pair is seen equally often the model size needed grows sublinearly with index size and that retrieval is constrained more by page exposure than by model capacity. we release octen-webgr-4b and octen-webgr-0.6b with their identifier tables and inference code.

octen-webgr retrieves web pages by generating a two-token semantic identifier constrained to real urls. its 4b model indexes 201 million pages and reaches 59.6% top-1 accuracy on subsequent navigational traffic versus 46.5% for a click-enhanced dense retriever. it is strongest on new queries for well-exposed pages dense retrieval retains an advantage on rarely visited pages. experiments up to 32 million urls link capacity requirements to index size and exposure offering evidence for large-scale generative retrieval rather than ctr ranking.
octen-webgr 生成受真实 url 表约束的双令牌语义标识符来检索网页。其 4b 模型索引 2.01 亿网页 在训练后月份的导航搜索流量上取得 59.6% 的首位命中率 结合点击先验的稠密检索为 46.5%。优势主要来自熟悉网页的新查询 稠密检索在少访问网页上仍有优势。最多 3200 万 url 的缩放实验分析了索引规模、曝光与容量需求 可参考于大规模生成式检索 尚非 ctr 排序验证。

large language models incur substantial training and inference costs in personalized search and recommendation as growing interaction histories lengthen request inputs and repeatedly expose the same item text to the model. we propose composable and reusable item memory crim a framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling. a small set of learnable summary tokens compresses each item into compact continuous memories while segment-level readout tokens rec tokens introduce predictive supervision within the interaction history. these memories are independent of users and queries and can therefore be reused across requests. at inference time crim composes cached memories in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to produce a personalized retrieval representation reducing repeated item-text encoding while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling. we further introduce a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. re-encoding only a few history items per request allows the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the item and request encoders at limited computational cost while periodic cache refreshes maintain consistency. extensive evaluation and cost analysis on movielens-1m qilin and our new lazseq dataset show that crim achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance with substantially lower inference costs at the same backbone scale while limiting item re-encoding during joint training. we will publicly release our code and dataset.

crim reduces repeated item-text encoding in personalized retrieval by compressing each item into user- and query-independent continuous memories. requests compose cached memories in interaction order while readout tokens and sampled live re-encoding support joint training with periodic cache refreshes. evaluations on movielens-1m qilin and lazseq report stronger retrieval with lower inference costs at the same backbone scale. the reusable item representation offers a practical route to compressing recommendation histories without removing request-level context modeling.
crim 将物品压缩为不依赖用户和查询的连续记忆 减少个性化检索中重复编码物品文本的开销。请求按行为顺序组合缓存记忆 训练通过读出令牌、少量物品实时重编码和定期缓存刷新共同优化编码器。在 movielens-1m、qilin 和 lazseq 上 同等骨干规模下报告了更好的检索效果和更低推理开销。可复用物品表示为历史压缩提供了工程方案 同时保留请求层面的上下文建模。

generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic ids sids code by code under trie-constrained beam search an approach now deployed on large web platforms. standard autoregressive interfaces pay for the sid length k twice a history of t items enters the backbone as tk code tokens and every beam-search step runs through the backbone so returning b candidates costs o bk backbone decode tokens per user. the second cost often dominates and it grows with the backbone the sid depth and the candidate budget. we introduce deco decoding from concepts which separates reading the history from writing the identifier. the backbone reads each history item as one fused token and condenses the history once into a compact next-item concept a light kv-cached decoder conditioned on the concept and the generated prefix runs the entire beam search while the identifiers the trie and the autoregressive factorization stay unchanged. the decoder approaches full-backbone accuracy with cross-entropy alone and distillation improves it further. on seven datasets from e-commerce movies and music streaming deco achieves comparable or better accuracy than both a standard generative recommender and the full-backbone teacher with fused inputs while delivering 3.2-8.6× their throughput under a 50 ms p95 latency budget in a production-style serving pipeline. delegating beam search makes larger candidate pools and models practical deco generates 1000 candidates faster than its teacher generates 100 and with a 1.5b-parameter llm backbone it matches the 69m-parameter teacher's throughput while achieving higher accuracy.

deco separates history reasoning from semantic-id decoding each history item becomes one fused token a heavy backbone produces one next-item concept and a lightweight cached decoder performs beam search. on seven recommendation datasets it matches or improves the compared models while delivering 3.2–8.6 times their throughput under a 50 ms p95 budget in a production-style pipeline. the result supports larger candidate pools and backbones through cheaper decoding it is not an online business-lift claim.
deco 将历史建模与语义标识符解码分开 每个历史物品合并为一个令牌 重骨干一次生成下一物品的概念表示 再由带缓存的轻量解码器执行束搜索。在七个推荐数据集上 其效果达到或超过所比较模型 并在生产式流水线的 p95 50 毫秒预算下获得 3.2–8.6 倍吞吐。该结果说明降低解码成本可支持更大的候选池和骨干 不代表已验证的线上业务收益。

generative recommendation with semantic ids sids represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and autoregressively predicts the next item's sid. despite strong recommendation performance repeated decoding over multiple sid positions incurs substantial inference cost. knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a powerful generative teacher to a lightweight student yet conventional objectives do not fully account for multi-token sid generation. we identify two limitations item-level distribution alignment may not adequately preserve the teacher's ranking of candidate groups sharing sid prefixes while uniform alignment across sid positions may affect final item ranking differently. we propose musid-kd which combines hierarchical candidate distribution alignment hcda and ranking impact guided levelwise distillation rigd . hcda aggregates item probabilities according to shared sid prefixes and aligns candidate distributions at successive levels from candidate groups to individual items. rigd evaluates the reduction in pairwise ranking surrogate loss when one student score contribution is replaced with the teacher's contribution and allocates supervision accordingly. experiments on real-world recommendation datasets using three lightweight student architectures demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy and better alignment of prefix marginal distributions and pairwise item rankings without modifying the student's online inference architecture. code is available at https //anonymous.4open.science/r/m7k2-review-83f9/.

musid-kd transfers semantic-id recommendation knowledge to lightweight students at multiple granularities. it aligns candidate distributions aggregated by shared prefixes and allocates token-level supervision according to estimated ranking impact. experiments with three student architectures report better recommendation accuracy and closer prefix and pairwise ranking alignment without changing online inference architecture. this is a training-side method for preserving ranking quality in compact generative recommenders.
musid-kd 在多个粒度上向轻量学生模型蒸馏语义标识符推荐知识。它按共享前缀聚合并对齐候选分布 再依据估计的排序影响分配各令牌位置的监督。三类学生架构的实验报告了推荐准确率、前缀分布和物品两两排序对齐的改善 在线推理架构保持不变。其价值是在训练阶段帮助紧凑生成式推荐模型保留排序质量。

looped transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. however each loop depends on the preceding loop so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. existing approaches include parallel loop transformers which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. to address this challenge we introduce loopfold which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. a lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. a corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. all components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. in experiments with 1.4b models deeper loopfold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. vanilla looped models and plt show limited gains over the same depth range. compared with a nine-loop vanilla model loopfold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

loopfold reduces sequential dependencies in looped transformers by predicting inputs to later loops executing multiple depths in parallel and correcting their outputs with newly available earlier states. in 1.4b language models deeper configurations improve average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks five sequential stages reduce decoding latency by 46% relative to a nine-loop vanilla model using additional parallel computation. this suggests a latency–compute trade-off for recurrent architectures with no recommendation evaluation reported.
loopfold 先预测后续循环的输入 让多个深度并行执行 再利用新得到的前序状态修正输出 以减少循环 transformer 的串行依赖。在 1.4b 语言模型中 更深配置提高了八项任务的平均零样本准确率 相对九次普通循环 五个串行阶段以额外并行计算换取 46% 的解码延迟下降。它提供了循环架构中延迟与计算量的权衡思路 尚未报告推荐实验。

looped transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. vanilla looped transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. these outputs may contain information useful several iterations later but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. we introduce stateloop which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. at each iteration a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. the updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. this design reduces pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over vanilla looped. its perplexity advantage over vanilla looped grows with trained loop depth consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

stateloop adds a persistent state to every token in a looped transformer. a learned gate retains and updates information across iterations and a projection feeds that state back into subsequent computation and prediction. it lowers pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks against vanilla looping with the perplexity advantage growing at greater trained depth. the mechanism is relevant to parameter-sharing architectures but transfer to ranking remains untested.
stateloop 为循环 transformer 的每个令牌增加持久状态 通过可学习门控在迭代间保留和更新信息 再将该状态投影回后续计算与预测。相对普通循环 它降低了 pile 困惑度并提高八项零样本任务的平均准确率 且困惑度优势随训练循环深度增加而扩大。该机制可供参数共享架构参考 迁移到排序仍待验证。

transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention. sparse attention can reduce this cost but effective sparsity must preserve useful long-range communication and map well to gpu hardware. we introduce intra--interleaved non-contiguous token sparse attention--a hardware-aware static sparse attention design based on a relay-communication view under computational query set cqs constraints. rather than directly covering all token-to-token interactions within each sparse layer intra uses complementary sparse groups to provide short mediated communication paths across layers. scatter forms relay groups that sample broadly across local neighborhoods while gather reconnects these groups in subsequent layers. under a partition model this structure guides cqs-compatible sparse patterns with global reachability. our cqs-aware flashattention-style kernel computes structured indices at runtime loads selected non-contiguous tokens and packs them densely for computation. on an a100 intra achieves a 1.53× speedup in 2k flux.1-dev generation with better measured image quality than evaluated clear configurations after lora self-distillation. on llama-3.1-8b it improves long-context prefill efficiency with strong teacher-forced retrieval performance under matched lora adaptation. attention-only benchmarks further show up to 8.4× and 10.4× speedups over moba and density-constrained nsa respectively.

intra uses complementary scatter and gather sparse token groups to relay information across layers with a gpu kernel that packs non-contiguous tokens for computation. after adaptation it reports a 1.53-fold flux.1-dev generation speedup on an a100 and improved long-context prefill efficiency for llama-3.1-8b. larger reported gains are attention-only benchmarks not end-to-end speedups. its hardware-aware static pattern offers a transferable sparse-attention design ctr performance is unverified.
intra 以互补的 scatter 和 gather 稀疏令牌组跨层传递信息 并由 gpu 内核将不连续令牌打包计算。经过适配后 它在 a100 上报告 flux.1-dev 生成加速 1.53 倍 并改善 llama-3.1-8b 的长上下文预填充效率。论文中更大的加速数字来自纯注意力基准 不能视为端到端收益。其硬件感知静态模式可供稀疏注意力设计参考 ctr 效果尚未验证。

we present hyscale a long-context training system for learned sparse attention. learned sparse attention is a promising architecture for million-token contexts widely adopted in production since deepseek-v3.2. selection however grows into the training bottleneck. for each query it scores every previous token whereas sparse attention reads only k worse current systems materialize a full score table and repeat selection during recomputation. our key insight is that the output of selection is not an activation but rather a set of indices. building on it hyscale introduces flashtopk and selection replay. flashtopk finds each query's exact top-k on the fly without a score table while selection replay reuses forward-pass selection in recomputation. together with holistic system optimizations tackling end-to-end challenges hyscale speeds up glm-5.1 training on 1m-token sequences by 2.07× over megatron-lm on 512 h20 gpus. it also speeds up the csa layers of deepseek-v4-flash and the qsa layers of qwen3.8-flash-next by 2.01× and 1.57× at 1m tokens on 32 h800 gpus.

hyscale targets the selection bottleneck in learned sparse-attention training. flashtopk computes exact top-k indices without materializing the score table and selection replay reuses forward selections during recomputation. with other system optimizations it speeds up million-token glm-5.1 training by 2.07 times over megatron-lm on 512 h20 gpus additional results measure individual attention layers on 32 h800 gpus. the selection and recomputation design is relevant to long-sequence training engineering with no ctr benchmark claimed.
hyscale处理可学习稀疏注意力训练中的选择瓶颈 flashtopk不保存完整分数表 直接求精确top-k索引 选择重放则在重计算阶段复用前向选择结果。结合其他系统优化 在512张h20上 百万token序列的glm-5.1训练速度为megatron-lm的2.07倍 另有在32张h800上测量单独注意力层的结果。其选择与重计算设计可供长序列训练工程参考 论文未验证ctr收益。

click-through rate ctr prediction relies on historical behaviors and contextual features to estimate clicks on a target item. existing transformer-based ctr models often adopt index-based or temporal positional encodings and token-level causal interaction. however we observe that most existing positional encodings do not outperform nope while relaxing causal constraints within target-relative temporal groups also yields gains. these observations motivate a fundamental question what positional encoding and interaction granularity does ctr prediction actually require to address this question we propose trip which combines target-aware rank--time positional encoding with temporal-group interaction modeling. specifically factorized rank encoding represents each behavior's ordinal position within the historical sequence through a low-rank factorization while target-relative time encoding characterizes its temporal distance to the target on a coarse-to-fine scale. this joint design grounds each behavior's positional representation in its sequence context and temporal relation to the current target. furthermore temporal group-causal interaction enriches intra-group representations through bidirectional interaction and masked reconstruction while preserving inter-group causal order. finally behavior representations are condensed into compact group summaries for efficient group-level modeling in subsequent layers. experiments on four public benchmarks show that trip improves auc by up to 4.45% relative to the strongest baseline.

trip combines factorized rank encoding and target-relative time encoding with temporal-group interactions for ctr prediction. bidirectional interaction and masked reconstruction operate within groups while causal order is preserved between groups compact group summaries support efficient later-layer modeling. on four public benchmarks the authors report up to 4.45% relative auc improvement over the strongest baseline.
trip 将低秩分解的序位编码、目标相对时间编码与时间分组交互结合 用于 ctr 预测。组内采用双向交互和掩码重建 组间保留因果顺序 并以紧凑的分组摘要降低后续层建模开销。在四个公开基准上 作者报告相对最强基线最高 4.45% 的 auc 提升。

generative recommendation gr models for ranking typically adopt a fast-thinking direct prediction paradigm with strong practical efficiency. however ranking requires fine-grained scoring across multiple candidate items while existing gr models still mainly rely on one-shot prediction. this raises the question whether additional inference-time computation can further improve ranking quality. recently inspired by chain-of-thought cot reasoning in large language models llms some work has begun to introduce reasoning into recommendation systems. some of these methods rely on llm reasoning frameworks to perform explicit reasoning in textual space but such designs are not suitable for more widely deployed non-textual recommendation models. a more relevant direction is to introduce latent reasoning into id-based recommendation models. although recent work has extended latent reasoning to industrial ranking how successive reasoning steps should improve fine-grained candidate scores remains less explored. to address this problem we propose refiner a latent residual reasoning framework with parameter-efficient fine-tuning for generative ranking. our approach introduces three key components 1 a residual reasoning mechanism that progressively refines ranking scores through cumulative additive corrections 2 history queries that provide condensed user behavior representations to enhance candidate-specific reasoning and 3 a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that leverages lora modules to adapt pre-trained models for latent reasoning. extensive experiments on two public benchmarks an offline industrial dataset and an online a/b test demonstrate that refiner consistently improves over direct prediction validating its effectiveness and practical utility.

refiner adds latent residual reasoning to generative ranking successive steps make additive corrections to candidate scores guided by condensed history queries. lora adapts pretrained models with parameter-efficient fine-tuning. experiments on two public benchmarks an industrial dataset and an online a/b test report consistent gains over direct prediction supporting additional inference-time computation for ranking.
refiner 为生成式排序引入潜在残差推理 利用压缩的历史查询引导候选级推理 通过连续的加性修正逐步改进分数 并以 lora 对预训练模型进行参数高效微调。两个公开基准、工业数据集及线上 a/b 测试均报告优于直接预测的结果 支持通过增加推理时计算改善排序。

generative retrieval models have been increasingly adopted in search and recommendation systems. however industrial generative retrieval models are commonly specialized to a fixed online scenario they learn from scenario-specific interactions support a narrow set of query forms and retrieval objectives. we study how to remove these couplings and build a unified end-to-end multimodal search system for open-ended image--text queries heterogeneous shopping intents and online scenarios with different resource constraints. we present pailitaommsearch which directly generates product semantic ids from a raw query image and free-form instruction and scales along three dimensions. data scaling uses a reusable toolset that can be composed into intent- and lifecycle-specific workflows for cold-start synthesis quality control real-traffic refinement and continuous data production. intent scaling progressively equips one model with e-commerce product knowledge multiple retrieval relations and adjustable reasoning budgets through continual pre-training cpt mixed-budget supervised fine-tuning sft and unified reinforcement learning rl . the rl stage combines intent-balanced optimization and sample--beam rollouts aligned with multi-candidate serving. scenario scaling exposes quality--cost operating points across model capacity and reasoning budget. the system is deployed in multimodal search applications on taobao pailitao. a controlled online a/b test reports statistically significant improvements including item page views +17.90% transactions +27.04% and gross merchandise value +8.94%.

pailitaommsearch directly generates product semantic ids from images and free-form instructions. it scales data workflows shopping intents and deployment scenarios through continual pretraining mixed-budget supervised fine-tuning and intent-balanced reinforcement learning with serving-aligned rollouts. a controlled online a/b test on taobao pailitao reports statistically significant gains of 17.90% in item page views 27.04% in transactions and 8.94% in gross merchandise value.
pailitaommsearch 从图像和自由文本指令直接生成商品语义 id 通过持续预训练、混合推理预算监督微调 以及兼顾意图平衡和服务端多候选生成的强化学习 扩展数据生产、购物意图和部署场景。淘宝拍立淘的受控线上 a/b 测试报告商品浏览量、交易量和成交总额分别显著提升 17.90%、27.04% 和 8.94%。

generative recommendation gr predicts the next item through its semantic id sid . existing methods commonly fit sid vocabularies to pretrained language model plm representations of item descriptions incurring additional training costs and making vocabulary coverage dependent on the fitting domains. we observe that pretrained sparse autoencoders expose plm features with human-interpretable semantic annotations allowing feature indices to serve as a reusable sid vocabulary. however reusing this vocabulary requires preserving item distinctions under compact token budgets and learning to favor target items over candidates with shared dominant features. it also requires extending feature interpretability from item content to retrieval decisions. to address these challenges we propose api a framework that adapts the pretrained interpretable vocabulary for effective and explainable gr without additional vocabulary learning. within api pretrained interpretable ids pids retain selected feature indices and relative activation strengths for item discrimination. with pids as supervision the semantic prediction adapter spa learns user preferences from interaction histories through joint feature-index and strength prediction. spa combines both predictions to score candidate items with item-level supervision encouraging the observed next item to outrank its alternatives. api further explains candidate score differences through feature contributions paired with their pretrained semantic annotations. extensive experiments show that api achieves competitive performance across backbones and decoding schemes while preserving item distinctions under compact token budgets and enabling explainable retrieval.

api reuses interpretable features from pretrained sparse autoencoders as a semantic-id vocabulary without training a new vocabulary. its ids retain feature indices and relative strengths a semantic prediction adapter jointly predicts both to score items from user histories. feature contributions explain candidate-score differences. experiments report competitive recommendation across backbones and decoding schemes while preserving item distinctions under compact token budgets.
api 复用预训练稀疏自编码器的可解释特征作为语义 id 词表 无需重新训练词表。其 id 保留特征索引和相对激活强度 语义预测适配器根据用户历史联合预测二者并给候选评分 以特征贡献解释分数差异。实验报告在不同骨干和解码方式下具有竞争力 并能在紧凑 token 预算内保留物品差异。

semantic id-based recommendation represents each item as a sequence of semantic tokens obtained through residual quantization. this paradigm generates the next item's tokens autoregressively from coarse to fine entailing each prediction attending to historical tokens at all semantic levels. however our inference-time analysis reveals that historical tokens at the target-token's semantic level tend to be more informative whereas other levels can introduce interference. motivated by these findings we propose lessrec that separately encodes the historical token sequence at each semantic level and restricts attention over historical tokens to the sequence at the target token's semantic level during prediction. to complement these level-specific histories lessrec explicitly provides an item-level semantic sequence that represents each historical item's overall semantics in chronological order. the decoder accesses the level-aligned token sequence and the item-level semantic sequence through two separate cross-attention branches and fuses their contexts. we further introduce lessrec+ which uses separate encoders for different semantic-level histories with the same total parameter count to reduce encoder computation. extensive experiments across three public datasets and three tokenizers demonstrate the recommendation effectiveness of lessrec and lessrec+ with efficiency analyses highlighting the computational benefits of lessrec+.

lessrec encodes semantic-id history separately by quantization level and restricts historical token attention to the target level. a second cross-attention branch accesses chronological item-level semantics to complement the level-specific context. lessrec+ uses separate level encoders at the same total parameter count to reduce encoder computation. three datasets and three tokenizers support recommendation effectiveness and the computational benefits of lessrec+.
lessrec 按语义 id 的量化层级分别编码历史 并让目标 token 只关注同层级的历史 token 另一交叉注意力分支读取按时间排列的物品级语义 补充层级上下文。lessrec+ 在总参数量不变时使用独立层级编码器以减少编码计算。三个数据集和三种 tokenizer 的实验支持其推荐效果及 lessrec+ 的计算收益。

coordinating multiple recommendation objectives e.g. click and conversion is critical for real-world generative recommendation gr . however since a positive item in gr can be retrieved only when its tokens are successively selected at every decoding step traditional item-wise methods lack fine-grained token-wise supervision to guide intermediate steps. motivated by its success in foundation models we consider introducing multi-objective on-policy distillation mopd into gr to distill two single-objective teachers into a student at each token. yet we find that in vanilla mopd i teachers exhibit unequal distillation difficulty at each token i.e. token-level imbalance and ii the harder-to-distill teacher varies across tokens i.e. cross-token inconsistency leaving each objective poorly learned at certain steps and hindering positive item retrieval for both objectives leading to suboptimal performance. to address this challenge we propose kl-mopd kl-weighted multi-objective on-policy distillation a simple yet effective distillation method that allocates token-wise teacher weights proportional to the initial student-teacher token-wise kl divergences thereby strengthening supervision for the harder-to-distill teacher at every decoding step. despite its simplicity we theoretically prove that kl-mopd strictly outperforms vanilla mopd in the additive joint recommendation objective under mild conditions. moreover kl-mopd is plug-and-play and computationally efficient requiring only a one-time pre-training weight calibration with negligible training overhead. extensive experiments on three public benchmarks a billion-scale industrial dataset and online a/b tests on our e-commerce advertising platform demonstrate that kl-mopd significantly improves both individual and joint recommendation performance. the anonymous code is provided for peer review.

kl-mopd distills single-objective teachers into a multi-objective generative recommender weighting each teacher at each token by the initial student-teacher kl divergence. this prioritizes harder-to-distill objectives with one-time calibration and negligible training overhead. the paper proves improvement over vanilla multi-objective on-policy distillation under stated mild conditions and reports individual and joint objective gains on public benchmarks a billion-scale industrial dataset and online advertising tests.
kl-mopd 将单目标教师蒸馏到多目标生成式推荐学生中 按初始学生与教师的 token 级 kl 散度分配权重 增强较难蒸馏目标的监督 仅需一次校准 训练额外开销很小。论文在所述温和条件下证明其优于普通多目标在策略蒸馏 并在公开基准、十亿级工业数据和线上广告测试中报告单目标与联合目标收益。

personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. generative recommendation gr offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic ids sids of items. however randomly initialized sid token embeddings and gr models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. to address this limitation we propose reger a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining history encoding and sid generation. we pretrain the gr model through generative semantic retrieval enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' sids. we combine global attention with local attention aligned with sid boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. we further develop a theoretical framework for hierarchical preference decomposition over the sid prefix tree proving an exact factorization of collaborative preference distributions and a weighted decomposition of item-level kl divergence into prefix-conditional kl divergences. building on this analysis we distill a discriminative teacher's full conditional distributions over all legal next tokens at ground-truth prefixes along the target sid path jointly optimizing this objective with cross-entropy. extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing gr baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.
