reger explicitly models inter-item relations through semantic-neighbor sid pretraining combined global and sid-boundary local attention and discriminative-teacher preference distillation. a hierarchical sid-prefix analysis factorizes collaborative preferences and item-level kl divergence motivating distillation over all legal next tokens along target prefixes. experiments on real-world datasets report consistent gains over generative-recommendation baselines.
reger 通过语义邻居 sid 预训练、全局与 sid 边界局部注意力结合 以及判别式教师偏好蒸馏 显式建模物品间关系。对 sid 前缀树的层级分析分解协同偏好及物品级 kl 散度 据此在目标前缀上蒸馏全部合法下一 token 的分布。真实数据集实验报告持续优于生成式推荐基线。

self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of large language models. recently multi-state linear attention msla mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. msla aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. in order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation we propose merlin moment routing for multi-state linear attention a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. using the moments of keys a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. experiments on multi-state variants of gated deltanet-1.3b and mamba-2-780m show that merlin consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. in particular merlin outperforms baselines on ruler needle-in-a-haystack and long-context qa +8.3% for gated deltanet-1.3b and +7.0% for mamba-2-780m and diverse subtasks in longbench +13.5% and +12.0% . it even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. merlin provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of msla models.

merlin improves multi-state linear attention by tracking first and second moments of segment keys allowing queries to use both mean and variance of alignment when combining memory-state readouts. tests on gated deltanet-1.3b and mamba-2-780m report stronger long-context retrieval and question answering including improvements over baselines using four times more memory. the method offers a general content-aware routing design for compressed sequence states.
merlin 跟踪各片段键向量的一阶与二阶矩 使查询在聚合多状态线性注意力输出时同时利用对齐均值和方差。在 gated deltanet-1.3b 与 mamba-2-780m 上 实验报告长上下文检索和问答改进 甚至超过使用四倍内存的基线 为压缩序列状态提供通用的内容感知路由设计。

sparse mixture-of-experts moe language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with muon-family optimizers. we introduce energycal a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared frobenius norm of their finite-step newton-schulz directions. energycal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. we evaluate it on a 4b-parameter moe model. against a development-selected lower-learning-rate muonh recipe energycal-muonh reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06% with a modest throughput cost. with plain muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents accompanied by small endpoint improvements. these findings support stabilization both with and without hyperball in the evaluated setting.

energycal attenuates routed-expert updates using normalized squared frobenius norms of finite-step newton-schulz directions leaving the spectral transform unchanged and adding no persistent optimizer state. on a 4b-parameter sparse moe it reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06% relative to a selected lower-learning-rate muonh recipe with modest throughput cost. plain-muon experiments also show stabilization within the evaluated settings.
energycal 按有限步 newton-schulz 更新方向的归一化 frobenius 范数平方衰减路由专家更新 不改变谱变换 也不增加持久优化器状态。在 40 亿参数稀疏 moe 上 相对经开发选择的较低学习率 muonh 配方 阈值化损失尖峰负担均值下降 99.51% 最终几何平均困惑度下降 4.06% 吞吐代价适中。普通 muon 实验也在所评测设定下显示稳定性收益。

attention matching am compacts a kv cache by keeping some keys per head refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. flashattention and vllm's paged caches have no input for it. we fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head fitted on context queries giving a plain cache with am's size and head dimension and the model's own query path the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. with equal per-head budgets unmodified vllm serves folded caches through a kv connector matching hugging face's answers on all 51 qwen3-4b questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 qwen3-14b longbench samples. with equal budgets on quality qwen3-1.7b 4b 8b llama-3.1-8b and longhealth three qwen3 models the fold is within noise of am's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings with lower kl to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. under the published per-head budgets on qwen3-4b its instruct-2507 variant and llama-3.1-8b it is within noise of am in 9 of 10 no longer beats dropping the bias in kl and the two each win once in accuracy.

the method folds attention matching logit biases into retained keys along one fitted direction per head producing compact kv caches compatible with standard attention kernels and the original query path. unmodified vllm serves these caches through a connector. under equal head budgets accuracy is within noise of attention matching in 13 of 14 tested settings results are less uniformly favorable under the published per-head budgets emphasizing budget-dependent tradeoffs.
该方法沿每个注意力头拟合的一条方向 将 attention matching 的 logit 偏置折叠到保留的键中 得到兼容标准注意力内核及原查询路径的压缩 kv 缓存 可经连接器由未修改的 vllm 服务。在各头预算相同的测试中 14 个设定有 13 个准确率与 attention matching 的差异处于噪声范围 采用其公开的逐头预算时优势不再一致 说明效果依赖预算配置。

in expert-parallel mixture-of-experts moe serving dispatch moves tokens to the accelerators hosting their selected experts and combine returns expert outputs to each token's owner. both operations lie on the critical path and can dominate moe layer latency in multi-node deployments. we present inc-moe an expert-parallel moe layer that offloads dispatch and combine to the network switch and overlaps both collectives with each other and with expert computation. dispatch uses in-network allgather through switch-side multicast while combine uses in-network reducescatter through switch-side reduction. both collectives use message semantics between the end hosts and the switch. because the in-network collectives load opposite directions of each link executing them concurrently reduces bandwidth-bound communication time by $ n-2 / 2 n-1 $ relative to concurrent ring-based collectives 33% for four ranks and 43% for eight. inc-moe partitions tokens into bands and processes them through a three-stage allgather-feed-forward network ffn -reducescatter pipeline inside a single persistent kernel. at steady state role-specialized thread blocks gather the next band compute the current band and reduce the previous band concurrently overlapping both collectives with each other and with computation using device-side synchronization. inc-moe integrates as a drop-in replacement for the moe layer of vllm. we evaluate it in an emulated four-node scale-out deployment with a dedicated accelerator emulating an in-network computing inc switch. on olmoe prefill with four-way expert parallelism inc-moe reduces time to first token ttft by up to 33% and increases throughput by up to 50% relative to vllm's default collective path while matching its outputs.

inc-moe offloads expert-parallel dispatch and combine to switch-side multicast and reduction overlapping these collectives with expert computation through a banded persistent-kernel pipeline. it integrates as a vllm moe-layer replacement. in an emulated four-node deployment using a dedicated accelerator as the network switch olmoe prefill reduces time to first token by up to 33% and raises throughput by up to 50% while matching outputs.
inc-moe 将专家并行的分发与合并卸载到交换机侧的组播和归约 并通过分带持久内核流水线使通信与专家计算重叠 可替换 vllm 的 moe 层。在以专用加速器模拟网络交换机的四节点部署中 olmoe 预填充的首 token 延迟最高降低 33% 吞吐最高提升 50% 同时保持输出一致。

mixture-of-experts moe models are bottlenecked by loading routed-expert weights from memory during interactive decoding at small batch sizes. because most intermediate channels in a routed expert contribute little to any single token channel selectors predict which channels matter and read only their weights typically keeping channels above a threshold calibrated on offline data. we show that channel selection needs no calibration data. first a calibrated threshold does not fix how much a selector reads because the number of channels passing it varies across inputs prox with thresholds calibrated for an 18% read budget actually reads only 12.9% on average across our benchmarks. second top-k keeps each token's k highest-scoring channels and needs no calibration data. at the calibrated budget a selector's top-k version matches or beats its threshold version on the same score in 40 of 43 comparisons at 13% and 18% budgets including all 23 on generation tasks. the top-k versions also avoid the repetition-loop collapse that calibrated thresholds cause on gemma 4. calibrating a threshold thus provides neither of the two things selectors use it for a known read budget and a consistent accuracy gain at that budget. we furthermore introduce a reader built entirely from the model's weights which screens channels with a ternary sketch and recovers the skipped ones with a low-rank map. across three post-trained moe models our reader retains 98.1% of full-model accuracy at 17.8% of routed-expert reads with triton kernels running moe blocks 1.60 to 1.90x faster than optimized vllm at batch one and up to 2.69x at larger batches on the same three models.

the paper replaces calibrated channel-selection thresholds with per-token top-k selection for predictable routed-expert read budgets. it also builds a weight-only reader using a ternary sketch and low-rank recovery of skipped channels. across three post-trained moe models the reader retains 98.1% of full-model accuracy at 17.8% of expert-weight reads triton moe blocks run 1.60–1.90x faster than optimized vllm at batch one and up to 2.69x at larger batches.
论文以逐 token 的 top-k 通道选择替代依赖校准数据的阈值 固定路由专家的读取预算 并提出仅依据模型权重、结合三值草图与低秩补偿的读取器。在三个后训练 moe 模型上 以 17.8% 的专家权重读取保留全模型 98.1% 的准确率 triton moe 模块在批量为一时相对优化后的 vllm 加速 1.60–1.90 倍 在较大批量时最高 2.69 倍。

variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. the longest samples require wide sequence-parallel sp groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. sparse-attention layers dominated by near-linear moe work can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local sp8 groups. reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer. layerwise repacking keeps each sp16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at sp 1 2 4 8 where hidden states persist between full layers. the layout change rides on the two existing full-layer ulysses sites at each one variable-size all-to-all performs both the head exchange and the sample repacking so no redistribution pass is added. because the balance the children can reach depends on which samples share a parent an auxiliary parent solver rebalances parent membership before the children are formed. on all 22 steps with sp16/32 parents among the first 200 training steps of a 1f3s hybrid-attention model one full-attention layer per three sparse-attention layers repacking alone reduces the mean end-to-end time by 5.95% and raises model flops utilization mfu by 3.75 percentage points over the baseline with repacking disabled with the improved solver end-to-end time falls by 7.61% and mfu rises by 4.83 percentage points.

layerwise repacking adapts sequence-parallel groups to variable-length hybrid-attention training wide groups serve full-attention layers while node-local child groups serve sparse layers. sample repacking shares existing ulysses all-to-all exchanges avoiding an extra redistribution pass. on the 22 relevant steps among the first 200 steps of a 1f3s model repacking plus a parent-group solver reduces mean end-to-end time by 7.61% and increases mfu by 4.83 percentage points.
layerwise repacking 针对变长混合注意力训练 让全注意力层使用较宽的序列并行组 稀疏层使用节点内子组 样本重排复用已有 ulysses all-to-all 交换 避免额外再分发。在一个 1f3s 模型前 200 步中符合条件的 22 步上 结合父组优化求解器后 平均端到端耗时降低 7.61% mfu 提高 4.83 个百分点。

under a fixed embedding-storage budget recommenders can use a small full-precision model a distilled student or a higher-rank low-precision model. we asked which choice preserves rare-item recall and whether teacher fidelity reflects it in seven dataset-backbone cells matrix factorization on gowalla last.fm amazon video games steam goodbooks-10k and movielens-20m and lightgcn on amazon video games. seven candidates fit in 168 bytes per user or item row 40-dimensional bayesian personalized ranking bpr two 40-dimensional unbiased knowledge distillation unkd students and factorizations of a 300-dimensional teacher's scores at ranks 40 80 155 and 300 stored in 32 16 8 and 4 bits. each test set was evaluated once after fixing candidates and confirmatory analyses. the rank-300 4-bit factorization used 13% of teacher storage and retained 95-103% of its tail recall@20 and 93-97% of its ndcg@20 in every cell. the rank-40 factorization had the lowest tail recall in every cell the 4-bit factorization had 1.2-12.7 times its tail recall and 0.99-1.46 times its ndcg. unkd students retained 56-102% of teacher tail recall. in all ten prespecified comparisons across five prospective-expansion cells the 4-bit factorization had higher tail recall with simultaneous 95% intervals excluding zero. teacher-hit retention the share of the teacher's relevant tail hits also found by a model ordered 23 of 147 candidate pairs differently from tail recall and identified the wrong tail-recall leader in 3 of 7 cells models can find relevant tail items the teacher misses. in these cells spending bytes on rank rather than precision preserved rare-item recall at 7.5 times the arithmetic per score. compressed recommenders should be judged by total tail recall not teacher fidelity alone.

under a fixed embedding-storage budget the study compares low-dimensional models distilled students and higher-rank low-precision factorizations across seven dataset-backbone cells. a rank-300 4-bit factorization uses 13% of teacher storage while retaining 95–103% of tail recall@20 and 93–97% of ndcg@20 at 7.5 times the arithmetic per score. teacher-hit retention can misrank candidates so the authors recommend assessing total rare-item recall directly.
该研究在固定嵌入存储预算下 比较低维模型、蒸馏学生和较高秩低精度分解 覆盖七个数据集—骨干组合。秩 300 的 4 位分解仅使用教师 13% 的存储 保留其 95–103% 的长尾 recall@20 和 93–97% 的 ndcg@20 但每次评分的算术量增加至 7.5 倍。教师命中保留率可能错误排序候选方法 因此作者建议直接评价总的稀有物品召回。

high-quality representations are a core requirement for effective recommendation. in this work we study the problem of llm-based descriptor generation i.e. keyphrase-like natural language item representation generation frameworks with minimal constraints on downstream applications. we propose agentictagger a framework that queries llms for representing items with sequences of text descriptors. however open-ended generation provides little control over the generation space leading to high cardinality low-performance descriptors that render downstream modeling challenging. to this end agentictagger features two core stages 1 a vocabulary-building stage in which a set of hierarchical low-cardinality and high-quality descriptors is identified and 2 a vocabulary-assignment stage in which llms assign in-vocabulary descriptors to items. to effectively and efficiently ground vocabulary in the item corpus of interest we design a multi-agent reflection mechanism in which an architect llm iteratively refines the vocabulary guided by parallelized feedback from annotator llms that validate the vocabulary against item data. experiments on public and private data show agentictagger brings consistent improvements across diverse recommendation scenarios including generative and term-based retrieval ranking and controllability-oriented critique-based recommendation.

agentictagger addresses uncontrolled high-cardinality item descriptors by building a hierarchical vocabulary and assigning its descriptors to items with llms. an architect model refines the vocabulary using annotator-agent feedback. public and private evaluations report improvements across generative and term-based retrieval ranking and critique-based recommendation.
agentictagger针对自由生成商品描述时词汇过散、难以建模的问题 先构建分层且规模受控的描述词表 再由大模型为商品分配词表内标签。架构代理根据标注代理的反馈反复改进词表 公开及私有数据实验显示其可改善生成式与词项检索、排序及基于用户反馈的推荐。

graph-based approximate nearest neighbor ann indexes such as hnsw are the backbone of modern vector search. however their massive memory footprint creates a severe infrastructure bottleneck. while vector quantization is widely adopted to reduce the memory required to store data vectors the graph's edge structure increasingly dominates total memory usage. compressing these adjacency lists for online search presents a critical system challenge because decompression occurs during query processing i.e. while navigating the graph memory savings cannot come at the expense of query latency. in this paper we present a compression technique explicitly tailored for live hnsw routing. by applying offline graph permutations to artificially induce structural locality we enable the use of simd-accelerated integer compressors such as stream vbyte for rapid on-the-fly decompression. evaluated across diverse real-world workloads we significantly outperform the current state of the art in both compression ratio and query latency. our experimental results show that we achieve compression ratios up to 52.7% with negligible penalties in latency compared to the uncompressed baseline. furthermore our technique has been effectively deployed in production at ebay achieving up to 44.3% reduction in edge storage with no degradation in query latency.

this work reduces hnsw graph-edge storage by permuting nodes offline to create locality and applying simd-accelerated integer compression during online traversal. it reports compression ratios up to 52.7% with negligible latency penalties an ebay deployment reduces edge storage by up to 44.3% without query-latency degradation. the savings concern graph edges rather than the entire retrieval service.
该研究通过离线重排节点增强邻接表局部性 再以simd整数压缩支持查询时快速解码 减少hnsw图边的内存开销。实验报告最高52.7%的压缩比例且延迟代价很小 ebay生产部署中 边存储最多减少44.3% 查询延迟未退化。这里的节省针对图边 而非整个检索服务。

embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth width or dense computation. extending this idea to vision-language models vlms is challenging because visual features are continuous spatially structured and query-dependent unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. we introduce v-lumen a visual lookup memory for vlms. v-lumen discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals all addressing is non-parametric and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. on five reasoning-intensive benchmarks v-lumen substantially improves a frozen qwen3-vl-2b backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. at a matched parameter budget moving part of a lora or moe adapter's capacity into v-lumen preserves accuracy on two backbones indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. code is available at https //github.com/miso-choi/v-lumen.

v-lumen expands vision-language capacity with a lookup table instead of additional dense per-token computation. a frozen codebook discretizes visual features spatial hashing and text-conditioned relevance address memory whose embeddings enter the backbone through gated residuals. tests on five reasoning benchmarks and three disjoint-image transfer benchmarks support this capacity axis matched-budget lora/moe comparisons preserve accuracy on two backbones. lookup occurs once at prefill and is constant in table size.
v-lumen将视觉特征经固定码本离散化 用空间哈希和文本相关性寻址外部记忆 再通过门控残差接入视觉语言模型 以存储扩容代替增加逐token稠密计算。五个推理基准和三个图像不重叠的迁移基准验证了这条容量扩展路径 在两个骨干上 将部分lora或moe容量转入记忆仍能保持准确率。查表仅发生在预填充阶段 其成本不随表大小增长。

we present embeddinggemma 2 an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text images audio video and combinations thereof in a unified space. our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal cross-modal and mixed-modal evaluations. notably in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities embeddinggemma 2 establishes a new pareto frontier outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. furthermore our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments supporting selective modality encoder loading adjustable vision token budgets truncatable embedding dimensions and quantized weights. we present ablations analyzing key decisions and release embeddinggemma 2 to promote further research.

embeddinggemma 2 places text images audio video and mixed inputs in one embedding space. simplified per-layer embeddings and a staged modality/objective curriculum support quality across modalities. the reported benchmarks outperform specialist and 2–12x larger models selective encoder loading adjustable visual-token budgets truncatable dimensions and quantized weights provide deployment tradeoffs.
embeddinggemma 2把文本、图像、音频、视频及混合输入映射到同一表征空间 通过简化逐层embedding和分阶段模态/目标课程训练提升跨模态质量。论文报告在所测基准中超过专用模型及规模大2至12倍的模型 并提供按需加载模态编码器、调整视觉token预算、截断向量维度和权重量化等部署选项。

daily item co-occurrence embeddings are paired with next-day behavior without future-behavior leakage. multi-day click-through rate ctr training therefore mixes versions whose directions and norms may differ for the same item. we compare word2vec and an item-graph xsimgcl adaptation across initialization inheritance post-processing training constraints and downstream augmentation. the inventory contains 48 configurations including 32 common-protocol ctr evaluations. observed metrics are reported as relative percentage changes from the corresponding word2vec baseline 0% with raw values and exact dataset sizes withheld. three findings emerge. first multiple upstream interventions improve compatibility and ctr. id-init and orthogonal alignment increase cosine by 51.2% and 93.4% and gauc by 2.2% and 2.6% relative to ordinary word2vec. retrieval and geometry remain insufficient downstream surrogates. second warm starts perform strongly but accumulate scale. the day-matched norm increase over word2vec reaches 102.5% after eight days daily global rescaling limits it to 8.2% and attains the highest observed gauc increase 4.0%. third ctr learning through a dimensionality-reducing encoder further adapts to residual drift. against dimension-matched random-projection svd and untrained-network controls trained encoders attain the highest cross-day cosine for four of six upstream methods. the other two rank third and second in train-to-test cosine. these industrial results support complementary roles for upstream stabilization inherited-scale management and downstream task learning.

this empirical study examines daily item-embedding drift in multi-day ctr training through 48 configurations including 32 common-protocol ctr evaluations. alignment warm-start scale control and downstream encoders play complementary roles. daily global rescaling achieves the highest observed gauc gain of 4.0% relative to the corresponding word2vec baseline. raw metric values and exact dataset sizes are withheld and better retrieval or geometric compatibility does not necessarily imply better ctr.
该研究分析每天更新的商品embedding在跨日ctr训练中出现的方向与尺度漂移 比较48种配置 其中32种进行了统一协议ctr评测。对齐、热启动后的尺度控制和下游编码器各有作用 每日全局重缩放取得所测最高gauc相对增幅4.0% 基线为对应word2vec配置。论文未公开原始指标与精确数据规模 检索或几何相容性改善也不必然对应ctr收益。

sequential recommendation models typically predict a user's next action from recent session interactions which limits personalization when short-term signals are weak or ambiguous. rather than assuming that incorporating longer-term history and community signals is universally beneficial we study when it actually helps. we propose behaverec a three-signal framework combining a causal session transformer a bidirectional user history encoder over a 90-day window and a graphsage module over a user-user graph built from behavioral embedding similarity rather than item co-occurrence a learned gate blends the three signals per user. on an industrial dataset of 137m sequences from 12.6m users behaverec improves r@5 by +3.2% over sasrec with a larger-capacity sasrec baseline more parameters than behaverec still trailing by +2.5% ruling out capacity as the explanation. more importantly a user-level stratification by history length reveals a clear dose-response relationship behaverec's advantage is negligible below roughly 10 interactions and grows monotonically with history richness reaching +0.017 r@5 for users with 101+ events. this pattern is corroborated across one industrial and three public datasets spanning history-rich to history-sparse regimes where session-only models remain preferable. these headline results and the resulting deployment threshold are established for category-level intent prediction a preliminary single-run check on the full item-level vocabulary yields a directionally mixed result and is scoped as an open question rather than a claim. we use these results to derive a practical deployment rule -- roughly 20 interactions per user -- for when long-term history and behavioral-graph signals are worth their added complexity. despite this added complexity behaverec remains lightweight it uses 5.67m parameters and trains on a single gpu in under two days.

behaverec gates together a causal session transformer a 90-day history encoder and a behavioral-similarity user graph. on an industrial dataset with 137 million sequences from 12.6 million users it reports a 3.2% r@5 gain over sasrec with benefits increasing as histories become richer. its roughly 20-interaction deployment rule concerns category-level intent prediction item-level findings are mixed and history-sparse settings may favor session-only models.
behaverec用门控融合近期会话transformer、90天历史编码器和基于行为相似性的用户图 研究哪些用户值得加入长历史信号。在覆盖1260万用户、1.37亿序列的工业数据上 论文报告相对sasrec的r@5增幅为3.2% 收益随历史丰富程度增加。约20次交互的部署建议针对类别级意图预测 商品级结果并不一致 历史稀疏时仅用会话可能更合适。

for efficiency industrial large language model llm labelers often pack many candidate labels into one prompt and generate a yes/no answer for each even when each decision depends only on the entity and one candidate. generating these independent decisions as one answer list couples them spends decoding on the list and relies on the list being well-formed. in this paper we present an end-to-end recipe that reformulates the labeler as semantic scoring fine-tuning it on single-candidate prompts to return each decision as one answer-token score from a prefill-only pass. we also adapt multiple-item scoring mis to score hundreds of candidates in one sequence with attention masked between them. deployed for profile qualification labeling at linkedin semantic scoring changes at most 0.01% of decisions when candidates are reordered and matches the agreement with reference labels that packed generation reaches only with about 4.7x as many training pairs. the mis-based stack raises throughput over the deployed stack by 1.24x offline and 1.9x in model serving under a one-second p99 latency target. for offline batch inference we implement mis-based scoring as a reusable model-agnostic ray data api proposed for upstream adoption. model serving uses mis support contributed to sglang.

linkedin replaces packed yes/no label generation with single-candidate semantic scores from a prefill-only pass and masks attention between candidates to score hundreds together with multiple-item scoring. candidate reordering changes at most 0.01% of decisions. compared with the deployed stack throughput rises 1.24x offline and 1.9x in serving under a one-second p99 target. the application is profile qualification labeling not an online ctr gain.
linkedin将一串yes/no标签的生成改成单候选语义打分 只做预填充 并通过候选间注意力隔离在一个序列里同时评估数百候选。候选重排最多改变0.01%的决策 相对原部署栈 离线吞吐为1.24倍 在p99一秒目标下在线吞吐为1.9倍。实验用于个人资料资质标签生成 不应解读为线上ctr提升。

the key-value kv cache places growing demands on gpu memory capacity and bandwidth as large language models serve longer contexts and more concurrent requests. its footprint limits concurrency while repeated kv reads during attention can make decoding memory-bandwidth bound. prior lossless kv cache compression methods reduce transfers between devices but restore the uncompressed kv cache in gpu memory before attention. they therefore leave these repeated kv reads unchanged and require additional work and memory for decompression. we present zipfusion which enables attention to consume the losslessly compressed kv cache directly. zipfusion co-designs the compression format and attention kernel to reduce the bytes read from gpu memory during attention. the kernel reconstructs the original values directly in registers using simple bit operations avoiding a separate decompression pass and easing the memory-bandwidth bound. zipfusion also reassigns memory freed by compression across layers to store additional kv cache. its memory manager reserves space for ongoing generation and makes the remaining capacity available to new requests. we implement zipfusion on top of flashinfer and integrate it with sglang. on an nvidia h100 zipfusion achieves about 1.25x speedup over flashinfer in decode attention. with 8k context it improves model decode throughput by up to 26.3% over uncompressed sglang under the same gpu memory budget. at each method's largest supported batch it also delivers up to 2.76x the throughput of the best-performing lossless kv cache compression baseline.

zipfusion co-designs a lossless kv format and attention kernel so compressed values are reconstructed directly in registers avoiding a separate decompression pass and reducing gpu memory reads. integrated with flashinfer and sglang it reports about 1.25x decode-attention speed on h100 and up to 26.3% higher model decoding throughput at 8k context under the same gpu-memory budget. the up-to-2.76x comparison uses each lossless-compression baseline at its largest supported batch.
zipfusion联合设计无损kv格式与注意力内核 在寄存器中直接恢复原值 省去单独解压过程并减少显存读取。它基于flashinfer并接入sglang 在h100上报告约1.25倍的解码注意力速度 同等显存预算、8k上下文下 模型解码吞吐最多提升26.3%。相对其他无损压缩方案最高2.76倍的结果采用各自可支持的最大batch。

effective discrete representation learning with vq-vae serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. however it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. to address this issue we propose flowvq a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. specifically we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training corresponding to a probability flow ode that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. based on this we define the codebook c_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes c_0 from the source space through the learned flow and obtaining the voronoi centroids under the induced distribution leading to a structured discretization. we evaluated on image tokenization and generation as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.

flowvq tackles vq-vae codebook collapse by jointly learning a latent distribution with a lightweight flow-matching model and constructing codes from equal-quantile partitions transported through that flow. voronoi centroids provide the resulting structured discretization. image tokenization/generation and two high-precision tokenization tasks show scalable expressive codebooks with full utilization recommendation semantic ids remain a potential application rather than an evaluated result.
flowvq针对vq-vae码本坍塌 将轻量流匹配学习与量化结合 把源分布等分位划分得到的初始码通过概率流搬运 再构造voronoi质心形成结构化码本。图像token化、生成和两项高精度token化任务显示其可扩展性、表达能力与完整码本利用率 推荐语义id属于可借鉴方向 尚非论文已验证的结果。

dense retrievers are a foundational component underlying modern rag and search systems. training these models typically requires a curated collection of annotated query-document pairs which are prohibitively expensive to obtain outside a handful of well-resourced domains. this has motivated a line of work that leverages large-scale unsupervised retrieval pretraining from unlabelled text alone. most such methods learn by optimizing a language modelling or contrastive learning objective over short spans within a document. this raises the question how can we extract richer learning signals from a single document for retrieval pretraining to address it we introduce xprt cross-passage retrieval pretraining an unsupervised framework that learns from the key information distributed across an entire document and the connections between its parts. we evaluate xprt against five state-of-the-art objectives on mteb english v2 continuing pretraining from a public unsupervised checkpoint while holding the corpus schedule and training procedure fixed. across diverse tasks spanning all task types we observe that xprt consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.2% on an average. notably in this continual pretraining setting many baseline methods incur substantial performance regressions whereas our method delivers the largest complementary gains over the initial pretrained checkpoint. controlled ablations confirm that xprt's performance gains stem from its proposed cross-passage signals. xprt demonstrates that a single unlabelled document is a much richer source of retrieval signal than prior work assumed and offers complementary gains to what current retrievers already capture.

xprt learns unsupervised dense-retrieval representations from information distributed across a document and the links between its passages. controlled continual-pretraining comparisons with five objectives on mteb english v2 report improvements over the strongest baseline. its cross-passage supervision offers a possible way to use unlabeled text for retrieval pretraining ctr gains are not established.
xprt 从一篇文档不同段落的信息及其联系中构造监督信号 训练无需查询—文档标注的稠密检索模型。在固定语料和训练流程的 mteb english v2 持续预训练比较中 作者报告优于五种对照目标中的最佳方法。可借鉴的是从无标注文本中提取更丰富的检索监督 摘要未验证 ctr 收益。

query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. we present r2qrec which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff while a kl penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. the stages have distinct roles verification identifies expressions to imitate and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. only the query generator is trained the retriever and item index remain fixed and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. across three public datasets r2qrec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.

r2qrec trains a recommendation-query generator while keeping the retriever and item index fixed. queries that retrieve observed items provide supervised targets subsequent policy refinement uses item log-rank in fused results with a kl constraint. experiments on three public datasets report leading overall performance among evaluated methods suggesting a way to improve generated queries without rebuilding the retrieval system.
r2qrec 固定检索器和物品索引 只训练推荐查询生成器 先把能找回已交互物品的查询作为监督目标 再依据多条查询合并结果中该物品的对数排名优化策略 并限制策略偏离。作者在三个公开数据集上报告了所比较方法中领先的整体效果。可借鉴的是用现有检索反馈改进生成查询 无需重建检索系统。

large language models llms have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. however processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. while sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. to better understand and mitigate this trade-off we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for llm-based listwise ranking. our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. to this end we propose gistrank a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training and adapting the model to the listwise objective. gistrank collapses each passage into only k=4 gist tokens this gives 14× speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average ndcg@10 over trec dl19/20 and five beir subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. overall gistrank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

gistrank compresses each passage into four learned gist tokens for llm listwise ranking. semi-bidirectional compression training is followed by pairwise comparison and listwise adaptation. on trec dl19/20 and five beir subsets the abstract reports a 14-fold speedup over one-shot full-text ranking and average ndcg@10 of 59.17 within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. the design is relevant to reducing reranking input cost rather than a demonstrated ctr improvement.
gistrank 将每篇候选文本压成四个可学习的摘要 token 再做大模型列表排序 训练依次学习半双向压缩、成对比较和列表排序。摘要报告 在 trec dl19/20 与五个 beir 子集上 相比一次性全文排序加速 14 倍 平均 ndcg@10 为 59.17 与最强全文对照相差不超过 0.89。可借鉴的是通过保留比较所需信息来降低重排输入成本 尚非 ctr 效果验证。

generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier sid one code at a time. early codes select broad branches so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. in multimodal recommendation these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. we introduce rofigr a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both sid construction and generation. it aligns cumulative l1-l2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. during generation a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. on instruments arts and games rofigr improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. five-seed paired tests with holm correction support the main ndcg@10 improvements. comparisons with alternative collaborative supervision objectives and tokenizers support the proposed design. matched task and decoding analyses distinguish the effects of training exposure stream fusion and candidate budgets.

rofigr targets early routing errors in multimodal semantic-id recommendation. it aligns coarse code representations with collaborative item embeddings and uses a sequential teacher to supervise valid generation branches combining fixed coarse-level weights with bounded adaptive adjustments. results on instruments arts and games improve all five reported ranking metrics over evaluated external baselines with corrected five-seed tests supporting the main ndcg@10 gains. it offers a design for preserving collaborative preferences during coarse-to-fine generation.
rofigr 关注多模态生成式推荐中前几位物品编码选错分支、后面便无法找回目标的问题。它用协同物品表征约束粗粒度编码 再由序列教师监督合法生成分支 以固定粗层权重配合有界自适应调整。三个数据集上的五项排序指标均优于所比较的外部基线 五随机种子并经多重检验校正的结果支持主要 ndcg@10 提升。可借鉴的是让粗到细的生成过程保留协同偏好。

list-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content ads and candidates from other businesses while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. meanwhile generative ranking over heterogeneous multi-business candidates remains less explored particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price gsp auctions. we propose unified generative ranking ugr which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. to go beyond exposure-sequence imitation ugr introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. ugr uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and gsp pricing rules. multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality while online a/b tests on taobao's guess you like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in core ipv 3.29% in transaction volume and 2.10% in gmv over the production baseline.

ugr generates ranked lists from the full request-level pool of heterogeneous e-commerce candidates typically around a thousand in production. candidate-aware autoregressive decoding is trained with feedback-weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization. a training-time ad-debiasing tower and serving-time ad-value integration retain existing allocation and generalized second-price auction rules. online tests on taobao's guess you like service report gains over the production baseline offering a practical design for unified multi-business generative ranking.
ugr 从一次请求的完整候选池中生成排序列表 统一处理自然推荐、广告等异构业务 生产环境通常包含约一千个候选。模型通过候选感知的自回归解码生成列表 再用反馈加权的监督微调和排列偏好优化学习曝光后的反馈。训练时校正历史广告曝光影响 服务时纳入当前广告价值 同时保留既有分配和广义第二价格拍卖规则。淘宝 猜你喜欢 的线上测试报告了相对生产基线的收益 为多业务统一生成式排序提供了实践参考。

long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation gr but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. to accelerate long-sequence decoding existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention however the former risks losing critical semantics whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. in this work we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during gr decoding and reveal two key properties i progressive attention focusing where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens and ii cross-step ranking consistency where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. motivated by these observations we propose progressively focused attention pfa an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence gr. pfa retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. it then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that pfa outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. a 7-day online a/b test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that pfa delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. our code is publicly available at https //anonymous.4open.science/r/pfa-review-088d.

pfa reduces long-history attention overhead during autoregressive beam-search decoding for generative recommendation. it uses full attention initially aggregates importance across beams and reorganizes selected key-value entries contiguously. later steps reuse the importance ranking and geometrically shrink the token budget exploiting the observed concentration of attention and stability of rankings across steps. evaluation on two public benchmarks an industrial dataset and a seven-day e-commerce advertising a/b test supports its use for low-latency long-sequence serving.
pfa 面向长序列生成式推荐的束搜索解码 减少反复读取历史行为的开销。首步保留完整注意力 再跨候选解码路径汇总历史 token 的重要性 将选中内容的键值缓存整理为连续存储。后续步骤复用重要性排序 并按几何比例缩减 token 预算 利用注意力逐步集中、跨步排序相对稳定的现象减少计算和访存。论文在两个公开基准、工业数据集和为期七天的电商广告线上测试中评估该方法 为长历史推荐的低延迟部署提供参考。

long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes evidence scaling exposes longer histories while reasoning scaling adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. existing models couple them sequence encoders propagate every added event through depth whereas one-shot selection prevents later layers from revisiting omitted evidence. we introduce the latent workspace ranker lwr which keeps typed evidence in persistent banks and propagates a fixed-size candidate-local workspace. each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. we compare four architectures across various history--depth configurations using evidence scaling at fixed depth reasoning scaling at fixed 10k history and their joint compute-efficient frontier. lwr leads all families at long histories continues improving with reasoning compute and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. at 10k history it improves ne by 0.19% over hstu while using 69.6% fewer forward gflop/request. it also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. these results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.

lwr separates persistent user-history evidence from a fixed-size candidate-local workspace propagated through the model. each layer rereads the evidence banks and archives compact post-interaction states allowing history length and reasoning depth to scale independently. across four architecture families and history-depth configurations it reports better long-history quality and compute efficiency at a 10k-event history it improves ne by 0.19% over hstu with 69.6% fewer forward gflop per request. the design offers a direct route to jointly scaling long-history ranking and model depth.
lwr 将持续保存的用户历史与层间传递的固定大小候选工作区分开。每一层根据更新后的工作区重新读取历史 并保存紧凑的交互后状态 使历史长度和推理深度可以分别扩展。论文比较了四类架构及多种历史长度、深度组合 在一万条历史行为的设定下 相对 hstu 报告了 0.19% 的 ne 改善 同时每请求前向计算量减少 69.6%。这一设计为同时扩展长序列排序和模型深度提供了直接参考。

generative recommendation gr reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers sids offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. gr4ad as an industrial generative recommendation framework has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in kuaishou.however continued deployment has exposed three limitations deterministic sid assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate sid decisions causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. we present gr4ad-x which addresses these limitations through reliable sid construction serving-efficient capacity scaling and unified value alignment. specifically gr4ad-x improves sid reliability through multi-path assignment. it expands model capacity along multiple complementary dimensions rather than relying solely on wider or deeper backbones achieving a better effectiveness-efficiency trade-off under strict serving constraints. finally unified value-guided generation and discrimination univgd aligns generation with commercial value through prefix-level reward optimization value-guided beam pruning and discriminative reranking within a unified model. large-scale online a/b tests on the kuaishou advertising platform demonstrate that gr4ad-x achieves a cumulative revenue improvement of 3.07% over the deployed gr4ad baseline while satisfying strict latency and throughput constraints.

gr4ad-x combines multi-path semantic-id assignment capacity expansion across complementary dimensions and unified value-guided generation and reranking for advertising retrieval under serving constraints. prefix-level rewards and value-guided beam pruning aim to retain commercially valuable candidates. online a/b tests on kuaishou report a cumulative 3.07% revenue improvement over deployed gr4ad while meeting latency and throughput constraints offering a serving-aware approach to generative-recommendation scaling.
gr4ad-x 面向受延迟和吞吐约束的广告生成式召回 结合多路径语义 id 分配、多维容量扩展 以及统一的价值引导生成与重排。它用前缀级奖励和价值引导的束搜索剪枝 减少高商业价值候选被过早丢弃。快手线上 a/b 实验报告 相对已部署 gr4ad 累计收入提升 3.07% 同时满足服务约束 为生成式推荐的扩容与线上成本协同设计提供参考。

sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. the same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation even when users have different relationships to the item. we propose personalized item representations in user history where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling. we instantiate this idea with prism which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. an autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower a user--item tower and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. offline evaluation on surface 1 a major recommendation surface at billion scale reports an average downstream normalized entropy ne change of -0.15% compared with -0.07% for vista at similar history lengths. we further identify an empirical sequence-length scaling law over history lengths of 26--240 events ne gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468 increasing from 0.06% to 0.17%. therefore personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.

prism makes each history-item representation user-specific by compressing all layer states from an upstream user tower user–item tower and same-request candidate mixing into one replayable embedding per scored pair. offline evaluation on a billion-scale recommendation surface reports an average normalized-entropy change of −0.15% versus −0.07% for vista at similar history lengths. over 26–240 events the reported ne gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468 suggesting a way to reuse ranking computation when scaling history modeling. the abstract reports no online gains.

prism 将历史商品表示与具体用户绑定 用自编码器把上游用户塔、用户–商品塔以及同请求候选交互的各层状态 压缩成可供后续序列模型复用的用户–商品向量。在十亿级推荐场景的离线评估中 归一化熵平均变化为 −0.15% 相近历史长度下 vista 为 −0.07%。在 26–240 条历史事件范围内 ne 收益拟合出指数为 0.468 的幂律 为复用排序计算、扩展历史建模提供参考 摘要未报告线上收益。

local-commerce and food-delivery marketplaces run large ads businesses across hundreds of thousands of stores merchants pay to be surfaced on browse and search surfaces and a ranker decides which ads each consumer sees. ranking well demands strong per-consumer personalization yet a consumer's raw interaction history is sparse and high-cardinality. our production ranker had personalized only through hand-engineered signals aggregate engagement counts categorical embeddings and order-agnostic pooled history with no learned per-consumer sequence representation. we learn one by training a gpt-style generative model of the consumer's engagement sequence to predict their next few engagements and read its last-token hidden state as the consumer embedding. that single frozen vector becomes one shared personalization input for every ad surface a daily job refreshes it and each ranker consumes it as an ordinary dense feature. offline it is the largest single-feature gain in our ranking-auc ladder a relative eval-auc gain of +0.59% on a browse-driven feed and +0.57% on a query-driven search surface. online it shipped as one component of bundled ranker retrains on both surfaces discovery revenue +0.79% conversion rate +1.17% and search revenue +0.94% conversion rate +1.50% . three design choices adapt the generative objective to a repurchase-heavy marketplace and are the core of our contribution an exploration-weighted loss that up-weights businesses new to the consumer over ones already engaged a two-stage curriculum a click pretrain that keeps the representation broad and exploratory then a conversion fine-tune that sharpens purchase intent and a designed negative set that pairs a fixed popular-business pool and businesses shown but not ordered with random and in-batch negatives.

palate trains a gpt-style model to predict future consumer engagements and supplies its final hidden state as a daily refreshed frozen user feature shared by browsing and search ad rankers. exploration-weighted training click pretraining followed by conversion fine-tuning and mixed negative pools adapt the representation to repeated purchases. offline relative eval-auc gains are 0.59% and 0.57% online revenue and conversion gains come from bundled ranker retrains and cannot be attributed to palate alone. the design illustrates amortizing sequence modeling across ad surfaces.

palate 用 gpt 式模型预测用户后续互动 将末位隐藏状态作为每日更新的冻结用户特征 供浏览和搜索广告排序共同使用。探索加权损失、先点击预训练再转化微调 以及多来源负样本 使表示适应重复购买场景。两类场景的离线 eval-auc 相对提升分别为 0.59% 和 0.57% 线上收入与转化收益来自包含该特征的整套排序模型重训 不能单独归因于 palate。其借鉴点是把序列建模成本分摊到多个广告场景。

spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. however its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. to address this we propose relevance-guided residual calibration rrc a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. rrc estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. it retains directions with positive estimated weights decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. this allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. rrc applies to pca whitening and spectemp and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that spectemp + rrc achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the beir group and bright at every target dimension. on the five evaluated bright datasets it improves over spectemp by an average of 2.34 ndcg@10 points at 768 dimensions. the gains also persist under scalar and product quantization improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. our code is available at https //anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-b5ce/

rrc uses relevance judgments to calibrate individual spectral-compression directions while preserving the compressor s overall spectral trend. its closed-form residual correction is folded into the existing query–document transformation requiring neither iterative training nor an extra inference stage. across three encoders and nine retrieval datasets spectemp + rrc achieves the best mean effectiveness among tested compressors at every evaluated target dimension on five bright datasets the average gain is 2.34 ndcg@10 points at 768 dimensions. gains also persist with scalar and product quantization informing storage-efficient retrieval embeddings.

rrc 用相关性标注调整谱压缩中各方向的权重 同时保留压缩器整体的谱趋势。闭式计算得到的残差修正直接并入查询与文档已有的变换 不需要迭代训练或额外推理阶段。在三个编码器、九个检索数据集的实验中 spectemp + rrc 在各测试目标维度上取得被比较压缩器中的最佳平均效果 五个 bright 数据集在 768 维时平均提升 2.34 个 ndcg@10 点。收益在标量和乘积量化后仍保留 可用于检索向量存储成本与效果的权衡。

llm-based generative recommendation reads long text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers sids . this asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient encoding the history is expensive yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. we present merge and branch m&b to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. merge compresses each historical item's sid and text into a small number of learned tokens. branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target sids. to share history computation while keeping these targets independent m&b organizes each example as a shallow wide tree. we develop tree flashattention to execute this layout efficiently processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. a tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. experiments on public benchmarks show that m&b outperforms strong recommendation baselines while substantially improving training and decoding efficiency. online a/b tests on a large-scale e-commerce platform suggest that m&b effectively combines item text with multi-target supervision yielding statistically significant gains in per-user clicks orders and gmv.

merge and branch reduces the cost of supervised fine-tuning for generative recommendation by compressing each historical item s semantic id and text into learned tokens then predicting multiple independent target ids from the shared history. tree flashattention and a tree-structured key/value cache reuse history computation during training and constrained decoding. public benchmarks report improved recommendation quality and training and decoding efficiency. newly reported online a/b tests on a large e-commerce platform show statistically significant gains in per-user clicks orders and gmv without specifying their magnitudes. the design makes one history encoding support multiple supervision targets.
merge and branch先把历史物品的语义id与文本压成少量可学习token 再用同一段历史独立预测多个目标id。树状flashattention让各目标分支共享历史计算 树状kv缓存把复用延伸到约束解码。公开基准报告推荐效果及训练、解码效率改善 新版摘要还加入大型电商平台a/b测试 人均点击、订单和gmv均有统计显著提升 但未披露幅度。可借鉴的是用一次历史编码承担多个目标的监督与预测。

retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering duplicating model residency and passage processing. we introduce glance which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. short relevance probes branch from the cached context producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. a single resident 9b backbone supports generation general decisions and reranking with approximately 0.1 gib of additional memory per decision skill. after 39 minutes of ms marco fine-tuning glance achieves ndcg@10 of 0.741 on scifact and 0.345 on nfcorpus compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. on 300 hotpotqa questions its selected context improves answer f1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator paired bootstrap 95% ci 0.014 0.076 . in a scaling study reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates 43k tokens scored from one shared prefill where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 ndcg@10 and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. these initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets one qa dataset and one backbone family.

glance equips a generation backbone with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to rerank passages from one shared prefill avoiding separate encoding of every query-passage pair. a single resident 9b model supports generation and reranking with about 0.1 gib of additional memory per decision skill. initial evaluations on two retrieval datasets and one qa dataset report gains over the evaluated cross-encoder baselines a scaling study scores up to 200 candidates from the shared context. this provides a computation-reuse design for reranking with evidence limited to one backbone family.
glance 给生成模型增加轻量决策适配器和指针头 一次编码共享上下文后为候选段落打分 避免逐一重新编码查询—段落对。同一个常驻 9b 模型兼做生成与重排 每种决策能力额外占用约 0.1 gib。两个检索数据集和一个问答数据集的初步实验报告优于所比较的交叉编码器 扩展实验可从共享上下文评分最多 200 个候选。可借鉴的是重排计算复用 当前证据仅覆盖一个骨干模型系列。

linear attention and state space models ssms offer efficient alternatives to softmax attention by maintaining a fixed-size recurrent state but this design requires careful management to preserve useful historical associations and limit interference. the delta rule helps reduce interference through correction of the value associated with each key but it does not explicitly account for how related value features are distributed across the state. we observe that a state \boldsymbols\in\mathbbrdk× dv can be viewed as a bank of dk addresses storing dv-dimensional values. while a key-side read \boldsymbols\top\boldsymbolk retrieves the value associated with \boldsymbolk a value-side read \boldsymbols\boldsymbole aggregates addresses whose stored value features match the selector \boldsymbole. based on this observation we propose dual deltanet ddn which extends kimi delta attention kda with a two-sided delta rule. the key-side delta rule reads with the current key to correct its associated value while the complementary value-side delta rule reads with selected features of the current value to reorganize the addresses it occupies. we derive a chunkwise parallel training algorithm and a rank-2 recurrence that increases arithmetic intensity during inference. compared with kda gdn-2 and mamba-3 ddn achieves the strongest overall performance across language modeling zero-shot downstream tasks and retrieval while incurring modest training and inference overhead relative to kda. code https //github.com/reichtumqian/dualdeltanet

dual deltanet extends kimi delta attention with a two-sided delta rule key-side updates correct the value associated with a key while value-side updates reorganize addresses holding selected value features. a chunkwise parallel algorithm supports training and a rank-2 recurrence increases inference arithmetic intensity. the abstract reports the strongest overall results among kda gdn-2 and mamba-3 across language modeling downstream tasks and retrieval with modest overhead relative to kda. its fixed-state memory management is a potential design reference for efficient sequence models not a tested ctr result.

dual deltanet 在 kimi delta attention 上加入双侧 delta 更新 键侧修正某个键对应的值 值侧则根据选中的值特征重新组织存储地址。分块并行算法用于训练 秩二递推提高推理算术强度。摘要报告 其语言建模、下游任务及检索的整体表现优于所比较的 kda、gdn-2 和 mamba-3 相对 kda 增加较小开销。可借鉴的是固定大小状态中的记忆管理 尚未验证 ctr 效果。

deep click-through rate ctr prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. however predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples features or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. nevertheless they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. to address this issue we propose optidc a unified framework for optimal input-side dimensional configuration in deep ctr prediction. optidc jointly learns sample feature and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. to explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels optidc further introduces a selection-weighted optimal transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. moreover optidc is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing ctr models. extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that optidc consistently achieves higher auc than existing input-side selection methods validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.

optidc jointly learns sample feature and embedding-unit selection for deep ctr prediction. selection-weighted optimal transport coordinates coarse- and fine-grained decisions while retaining the meaning of each input level. the model-agnostic framework reports higher auc than existing input-side selection methods on four real-world benchmark datasets. it offers a way to coordinate input configuration before feature interaction the abstract does not establish a scaling law or quantify computational savings.
optidc 联合学习 ctr 模型的样本、特征和 embedding 单元选择 并通过选择权重参与的最优传输协调不同粒度的决策 减少跨层选择冲突。该框架可接入已有 ctr 模型 作者在四个真实数据基准上报告 auc 优于现有输入选择方法。可借鉴的是在特征交互前联合配置不同层级的输入 摘要未建立 scaling law 也未量化计算节省。

repeating transformer layers can improve language model performance without adding parameters. however the added computational depth increases both forward and backward computation costs during training. training such models requires choosing a backward window that controls how many final layer repetitions retain gradients during backpropagation. longer windows improve per-token learning efficiency but increase per-update cost while shorter windows reduce per-update cost but sacrifice per-token efficiency. understanding which window performs better requires examining different training budgets. prior work compares backward windows across computational budgets. when training budgets increase it remains unclear whether the same window continues to perform best. we measure how the relative performance of two windows shifts as training budgets grow. our method isolates per-token efficiency by training both windows on identical data and compares complete training recipes at approximately equal training time at each budget. results show that shorter windows lose much of their advantage as budgets grow. controlled experiments show that both benefits decrease at larger budgets with a greater decline in the benefit of extended training. backward window comparisons depend on the available budget and the preferred window among the tested candidates can change as the budget grows.

this study compares how many final repetitions of a looped language model should retain gradients during training. identical-data experiments isolate learning efficiency per token while approximately time-matched recipes compare the trade-off between deeper backpropagation and more updates. the tested shorter window loses much of its advantage as training budgets grow so the preferred choice can change with budget. this offers a budget-aware training lesson for weight-sharing depth architectures it does not establish a universal optimal window or a ctr result.
这项研究比较循环语言模型训练时 应让最后多少轮层重复保留梯度。相同数据实验用于分离每 token 的学习效率 近似等训练时间实验则比较更深反向传播与更多参数更新的取舍。结果显示 预算增加后 所测试短窗口的优势明显减弱 较优窗口可能随预算变化。可借鉴的是共享权重深度架构的训练配置应随预算评估 论文未给出普遍最优窗口或 ctr 结果。

looped transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. while existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. we introduce copyloop a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. rather than step-by-step generation copyloop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. it then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. we evaluate copyloop across six model checkpoints from the ouro raven and huginn families covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. copyloop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on base models and 2.74x--3.52x on thinking models consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. furthermore ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling while our analyses show that copyloop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.

copyloop accelerates looped transformer decoding without training by proposing multiple tokens copied from recurring context filtering them at shallow recurrent depth and overlapping newer blocks with earlier full-depth verification. across six checkpoints from ouro raven and huginn on code generation and mathematical reasoning the abstract reports speedups of 2.98–10.70 times for base models and 2.74–3.52 times for thinking models over full-depth autoregressive decoding. it suggests a decoding design for recurrent-depth architectures particularly when longer outputs contain reusable context recommendation transfer remains untested.

copyloop 从重复上下文复制多个候选 token 在较浅循环深度先筛选 并让后续块处理与前面块的全深度验证重叠 从而无需训练即可加速循环 transformer 解码。摘要报告 在 ouro、raven、huginn 六个检查点的代码生成与数学推理任务上 相比全深度自回归解码 base 模型加速 2.98–10.70 倍 thinking 模型加速 2.74–3.52 倍。可借鉴的是循环深度架构的解码调度 较长且可复用上下文的输出更受益 尚未验证推荐迁移效果。

sparse mixture-of-experts moe models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings especially in middle and deep layers. richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. we propose multi-view latent moe to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. its multi-router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. these routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. multi-view further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. each selected expert executes one forward pass preserving the active-expert count expert flops and all-to-all communication volume. on a 24-layer 10b-a1b model trained on 708b tokens multi-view latent moe improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. multi-router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on the expert and token.

multi-view latent moe combines several routers to select experts and uses their relative preferences to mix latent views into each selected expert s input. each selected expert runs once preserving the active-expert count expert flops and all-to-all communication volume. on a 24-layer model with 10b total and 1b active parameters trained on 708b tokens it improves the mean across nine downstream tasks by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. the design is relevant to sparse ranking architectures that seek more expressive routing under a fixed expert-computation budget it does not establish ctr gains.

multi-view latent moe用多个路由器共同选择专家 再利用各路由器对同一专家的相对偏好 混合不同隐空间视图作为专家输入。每个选中专家只执行一次 保持激活专家数、专家计算量和all-to-all通信量不变。在用708b token训练的24层、总参数10b、激活参数1b模型上 九项下游任务平均分比基线提高1.18个百分点。它为固定专家计算预算下增强稀疏排序模型的路由表达能力提供参考 论文未验证ctr收益。

many open mixture-of-experts moe language models train with muon instead of adamw. most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score adjusted after every step. their recipes disagree on whether muon should also train the router. in models with 55m and 108m active parameters we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases the largest minus the smallest in a layer. the span grows when all tokens favor the same experts so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. at learning rates tuned on shorter runs muon raised the span of the first moe layer at every seed roughly doubling it on average while the other layers changed much less. the rise came from muon on the rest of the network whichever optimizer trained the router. in those runs the inputs to the first router shared a direction and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. over the first 3 000 steps subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. on the smaller model halving muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. moving only the router to adamw made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on muon.

in moe language models with 55m and 108m active parameters this study finds that muon can increase load imbalance in the first expert layer even when its router uses a different optimizer. shared directions in router inputs coincide with expert overload subtracting the batch mean removes the observed early overload with little loss change while reducing muon's learning rate helps on the smaller model. the findings inform optimizer and routing diagnostics for sparse scaling but their demonstrated scope is limited to these model sizes and training settings.
这项研究在激活参数为 5500 万和 1.08 亿的 moe 语言模型中发现 muon 会加重第一层专家的负载不均 即使单独更换路由器优化器也不能消除这一现象。路由输入中的共同方向伴随专家过载 减去批次均值可消除观察到的早期过载 损失变化很小 在较小模型上降低 muon 学习率也有帮助。这为稀疏扩展中的优化器选择和路由诊断提供参考 结论范围限于论文测试的模型规模和训练设定。

local deployment of moe-based llms on cpu-gpu nodes is attractive for cost and privacy reasons yet limited gpu memory forces most experts into cpu memory. prefill is then compute-bound and benefits from aggressive gpu loading while decode is i/o-bound and requires conservative pcie transfers. these demands cannot be amortized under low batching---typical of local assistants and document tools---forcing phase-agnostic schedulers into a seesaw favoring prefill's aggressive loading injects unmaskable i/o that stalls decode while favoring decode's conservative transfers starves prefill's gpu of work. we observe that expert routing is predictable in phase-specific ways allowing us to decouple the two phases and optimize prediction scheduling and execution independently for each phase. pdscope predicts expert activations to guide placement and prefetching adapts these policies to each phase's bottleneck via cross-layer cost modeling and compiles decisions into overhead-free pipelines using a static computation graph cache prefetching and zero-copy asynchronous i/o. on mainstream moe models pdscope achieves 2.5-10.3x higher prefill throughput and 2.1-6.1x higher decode throughput than existing systems showing that phase-aware co-design unlocks efficient moe inference under memory constraints and extends naturally to multi-batch settings.

pdscope accelerates cpu-gpu moe inference when gpu memory cannot hold most experts. it predicts expert activations and adapts placement prefetching and execution separately for compute-bound prefill and i/o-bound decoding using cross-layer cost models and static execution pipelines. on tested moe models it reports 2.5–10.3× higher prefill throughput and 2.1–6.1× higher decoding throughput than existing systems. phase-specific scheduling is a transferable serving idea for memory-constrained sparse models though the reported experiments concern llm inference rather than ctr ranking.

pdscope 面向显存不足、多数专家需放在 cpu 内存中的 moe 推理。它预测专家激活 分别针对计算受限的提示处理阶段和输入输出受限的逐 token 解码阶段 调整专家放置、预取和执行流水线。在测试的 moe 模型上 相对既有系统报告了 2.5–10.3 倍的提示处理吞吐和 2.1–6.1 倍的解码吞吐。按阶段区分瓶颈的调度思路可供显存受限的稀疏模型部署借鉴 但实验对象是大语言模型推理 未验证 ctr 排序收益。
