sparse mixture-of-experts moe models offer scalable capacity for web applications but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited gpu memory. we present lrmoe a memory-aware moe training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. during forward execution it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. during backpropagation a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. a capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped gemms reducing backward traffic computation and execution-buffer demand. experiments on qwen3-30b-a3b and glm4.5-106b-a12b show that lrmoe reduces cumulative moe-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to symi.

lrmoe reduces memory-constrained moe training cost by jointly setting expert-placement and backward-retention quotas. it preserves all routed forward computations then selects token-expert pairs for backpropagation according to estimated update contribution and routes retained pairs to instances of their original experts. compact communication buffers and variable-size grouped matrix multiplications reduce backward work. on qwen3-30b-a3b and glm4.5-106b-a12b cumulative moe-layer time to fixed-loss targets falls by 21.2–44.8% versus symi providing a systems reference for sparse scaling rather than a demonstrated recommendation gain.

lrmoe 联合规划专家放置和反向计算保留配额 降低显存受限节点上的 moe 训练成本。它保留全部已路由的前向计算 反向传播时按估计的参数更新贡献筛选 token—专家对 再将保留的计算分配给原专家的可用实例。通过压紧通信缓冲区和使用可变大小的分组矩阵乘法 减少反向计算与通信。在 qwen3-30b-a3b 和 glm4.5-106b-a12b 上 达到固定损失目标所需的累计 moe 层训练时间相对 symi 减少 21.2–44.8%。这为稀疏扩展提供了系统层参考 并非已验证的推荐收益。

video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but the quadratic cost of 3d full attention dominates their inference. dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. however its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering pruned blocks vanish from the softmax and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. to address these limitations we propose accurate block attention ab-attention a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. its intra-block clustering selector ibcs estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block without permuting tokens. sampling with inclusion-probability weighting sip then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. finally its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. on wan2.1 and hunyuanvideo ab-attention skips 89--92% of attention whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6× as much yet it still improves psnr by up to 4.4~db over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23× end-to-end speedup. our code is available at https //github.com/infrec-cardinal/ab-attention.

ab-attention approximates dense attention with dynamic block sparsity without retraining. it estimates block importance by clustering queries within each block samples and reweights selected blocks by inclusion probability and packs smaller key-value blocks into full tensor-core tiles. on wan2.1 and hunyuanvideo the abstract reports skipping 89–92% of attention and up to 2.23-fold end-to-end speedup. its selection and kernel design may inform sparse long-sequence attention but recommendation gains are not established.
ab-attention 无需重新训练 用动态块稀疏计算近似稠密注意力 先在查询块内部聚类以估计重要性 再按概率采样键值块并按纳入概率重新加权 内核将更小的键值块拼成完整的张量核心计算块。在 wan2.1 和 hunyuanvideo 上 摘要报告跳过 89–92% 的注意力计算 端到端最高加速 2.23 倍。块选择与内核协同设计可供长序列稀疏注意力借鉴 尚未验证推荐收益。

modern llms strain device memory through large model weights and attention states particularly in resource-constrained scenarios. existing systems separately provision memory for model weights and attention states imposing fixed fixed boundaries that cannot adapt to the changing memory demands of workloads. under heavy workloads insufficient state capacity limits request concurrency and reduces throughput under light workloads idle memory in one region cannot be reallocated to another wasting device memory. meanwhile modern llm architectures introduce heterogeneous tensors with diverse layouts and lifetimes further complicating memory management. these problems motivate unified memory management for heterogeneous tensors. however a shared pool alone does not make memory directly reusable across tensors with different allocation granularities and execution layouts. this paper presents rimuru a modern llm serving system that unifies memory management through elastic expert offloading. rimuru establishes a shared page pool to enables elastic memory sharing across heterogeneous tensors. to accommodate different allocation granularities rimuru introduces memory views that allow each tensor type to interpret the shared memory space using its own page size and page table. furthermore rimuru combines huge-page alignment with a multi-level page allocator that splits and merges pages enabling cross-type capacity reuse. a page-table-aware fused moe kernel directly accesses non-contiguous expert weights avoiding copy overhead. building on these mechanisms rimuru employs a workload-aware adjuster that dynamically reallocates pages across tensor types according to runtime demands. implemented on top of vllm rimuru remains compatible with modern llms. evaluations show that rimuru achieves up to 19.03x baseline throughput and reduces ttft by 98.1% on average.

rimuru pools memory for expert weights and attention states instead of reserving fixed regions for each. tensor-specific memory views a split-and-merge page allocator and a page-table-aware moe kernel allow capacity to move between heterogeneous tensors without copying expert weights into contiguous buffers. a workload-aware controller adjusts allocation at runtime. implemented on vllm the system reports improved throughput and time to first token in its tested settings the transferable idea is jointly managing sparse-model weights and request state not an established recommendation-serving gain.
rimuru 让专家权重与注意力状态共享内存池 避免为两者预留固定空间。不同张量通过各自的内存视图访问共享页 分裂与合并分配器调整容量 支持页表的 moe 内核直接读取非连续专家权重 减少额外复制。控制器再按运行负载动态分配空间。基于 vllm 的实验报告了吞吐与首 token 延迟改善 可借鉴的是联合管理稀疏模型权重和请求状态 尚未验证推荐服务收益。

a user history can admit multiple plausible next interactions yet conventional sequential recommenders produce a single deterministic ranking. while diffusion models offer a natural way to sample alternative continuations we show that existing target-item diffusion recommenders often suffer from severe sampling collapse producing nearly identical outputs across independent draws. we identify two ubiquitous design choices that promote this collapse joint learning of the latent space and denoiser and in-trajectory supervision via discrete losses. to address these failure modes we introduce darts diverse and accurate recommendation through sampling a three-stage latent diffusion framework that explicitly decouples representation learning generative modeling and discrete ranking by learning and freezing the latent space before diffusion training and postponing ranking supervision to the final decoding stage. we further characterize sampling diversity using complementary measures of variation before and after decoding and use posterior-predictive aggregation to exploit this diversity at inference. across three amazon reviews 2023 categories darts preserves substantially greater sampling diversity while outperforming strong sequential generative-retrieval and diffusion baselines by 7-12% on standard ranking metrics. aggregating multiple samples further improves ranking accuracy at a fixed slate size.

darts separates representation learning diffusion modeling and discrete ranking to preserve alternative next-item samples. it freezes the latent space before diffusion training and postpones ranking supervision until decoding addressing collapse associated with jointly learning representations and the denoiser or applying discrete losses inside denoising trajectories. on three amazon reviews 2023 categories it reports greater sampling diversity and stronger ranking metrics than evaluated baselines. aggregating several samples further improves ranking at a fixed slate size suggesting a recommendation-specific way to use additional inference compute.
darts 将表示学习、扩散建模和离散排序分开 先冻结潜在空间 再训练扩散模型 把排序监督延后到最终解码 缓解多次采样仍生成近乎相同结果的问题。在 amazon reviews 2023 的三个类别中 作者报告采样多样性和排序指标均优于所比较的基线。最终推荐列表大小固定时 聚合多个样本还能改善排序 为生成式推荐增加推理计算提供了一条具体路径。

looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer or parts of it making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates model size training compute or autoregressive inference efficiency. we study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch varying which parts of the model are looped how many loops are applied and how information is passed between loops. our experiments span models with up to 1b parameters trained on up to 155b tokens with up to 1.07×1021 flops and 32 loops. we find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training flops are constrained. adding loops is not uniformly beneficial gains eventually saturate reverse or become unstable. this motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. we address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality with larger gains as more loops are added. looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. parallel loop transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions allowing loop stages to run concurrently. however in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. we find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. together these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

this study compares looped decoder-only transformers under parameter training-compute and decoding constraints using models up to 1b parameters 155b training tokens and 32 loops. full-model looping generally works best at fixed parameter count while middle-block looping gives better returns at fixed training flops additional loops can also saturate or destabilize training. loop-specific low-rank adapters improve quality and preserving the current-token embedding with separate normalization improves parallel-loop inference. the findings guide resource-aware shared-depth designs rather than establish recommendation gains.

这项研究比较共享权重的循环 transformer 在参数量、训练计算量和解码效率约束下的取舍 实验最大为 10 亿参数、1550 亿训练 token 和 32 次循环。固定参数量时 循环整个模型通常效果更好 限制训练 flops 时 只循环中间层更划算 但增加循环也可能收益饱和或引起不稳定。逐循环低秩适配器能改善效果 并行循环推理中 保留当前 token 表示并对两路输入分别归一化也有帮助。这些结果可指导按资源约束设计共享深度架构 尚非推荐收益验证。

large language models llms bring world knowledge to user preference modeling in sequential recommendation but generation-based recommenders express next-item predictions indirectly as text. generated outputs may fail to identify a unique candidate item depend on candidate presentation order in the prompt and lack explicit confidence in the recommendation. recent studies explore jev a model for fast option selection with explicit confidence. inspired by jev we introduce decision-native recommendation a new paradigm that jointly models item choice and recommendation confidence using llm representations. it requires valid candidate selection consistency under candidate reordering and confidence that reflects recommendation accuracy. we propose direct item choice estimation dice which learns a personalized next-item distribution over supplied candidates from user interaction history and recommends the highest-scoring item with calibrated confidence. tree-structured attention shares history computation across isolated candidate branches for order-consistent candidate scoring in a single forward pass. on three recommendation datasets dice achieves higher top-one accuracy than all evaluated baselines. separate evaluations show unchanged item choices under tested candidate reorderings and end-to-end speedups of up to approximately 6× over the evaluated generation-based methods. its confidence estimates support selective recommendation by identifying more reliable predictions and guide additional computation for low-confidence examples in offline routing.

dice directly estimates a next-item distribution and confidence over supplied candidates instead of expressing the choice as generated text. tree-structured attention shares history computation while isolating candidate branches enabling order-consistent scoring in one forward pass. on three recommendation datasets it reports the highest top-one accuracy among evaluated baselines unchanged choices under tested reorderings and up to roughly sixfold end-to-end speedup over evaluated generation-based methods. confidence supports selective recommendation and offline allocation of extra compute offering a candidate-scoring design rather than a demonstrated full-catalog or online result.
dice 直接对给定候选估计下一物品分布与置信度 省去用生成文本表达选择的过程。树状注意力让候选分支共享历史计算、彼此隔离 在一次前向中完成对候选顺序稳定的打分。三个推荐数据集上 作者报告所比较方法中最高的首位准确率 测试中的候选重排不改变选择 相对生成式方法端到端速度最高约为 6 倍。置信度还用于选择性推荐和离线分配额外计算 这些结果不等于全目录或线上验证。

as growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. unfortunately existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. first past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. second past works neglect ensembling a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. as a surprising consequence prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. we address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. training on 100m tokens from fineweb our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes a 14% decrease in perplexity and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. these gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12× larger compute budgets.

this work improves data-constrained language-model scaling by fitting power laws for hyperparameter transfer and scaling laws for allocating compute to ensembles. on 100m fineweb training tokens the recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats or perplexity by 14% relative to prior recipes and reports monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. prescriptions fitted to smaller runs are validated at up to 12-fold larger compute budgets. the method may inform data-limited ranking experiments but transfer to ctr models and ensemble serving costs remain unverified here.

这项工作针对训练数据受限时的模型扩展 拟合超参数随规模迁移的幂律 并用 scaling law 分配集成模型的计算预算。在 fineweb 的 1 亿训练 token 上 相比既有方案 验证损失降低超过 0.15 nats、困惑度降低 14% 且集成方案随计算预算增加持续改善。由小规模实验拟合的配置在最高 12 倍计算预算下得到验证。其方法可供数据受限的排序实验参考 但摘要未验证 ctr 迁移效果或集成模型的线上服务成本。

mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. existing compressors quantize state values or prune coordinates with per-channel scores. trained states are nearly rank-one and bias-like aligned with the mean write but the output's energy spans an order of magnitude more directions. per-channel scores see only the diagonal of the write--read operator so they cannot select the subspace that governs the input--output map which is a rotation of the coordinates. we therefore propose \method which keeps that subspace by applying balanced truncation exactly via mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. layers differ just as sharply most are bias-dominated while the few that carry long-range associations are the flattest and need most of their state. we therefore introduce \spar which redistributes a fixed total rank budget across layers according to the hankel spectrum. on mamba-2 checkpoints from 130m to 2.7b \method+\spar halves the state at an average cost of 0.3 wikitext-2 perplexity points against 1.6 for ghost while retaining 97% of the dense model's five-digit in-context recall. at a quarter of the state giving every layer the same rank keeps 5% of that recall and \spar 77% for a 7% perplexity cost.

this method compresses mamba-2 states by preserving the rotated write–read subspace through balanced truncation rather than scoring coordinates independently. spectral rank allocation distributes a fixed state budget across layers using the hankel spectrum protecting flatter-spectrum layers that carry long-range associations. across 130m–2.7b checkpoints halving the state costs 0.3 wikitext-2 perplexity points on average versus 1.6 for ghost while retaining 97% of dense five-digit in-context recall. at quarter-state size spectral allocation retains 77% of recall versus 5% with uniform ranks with a 7% perplexity cost. this informs long-history state compression not established ctr gains.

该方法通过平衡截断保留旋转后的mamba-2写入—读取子空间 而非逐坐标独立评分。谱秩分配按hankel谱在层间分配固定状态预算 保护承载长程关联、谱更平坦的层。在1.3亿至27亿参数检查点上 状态减半时wikitext-2平均困惑度增加0.3 ghost为1.6 同时保留稠密模型97%的五位数字上下文召回能力。状态缩至四分之一时 谱分配保留77%的召回 统一秩仅保留5% 代价为困惑度增加7%。这为长历史状态压缩提供参考 并非已验证的ctr提升。

as llms scale mixture-of-experts moe architectures increase model capacity while keeping per-token computation manageable through sparse expert activation. this sparsity also enables memory-efficient deployment by retaining most expert weights in cpu memory and transferring or executing only the routed experts on demand. existing moe offloading systems typically target specific model-platform configurations yet differences in model sparsity cpu and gpu throughput vram capacity and host-device bandwidth can change the policy ranking. because implementing and exhaustively evaluating all candidate policies incurs substantial engineering cost efficiently selecting the best-performing policy for each model-platform configuration remains a key challenge for practical moe offloading. we present cope composable offloading policy emulator which selects the best-performing moe offloading policy for a target model-platform configuration before runtime integration. cope comprises two components. its policy matrix factors the design space into two independent axes expert residency and moe execution strategy enabling mechanism reuse across candidate policies and exposing four new candidates. its virtual heterogeneous machine profiles combined-operator schedules on the target platform and combines these measurements with offline routing traces to estimate candidate performance. compared with the evaluated baselines cope improves fastest-policy selection accuracy by 24%-100% and reduces performance-prediction error by 1.7× to 6.8×. by identifying the preferred policy before integration cope further reduces policy-specific implementation effort by up to 74%.

cope selects a moe offloading policy for a target model and hardware platform before implementing it in the runtime. it separates expert residency from execution strategy then combines profiles of operator schedules with offline routing traces to predict candidate performance. against evaluated baselines it reports better fastest-policy selection and lower prediction error with policy-specific implementation effort reduced by up to 74%. the transferable idea is to choose offloading around actual memory compute and bandwidth limits the reported gains concern policy selection and integration effort not model accuracy or ctr throughput.
cope 在接入运行系统之前 为目标模型与硬件平台选择 moe 卸载策略。它把专家驻留位置和执行方式分开组合 再结合算子调度的实测性能与离线路由轨迹 估计各候选方案的表现。相对所比较的基线 论文报告最佳策略选择更准、性能预测误差更低 特定策略的实现工作量最高减少 74%。可借鉴的是按实际内存、算力和带宽约束选方案 这些收益指策略选择与集成成本 不是模型准确率或 ctr 吞吐提升。

quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. in full-batch gradient descent with learning rate lr \eta cohen et al. 2021 observed the edge of stability eos where the largest hessian eigenvalue concentrates near 2/\eta seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. in this work we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics with a particular focus on their failure modes in llm training. we first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the lr even though the real dynamics remain stable. we term this phenomenon the edge of convexity eoc . after removing the effect of this lr-independent instability we then propose a generalized definition of edge of stability eos for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers based on whether increasing the lr induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. across different llm pretraining runs with various model sizes up to 787m we find that 1 eoc is always observed across llm pretraining and 2 eos is also prevalent but not universal it disappears when the lr becomes sufficiently small e.g. after decay or when the batch size falls below a critical threshold that has a positive correlation with the critical batch size. together these findings characterize when and how quadratic approximations fail and provide a foundation for future work on understanding training dynamics.

this study tests when quadratic approximations misrepresent language-model training dynamics. persistent negative curvature can make the approximate dynamics diverge at any learning rate while real training remains stable after separating that effect the authors define a stability-edge diagnostic for stochastic adaptive optimization. in pretraining runs up to 787m parameters the learning-rate-dependent effect is common but disappears at sufficiently small learning rates or batch sizes. the results caution against equating local curvature-based instability with failed training they do not provide a new optimizer or ctr evidence.
这项研究检验二次近似何时无法描述语言模型训练 持续的负曲率可能让近似动力学在任意学习率下都发散 而真实训练仍然稳定。分离这一影响后 作者提出适用于随机自适应优化的稳定性边缘诊断。在最大 7.87 亿参数的预训练实验中 与学习率相关的这种现象较常见 但学习率或批量足够小时会消失。可借鉴的是判断训练稳定性时 不把局部曲率近似的发散直接视为训练失败 论文未提出新优化器或验证 ctr 效果。

mixture-of-experts moe inference on memory-constrained edge platforms is often dominated by expert-weight movement rather than computation. although each token activates only a small subset of experts routing is input-dependent so all experts must remain accessible and memory movement dominates latency. existing approaches such as uniform pruning and expert dropping overlook two properties of moe execution expert combinations are highly skewed in frequency and experts contribute asymmetrically within each combination. we present crisp a combination-aware framework that co-designs pruning and runtime scheduling for efficient moe serving on memory-constrained edge platforms. crisp reorders neurons by importance so one stored expert can support multiple execution widths assigns differentiated execution to hot warm and cold combinations based on frequency and expert role and exploits heterogeneous widths to overlap expert loading with computation. across mixtral-8x7b and deepseek-moe-16b crisp improves throughput by up to 2.1× at the same memory budget while limiting accuracy loss to 3.6% relative to full-width inference. our results highlight that efficient edge moe serving requires jointly optimizing which expert capacity is preserved and how expert execution is scheduled.

crisp jointly designs expert pruning and runtime scheduling for memory-constrained moe inference. neuron reordering lets one stored expert execute at several widths expert-combination frequency and each expert's role determine how much computation to retain while heterogeneous widths help overlap weight loading with computation. on mixtral-8x7b and deepseek-moe-16b it reports up to 2.1 times throughput at the same memory budget with reported accuracy loss limited to 3.6% relative to full-width inference. the result informs sparse-model deployment with an explicit quality trade-off rather than demonstrating ctr gains.

crisp 联合设计显存受限 moe 推理的剪枝与调度。它先按重要性重排神经元 让同一份专家权重支持不同执行宽度 再根据专家组合出现频率及各专家的作用分配计算 并利用不同宽度把权重加载与计算重叠。在 mixtral-8x7b 和 deepseek-moe-16b 上 论文报告同等内存预算下吞吐最高达到 2.1 倍 相对全宽度推理的准确率损失控制在所报的 3.6% 范围内。这是带有效果折损的稀疏模型部署方案 未验证 ctr 收益。

estimating neural scaling laws involves an end-to-end pipeline designing a scaling recipe training models across scales evaluating models on a target metric and deploying an algorithm to fit a scaling law to the resulting data. this final fitting stage is often treated as routine standard procedures minimize a non-convex fitting loss using local optimization from a grid of initializations and return the best solution found. yet such heuristic searches can fail in two distinct ways they offer no guarantee of returning a nearly optimal solution and they obscure whether fundamentally different parameter choices fit the data nearly as well. indeed we show that standard scaling law fitting is subject to a rashomon effect breiman 2001 the sublevel sets of near-minimizers correspond to broad parameter regions whose extrapolations diverge substantially at scale. we resolve these issues with a deterministic branch-and-bound algorithm that guarantees nearly optimal fitting loss and exhaustively maps the near-minimizers to the implied range of scaling curves.

ambiguous fits examines the final fitting stage of neural scaling laws where different parameter settings can fit observed data nearly equally well yet diverge in large-scale extrapolation. it replaces heuristic local searches with deterministic branch-and-bound optimization that guarantees nearly optimal fitting loss and maps near-minimizers to a range of implied scaling curves. this provides a way to expose fitting ambiguity when planning ranking-model scale the guarantee concerns fitting loss not accurate extrapolation or demonstrated ctr performance.
ambiguous fits 关注 scaling law 的最后拟合环节 不同参数可能同样贴合已有实验数据 却对更大规模给出明显不同的预测。论文用确定性的分支定界算法替代启发式局部搜索 保证拟合损失接近最优 并把近似最优参数集合映射为一组可能的扩展曲线。它为规划排序模型规模时识别拟合歧义提供方法 保证针对的是拟合损失 并不保证外推准确 也未验证 ctr 效果。

generative bundle construction completes a partially observed bundle by generating its missing items from a large product catalog. compared to autoregressive llms diffusion llm emerges as a natural fit for this unordered generation task. their bidirectional attention provides an inductive bias better aligned with unordered bundle construction. iterative denoising can reveal multiple tokens per step potentially reducing inference latency. however directly applying dlms to this task presents two key challenges 1 despite its flexible reveal order confidence-guided decoding tends to postpone semantic-fork decisions until refinement tokens constrain their choices reducing bundle diversity. 2 revealing more tokens per step can compromise recommendation quality stifling the potential for faster inference. we introduce dpe-rec a diffusion framework for diversity preservation and efficient recommendation. dpe-rec preserves diversity by introducing semantic-fork-aware grpo which prioritizes semantic-fork decisions via autoregressive rollouts. it improves efficiency through pseudo-trajectory distillation which concentrates learning from the vast random corruption space onto the compact trajectory-induced subspace visited by high-quality decoding unlocking reliable multi-token decoding. together these components enable diverse and accurate bundle construction with substantially fewer denoise steps. experiments on multiple bundle construction benchmarks show that dpe-rec improves recommendation performance by 63% on average and its fast variant achieves 25.6$times$ faster inference on average than existing generative recommendation arts with minimal loss in recommendation quality.

dpe-rec uses diffusion language models to complete partially observed item bundles. semantic-fork-aware grpo prioritizes decisions that determine different bundle compositions while pseudo-trajectory distillation concentrates training on states reached by high-quality decoding so more tokens can be revealed per step. experiments report improved bundle recommendation and a fast variant averages 25.6 times faster inference than evaluated generative recommenders with little quality loss. the evidence concerns bundle construction offering a way to trade denoising steps against recommendation diversity and quality rather than a validated ctr speedup.
dpe-rec 用扩散语言模型补全商品组合 针对会决定不同组合方向的关键选择设计 grpo 训练 再用伪轨迹蒸馏聚焦高质量解码经过的状态 使每一步可以可靠地确定更多 token。组合推荐实验报告了效果改善 快速版本相对所比较的生成式推荐方法平均推理速度达到 25.6 倍 同时只损失少量质量。可借鉴的是协同调整去噪步数、多样性和推荐效果 这些证据来自组合构建任务 不能直接当作 ctr 加速。

next-item prediction is inherently ambiguous a single interaction history often admits multiple plausible continuations across distinct catalogue regions. standard sequential recommenders compress these alternatives into a single prediction conflating user intents. we introduce collapse-resistant multiple hypothesis learning compote a multi-hypothesis transformer trained with an annealed objective that transitions from uniform supervision to a winner-takes-all assignment. this mechanism forces hypotheses to specialize into distinct catalogue regions while inference relies on an efficient normalizer-free max-similarity rule. theoretically we show that in the population case the optimal solutions partition the conditional next-item distribution according to a max-entropy quantization principle while pooled scores preserve the bayes-optimal ranking. we also prove a generalization bound scaling logarithmically with the number of hypotheses. across three amazon reviews 2023 benchmarks compote outperforms strong id-based generative and multi-interest baselines using item ids alone. matched-capacity ablations confirm that performance gains stem directly from the annealed objective preventing the head collapse observed in conventional multi-head architectures rather than added capacity ensembling or routing.

compote represents several plausible next-item continuations with a multi-hypothesis transformer. an annealed objective moves from uniform supervision to winner-takes-all assignments so hypotheses specialize while inference uses a normalizer-free maximum-similarity rule. across three amazon reviews 2023 benchmarks it outperforms evaluated id-based generative and multi-interest baselines matched-capacity ablations attribute the gains to the training objective rather than added capacity. it offers a way to reduce head collapse in multi-interest modeling but does not establish a long-history or model-size scaling law.

compote 用多个假设表示同一段历史可能对应的不同下一物品意图 训练目标从均匀监督逐步转向赢家负责 促使不同假设形成分工 推理采用无需归一化的最大相似度打分。在 amazon reviews 2023 的三个基准中 作者报告优于所比较的 id、生成式和多兴趣方法 等容量消融将收益归于训练目标 而非增加参数。可借鉴的是减少多兴趣表示中的预测头坍塌 论文未建立长历史或模型规模的 scaling law。

sequential recommendation must combine semantic preferences with behavioral associations to deliver accurate rankings at low inference cost. sharing history selection connects preference representation directly to the behavioral evidence used in candidate scoring. we present relay a compact sequential recommender built around one query two roles semantic readout and behavioral-memory routing. a single learned query forms a semantic preference representation and reuses its attention to route direct-history and transition evidence into candidate scores. candidate-conditioned gates calibrate the two memory channels for each candidate. relay trains both roles with a single catalog likelihood and produces the final ranking in one forward pass. full-catalog experiments on six datasets show that relay achieves the highest recall@5 and ndcg@5 among the compared methods on every dataset improving over the previous best model by 14.22% and 17.88% on average. with 2.044 million predictor parameters relay reduces predictor size by 65.12% and achieves a 1.75~1.79× inference speedup over the previous best model.

relay reuses one learned query for both semantic preference readout and routing behavioral evidence into candidate scores. candidate-conditioned gates calibrate direct-history and transition memories and a single catalog-likelihood objective trains the one-pass ranker. across six full-catalog benchmarks it reports average recall@5 and ndcg@5 improvements of 14.22% and 17.88% over the previous best model. its 2.044m-parameter predictor is 65.12% smaller and runs 1.75–1.79 times faster than that comparator illustrating compact history-computation reuse rather than proven industrial scaling.

relay 复用一个学习得到的查询 既提取语义偏好 也把直接历史和行为转移两类证据送入候选打分 再用候选相关门控调整两类记忆。模型以同一个全目录似然目标训练 一次前向生成排名。在六个全目录评测数据集上 作者报告 recall@5、ndcg@5 相对此前最佳模型平均提升 14.22%、17.88%。其预测器包含 204.4 万参数 规模减少 65.12% 推理速度为该对照的 1.75–1.79 倍 可供紧凑历史建模参考 尚非工业扩模验证。

session-based recommendation sbr infers user interest from limited interaction sequences yet current models show a consistent performance drop when longer histories are available. this degradation is associated with decoder designs that overemphasize recent items while underutilizing distant yet semantically relevant interactions leading to poor modeling of long-range dependencies and multi-interest behaviors. to address this challenge we introduce mida multi-interest decoding with adaptive aggregation for session-based recommendation a lightweight and encoder-agnostic framework that provides a reformulation of the decoding stage. the central design principle is a two-space decoupling clustering operates on raw item embeddings so that semantic groupings are not distorted by encoder-learned relational biases encoder outputs are reserved for aggregation where sequential context remains intact. concretely mida i employs differentiable multi-interest clustering on raw embeddings preserving semantic structure that encoder representations would otherwise obscure and ii fuses stability and plasticity branches through a gate conditioned on average cluster size so that the inferred clustering structure directly governs aggregation behavior through a structural coupling across the two stages. extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that mida consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with meaningful accuracy improvements while remaining computationally practical.

uses raw-embedding interest clustering and cluster-size-conditioned aggregation to improve session recommendation with longer histories. the encoder-agnostic decoder separates semantic grouping from contextual aggregation reported gains are on benchmark datasets not industrial online traffic.
针对较长会话中远期兴趣被忽略的问题 mida在原始物品嵌入上聚类 再按簇规模门控聚合编码器输出。语义分组与序列上下文分工处理 多个离线基准显示收益 可作为长历史兴趣聚合模块参考。

cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to improve next-item prediction in a target domain by leveraging user behavior from auxiliary source domains. however real-world deployment faces two critical challenges business constraints that isolate interaction data across domains and user heterogeneity where many users lack cross-domain activity. this makes existing cross-domain methods difficult to apply. in this paper we propose a simple and practical framework for cross-domain sequential recommendations that transfers information exclusively through learned user representations without sharing raw interaction data or item embeddings across domains. we introduce a lightweight adapter that projects the source-domain user representation into the target-domain embedding space and integrates it with the target interaction sequence. importantly when source data is unavailable i.e. the user observed only in the target domain the model seamlessly defaults to a robust target-only sequential recommender retaining benefits from joint training across all users. extensive experiments were conducted under two setups one targets benchmarking against previous baselines while the other focuses on realistic and scalable conditions. both sets of experiments demonstrate consistent performance gains for shared and unshared users.

transfers cross-domain information through learned user representations and a lightweight adapter without sharing raw interactions or item embeddings. shared and target-only users are trained jointly with target-only fallback when source representations are unavailable experiments cover benchmark and deployment-oriented settings.
跨域迁移仅交换用户表征 通过轻量适配器接入目标域序列 减少对原始行为和物品嵌入共享的依赖。源域信息缺失时回退为目标域模型 实验同时覆盖跨域活跃用户与单域用户 为受业务隔离约束的序列推荐提供实现思路。

linear attention stores historical information in a recurrent state of fixed size providing a compact memory representation for long-context inference. reducing state precision further lowers per-request storage requirements but quantized writeback errors enter subsequent recurrences degrade prediction quality on long-reasoning tasks and can be accompanied by repetitive generation and excessively long outputs. we propose global gradient-aware allocation gga and the pure-write sliding window pw to address precision allocation and recent-information maintenance. gga combines candidate quantization residuals with gradient sensitivity to future prediction loss to allocate head bit widths under a model-wide mixed-precision budget. pw independently maintains recent pure writes as fp8 vector pairs propagates them through the full gdn state transition and merges them into the low-bit historical state only after they leave the window. across seven evaluations on qwen3.5-4b/9b gga allocation alone improves over stepquant@4 by 19.48/29.84 percentage points. adding pw-s8 yields seven-task macro-averages of 69.83%/78.63% improving over stepquant@4 by 38.39/41.21 percentage points respectively. both precision reallocation and window maintenance improve task scores while mitigating excessively long outputs at @6 gga reduces mean generation length averaged equally across tasks by 10.45%/14.65% relative to stepquant adding pw-s8 to gga@4 further reduces mean generation length by 32.32%/36.77%. comparisons at similar storage budgets further show that using additional capacity to maintain recent writes yields higher task scores and shorter mean outputs than solely increasing the bit width of the accumulated state.

combines gradient-aware mixed-precision allocation with an fp8 window of recent pure writes for low-bit gdn recurrent states. on qwen3.5-4b/9b the combination improves long-reasoning task scores over the evaluated quantization baseline while reducing excessive generation similar-storage comparisons motivate spending capacity on recent writes rather than only higher state precision.
针对低比特递归状态的写回误差 采用梯度敏感度分配各头位宽 并用fp8窗口保存近期纯写入。qwen3.5两种规模的实验表明 组合设计可改善推理任务表现并缓解异常长输出 相近存储预算下 保留近期写入比单纯提高累积状态位宽更有效。

speculative decoding sd accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. for mixture-of-experts moe models prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. we evaluate this across 10 sparse moe models 30b--1t parameters 8--512 experts and find recent fine-grained models break this trend showing higher speedup at low batch size. we find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and gpu execution dynamics. at low batch size moe layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights on h100 kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of moe kernels relative to attention with l2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. across draft tokens routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. we model this effect using a maximum-entropy iterative proportional fitting ipf framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4% error and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.

studies speculative decoding across ten sparse moe models and explains unexpectedly strong low-batch gains through expert routing overlap and kernel bandwidth utilization. an ipf model predicts unique activated experts with under 4% error in the reported evaluations offering a more grounded cost model than parameter-byte counts alone.
在10个稀疏moe模型上分析小批量推测解码 发现收益与草稿间专家重叠、内核带宽利用及缓存复用共同相关。利用路由重叠统计建立ipf模型 报告的独立激活专家数预测误差低于4% 为稀疏推荐模型的容量与延迟估算提供参考。

sparse expert execution does not remove the stored states needed to adapt a mixture-of-experts language model. we present duplextune a framework for replaying coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules. trainable width bridges connect two residual streams to the backbone. bridge warm-up precedes backbone adaptation with router weights kept frozen. we analyze the implicit state-recovery equation and identify the convergence and replay conditions needed for reconstruction. on qwen1.5-moe-a2.7b the single-h800 evaluation reports 38.8 gb peak memory versus 64.8 gb for supervised fine-tuning with checkpointing and throughput of 25.1 versus 19.9 samples/s. duplextune achieves 67.2% mmlu 75.6% gsm8k and 7.69 mt-bench with a weaker multilingual score than the checkpointed baseline. the results characterize a configuration-dependent tradeoff among state storage throughput and adaptation quality.

replays coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules using trainable width bridges with bridge warm-up and frozen routers. a single-h800 qwen1.5-moe experiment reports 38.8 versus 64.8 gb peak memory and higher throughput than checkpointed fine-tuning with task-dependent quality tradeoffs including weaker multilingual performance.
以可训练宽度桥连接两条残差流 在预训练注意力和专家模块中重放耦合状态 降低moe适配时的激活存储。单h800实验的峰值显存由检查点微调的64.8gb降至38.8gb 吞吐提高 但多语言指标较弱 适合借鉴状态重建与质量权衡。

when a mixture-of-experts moe model does not fit in gpu memory batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. we propose prefetch-steered routing psr routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token physical copies affect only latency. on olmoe-1b-7b with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an rtx 4090 psr decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with lru and 25-30% faster than the cache-prior operating point with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points 95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3 . in greedy generation its lead over cache-prior depends on the workload and reverses on humaneval at 50% residency. on moonlight-16b-a3b psr is 1.9x faster than exact routing with lru at 37.5% residency and at the latency of cache-prior significantly better on three of eight benchmarks. on qwen3.6-35b-a3b where copies are cheap relative to computation psr keeps its advantage over cache-prior on the likelihood benchmarks but not its speed. distillation-trained gates did not help. speculative decoding with block-level expert selection was slower than psr with a 1b autoregressive drafter on olmoe but with a block drafter on qwen3.6 it was 2.1-2.9x faster than any autoregressive configuration with at most its gpu memory on the 64 prompts we timed.

uses a deterministic logical expert cache to steer routing in offloaded moe decoding separating model decisions from physical transfer timing. reported speed and quality tradeoffs vary by model expert residency and workload results provide a reproducible way to study cache-aware routing and prefetching together.
用确定性的逻辑专家缓存决定路由 让实际拷贝时序只影响延迟 避免异步预取改变模型输出。多模型实验比较专家驻留比例、速度和任务表现 为专家卸载、缓存感知路由与预取的联合评估提供可复现设计。

speculative decoding checks several drafted tokens in one verification pass. on a mixture-of-experts moe model consecutive tokens often select the same experts. a deduplicating engine reads each selected expert once per pass so it requests fewer bytes than a per-slot engine which reads it once per token. we write a step's time as the bytes each kernel requests over its effective bandwidth plus fixed time. under geometric acceptance we derive from this step time when speculation is faster than plain decoding. the best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate. we bound how a bandwidth error moves each result and we check the main steps in lean. deduplication is faster exactly where its share \bar u n of the per-slot bytes is below its ratio r n of the per-slot bandwidth. on llama.cpp metal mlx-lm and llama.cpp cuda which we modified to deduplicate the per-slot kernel has the higher effective bandwidth r = 0.32 to 0.75 . thus deduplication is faster only from 5 to 8 tokens per pass or never. we fit the bandwidths on one layer's expert operation run alone in under an hour per model. bytes from routing traces over these bandwidths predict the time that deduplication saves. the measured saving lies inside its error bound at every point on cuda and mlx-lm and at 36 of 48 points on metal. the crossover is the first pass size at which deduplication is faster. the prediction places it within one pass size in 10 of 12 configurations of engine model and depth. we computed these predictions after the measurements. on deepseek-v2-lite operation times measured before its speculative runs give the best draft length on cuda within one at all 22 acceptance values.

models moe speculative verification time using requested expert bytes effective kernel bandwidth and fixed overhead. measured engines show that deduplicating expert reads can lose bandwidth efficiency so fewer bytes do not always mean lower latency the model estimates crossover points and draft lengths with explicit error bounds.
把moe推测验证时间拆为专家读取字节数、有效内核带宽和固定开销 推导去重读取的收益条件与草稿长度选择。多个执行引擎的实验说明去重也可能降低带宽效率 适用于专家复用优化前的延迟建模与实测校准。

softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts suppressing access to the others. we study how this concentration forms why it persists and how suppressed probabilities recover. for fixed experts a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. in a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. an exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths uniform over initial masses the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. an exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. in paired transformer-moe training removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens both with and without capacity constraints.

analyzes expert suppression and recovery in softmax routing through simplified fixed-expert and adapting-expert dynamics. transformer-moe interventions connect class-conditional router gradients to recovery delays offering theoretical and experimental insight into routing collapse rather than a general guaranteed remedy.
分析softmax路由中专家概率集中、受抑专家恢复的动力学 用简化模型刻画恢复时间与梯度优势的关系。配对transformer-moe训练通过干预类别条件路由梯度验证恢复延迟 为诊断专家坍塌与负载恢复提供机制依据。

agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks such as open-ended scientific work where models benefit from long context windows. however at ultra-long context above 1m tokens full attention is prohibitively expensive. a promising approach is sparse attention in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. we address this with latent sparse attention lsa an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. in lsa keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key making prefill decode and training faster at long context. we propose two variants distilled-lsa d-lsa which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation and native-lsa n-lsa which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. on glm-5.3-flash qwen-3.8-27b at 10m tokens d-lsa speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x 72.4x in prefill and 4.6x 42.5x in decode over its original sparse attention full attention while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. n-lsa matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. lsa offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.

clusters keys hierarchically in a learned latent space so queries select clusters rather than score every key. distilled and natively trained variants improve ultra-long-context attention reported 10m-token speedups concern individual attention layers while native training achieves a 1.6x per-layer speedup at 128k. the indexer offers a design reference for long-history retrieval.
将键向量在学习得到的潜在空间中分层聚类 查询沿簇层级选择候选 减少超长上下文的索引成本。提供蒸馏和原生训练两种方案 1000万token实验报告单层注意力加速 原生方案在128k长度下实现单层训练1.6倍加速 可借鉴于超长行为序列的稀疏检索。

decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. however transferring a generative llm's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document id sequences while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. to bridge this gap we introduce decisionrank a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation opd . item-space opd constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. a generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. combined with offline ranking supervision decisionrank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as trec dl beir and bright. across four benchmarks item-space opd consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. even at 1.7b parameters decisionrank surpasses its 27b generative teacher on trec dl19--23. at 8b it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running 24.5× faster on trec dl and 16.7× faster on bright.

sorts student first-token document scores into a ranking and obtains conditional feedback from a generative teacher for item-space on-policy distillation. a 1.7b student surpasses its 27b teacher on trec dl19–23 the 8b model runs 24.5x faster on trec dl and 16.7x faster on bright than its generative listwise counterpart supporting efficient reranking.
将学生对文档的首token打分排序为列表 再由生成式教师沿该排序给出条件反馈 实现物品空间的在策略蒸馏。1.7b模型在trec dl19–23超过27b教师 8b模型相对生成式列表重排在trec dl和bright分别加速24.5倍和16.7倍 为低延迟重排提供训练路径。

the quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models llms . a variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness e.g. sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state or only achieve constant-factor speedups e.g. sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically . in this paper we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical tree-structured indexer which we call zyphra hierarchical attention zha . zha constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the kv cache which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. crucially by iteratively growing the tree's depth the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length resulting in overall subquadratic but superlinear scaling for attention. we demonstrate that zha can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short kl distillation training stage of a billion tokens and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning mathematical and agentic coding evaluation tasks. moreover we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. finally we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million tokens of context and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

zha builds a tree of compressed kv summaries and retrieves keys top-down giving subquadratic indexing and attention cost. the revision specifies a one-billion-token kl-distillation stage to adapt pretrained models while retaining evaluated retrieval and reasoning capabilities. advantages beyond one million context tokens are projections from a performance model.
zha将kv摘要组织为树 自顶向下检索键 使索引与注意力整体呈次二次计算增长。修订版将适配已有模型的kl蒸馏规模明确为10亿token 并报告保留所测检索与推理能力 百万token以上的速度优势来自性能模型推算。

looping re-applies a block of layers so that each token passes through the block more than once. adding a loop to a trained model is attractive because it leaves the parameter count and hence the disk size the memory footprint and the training cost unchanged. unfortunately every generated token pays for the loop. re-applying m of n layers makes each token about n+m /n times as expensive. loops that a model learns during large-scale pretraining justify this price but whether loops added after pretraining justify this cost remains unclear. we compare a looped model with two simple baselines. we first compare it with the same model trained identically without the loop equal parameters . secondly we compare it with the best unlooped use of the same inference floating-point operations equal flops . across qwen3 and qwen3.5 models from 0.8b to 9b parameters only the looped 0.8b model beats both baselines. at 4b and 9b the looped model does not beat the first baseline i.e. the same model trained without the loop. this is not because the benchmarks are too easy since on the same benchmarks the unlooped 9b model still scores up to 13 points higher than the 4b model showing that there is ample room for improvement. introducing loops in an already pretrained model therefore only pays for small models with a fixed parameter budget.

evaluates post-hoc layer looping against both equal-parameter and equal-inference-flop baselines. across tested qwen3 and qwen3.5 models from 0.8b to 9b only the 0.8b looped model beats both baselines. the controlled comparisons provide a practical methodology for assessing the compute return of shared-depth scaling.
研究给已训练模型添加共享层循环是否值得额外推理计算 同时设置等参数与等推理flops基线。在qwen3和qwen3.5的0.8b至9b实验中 仅0.8b循环模型同时超过两类基线 为循环深度扩展的成本评估提供直接对照方法。

linear attention scales linearly with sequence length but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. in gated linear recurrences memory retention depends on state decay which is shaped jointly by gate parameters a_log and dt_bias and by input activations. in controlled gated deltanet gdn experiments both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training highlighting the importance of initialization. therefore we introduce dual-axis memory initialization dami which jointly configures these parameters before training. dami assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. a small activation sample calibrates the gdn-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. across gdn kda gdn2 mamba-2 and rwkv-7 dami improves average ruler-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. performance on language modeling commonsense reasoning and 2k real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. our code is available at https //speedai.com/research/dami.

jointly initializes decay parameters to distribute memory timescales across heads and input sensitivity across depth. small activation samples calibrate the initialization without adding trainable parameters. reported ruler-style retrieval gains span 5.29–16.71 percentage points across gated recurrent architectures suggesting an initialization strategy for long-history memory.
在训练前联合设置门控线性注意力的衰减参数 使不同头覆盖不同记忆时间尺度 并沿深度配置输入敏感度。小规模激活校准无需新增可训练参数 在gdn、kda、mamba-2等架构上提升长距离检索准确率5.29至16.71个百分点 可参考用于长行为序列记忆初始化。

looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. however each additional pass increases training floating-point operations flops making these gains more expensive to obtain. to address this cost we propose uploop a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count total training tokens and training flops. specifically uploop begins with a shallow transformer progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3b parameters. these gains also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.

starts with a shallow transformer grows it by copying learned layers and spends the saved early compute on repeated execution of a shared middle block. with final parameters training tokens and flops matched to a dense baseline the 1.3b model improves its mean score over 22 tasks from 22.99 to 27.52 providing a compute-budgeted depth-scaling schedule.
先训练较浅网络 再复制已学习层逐步增加深度 将前期节省的计算用于后期共享中间层的循环执行。与普通transformer匹配最终参数量、训练token和训练flops后 1.3b模型在22项任务上的均分从22.99提升到27.52 为固定预算下的深度扩展提供训练方案。

modern recommender models scale sparse representations and dense computation together. they process thousands of heterogeneous feature fields long user-behavior sequences and trillion-scale embedding parameters while their dense networks increasingly use large transformer architectures. the resulting execution mismatch creates fine-grained operations within stages load imbalance and synchronization delays across devices and gpu resource bubbles between stages. as models grow these costs become a primary limit to scalable recommender training. although existing systems improve embedding caching and data prefetching these inefficiencies still coexist in the gpu-centric workloads we study and jointly limit end-to-end throughput. we present recis a unified framework for gpu-centric recommender training. recis treats the complete path from input features to dense computation as one optimization target and coordinates three complementary mechanisms. first adaptive fusion combines fragmented feature transformations with vectorized memory access. second a gpu embedding engine uses hash-based sharding and hierarchical communication to balance request placement and eliminate redundant transfers it also specializes aggregation for forward and backward index structures. third a multistage pipeline overlaps input preparation for future iterations with dense computation in the current iteration. together these mechanisms reorganize a fragmented sparse front end into a dataflow that continuously feeds dense computation. we evaluate recis on representative industrial recommender models across distributed training platforms. compared with picasso and torchrec recis reaches up to 2.62× and 1.15× their throughput respectively while reducing step latency by up to 61.5% and 12.9%. recis provides an efficient and scalable training system for large recommender models.

coordinates feature processing sparse embeddings and dense networks for scalable recommendation training. adaptive feature-operation fusion gpu embedding sharding with hierarchical communication and multistage pipelining reduce synchronization and idle resources. reported throughput reaches up to 2.62x picasso and 1.15x torchrec supporting joint sparse-and-dense model scaling.
面向大规模推荐训练 统一优化特征处理、稀疏嵌入与稠密网络之间的执行开销。通过自适应算子融合、gpu嵌入分片与分层通信 以及多阶段流水线减少同步和资源空闲 实验吞吐最高达到picasso的2.62倍、torchrec的1.15倍 为稀疏与稠密模型共同扩展提供系统支持。

gated delta networks gdns offer linear-time sequence modeling yet long-context prefill remains costly due to dense intra-chunk computation recurrent-state updates and intermediate state storage. we introduce sparsegdn a hardware-aware framework that combines structured intra-chunk approximation with input-dependent recurrent-event selection while producing outputs for every token. a block-adjacent solver reduces local delta-solve computation while a dynamic selector allocates recurrent-update budgets across head pairs. the gpu implementation materializes updates only for selected events and reconstructs token outputs using compact state snapshots and group-local interactions reducing computation and memory traffic. we evaluate sparsegdn on qwen3.5-4b and qwen3.5-9b across ruler tasks and context lengths from 4k to 128k. retaining approximately 29% of recurrent events on average sparsegdn achieves 1.50-1.94x gdn-core prefill speedups over native fla kernels including online selection overhead.

combines a block-adjacent delta solver with input-dependent recurrent-event selection reconstructing every token output from compact state snapshots. on qwen3.5-4b and 9b retaining about 29% of recurrent events yields 1.50–1.94x gdn-core prefill speedups over native fla kernels across 4k–128k contexts including online selection overhead.
用块邻接近似减少局部delta求解 再按输入动态选择递归更新事件 并通过紧凑状态快照重建全部token输出。qwen3.5的4b和9b实验平均保留约29%的递归事件 在4k至128k上下文获得1.50至1.94倍gdn核心预填充加速 包含在线选择开销。

training-free expert pruning makes two decisions which experts to remove and what the layer computes when its router still selects a removed expert. published methods change both at once. holding the mask fixed we compare replacement operators from three families on olmoe deepseek-v2-lite and moonlight with granite as a fourth router using paired multiplicity-corrected tests. the largest effect is a choice usually left implicit the survivors' gate scale. on routers trained without top-k renormalization renormalizing the survivors' gates a common implementation choice costs 0.8-8.5 points and reverses whether rerouting beats mone's mean-output replacement on two routers trained with renormalization the trained scale wins at 50% pruning. we introduce the tilted novice a closed-form low-rank map of the pruned expert's input whose rank-0 case is mone's constant. at 50% pruning it adds 1.2-1.8% parameters and gains 3.45 and 1.37 points over the constant on olmoe and moonlight stable across calibration draws and largely unchanged by 4- and 3-bit quantization. no operator dominates trained-scale rerouting is best on deepseek-v2-lite and a partial copy of each pruned expert is statistically indistinguishable from the tilted novice on two models. evaluation can change conclusions at 25% pruning mone's constant keeps 92-97% of dense multiple-choice accuracy but only 5-65% of gsm8k and 0-17% of code scores and the calibration domain moves the mask 4-9 times more than resampling. we propose a five-item reporting checklist.

holds pruning masks fixed to isolate replacement operators and surviving-expert gate scales. introduces the tilted novice a closed-form low-rank input map that improves over constant replacement on olmoe and moonlight. experiments show that preserving trained routing scale and choosing calibration data materially affect pruning results informing practical sparse-model compression.
固定专家裁剪集合 单独比较被裁专家的替代计算与剩余专家的门控缩放 揭示路由实现对裁剪收益的影响。提出低秩输入映射tilted novice 在olmoe和moonlight上优于常量替代 为稀疏模型压缩时保留路由语义和选择校准方案提供依据。

sparse moe mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. however practical deployment still requires storing all experts resulting in substantial memory overhead. we show that expert outputs in moe layers exhibit structured redundancy. across different models and task categories the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. motivated by these observations we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. we propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework projection energy expert pruning peep which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy and distributional coverage expert pruning dcep which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. experiments on deepseek-v2-lite and qwen3-30b-a3b demonstrate that at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50% our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.

treats expert pruning as structure-preserving subset selection peep preserves weighted projection energy while dcep preserves distributional coverage with router-derived weights. greedy selection achieves the best reported average results at 75% and 50% expert retention on deepseek-v2-lite and qwen3-30b-a3b targeting moe storage cost.
将专家裁剪转化为保持整体结构的子集选择 peep保留输出子空间的投影能量 dcep覆盖专家输出的分布几何 并引入路由权重。贪心选择在deepseek-v2-lite和qwen3-30b-a3b保留75%或50%专家时取得较好平均表现 为降低moe存储开销提供方法。

we study post-training for dynamically routed mixture-of-experts moe models focusing on integrating independently optimized specialists while keeping consolidation efficient. our approach combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation c-mopd which matches each selected teacher on a local top-k support with teacher-wise loss normalization and clipping with an execution path that uses post-capacity bounded-width dispatch final-route replay and asynchronous rollout--training overlap. on turing-20b-a2b the selected model achieves a four-domain normalized integration score of 0.9988 and retains at least 90.16% of the measured specialist gain in every domain. at matched k=32 the full calibration objective scores 0.9962 compared with 0.9724 without calibration and 0.9834 without clipping. at a matched 8k response cap the model exceeds both shared sft and qwen3-8b on all four reasoning-enabled mathematics and code benchmarks unweighted mean 85.92 versus 80.33 for qwen3-8b and 74.21 for sft and improves over sft on ten of twelve broader evaluation metrics. in a ppu-based profile the combined execution configuration reduces consolidation step time from 398.7 to 139.3 seconds an observed 2.86× speedup over serial execution. these results demonstrate strong specialist integration alongside more efficient consolidation while reflecting the complete training and execution framework rather than any single component.

combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation with bounded-width dispatch final-route replay and asynchronous rollout–training overlap. turing-20b-a2b retains at least 90.16% of measured specialist gains in each domain. the complete ppu execution configuration reduces consolidation step time from 398.7 to 139.3 seconds illustrating coordinated routing and training-system optimization.
通过教师局部top-k匹配、损失归一化与裁剪 将多领域专家蒸馏到动态moe学生 执行端结合容量限制后的定宽分发、最终路由回放及异步流水线。turing-20b-a2b保留各领域至少90.16%的专家增益 完整执行配置在ppu测量中将整合步骤从398.7秒降至139.3秒。

low-precision training reduces computation but introduces additional rounding error. we theoretically study how stochastic rounding sr affects prediction risk as model size training time and precision change. we consider a two-layer linear network with a fixed random first layer trained by mini-batch sgd on fresh gaussian data with power-law spectra. at each sgd step the features used in forward and backward computations are rounded independently. we prove matched upper and lower bounds on prediction error for the final model and for uniform parameter averaging with general learning-rate and precision schedules chosen before training. for fixed precisions and constant learning rates with parameter averaging we derive how the smallest prediction error decreases with compute and we identify model sizes and training times that achieve this optimal-compute scaling. rounding only the forward features preserves the compute scaling of exact arithmetic while rounding backward features changes it. averaging parameters can change which computation needs higher precision and when higher precision is useful. our results also give bit requirements for a given accuracy tolerance and show how backward rounding can change learning-rate schedule design. at a fixed compute budget lower precision can improve prediction when the benefit of a larger model or longer training outweighs the additional sr-induced error. model simulations illustrate these tradeoffs and experiments with an mlp and a small transformer examine rounding choices beyond the theoretical model.

derives stochastic-rounding scaling laws in a two-layer linear model with a fixed random first layer distinguishing forward and backward rounding and parameter averaging. the analysis connects width training time and precision budgets with mlp and small-transformer experiments examining rounding choices beyond the theoretical setting. it informs low-precision training allocation.
在固定随机首层的两层线性网络中 联合分析模型宽度、训练时长和随机舍入精度 区分前向与反向舍入对误差及计算最优尺度律的影响。推导给定精度目标下的位数与调度要求 并用mlp和小型transformer实验检验精度分配 为低精度训练预算设计提供参考。

the bottleneck of attention mechanisms which are the fundamental building block of modern language models is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. there has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context also called kv-cache compression. in this article we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the hilbert space associated with its kernel. in this formalism attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. we thus introduce two novel kv-cache compression methods which we call gaim and q-daim based on the generalized empirical interpolation method geim and the q-discrete empirical interpolation method q-deim respectively. as the cost of these methods is quadratic in terms of context length we propose surrogate models based on the taylor series the performer and the random fourier features method which allow the compression to be done in linear time. finally we extend this result to the streaming attention setting providing new methods which allow one to penalize the selection of interpolation nodes based on the previously interpolated context and to update the previous interpolation based on new information. we then provide numerical results on the convergence of the residuals and the output error in future queries and preliminary results on the longbench-e benchmark showing performance comparable to the state-of-the-art methods. these experiments suggest that the range revealed by our q-daim method could help identify where information is concentrated in the kv cache thus enabling an efficient compression.

expresses attention as a ratio of linear maps and uses empirical interpolation to build gaim and q-daim kv-cache compression. kernel surrogates reduce compression cost to linear time and streaming variants update compressed history. numerical experiments and preliminary longbench-e results offer a numerical-analysis approach to long-context memory reduction.
把注意力写成两个线性映射之比 通过经验插值选择代表性kv信息 提出gaim与q-daim压缩方法。进一步采用核近似将压缩开销降为线性 并支持流式历史更新 数值实验与初步longbench-e结果为长序列缓存压缩提供数值分析视角。

we introduce nemotron 3.5 super and nemotron 3.5 lightning open and efficient mixture-of-experts hybrid mamba-transformer models designed for reasoning long-context understanding and agentic workloads. super is a 120b-parameter 12b-active multimodal model while lightning is a smaller 30b-parameter 3b-active text model both designed for efficient deployment. both models combine large-scale distillation long-context training and native speculative decoding while super further incorporates indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. we develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning rlvr and rlhf complemented in super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation mopd . this transforms super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text images video and interactive tool environments. we further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. across training and deployment we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. indic continued pretraining improves indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. the post-trained super model achieves 51.78% on swe-bench pro surpassing nemotron 3 ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. post-training mtp boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling while nvfp4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to bf16. inference optimizations enable up to 4 856 output tokens/s/gpu on gb200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

presents the 120b/12b-active super and 30b/3b-active lightning hybrid mamba-transformer moe models combining distillation long-context training and native speculative decoding. nvfp4 quantization reports 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to bf16. the report provides engineering recipes connecting sparse architecture cache management and deployment precision.
报告120b总参数、12b激活参数的super与30b总参数、3b激活参数的lightning 结合mamba-transformer混合架构、moe、蒸馏和原生推测解码。nvfp4量化的准确率恢复中位数达到bf16的99.62% 展示稀疏架构、缓存管理与部署精度协同优化的工程路径。

transformers retain an explicit history of the sequence allowing attention to directly retrieve past representations. however the size of the kv-cache and the cost of a new token increase with the context length. state space models compress the past into a fixed-size recurrent state at the cost of reduced addressability. we present the dynamical memory transformer dmt a hybrid architecture that separates sequence encoding from information reading. the encoder uses several memory units each implemented by a dynamical system with a complex diagonal recurrent matrix. an input-dependent leak rate controls their updates. the decoder then uses attention to read and combine their outputs without going through the token history. the formulation of the recurrence allows an associative scan with o t total work and o log t parallel depth with fixed dimensions. during autoregressive inference the recurrent states and the convolution cache remain fixed in size. we compare dmt with mamba and transformer on cognitive and language modeling tasks and show its strengths and limitations dmt achieves the best results on several cognitive tasks and language modeling performance close to that of transformer but remains behind mamba in language modeling. on selective copy dmt also shows stronger length extrapolation than mamba and transformer. these results demonstrate that parallel dynamical memory units are a promising mechanism for retaining and using information over sequences.

separates recurrent sequence encoding from attention-based reading of memory-unit outputs. input-dependent updates and diagonal complex recurrence permit linear-work associative scans with fixed-size inference state. cognitive tasks and selective-copy extrapolation show benefits language modeling is close to the evaluated transformer but trails mamba offering an alternative long-sequence memory design.
将序列编码与信息读取分离 多个带输入相关更新率的递归记忆单元压缩历史 再由注意力读取这些单元的当前输出。固定维度下采用线性总工作量的并行扫描 推理状态大小保持固定 认知任务与选择性复制显示优势 语言建模接近transformer而落后于mamba 为长序列记忆设计提供参考。
