generative recommendation generates the semantic id sid of the next item from a user's interaction history. existing training objectives mainly supervise target sid tokens while on-policy distillation opd provides denser supervision through a teacher's probability distribution over all tokens for more effective and efficient training. however opd can aggravate popularity bias teacher feedback favors popular-item tokens transferring this preference to the student while student rollout favors popular items leaving unpopular-item sid paths rarely generated and supervised. these two sources of bias reinforce each other and reduce recommendation diversity. we propose hero a diversity-aware opd framework. heterogeneous teacher distillation trains two teachers specializing in popular and unpopular items and routes each training sample to the teacher matching the popularity group of its ground-truth item. the student learns from the routed teacher's probability distribution along its own generated sids. diversity-aware item rollout incorporates ground-truth sids of unpopular items into training covering sid paths that the student rarely generates. only the student is used for inference. offline experiments on an industrial dataset and three public datasets further demonstrate its effectiveness diversity and robustness. moreover we deploy hero in the guess what you like module on the 1688 homepage where a 15-day online a/b test shows a 3.412% increase in gross merchandise value gmv .

hero routes popular and long-tail training examples to specialized teachers and supplements rare student-generated semantic-id paths. only the student serves inference the authors report offline improvements and a 3.412% gmv increase in a 15-day 1688 a/b test.
hero将热门和长尾样本分别交给专长不同的教师蒸馏 并补充学生较少生成的长尾语义id路径。推理仅使用学生模型 作者报告离线效果改善 以及1688上15天a/b实验中gmv提升3.412%。

large language model llm embeddings have been increasingly adopted in sequential recommendation to encode static item attributes and alleviate the limitations of item id embeddings under sparse interactions. however these embeddings typically capture only static content similarity while neglecting sequential transitions and since their adaptation quality relies on sparse per-item updates or global geometric calibration existing methods still struggle to explicitly transfer preceding interaction contexts from frequent to long-tail items under unevenly distributed behavioral evidence limiting recommendation effectiveness across the catalog. to address this challenge we propose pacerec an id-free progressive adaptation framework that incorporates preceding interaction contexts into semantic representation adaptation by learning a shared velocity field from items with sufficient interactions via frequency-weighted flow matching. in this way pacerec progressively guides static llm embeddings toward collaborative behavioral targets while preserving original item semantics overcoming sparse per-item updates to effectively generalize sequential transition patterns to long-tail items for both user modeling and candidate scoring. extensive experiments on three real-world datasets across three sequential backbones demonstrate the superiority of our method over competitive baselines in both overall and long-tail recommendation.

pacerec uses frequency-weighted flow matching to adapt static llm item embeddings toward collaborative behavioral targets. a shared velocity field transfers preceding-interaction patterns from frequent to long-tail items with improvements reported across three datasets and three sequential backbones.
pacerec通过频次加权的流匹配 将静态llm物品向量逐步适配到协同行为目标。共享速度场把高频物品的前序交互规律迁移给长尾物品 作者在三个数据集、三种序列骨干上报告效果提升。

reasoning-augmented recommender systems recsys enhance user preference modeling by generating reasoning trajectories over historical interactions before making recommendations. knowledge distillation provides a practical paradigm for transferring such reasoning capabilities from powerful large language models to lightweight recsys. however existing methods typically rely on a single fixed teacher remain constrained by the teacher knowledge ceiling and indiscriminately distill teacher-generated trajectories without assessing their actual utility for downstream recommendation. to address these limitations we propose muse multi-teacher utility-guided selection with self-exploration an adaptive reasoning distillation framework that jointly improves reasoning generation and reasoning utilization. muse first constructs a diverse reasoning pool using multiple teacher llms and progressively augments it via student self-exploration enabling the student to leverage the strengths of different teachers and gradually explore reasoning strategies beyond teacher imitation. we then develop rank-gain utility assessment rgua which evaluates each candidate according to the normalized full-catalog rank improvement of the ground-truth item and identifies the most and least recommendation-beneficial trajectories. based on these utility-aware trajectory pairs we introduce dual-level contrastive learning objectives that guide the student generator to prefer beneficial reasoning while training the recommendation encoder to more effectively exploit recommendation-relevant preference evidence. extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework.

muse combines reasoning from multiple teachers with student self-exploration and scores trajectories by full-catalog rank improvement. dual-level contrastive objectives teach the generator to prefer useful reasoning and the recommendation encoder to exploit it experiments cover three datasets.
muse结合多教师推理和学生自探索 以目标物品在全目录中的排名改善衡量推理轨迹价值。双层对比目标分别训练生成器选择有用推理、推荐编码器利用偏好证据 并在三个数据集上验证。

semantic ids sids have emerged as a promising approach for discriminative recommendation by encoding continuous item rep- resentations into compact discrete identifiers. however existing sid-based methods face two fundamental limitations semantic mis- match between content semantics and collaborative preferences and objective mismatch between sid construction and downstream recommendation optimization. to address these challenges we propose sidrec an end-to-end recommendation-aware sid learn- ing framework that jointly models content and collaborative in- formation while aligning sid construction with recommendation objectives. specifically sidrec introduces a self-updating fusion mechanism that explicitly integrates pretrained content represen- tations with collaborative embeddings initialized from a trained recommendation model enabling preference-aware semantic mod- eling. furthermore sidrec employs an mmoe-inspired joint opti- mization mechanism with shared experts and task-specific gates allowing recommendation supervision to directly guide differen- tiable quantization and produce task-adaptive discrete representa- tions. extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that sidrec consistently outperforms all competing methods across both auc and gauc achieving up to 5.15% relative improvements over the strongest baselines. further ablation stud- ies validate the effectiveness and complementarity of collaborative semantic modeling and end-to-end sid optimization.

sidrec jointly learns content and collaborative semantic ids with recommendation supervision. self-updating representation fusion and an mmoe-inspired differentiable-quantization objective address semantic and training-objective mismatch three public datasets show auc and gauc improvements with up to 5.15% relative gains over the strongest baselines.
sidrec将内容与协同信息融合 并用推荐监督端到端学习语义id。自更新表征融合和受mmoe启发的可微量化联合目标缓解语义与优化目标不一致 三个公开数据集上的auc和gauc改善 相对最强基线最高提升5.15%。

numerical embeddings map scalar features into vectors before a click-through rate ctr backbone combines the fields. to our knowledge numembbench is the first open benchmark dedicated to comparing numerical embeddings for ctr prediction. we classify 18 configurations into six mechanism-based families and evaluate them through one fuxictr interface. after equal-budget validation tuning we compare frozen configurations on three datasets nine backbones and five seeds under a shared train-only z-score protocol. deer has the best mean rank but six methods lead at least one dataset--backbone setting. a matched native-scale test changes the winner in 11 of 27 settings while paired latency measurements show that accuracy and inference cost need not move together. code and per-seed results https //github.com/yh-learning/numembbench

numembbench compares 18 numerical-embedding configurations across six mechanism families using a shared fuxictr interface three datasets nine backbones and five seeds. native-scale evaluation changes the winner in 11 of 27 settings highlighting dependence on preprocessing and the need to measure both accuracy and inference latency.
numembbench通过统一fuxictr接口 在三个数据集、九种骨干和五个随机种子下比较六类机制的18种数值编码配置。改用原始尺度后 27个设置中11个更换最优方法 说明选型需要同时考虑预处理、预测效果和推理延迟。

generative recommendation can reproduce a wider beam's ranked output with roughly half the prefix-capacity budget by reallocating retention capacity across semantic-id positions. we identify a first-step coverage bottleneck across six full-test settings of the tiger generative recommender spanning three domains and two identifier constructions every pruned exact top-10 path is first lost at the initial decoding step. an exact-catalog reference isolates search losses and guides a controlled budget intervention. moving width to the first step raises search recall@10 by 0.96--10.90 percentage points at beam-50's unchanged budget. across all 77 373 test users with residual-quantized variational autoencoder rq-vae tokenization the reallocated schedule reproduces beam-100's ordered top-10 at nominal budgets of 151 rather than 301 without retraining or changing identifiers or scores. matched-output timing saves 6.35--6.39% of decoder latency profiling identifies the execution costs that limit the translation from reduced search work to runtime savings. larger-candidate experiments reveal how output size changes retention requirements. these findings make budget placement an actionable serving decision locate ranking loss redirect search capacity and preserve downstream inputs before increasing uniform beam width.

a controlled tiger study finds that exact top-10 paths lost by beam search are first pruned at the initial semantic-id step in six tested settings. reallocating capacity to that step reproduces beam-100 output at a nominal budget of 151 rather than 301 while matched-output decoder latency improves by only 6.35–6.39%.
这项tiger受控实验发现 六个测试设置中被束搜索遗漏的精确top-10路径 首次丢失均发生在语义id解码第一步。将保留容量前移 可用151而非301的名义预算复现beam-100输出 相同输出下实际解码延迟改善为6.35%—6.39%。

we present wesearch a unified model-centric retrieval framework for large-scale continuously evolving content search. prevailing methods assign documents fixed hierarchical semantic ids implicitly assuming each document follows a single coherent semantic path-an assumption that often breaks down for multi-topic documents. wesearch instead retrieves query-relevant clusters and then ranks atomic documents within the resulting query-specific candidate space decoupling candidate pruning from fine-grained relevance modeling. combined with relevance-aware training compact document representations and incremental index updates this design enables weekly-or daily when needed-model refreshes. deployed as the primary semantic retrieval path in wechat search alongside a lexical syntax tree wesearch shows consistent one-week a/b gains on corpora from hundreds of millions to billions of documents and a one-month full-traffic a/b test confirms stable improvements of +0.68% ctr and +2.27% per-user article clicks together with a 41% reduction in retrieval resource cost and a 19 ms reduction in graphic-text retrieval latency. wesearch is now fully deployed in wechat search serving 100% of production traffic.

wesearch retrieves query-relevant clusters before ranking atomic documents decoupling candidate pruning from document relevance. compact representations and incremental updates support frequent refreshes the authors report full deployment in wechat search with a month-long test showing +0.68% ctr +2.27% per-user article clicks 41% lower retrieval resource cost and 19 ms lower graphic-text retrieval latency.
wesearch先检索与查询相关的簇 再对簇内原子文档排序 将候选裁剪与精细相关性建模分离。紧凑表示和增量索引支持频繁更新 作者报告已在微信搜索全量部署 一个月实验中ctr提升0.68%、人均文章点击提升2.27% 检索资源成本下降41% 图文检索延迟降低19毫秒。

recommending creators that a user does not yet follow is a cold-start problem from hundreds of thousands of popular creators and only a short trail of prior engagements the system must predict the next creator worth surfacing. the prevailing generative recommendation recipe tokenizes each creator into a semantic id sid by quantizing a frozen embedding and trains a language model to generate sids. we show that this sid layer not the language model is the binding constraint. the creator-to-sid map is many-to-one so colliding creators must be resolved by a popularity tie-break that caps creator-level recall and favors already-popular creators and the frozen quantizer stops the training gradient from reaching the creator representation. we propose atomic creator token act which gives every creator its own vocabulary token trained end-to-end. the map is bijective so collisions are impossible and inference is a direct top-k over creator logits. in a controlled comparison on production data in which the token layer is the only variable act improves creator-level recall@15 by 19.8 points 1.84× over a matched sid baseline still leads when the sid codebook is enlarged 64× and serves at ∼2.7× lower per-user latency. the advantage carries over to the public kuairand dataset where act is the only method that beats a global-popularity baseline provided each creator token sees enough training examples. in a live a/b test act is directionally positive on every reported metric against both the sid-enhanced and the classic production rankers.

atomic creator token assigns each creator a unique end-to-end-trained vocabulary token instead of a frozen quantized semantic id. a controlled production-data comparison reports a 19.8-point recall@15 gain and about 2.7× lower per-user latency public-data gains require enough training examples per creator and online metrics are reported as directionally positive.
atomic creator token为每个创作者分配唯一且端到端训练的词表token 替代冻结量化的语义id。生产数据受控对比报告recall@15提高19.8个百分点、人均延迟约降低至原来的1/2.7 公开数据上的收益依赖每位创作者有足够训练样本 线上结果报告为方向性正向。

recommendation models consume increasingly long attribute-rich user histories making small continuous updates and repeated large reads a central storage asymmetry. we present usdb bytedance's unified sequence storage practice for streaming and batch workloads. cascadelsm time-based compaction stages materialize application-specific histories differentiated replicas share persistent files partial dumps reconstruct inference inputs from captured recent state and versioned history and a hybrid columnar format accelerates projected reads. these designs reuse maintenance results across ingestion inference and training. production migration records show 85.8% lower mean write latency while normalized deployment accounting shows 42.1% lower infrastructure cost. controlled comparisons with an optimized rocksdb sequence baseline show faster long-history reads across projections and client loads. aggregation pushdown sustains 8.5x the throughput of ordinary reads under a constrained receive budget. production reconstruction and direct-file training results demonstrate how shared sequence maintenance supports fresh serving and repeated historical access.

usdb addresses the mismatch between small streaming updates and repeated long-history reads in recommendation storage. cascadelsm compaction shared-file replicas partial dumps and a hybrid columnar format reuse maintenance work across ingestion serving and training production records report 85.8% lower mean write latency and normalized accounting reports 42.1% lower infrastructure cost.
usdb针对推荐存储中小规模持续写入与长历史反复读取的不对称 结合cascadelsm分层压缩、共享文件副本、局部转储和混合列式格式 在写入、推理及训练间复用维护结果。生产迁移记录显示平均写延迟降低85.8% 归一化部署核算显示基础设施成本降低42.1%。

the sparse path comprising sparse operations and collective communication is a critical component of large-scale recommendation models. however these operations are often represented as opaque nodes in the training computation graph hindering whole-graph optimization. we present sparselift a low-overhead compiler for the sparse path of large-scale recommendation training. it exposes sparse computation and communication to whole-graph analysis to expand the optimization space and improve training efficiency. by analyzing model structure and runtime information sparselift reconstructs opaque nodes as analyzable subgraphs recovering the resource semantics of sparse computation and communication within the graph. building on the recovered semantics we design incremental cost models and a constraint-aware planner to automatically select and organize subgraph optimizations into an execution plan that is reused during subsequent steady-state training. we evaluate sparselift on an industrial video-platform recommendation task with 100b sparse parameters and the public dlrm benchmark. sparselift improves steady-state throughput for ordinary industrial training steps by 16.5% over the native baseline. on dlrm it achieves 1.60× and 1.26× model-execution speedups over dlrm-baseline and torchrec respectively.

sparselift exposes opaque sparse operations and collective communication as analyzable training subgraphs then uses incremental cost models and a constraint-aware planner to reuse optimized execution plans. it reports 16.5% higher ordinary steady-state throughput on a 100b-sparse-parameter industrial recommender and 1.60×/1.26× model-execution speedups over dlrm-baseline/torchrec.
sparselift将不透明的稀疏算子与集合通信展开为可分析子图 用增量成本模型和约束规划器生成可复用的训练执行计划。在1000亿稀疏参数的工业推荐模型上 普通稳态训练步吞吐提升16.5% dlrm模型执行速度分别为dlrm-baseline和torchrec的1.60倍、1.26倍。

generative recommendation has been widely adopted in large-scale industrial recommendation systems where multimodal item embeddings are quantized into offline semantic identifiers sids and items are retrieved by autoregressively generating their sids. however conventional sid construction often underrepresents item utility reflected in post-exposure behaviors such as shares long views and video completion making semantically similar items with different utility insufficiently distinguishable while struggling to accommodate rapidly changing utility signals. moreover generation likelihood may be misaligned with downstream utility causing high-utility candidates to be prematurely pruned during beam search before post-generation reranking or training-time reward alignment can effectively compensate. to address these limitations we propose uagr which aligns both sid construction and decoding with downstream multi-objective utility. our utility-enriched semantic codes preserve the original semantic information while incorporating item-level utility without increasing sid length or vocabulary size supporting incremental utility updates with no additional tokenization or sequence-decoding cost. meanwhile our utility-guided decoding estimates candidate utility by combining predictions of multiple post-exposure outcomes and incorporates these estimates into beam scoring reducing the risk of prematurely pruning high-utility paths while enabling flexible utility control without interfering with generative backbone training. extensive offline experiments and online a/b tests under real-world traffic demonstrate the effectiveness and deployability of uagr which has been fully deployed on kuaishou and increases video watch time by 0.206% online.

uagr incorporates post-exposure utility into semantic codes and beam scoring without increasing semantic-id length or vocabulary size. incremental utility updates and utility-guided decoding aim to retain valuable candidates early the authors report full kuaishou deployment and a 0.206% online watch-time increase.
uagr把曝光后行为效用融入语义编码与束搜索打分 同时保持语义id长度和词表规模不变。增量效用更新与效用引导解码帮助提前保留高价值候选 作者报告已在快手全量部署 线上观看时长提升0.206%。

generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating semantic ids typically via beam search. on-policy self-distillation opsd enhances training supervision by transferring privileged self-teacher knowledge at student-generated states. however beam-search retention depends on competition among prefixes visited states differ in importance and initially reliable decisions may approach the pruning boundary as training evolves. moreover conventional distribution matching couples target-token confidence with preferences among competing continuations potentially weakening relational supervision when the self-teacher strongly favors the target. to address these challenges we propose search-aware on-policy self-distillation sa-opsd a framework that transfers privileged self-teacher knowledge to the states visited during the student's own beam search. specifically we introduce evolving-boundary sampling which prioritizes search-critical states by considering both current pruning-boundary proximity and initial-reference retention-margin decline under a controlled distillation budget. furthermore we develop confidence-decoupled branch distillation which separates target-probability calibration from informative sibling relations to better preserve the teacher's preferences among competing branches. experiments on industrial office and instruments demonstrate strong performance for sa-opsd.

sa-opsd targets the beam-search states most vulnerable to pruning under a fixed distillation budget. it combines evolving-boundary sampling with confidence-decoupled branch distillation to preserve sibling preferences from a privileged self-teacher reporting gains on an industrial dataset and two public domains.
sa-opsd在固定蒸馏预算下 优先监督学生束搜索中最容易被裁剪的状态。方法结合演化边界采样和置信度解耦的分支蒸馏 保留特权自教师对兄弟分支的偏好 并在工业数据集及两个公开领域报告提升。

generative recommendation promises to simplify conventional multi-stage recommender systems by generating item semantic ids sids autoregressively. however two obstacles limit its effective- ness in industrial settings interaction-only supervision underuses the semantic knowledge encoded in pretrained language models while beam-search likelihood ranks token sequences rather than directly estimating item relevance. to address these limitations we propose higentrans a three-level framework that introduces llm knowledge at the input representation and decision levels. first global semantic priming gsp adds an llm-derived user representation to the beginning-of-sequence embedding provid- ing a semantic prior before sid generation. second hierarchi- cal representation transfer hrt aligns intermediate llm representations with depth-matched genrec layers through mean- centered projections and gated residual connections. finally multi- signal decision calibration mdc uses a lightweight mixture- of-experts calibrator to combine semantic relevance generation confidence and candidate-set context when reranking beam-search outputs. all semantic features are computed only from the observ- able interaction prefix preventing target leakage and can be cached offline. experiments on three public benchmarks show that higen- trans improves recall@10 by up to 12.9% and ndcg@10 by up to 33.7% over the strongest baselines. these results demonstrate the value of transferring llm knowledge at complementary stages of the generative recommendation pipeline.

higentrans transfers llm knowledge into semantic-id recommendation through a user semantic prior depth-aligned hidden representations and a lightweight moe beam-output calibrator. prefix-only semantic features can be cached offline three benchmarks show up to 12.9% recall@10 and 33.7% ndcg@10 improvements over the strongest baselines.
higentrans从用户语义先验、按深度对齐的中间表征和轻量moe候选校准三个层面 将llm知识迁移到语义id推荐。仅基于可观测交互前缀的语义特征可离线缓存 三个基准上 相对最强基线的recall@10与ndcg@10最高分别提升12.9%和33.7%。

most parameters of a mixture-of-experts moe model belong to its experts and standard training keeps every expert gradient in gpu memory until the optimizer step. this memory grows with the number and size of the experts so it rises as moe models scale. we introduce sonar-moe which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. it brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched moe expert tensors so the gpu never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. when we fine-tune olmoe-1b-7b and granite-3.1-3b-a800m in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends sonar-moe lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps sonar-moe fast as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. sonar-moe matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.

sonar-moe updates batched expert tensors during backpropagation and releases their gradients immediately limiting resident expert gradients to one layer. bf16 fine-tuning of two moe models reduces peak memory by 19–22% updates match standard training bitwise without expert gradient clipping while step time falls 17–23% relative to global-norm-clipped training.
sonar-moe在反向传播中按批量专家张量执行优化器更新并立即释放梯度 使显存中至多保留一层专家梯度。两个moe模型的bf16微调中峰值显存降低19%—22% 不裁剪专家梯度时更新与标准训练逐位一致 相比全局范数裁剪训练每步时间缩短17%—23%。

computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives for example conditional statements or loops but in different orders to implement different algorithms. in contrast existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. we introduce library of layers lol an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. lol has a single hyperparameter the size of its global library of transformer blocks that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity generalizing the parameter-efficiency and flops-efficiency tradeoffs of dense depth-recurrent and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. we show that lol achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. on synthetic sudoku and maze data we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. in a multilingual natural language setting we find that lol chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. similarly we train lol on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high auroc. lol provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.

library of layers dynamically selects the order of transformer blocks from a shared library at inference. library size interpolates between parameter reuse and sparse computation text pretraining is competitive with dense recurrent and moe baselines while synthetic and multilingual studies expose input-dependent layer ordering.
library of layers在推理时从共享transformer模块库中动态选择执行顺序 借模块库规模调节参数复用与稀疏计算。文本预训练表现可与稠密、循环和moe基线竞争 合成任务及多语言实验显示执行顺序随输入改变。

attention remains a substantial computational cost in transformer training particularly at long context lengths. nvidia blackwell gpus provide high-throughput low-precision matrix multiplication but exploiting it in attention requires addressing quantization overhead causal information leakage through shared scales and numerical inconsistencies between the forward and backward passes. we present flamia a family of attention kernels for blackwell with mxfp8 and mixed nvfp4/fp8 training paths. our design combines token-block scaling that reuses quantized operands across matrix orientations targeted safeguards against scale-induced leakage and consistent forward and backward computations. fused quantization and architecture-specific kernel optimizations reduce overhead while document-local scaling and workload-aware scheduling support variable-length documents directly in packed layouts without repacking. across various causal packed-document workloads the mxfp8 path accelerates the combined forward and backward attention call including quantization by factors of 1.10--1.40× on b200 and 1.06--1.42× on b300 relative to the fastest evaluated baseline for each workload. we validate training stability and quality preservation on pretraining llama-style models. these results show how jointly designing quantization training numerics and document scheduling translates low-bit hardware throughput into practical attention acceleration.

flamia co-designs microscaling quantization consistent forward/backward numerics and packed-document scheduling for blackwell attention training. including quantization its mxfp8 path accelerates combined forward and backward attention by 1.10–1.40× on b200 and 1.06–1.42× on b300 against the fastest evaluated baseline per workload with llama-style pretraining checks.
flamia协同设计微缩放量化、前后向数值一致性和打包文档调度 以加速blackwell上的注意力训练。计入量化开销后 mxfp8路径的注意力前后向合计速度 在b200上为各负载最强已测基线的1.10—1.40倍、b300上为1.06—1.42倍 并进行了llama式预训练验证。

long-context llm inference is costly because attention repeatedly reads a growing key-value kv history. we introduce chunk-indexed sparse attention cisa which retrofits pretrained dense attention models without gradient updates. cisa selects fixed-size kv chunks using compact summaries of existing keys avoiding token-level indexing and a separate full-length index cache. it uses one indexing query per kv group and shares selected chunks across queries in that group. during prefill qshare reuses selections across adjacent queries to reduce indexing cost and improve kv reuse and gpu utilization. we evaluate cisa on nvidia nemotron 3 nano and ultra and inkling-small. in one-layer bf16 benchmarks at batch size 32 using ultra's per-device attention dimensions core attention is 11.7x faster for prefill queries near the end of a 1m-token prompt and 13.0x faster during decode. including chunk scoring selection and all other measured gpu work speedups are 8.6x and 3.0x. on ultra nvfp4 with a 4 096-chunk budget aggregate scores stay within 1.5 percentage points of dense attention on mrcr longbench v2 and graphwalks. ruler sweeps on nano and ultra bf16 up to one million tokens show scores within 2.05 percentage points of dense attention with 8-16x fewer kv reads. serving million-token prompts with 32 concurrent requests and 4k output tokens per request cisa achieves 2.29x the end-to-end throughput of dense attention using nemotron 3 ultra nvfp4 on four nvidia b300 gpus. selecting fewer chunks increases throughput to 2.61x in separate graphwalks evaluations the smaller budget widens the aggregate score gap from 1.49 to 3.59 percentage points. these results expose a practical quality-speed tradeoff without sparse training.

cisa retrofits dense attention without gradient updates by selecting fixed-size kv chunks using compact key summaries and sharing selections across queries. a four-b300 nemotron 3 ultra nvfp4 serving test reports 2.29× end-to-end throughput tighter chunk budgets increase speed while widening quality gaps.
cisa通过紧凑键摘要选择固定大小的kv块 并跨查询复用选择结果 无需梯度更新即可改造稠密注意力。四张b300上的nemotron 3 ultra nvfp4服务测试报告端到端吞吐为稠密版本的2.29倍 进一步缩减块预算可提高速度 但质量差距也会扩大。

large mixture-of-experts moe models are promising for local inference because sparse routing allows the routed-expert pool to reside on ssd while dram caches recently used experts. however under practical dram cache capacities substantial ssd i/o remains on the critical path despite i/o-computation overlap. token-level dynamic expert precision offers a natural way to reduce this data demand by allocating bits according to expert importance and quantization sensitivity. nevertheless treating each bit-width of the same expert as an independent object prevents cross-precision cache reuse causing overlapping data to be fetched repeatedly. the key insight is that precision should instead denote the refinement depth of one shared expert state. based on this insight we present pagedmoe which stores each expert once using a prefix-compatible tree codebook and bitplane layout. lower-precision representations are valid prefixes of higher-precision ones allowing cached data to be reused or extended by fetching only missing bitplanes. pagedmoe selects the required prefix length before i/o using current routing weights and offline expert-specific error profiles and directly executes cached 1-8-bit prefixes without materializing full-precision experts. at an average routed-expert precision of 2.5 bits pagedmoe achieves quality close to gptq-int4 on qwen3.5-397b-a17b and to mxfp4 on most evaluated glm5.2 tasks. with a 24 gib expert cache it reaches 8.89 tokens/s on qwen3.5 1.33x the throughput of the same dynamic requests using independent precision objects and 1.56x that of uniform 4-bit execution.

pagedmoe stores each ssd-resident expert in a prefix-compatible codebook and bitplane layout so cached low-bit representations can be extended rather than refetched. at 2.5-bit average routed-expert precision and a 24 gib expert cache qwen3.5 reaches 8.89 tokens/s 1.33× independent-precision objects and 1.56× uniform 4-bit execution with quality close to gptq-int4.
pagedmoe使用前缀兼容码本与位平面布局存储ssd上的专家 使缓存的低比特表示可增量扩展而无需重复读取。在路由专家平均2.5比特、专家缓存24 gib时 qwen3.5达到8.89 token/s 为独立精度对象方案的1.33倍、统一4比特执行的1.56倍 质量接近gptq-int4。

learned sparse attention used in production models such as deepseek-v4 and glm-5 lets each query attend to only k keys chosen by a lightweight indexer but the indexer still scores every key in the prefix. at one million tokens this selection takes more than half of prefill time. two-stage selection over contiguous blocks as in hisa reduces this cost but its recall declines as context grows at a fixed candidate budget. we present attentionindex which routes each query over an inverted-file index that groups indexer keys by similarity and refines the candidates with the native indexer score. attentionindex builds the index during prefill making new keys searchable immediately reusing previous clustering to keep maintenance cheap and exposing each query only to clusters built from its own prefix. on glm-5.3 and deepseek-v4-flash at one million tokens attentionindex delivers 1.3-1.8 times the prefill throughput of exhaustive selection and at throughput within 5% of hisa it recovers 17.0 and 10.0 percentage points more of the exhaustive top-k respectively. attentionindex also improves accuracy on long-context benchmarks by up to 18.4 percentage points over hisa at the same candidate budget.

attentionindex uses a causal inverted-file index to avoid scoring every key in learned sparse attention. at one million tokens on glm-5.3 and deepseek-v4-flash prefill throughput is 1.3–1.8× exhaustive selection at throughput within 5% of hisa it recovers 17 and 10 percentage points more of exhaustive top-k respectively.
attentionindex以因果倒排索引替代学习式稀疏注意力对全部历史键的逐一打分。在百万token的glm-5.3与deepseek-v4-flash测试中 预填充吞吐为穷举选择的1.3—1.8倍 吞吐与hisa相差不超过5%时 分别多找回17和10个百分点的穷举top-k结果。

residual connections give each transformer block access to all earlier layers only through one fixed sum broadcast to all of the block's inputs. this broadcast bottleneck imposes three constraints the query key value and residual inputs of a block which we call its roles read the same vector all hidden dimensions within a role share one set of weights over earlier layers and every earlier layer has the same fixed weight for every token. we propose the multi-role multi-group mixing residual m3 which removes all three every role and every group of hidden dimensions within a role reads its own token-dependent mixture of all earlier layers. m3 starts as an exact residual connection and adds as little as 1.4% parameters and 1.8% flops. from 100m to 1.4b parameters m3former outperforms the transformer and coarse-grained cross-layer connections at every size matching a transformer 1.19-1.34x the size of the one it modifies trained with 1.4-1.8x the compute. relaxing only some of the constraints recovers only part of this gain. m3former also improves sparse mixture-of-experts models of up to 4.6b parameters and trains more stably in deeper networks. code https //github.com/kingchet10/m3former

m3former lets query key value and residual roles read separate token-dependent mixtures of earlier layers further separating groups of hidden dimensions. it initializes as an exact residual connection and can add only 1.4% parameters and 1.8% flops experiments from 100m to 1.4b parameters report gains over conventional and coarser cross-layer connections with extensions to sparse moe.
m3former让查询、键、值及残差分别读取随token变化的历史层混合 并进一步按隐藏维度分组。模块初始化为精确残差连接 最低只增加1.4%参数和1.8% flops 1亿至14亿参数实验显示优于常规与粗粒度跨层连接 并扩展验证到稀疏moe。

delta-rule linear attention underlies language models such as kimi linear and qwen3-next. chunkwise implementations expose matrix parallelism but their backward passes compute unnecessary auxiliary adjoints. we present rewy an algebraic reformulation that reduces this work before optimizing accelerator execution. differentiating the chunk correction as one triangular residual system eliminates the inverse adjoint and reduces seven local wy matrix products to three. two complementary transformations expose further reuse centered matrix contractions replace pairwise vector-gate processing and scalar-gate reductions reuse key-gradient products instead of forming a key gram matrix. these identities simplify backward computation for deltanet gdn kda and gdn2 while preserving the recurrence and gradients in exact arithmetic without changing the architecture or training objective. we implement the reduced graph on gpus and ascend npus. under matched recomputation and full-saving policies precision-qualified six-shape comparisons with frozen fla references yield 1.15-1.81× geometric-mean complete low-level backward speedups on nvidia gpus. all four operators achieve 1.18-1.70× on h100 and h200 while retaining original fp32 working matrices. a separate public-autograd evaluation on ascend 950dt including gradient conversions yields 1.09-2.89× under available matched policies. paired ablations establish further rewy gains after optimizing the complementary contractions. complete-gradient checks validate the recorded operator cases supplementary full-model backward measurements assess integration into community fla models and a gdn2 layer port. code and reproduction materials https //github.com/flashserve/rewy.

rewy algebraically simplifies the backward pass of deltanet gdn kda and gdn2 reducing seven local wy matrix products to three while preserving exact-arithmetic gradients. gpu and ascend implementations exploit further contraction reuse matched-policy gpu tests report 1.15–1.81× geometric-mean low-level backward speedups.
rewy以代数重构简化deltanet、gdn、kda和gdn2反向传播 将七次局部wy矩阵乘法减少到三次 并保持精确算术下梯度一致。gpu和昇腾实现进一步复用张量收缩 匹配存储与重计算策略的gpu测试中 底层完整反向的几何平均加速为1.15—1.81倍。

mixture-of-experts moe models expand model capacity by activating only a subset of experts for each token. on accelerators with static execution plans expert capacities and placement are fixed before routing reveals each expert's load. uniform worst-case capacities waste work on padding smaller capacities tied to expert identities can overflow. we present ranklane which ranks each device's experts by current load and assigns them to fixed-capacity lanes. runtime indices select experts and token rows while tier populations shapes and device placement remain fixed. an aggregation graph preserves device ownership and reduces each token's local contributions on one core. routing calibration and measured execution costs guide tier selection overflowing chunks rerun at full capacity. we evaluate full-model prefill of qwen3-30b-a3b and gemma 4 26b-a4b with mxfp6 weights on four cloud ai 100 ultra socs using 128-2048-token chunks and including overflow detection and in-program recovery support. against a dense baseline ranklane achieves end-to-end prefill speedups of 1.27-4.18x on qwen3 and 1.93-3.46x on gemma.

ranklane assigns dynamically ranked expert loads to fixed-capacity execution lanes combining static shapes with runtime expert selection and full-capacity overflow recovery. four cloud ai 100 ultra socs with mxfp6 weights show full-model prefill speedups of 1.27–4.18× for qwen3-30b-a3b and 1.93–3.46× for gemma 4 26b-a4b over the evaluated dense baseline.
ranklane按当前负载给专家排序并分配到固定容量执行通道 在静态形状下动态选专家 并在溢出时以全容量重跑。四颗cloud ai 100 ultra soc、mxfp6权重测试中 相对所测稠密执行基线 qwen3-30b-a3b与gemma 4 26b-a4b全模型预填充分别加速1.27—4.18倍、1.93—3.46倍。

mixture-of-experts moe architecture has been widely adopted in large language models llms since it reduces the computational cost through sparse expert activation. however the massive parameter scale of moe models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. although existing mixed-precision quantization reduces the model size they are inherently static fixing the bit-width of each expert across decoding steps. such static schemes yield suboptimal performance as they overlook the dynamic variation in expert importance during decoding. furthermore they fail to adapt to the dynamic latency constraint driven by the fluctuating system utilization. to address these challenges we propose matmoe a dynamic mixed-precision quantization framework for efficient moe inference. matmoe features 1 a matryoshka moe ptq algorithm that enables experts to operate flexibly at multiple precisions within a stringent memory budget 2 a floor-and-compensation quantization method that eliminates redundant memory accesses in the matryoshka representation and 3 a dynamic bit-width allocation strategy that determines the precision for each expert based on their routing scores to satisfy the dynamic latency requirement. we implement our matmoe system atop llama.cpp for both cpu and gpu platforms. extensive evaluations across three modern moe models and challenging benchmarks demonstrate that matmoe achieves 4.0% ∼ 18.3% higher accuracy than state-of-the-art static mixed-precision method. compared to llama.cpp matmoe delivers 1.3× ∼ 3.7× speedup on raspberry pi 5 and 1.2× ∼ 1.3× speedup on nvidia rtx 4090 and jetson agx orin.

matmoe combines nested multi-precision expert representations floor-and-compensation quantization and routing-aware dynamic bit allocation for changing latency budgets. implemented in llama.cpp it reports 1.3–3.7× speedups on raspberry pi 5 and 1.2–1.3× on rtx 4090 and jetson agx orin alongside accuracy gains over the tested static mixed-precision method.
matmoe结合嵌套多精度专家表示、基础值与补偿量化 以及依据路由分数的动态比特分配 适配变化的延迟预算。基于llama.cpp的实现报告在树莓派5上加速1.3—3.7倍 在rtx 4090和jetson agx orin上加速1.2—1.3倍 并较所测静态混合精度方法改善准确率。

attention kernels on tensor processing units tpus often underutilize their matrix units mxus because of repeated matrix operand loads vector-intensive computation and dependencies that leave mxus idle. we present flywheel a set of fast tpu kernels for both softmax and linear attention. flywheel reformulates softmax and triangular inversion to reduce vector work while coordinating data layouts to improve matrix operand reuse. it then overlaps independent computation to hide execution latency. we apply these techniques to both softmax attention and gated deltanet on tpu v6e and v7x. flywheel speeds up softmax attention by up to 4.14× over the state-of-the-art rpa kernel and 1.80× over splash attention reaching 81% of peak bf16 throughput on v6e. it also speeds up gated deltanet prefill by up to 3.61×. integrated into vllm serving qwen3.8-27b flywheel improves prefill throughput by up to 1.56× while maintaining comparable accuracy.

flywheel reduces vector work and repeated matrix-operand loads in tpu softmax and linear attention then overlaps independent computation. tests on tpu v6e/v7x report up to 4.14× softmax-kernel and 3.61× gated deltanet prefill speedups qwen3.8-27b integration improves serving prefill throughput by up to 1.56× with comparable accuracy.
flywheel减少tpu上softmax与线性注意力的向量运算和矩阵操作数重复加载 并重叠独立计算。tpu v6e/v7x测试报告softmax内核最高加速4.14倍、gated deltanet预填充最高加速3.61倍 集成qwen3.8-27b后 在准确率相当时服务预填充吞吐最高提升至1.56倍。

relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to rope across various transformer architectures delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. these mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. unlike rope which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory bandwidth and compute overheads as sequences scale. to address this bottleneck we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into flashattention-style tiled computation. our method 1 uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses 2 computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes and 3 uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation eliminating atomic contention. we provide a unified efficient triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. for 8k-token sequences our method speeds up the forward backward pass by 1.8-6.4× 2.0-21× and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128× 1.4-54× over the strongest baseline for each mechanism enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8× faster and uses 2.4× less memory. our method thus provides a drop-in hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

this work integrates additive relative-position attention into exact flashattention-style tiling using offset-aware reuse and sharded gradient aggregation. at 8k tokens it reports 1.8–6.4× forward and 2.0–21× backward speedups over the strongest evaluated baseline for each mechanism a transcription integration is 1.8× faster and uses 2.4× less memory.
该研究将加性相对位置注意力纳入精确的flashattention式分块 通过偏移感知复用和梯度分片聚合减少开销。8k token下 相对各机制最强已测基线 前向加速1.8—6.4倍、反向加速2.0—21倍 转录任务集成后速度为1.8倍、内存用量降至约1/2.4。

long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain kv-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. we present jet-qsparse a training-free method that combines compact nvfp4 cache storage with native fp4 query-key computation on blackwell tensor cores. a dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse fp16 value aggregation with fp32 accumulation preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. calibrated key centering and at most two bf16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error fp8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from bf16 activations. across four hybrid llms a budget of 128 blocks per kv head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning coding and agentic benchmarks although some smaller budgets incur losses. with 64 blocks qwen3.8-27b achieves a 1.94× end-to-end decode speedup over dense bf16 at 128k context and batch size 16 on one gb300 and the measured qwen kv pools provide 2.58-2.76× bf16's token capacity.

jet-qsparse combines nvfp4 kv storage and native fp4 key scoring with sparse higher-precision value aggregation on blackwell. a 128-block budget shows no detected loss on evaluated tasks a separate 64-block setting gives qwen3.8-27b a 1.94× decode speedup at 128k context and batch 16 on one gb300.
jet-qsparse在blackwell上结合nvfp4 kv存储、原生fp4键打分与较高精度的稀疏值聚合。128块预算下 已测任务未检测到准确率损失 另一个64块设置中 单张gb300、128k上下文、batch 16的qwen3.8-27b解码加速1.94倍。

tabular transformer models such as tabpfn achieve strong predictive performance but incur substantial inference costs making them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained settings. while looped transformers reduce parameter count through weight sharing they can lose significant predictive power when stopped early. to address this challenge we introduce the elastically looped tabular transformer eltab a single model trained to operate across different computational budgets through supervision at randomly sampled early exits. across 30 openml classification datasets a single eltab model matches six depth-specific looped models while cutting training cost by more than half and matches a 12-layer tabpfn-style baseline with 25% fewer inference flops. these results show that elastic-depth training yields a single model that adapts to the deployment budget at hand offering a favorable trade-off among predictive performance storage and computational cost.

eltab trains one looped tabular transformer with randomly sampled early exits to serve multiple compute budgets. across 30 openml classification datasets it matches six depth-specific looped models with less than half their training cost and matches a 12-layer tabpfn-style baseline using 25% fewer inference flops.
eltab通过随机采样提前退出位置训练一个循环表格transformer 使同一模型适配多种计算预算。在30个openml分类数据集上 以不足一半训练成本匹配六个独立深度模型 并以少25%的推理flops匹配12层tabpfn式基线。

multi-token prediction mtp is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. we identify a flaw in standard mtp training in which a residual component of the mtp gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning increasingly so with scale. specifically the mtp cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a kl self-distillation term that pulls each mtp head toward the model's own next-token prediction ntp distribution and improves speculative decoding and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful kl signal. we introduce the kl gradient-recovery trick when two distributions share a linear output head the gradient of their kl divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. unlike minimizing the kl directly this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. this enables soft multi-token prediction soft-mtp a one-line code change to mtp that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the kl self-distillation signal by reusing the existing ntp and mtp cross-entropy computations. soft-mtp supports both deepseek- and meta-style mtp adds no parameters and incurs no measurable overhead. from 167m to 1.2b parameters soft-mtp improves over standard mtp with lower ntp perplexity faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale lower mtp perplexity from 689m onward and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2b. soft-mtp also matches if not exceeds direct kl divergence minimization on most metrics. soft-mtp is in effect a free lunch for mtp optimization. our code can be found at https //github.com/jaydenteoh/soft-mtp.

soft-mtp separates a useful kl self-distillation gradient from a noisy residual in multi-token prediction. straight-through routing recovers the kl gradient from existing cross-entropy computations without vocabulary-sized logit matrices 167m–1.2b language-model experiments report improved next-token perplexity speculative decoding and zero-shot accuracy over standard mtp.
soft-mtp从多token预测梯度中分离有用的kl自蒸馏项和噪声残差。直通梯度路由复用已有交叉熵计算恢复kl梯度 无需保存词表大小的logit矩阵 1.67亿至12亿参数语言模型实验中 下一token困惑度、推测解码和零样本准确率均优于标准mtp。

hybrid language models keep a key-value kv cache only in their few full-attention layers but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. we present dckv a differentiable codec for the kv cache and the first kv-cache codec that is trained end to end. its transform its quantizer and its entropy models which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions are optimized together against the frozen language model both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. on qwen3.5-2b dckv stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

dckv jointly trains a transform quantizer and conditional entropy model to compress the prompt kv cache against a frozen hybrid language model. on qwen3.5-2b it reports over 55× fewer bytes per compressed token with at most 1.8-point loss on three long-context benchmarks or over 100× compression with at most 3.6-point loss.
dckv面向冻结的混合语言模型 联合训练变换、量化器和条件熵模型来压缩提示词kv缓存。在qwen3.5-2b的三个长上下文基准上 每个压缩token的字节数减少超过55倍时损失最多1.8个百分点 减少超过100倍时损失最多3.6个百分点。

scaling laws predict the outcome of large expensive training runs by extrapolating trends from smaller cheaper runs. on downstream accuracy evaluations these predictions fail when the weaker models produced by the cheaper runs score near zero accuracy because these scores give no trend to extrapolate to larger scales. we introduce hinted scaling laws which use privileged information to turn a benchmark into a continuum of easier versions so that even the small models score above zero. we find that accuracy rises smoothly and predictably with the hint level enabling new types of scaling laws that operate below the noise threshold. on the delphi pretraining ladder a hinted scaling law fit on models trained with at most $10^ 20 $ flops forecasts the gsm8k accuracy of a $10^ 23 $ flop model 25.9% to within 3 percentage points a standard scaling law under-forecasts it by 13 percentage points when fit on the same models and by 12 even with models up to $10^ 22 $ flops in the fit. across both this pretraining ladder and a collection of post-trained model families hinted scaling laws reduce the median forecasting error on gsm8k aime and hle from 21 percentage points to 4.3. hinting also reduces the number of test examples needed to tell whether one model is better than another by widening the accuracy gaps between models while approximately preserving their order a single hinted rollout per problem ranks nearly indistinguishable models as accurately as five unhinted rollouts. our results suggest that hinting is a general primitive for improving the accuracy and cost of downstream scaling laws and other prediction tasks in model development.

hinted scaling laws uses privileged hints to make difficult evaluations informative for small models then extrapolates performance across hint levels and compute scales. on pretraining and post-training model families the reported median forecast error on gsm8k aime and hle falls from 21 to 4.3 percentage points offering a model-development tool rather than a validated recommendation scaling law.
hinted scaling laws借助特权提示 使小模型在困难评测上得到可用信号 再沿提示程度与训练规模外推性能。在预训练及后训练模型族上 gsm8k、aime和hle的预测误差中位数从21降到4.3个百分点 其价值在模型开发方法 尚非已验证的推荐扩展规律。

dense retrieval models are typically obtained by fine-tuning pretrained language models on supervised retrieval data where high-quality annotations or interaction logs are often limited and reused across many epochs. this data-constrained regime differs from the abundant-data setting assumed by standard scaling laws making it unclear how the best attainable retrieval performance changes with model size and unique fine-tuning data. we study this question through the minimum achievable evaluation loss mael defined as the lowest evaluation loss reached during training under fixed model-size and data-budget constraints. we first show that learning-rate choices strongly affect optimization trajectories but have little effect on the final attainable mael after rescaling the optimization-step axis learning curves collapse across learning rates and cka analysis shows that checkpoints reaching mael learn highly similar representations. we then fine-tune 35 bert-family dense retrievers on ms marco subsets and find that mael is accurately described by a simple multiplicative power law over non-embedding parameters and unique samples outperforming commonly used additive scaling formulations. we further derive a scaling law for the training step at which mael is reached and show that optimal weight decay follows an approximately invariant ema timescale yielding lower mael and stronger retrieval performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. finally combining loss and step scaling suggests that in our observed regime increasing pretrained model size is approximately 1.46 times as fine-tuning-compute-efficient as increasing unique in-domain data for reducing mael.

studies scaling when supervised retrieval data are limited and reused across epochs. across 35 bert-family retrievers fine-tuned on ms marco subsets minimum achievable evaluation loss mael follows a multiplicative power law in non-embedding parameters and unique samples more closely than additive alternatives. the paper also models steps to mael and relates optimal weight decay to an approximately invariant ema timescale. in the observed regime increasing pretrained model size is approximately 1.46 times as fine-tuning-compute-efficient as increasing unique in-domain data for reducing mael. ctr scaling takeaway test joint model/data/optimization scaling under repeated-data training the reported law and efficiency ratio are retrieval-specific findings not established ctr results.

研究监督检索数据有限、需要跨多个 epoch 重复使用时的扩展规律。在 ms marco 子集上微调的 35 个 bert 系列检索模型中 以非嵌入参数量和独立样本数构建的乘法幂律 比加法形式更好地拟合最低可达评估损失 mael 。论文还建模达到 mael 所需的训练步数 并将最优权重衰减与近似不变的 ema 时间尺度联系起来。在其观测范围内 为降低 mael 扩大预训练模型的微调算力效率约为增加独立域内数据的 1.46 倍。对 ctr scaling 的启发 在数据重复训练条件下联合考察模型、数据与优化配置 该规律与效率比例尚不能直接视为 ctr 结论。

industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. mix-ranking combines product cards short videos livestreams and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. they constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. to enable scalable and effective slate generation we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. specifically we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose onetrans-gsr a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed onetrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. during training a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. during decoding business constraints are explicitly enforced. offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system onetrans-gsr mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. in online a/b tests it improves gmv/u by 2.63% advertiser value by 2.06% and repurchase rate by 2.03% while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. these results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.

replaces separately engineered reranking and heterogeneous-content mix-ranking with one decoder-only slate-generation policy. a complete-slate reward model guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives while decoding explicitly enforces business constraints. offline slate quality improves with reward-model and policy compute. industrial online a/b tests report gains of 2.63% in gmv/u 2.06% in advertiser value and 2.03% in repurchase rate with 13% lower end-to-end latency across reranking and mix-ranking. ctr scaling takeaway move beyond pointwise scoring toward compute-scalable slate optimization while measuring business outcomes and constraints the abstract reports no ctr gain or fitted scaling law.

将分别设计的重排和异构内容混排统一为单个 decoder-only 列表生成策略。完整列表奖励模型通过强化学习引导列表级和长期目标 解码时显式执行业务约束。离线结果显示 奖励模型和策略计算量增加时 列表质量持续改善。工业在线 a/b 测试报告 gmv/u 提升 2.63%、广告主价值提升 2.06%、复购率提升 2.03% 重排与混排阶段的端到端延迟下降 13%。对 ctr scaling 的启发 从逐候选打分拓展到可随算力增长的列表优化 同时评估业务指标与约束 摘要未报告 ctr 增益或拟合的 scaling law。

generative recommendation is gaining traction in production retrieving items by generating their identifiers one token at a time. the generated sequences must identify relevant catalog items so constrained decoding couples relevance scoring with validity filtering. because most possible sequences are invalid scoring before filtering wastes computation on candidates that will be discarded. our evaluation shows that filtering first can avoid this work with negligible impact on recommendation quality. we present zerogr a filtering-first constrained decoding system for generative recommendation. zerogr uses a step-sliced filtering index to reduce gpu memory use by tailoring data representations to each decoding step. its execution engine adopts shared-slot execution to accelerate data exchange across stages and hybrid projection to adapt computation to workload patterns thereby reducing execution overhead. during index refreshes zerogr applies layout-guided streaming construction to speed up updates and limit serving interference. extensive evaluation shows that zerogr accelerates the filtering and scoring pipeline by up to 9.9× over representative baselines while reducing gpu index memory use and accelerating index reconstruction.

targets wasted computation in generative recommendation when invalid identifier sequences are scored before being filtered. zerogr filters first uses a step-sliced index to reduce gpu memory and combines shared-slot execution workload-adaptive hybrid projection and layout-guided streaming index construction. evaluations report up to 9.9× acceleration of the filtering-and-scoring pipeline over representative baselines with negligible recommendation-quality impact lower gpu index memory and faster reconstruction. ctr scaling takeaway validity-aware execution can free serving budget for larger generative retrieval models the maximum speedup applies to this pipeline not demonstrated end-to-end ctr serving or ctr quality gains.

针对生成式推荐中先评分、再过滤无效标识符序列造成的计算浪费 zerogr 将过滤前置 并采用按解码步切分的索引降低 gpu 内存占用 结合共享槽位执行、适配负载的混合投影和布局引导的流式索引构建。评估中 过滤与评分流水线相对代表性基线最高加速 9.9 倍 推荐质量影响很小 同时降低 gpu 索引内存并加快索引重建。对 ctr scaling 的启发 面向有效候选的执行方式可能为更大的生成式召回模型释放服务预算 最高加速比仅对应这段流水线 并非已验证的端到端 ctr 服务加速或 ctr 指标提升。

larger generative retrieval models can improve retrieval quality but their decoding cost makes low-latency serving difficult. when different users submit the same query generating complete semantic ids sids for every request repeats computation while their interaction histories call for different results. the challenge is to reuse large-model computation across requests while keeping retrieval personalized. we propose reusegr which separates query-level candidate planning from request-level personalized completion. a 7b offline planner generates sid prefix sets shared across requests with the same query. a 0.5b online model uses each request's history to select prefixes and generate the remaining tokens. reusecut chooses a cache depth for each query based on historical coverage balancing computation reuse and candidate coverage. to strengthen online completion we transfer 7b suffix-scoring knowledge to 0.5b through path-level knowledge distillation path kd . budgetcut then selects scored branches to improve final top-100 recall under a fixed branch budget. its selection policy is initialized by on-policy distillation opd and refined through group-relative policy optimization grpo . on an industrial search-advertising dataset with approximately 2m query--item records and 3.38m catalog items reusegr improves query-level hr@100 by 3.83 percentage points and reduces mean online latency by 38.9% relative to an all-online 0.5b baseline when prefixes are prepared. it achieves hr@100 comparable to an all-online 7b baseline with 57.7% lower online latency. a 14-day user-level online a/b test against the 0.5b baseline shows relative gains of 0.93% in click-through rate and 1.05% in revenue per thousand requests.

separates reusable query-level planning from personalized online completion a 7b offline model generates semantic-id prefixes and a 0.5b online model selects and completes them using user history. adaptive cache depth path-level distillation and branch-budget selection balance reuse coverage and cost. on an industrial search-ad dataset with prefixes prepared query-level hr@100 rises by 3.83 percentage points and mean online latency falls 38.9% versus all-online 0.5b hr@100 is comparable to all-online 7b at 57.7% lower online latency. a 14-day user-level a/b test versus 0.5b reports relative ctr and revenue-per-thousand-request gains of 0.93% and 1.05%. ctr scaling takeaway amortize large-model compute across repeated queries while retaining request-level personalization online-latency gains do not include the full offline planning cost.

将可复用的查询级规划与个性化在线补全解耦 7b 离线模型生成 semantic id 前缀 0.5b 在线模型根据用户历史选择前缀并补全。自适应缓存深度、路径级知识蒸馏与分支预算选择共同平衡复用、覆盖和计算成本。在工业搜索广告数据上 前缀已准备好的条件下 相比全在线 0.5b 查询级 hr@100 提升 3.83 个百分点、平均在线延迟下降 38.9% 相较全在线 7b hr@100 相当、在线延迟下降 57.7%。为期 14 天的用户级 a/b 测试中 相比 0.5b 基线 ctr 和每千次请求收入分别相对提升 0.93% 和 1.05%。对 ctr scaling 的启发 跨重复查询摊销大模型计算 同时保留请求级个性化 在线延迟收益不包含完整离线规划成本。

large language models llms have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models frms . existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit chain-of-thought cot reasoning under a think-then-answer paradigm. however explicit cot incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse dynamic user interests. we propose onelatent an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens enabling latent-reason-then-answer inference without generating verbose traces. onelatent first introduces multi-view adaptive cot mv-acot which creates diverse high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. building on pretrained frms it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize cot traces into learnable latent tokens. finally a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. experiments on an industrial-scale kuaishou dataset and the public kuaishou llm-rec benchmark show that onelatent consistently outperforms explicit cot-based methods and traditional baselines. compared with the think and no-think variants of frms onelatent improves sid@64 by 17.44% and 9.33% respectively while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. we further develop a production serving system for scalable real-time frm inference. an online a/b test in kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying onelatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines including onerec and onereason.

compresses explicit recommendation chain-of-thought into a few learnable latent tokens to reduce reasoning-generation overhead. multi-view adaptive teacher reasoning supplies supervision three-stage latent-token alignment and curriculum-based post-training internalize and activate that reasoning. on industrial kuaishou data and kuaishou llm-rec onelatent reports sid@64 improvements of 17.44% and 9.33% over think and no-think frm variants respectively alongside over 17× higher online inference throughput. an online local-services advertising test of onelatent plus its production serving system estimates a 9.6% revenue lift over strong baselines including onerec and onereason. ctr scaling takeaway latent reasoning offers a route to spend model capacity without long generated traces sid and combined-system revenue results do not establish a ctr gain or isolate model-only online impact.

将推荐任务的显式思维链压缩为少量可学习隐式 token 以降低生成推理文本的开销。方法先通过多视角自适应教师推理生成监督 再用三阶段隐式 token 对齐和课程式后训练内化并激活推理能力。在快手工业数据和 kuaishou llm-rec 上 onelatent 相比 frm 的 think、no-think 变体 sid@64 分别提升 17.44% 和 9.33% 并报告在线推理吞吐量提高超过 17 倍。快手本地生活广告在线测试中 onelatent 与配套生产服务系统联合部署 相对包含 onerec、onereason 的强基线取得估计 9.6% 的收入提升。对 ctr scaling 的启发 隐式推理有望在不生成长推理文本的情况下利用模型能力 sid 指标和联合系统收入收益不能直接证明 ctr 提升 也不能单独归因于模型。

residual connections underpin transformers but they implicitly tie the residual width carried through depth to the compute width used inside each layer. we introduce hierarchical residuals hires a minimalist architectural change that decouples these dimensions widening the residual state while keeping per-layer compute width fixed. hires groups layers into blocks standard d-dimensional prenorm layers operate inside each block while a wider d-dimensional postnorm outer residual connects blocks. learned read/write projections bridge the two spaces at block boundaries leaving individual transformer layers unchanged. across different model sizes and depths hires consistently outperforms vanilla residual addition with fitted scaling laws indicating a 1.30-fold improvement in flops efficiency. on olmoe-1b-7b pretraining for 500b tokens hires achieves 0.0208 lower training loss and 1.14-point higher downstream accuracy. hires is also competitive with other residual expansion methods such as vwn mhc and attnres with less activation memory and i/o costs. built from only dense projections and normalizations it requires neither specialized kernels nor infrastructure-level optimizations. hires thus exposes residual width as a practical scaling variable using only standard operators.

hires separates residual-state width from per-layer compute width narrow transformer layers operate inside blocks while learned read/write projections connect a wider outer residual stream. experiments report 1.30× flops efficiency from fitted scaling laws and a 1.14-point downstream gain for olmoe-1b-7b after 500b training tokens. this provides a practical capacity-scaling direction for transformer rankers without widening every layer ctr gains remain untested.
hires 将残差状态宽度与单层计算宽度解耦 块内使用较窄的 transformer 层 通过可学习的读写投影连接更宽的外层残差流。实验拟合的缩放规律显示 flops 效率提升至 1.30 倍 olmoe-1b-7b 在训练 500b token 后的下游准确率提升 1.14 个百分点。该方法为 transformer 排序模型提供了无需加宽每层的容量扩展方向 但尚未验证 ctr 收益。

looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. however standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. in this paper we introduce arloop a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. distinct from standard transformers we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales 140m and 370m and recurrent depths r = 1 to 5 arloop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. more importantly we further scale arloop to 0.6b and 1.2b parameters under a realistic llm pretraining recipe demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. our 1.2b model pretrained on only 0.5t tokens with three recurrences outperforms huginn-3.5b the only fully-open looped llm as of our release date across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as qwen3.5-2b despite being trained on substantially less data.

arloop combines shared-layer recurrence with attention residuals that selectively reuse representations across depth. sliding-window depth attention matches or exceeds full-history attention at larger recurrent depths with gains observed in controlled 140m/370m experiments and 0.6b/1.2b pretraining. the design suggests a parameter-efficient way to scale ranking-model depth while limiting residual-history access the reported evaluations are language-model tasks not ctr.
arloop 将共享层循环与注意力残差结合 选择性复用不同深度的表示。在较大循环深度下 滑动窗口式深度注意力达到或超过完整历史注意力 收益同时出现在 140m/370m 参数的受控实验及 0.6b/1.2b 参数的预训练中。该设计为排序模型提供了参数高效的深度扩展方式 并可限制残差历史访问范围 论文评测针对语言模型任务 而非 ctr。

parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention swa with a constant-size recurrent memory. but does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval investigating an swa and test-time training ttt hybrid we find that retrieval is sparse across depth concentrated in a few anchor layers and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. we exploit both observations in anchor ttt memory placed only at the anchor layers and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. on llama-3.1-8b and mistral-7b anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher mmlu accuracy than lolcats with a 10x smaller recurrent state retains 91-95% of the teacher's mmlu accuracy and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.

anchor finds that long-context retrieval in sliding-window-attention/ttt hybrids concentrates in a few layers. it places recurrent memory at these anchor layers and shares a state that is written once and read through layer-specific maps. on llama-3.1-8b and mistral-7b it reports 2.3–3.1× higher recall than lolcats with a 10× smaller recurrent state and up to 4.3× lower latency than softmax attention. shared memory is a promising direction for long user-history rankers although recommendation transfer is not evaluated.

anchor 发现 滑动窗口注意力与 ttt 混合模型的长上下文检索能力集中在少数层。它仅在这些锚点层设置循环记忆 并共享一次写入、经各层专属映射读取的状态。在 llama-3.1-8b 和 mistral-7b 上 相比 lolcats 其循环状态缩小至十分之一 召回率达到 2.3–3.1 倍 相比 softmax 注意力 延迟最多降低至约四分之一。共享记忆可为长用户行为序列排序提供思路 但论文未验证推荐场景迁移。

we introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. the method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. queries that select the same block are processed together so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. we evaluate two hybrid llms qwen3.5-4b and 35b-a3b on one nvidia h200. including the cost of building and using the index whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512k tokens and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1m. the 35b-a3b model stays close to dense attention on five ruler tasks through 1m on longbench-v2 overall and on mrcr through 256k. the 4b model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval yet outperforms dense qwen3.5-2b whose latency is similar at 512k on all three benchmarks.

this training-free sparse-attention method clusters noncontiguous keys into large semantic blocks selects blocks using centroid scores and groups queries that access the same block. including indexing overhead qwen3.5 models achieve 2.3–2.4× whole-model prefill speedups at 512k tokens on one h200 the 35b-a3b model remains close to dense attention on several long-context benchmarks. semantic block selection and grouped execution could reduce long behavior-history attention cost but ctr accuracy and production ranking latency are untested.

该免训练稀疏注意力方法将非连续位置的 key 聚成较大的语义块 通过质心评分选择块 并合并访问同一块的 query 执行计算。计入建索引开销后 qwen3.5 模型在单张 h200、512k token 场景中的整模型 prefill 加速达到 2.3–2.4 倍 35b-a3b 模型在多项长上下文评测中接近稠密注意力。语义块筛选与分组执行可为长行为序列注意力降本提供参考 但尚未测试 ctr 精度和线上排序延迟。

context parallelism cp partitions long sequences across gpus for llm training and inference. for variable-length training and full prefill attention-balanced placement can leave token loads uneven while ring execution repeats overhead at each computation and communication step. in stage-serialized decode cp dcp long-running tasks delay dependent work and leave substantial gpu hardware idle. we propose liquidcp which unifies training and inference through a common model of transfer compute and reduction tasks with tile-level dependencies decoupling attention tasks from communication and kernel boundaries. for training and full prefill megaring incorporates buddyring placement to balance attention and token loads and coalesces ready kv regions during forward attention to amortize overhead. for decoding and mixed batches megadcp selects history-kv splits by jointly modeling the completion of attention and its dependent reductions. a shared persistent gpu-resident engine executes both designs. compared with the fastest baseline per configuration on eight h100 gpus megaring achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of 1.23× forward and 1.18× backward and accelerates a transformer layer by 1.08--1.16×. megadcp achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of 1.20× for decode-only and 1.35× for mixed batches. in vllm serving with kv prefix cache it achieves an average time-to-first-token speedup of 1.22×.

liquidcp schedules context-parallel attention as tile-dependent transfer compute and reduction tasks rather than tying execution to communication and kernel boundaries. megaring balances token and attention loads for training/prefill while megadcp schedules history-kv splits for decoding. on eight h100s megaring improves core-attention forward/backward speed by 1.23×/1.18× and transformer-layer speed by 1.08–1.16×. its load balancing and overlap mechanisms are relevant to distributed long-history rankers with recommendation-specific benefits still unverified.
