liquidcp 将上下文并行注意力拆分为具有 tile 级依赖的传输、计算和归约任务 避免执行被通信步骤与 kernel 边界绑定。megaring 为训练及 prefill 平衡 token 和注意力负载 megadcp 则调度解码阶段的历史 kv 分片。在八张 h100 上 megaring 的核心注意力前向与反向分别加速至 1.23 倍和 1.18 倍 transformer 层加速至 1.08–1.16 倍。其负载均衡和通信计算重叠机制适用于分布式长行为序列排序的优化探索 但推荐场景收益仍待验证。

large-scale ranking and recommendation models of web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of llms. we address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. we introduce a scaling layer which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. on top of it axia fits scaling-informed surrogates selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion and returns a pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. a fleet-level evaluation protocol computed on a fixed representative model set under matched trial budgets makes refinements to either component measurable. our contribution is an automated system that learns model-specific complexity-quality relationships and gives uncertainty-aware guidance for allocating compute across a heterogeneous model ecosystem. across 34 model iterations in two development cycles on meta's ads ranking and retrieval system the workflow yielded a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.

axia learns model-specific quality–compute relationships for heterogeneous recommendation and ranking architectures with fewer trial runs. a scaling layer couples related architecture parameters into low-dimensional controls scaling-informed surrogate models and posterior-based acquisition select informative configurations and construct a pareto frontier. across 34 model iterations in two meta development cycles the authors report a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.
针对推荐排序模型结构异构、穷举扩模成本高的问题 axia先把相关架构参数组合成少量联动的扩模控制量 再利用带规模规律先验的代理模型与后验采集策略选择实验 形成质量与计算成本的帕累托前沿。作者在meta两个开发周期、34次模型迭代中报告平均0.66%的离线归一化熵改善和累计0.36%的线上提升 为有限实验预算下的扩模和算力分配提供方法。

whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. existing non-autoregressive nar approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. autoregressive ar methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking. we propose multi-item scoring mis a prefix-aware nar-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. mis integrates global candidate interactions localized prefix conditioning and position-aware scoring within a shared representation architecture. by computing reusable representations once per request and performing lightweight prefix-conditioned scoring during constrained beam search mis captures important sequential dependencies without repeated full-model inference. experiments on kuairand-1k and rl4rs demonstrate that mis approaches the generation quality of an autoregressive cga baseline while achieving 4.07x and 3.54x faster cpu decoding respectively. in a randomized evaluation on a large-scale social-video platform mis improves the realization metric by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058% while reducing ranking-service cpu consumption by 9.73%. these results demonstrate that prefix-aware multi-item scoring can narrow the quality gap between nar and ar generation while retaining the efficiency required for industrial scalability.

mis targets the quality–latency trade-off in whole-page ads–organic ranking. it computes shared candidate representations once then combines global interactions prefix conditioning and position-aware lightweight scoring during constrained beam search. on kuairand-1k and rl4rs it approaches an autoregressive cga baseline's generation quality with 4.07x and 3.54x faster cpu decoding the reported randomized industrial evaluation improves realization by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058% while reducing ranking-service cpu use by 9.73%.
mis面向广告与自然内容混排 把候选表示在每个请求内只计算一次 再在约束束搜索中用轻量前缀条件打分复用这些表示 同时保留候选交互和位置关系。在kuairand-1k与rl4rs上 生成质量接近自回归cga基线 cpu解码分别加速4.07倍和3.54倍 作者报告的线上随机实验中 realization指标提高0.104%、观看时长提高0.058% 排序服务cpu消耗降低9.73%。

sequential recommenders are widely applied in real-world scenarios to model user preferences and behavior patterns based on user interactions. recent advances in sequential recommendation enhance transformer-based models with latent reasoning to refine user representations by autoregressively generating intermediate reasoning vectors. however exploring the optimal reasoning depth for diverse user histories remains challenging existing methods typically employ a fixed number of reasoning steps for all users. this ``one-size-fits-all'' strategy often leads to suboptimal representation learning due to over-thinking in simple histories or under-thinking in complex ones. to address this issue we propose desrec a deliberate latent reasoning framework that performs personalized latent reasoning to learn more informative reasoning states and enhance user modeling for sequential recommendation. specifically it designs a reasoning step selection module that identifies the optimal reasoning step for each user sequence during the training phase. through a self-distillation mechanism it compresses this most informative state into the final reasoning step which serves as the final user representation for item ranking during inference. moreover it introduces a progressive preference extraction mechanism for personalized reasoning which dynamically segments a user's history into a variable number of periods and summarizes each into a latent milestone representing the user's preference for that period. it will be used as the input of the subsequent reasoning. the number of milestones varies with the users' history enabling a personalized reasoning over users' evolving interests. extensive experimental results on six public datasets and four backbone recommenders demonstrate the superiority of desrec over eight baseline models.

desrec adapts latent reasoning to different user histories in sequential recommendation. during training it selects each sequence's most informative reasoning step and self-distills that state into the final step used for ranking. progressive preference extraction also segments histories into a variable number of periods and summarizes them into latent milestones. experiments span six public datasets four backbone recommenders and eight baselines the paper reports improved recommendation performance rather than an industrial scaling-law result.
desrec针对固定隐式推理步数难以适配不同用户历史的问题 在训练时为每条序列选择信息最充分的推理状态 再通过自蒸馏将其压入最终推理步骤。它还把用户历史动态分段 生成数量可变的偏好里程碑作为推理输入。论文在六个公开数据集、四种推荐骨干上与八个基线比较 为序列建模中的推理深度选择和知识压缩提供参考。

gated-delta linear attention layers such as gated deltanet gdn kimi delta attention kda and gdn-2 are tuned for gpus where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. on google tpus which concentrate compute in wide 256 × 256 systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. we present systolic linear attention sla which reshapes gated delta attention around the matrix unit by widening keys to 256 with grouped value heads grouping decay gates into four 64-channel tiles and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel. on tpu v7x a full \textttsla-r4 layer runs 1.6×--2.5× faster than the open-source tokamax kda kernel 1.4×--2.4× with exact chunk inversion driven primarily by head sharing and kernel fusion. across a 2 048-chip tpu v7x pre-training study of sparse mixture-of-experts moe models from 6.5b to 63.1b parameters sla trains 11%--24% faster than kda at similar perplexity and reaches slightly lower perplexity than kda in smaller matched-seed runs.

sla co-designs gated-delta linear attention for tpu systolic units 256-wide keys shared by grouped value heads tile-grouped decay gates and matrix-based chunk solves in a fused kernel. on tpu v7x sla-r4 layers are reported 1.6–2.5x faster than the open tokamax kda kernel. in a 2 048-chip study of 6.5b–63.1b sparse moe models training is 11–24% faster at similar perplexity. the results concern tpu-aligned attention design not measured recommendation gains.
sla把门控delta线性注意力与tpu矩阵单元共同设计 使用256维宽键并共享给多组值头 将衰减门按块组织 再把块内求解转成融合核中的矩阵运算。论文报告tpu v7x上单层较tokamax kda加速1.6—2.5倍 在2048芯片、6.5b至63.1b稀疏moe预训练中以相近困惑度获得11%—24%的训练提速。可借鉴之处是按硬件形状重构序列算子 推荐任务收益仍需验证。

as sequence lengths continue to grow distributed attention based on sequence parallel e.g. ring-attention has become a mainstream solution for large language models llms . nevertheless inherent communication dependencies limit computation-communication overlap reducing gpu utilization. moreover in cross-hardware numa or node architectures due to imbalanced communication bandwidth frequent communication synchronization will limit overall performance. based on these insights we propose charm+ cross-hardware attention with re-merge multistream mechanism. we reorganize sequential communications into several levels and achieve intra-level parallelism and computation overlap. furthermore we decouple cross-hardware communication from intra-hardware communication eliminating synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance. forward and backward algorithms were evaluated on multiple hardware architectures and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods. compared to ring-attention our forward and backward algorithms achieve average speedups of 1.3x and 1.7x on a dual-numa pcie architecture and 2.8x and 2.9x on a dual-node nvlink architecture respectively.

charm+ reorganizes distributed long-sequence attention communication into levels to overlap transfers and computation. it separates cross-numa or cross-node exchanges from local communication to reduce synchronization under unequal bandwidth. relative to ring-attention reported average forward/backward speedups are 1.3x/1.7x on dual-numa pcie and 2.8x/2.9x on dual-node nvlink systems. these are attention implementation measurements with potential relevance to distributed long-history model training.
charm+把分布式长序列注意力的串行通信重排成多个层级 增加同层并发与计算重叠 并把跨numa或跨节点交换同局部通信解耦 减少带宽不均造成的同步等待。相对ring-attention 作者报告双numa pcie配置前向与反向平均加速1.3倍和1.7倍 双节点nvlink配置为2.8倍和2.9倍。这类通信调度可供长历史模型训练参考 数字对应论文的attention实现实验。

second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. prior research has questioned the assumption that increasing the re-ranking depth yields linear performance gains further suggesting that optimal re-ranking depth varies considerably from query to query. in the past studying such phenomena was methodologically difficult given the scale of manual annotation required. with the advent of llm-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. using dense llm-based relevance judgments over a typical re-ranking pipeline we show that many queries exhibit a well-defined optimal re-ranking depth beyond which effectiveness stagnates or degrades. we formulate re-ranking depth as a query-specific property and study whether it can be predicted a priori from first-stage retrieval characteristics. through a large-scale analysis we find that most standard query performance prediction qpp methods are ineffective for this task. in contrast a predictor derived from llm-assessed first-stage ranking quality which we term ir-dcg@10 can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. under oracle selection of optimal depths we further show that retrieval effectiveness can improve by more than 7% while reducing the average re-ranking depth by a factor of 5 on the msmarco dev collection. given our promising preliminary findings we would encourage the use of automatic judgments to facilitate research otherwise infeasible under manual annotation. towards this point we release relevance judgments our codebase and experimental artefacts to support reproducibility and further research.

this study treats reranking depth as query-dependent rather than fixed. dense llm relevance judgments reveal saturation or degradation beyond each query's preferred depth while common query-performance predictors transfer poorly. an ir-dcg@10 predictor based on llm-assessed first-stage quality reduces mean reranking depth by up to 3x while preserving effectiveness in the evaluated pipelines. larger oracle improvements are upper bounds and the judgments introduce a dependency on llm assessment quality.
论文把重排深度视为查询相关的决策 借助密集llm相关性标注发现 增加候选数量可能出现收益饱和甚至效果下降 常见查询性能预测方法也难以直接预测最优深度。由首阶段排序质量构造的ir-dcg@10预测器 在所测排序组合中最多把平均重排深度降低到约三分之一并保持效果。对推荐系统的启发是按请求分配重排计算量 oracle结果仅代表上界 标注质量依赖llm判断。

sparse attention limits the history read by each query but serving long contexts still requires substantial gpu memory. existing kv offloading systems retain the full history of indexer keys on gpu limiting decode concurrency. prefill's temporary memory demand can further delay admission even when enough memory remains for the same request's subsequent decode. we present leansparse a serving system that reduces both decode's persistent memory use and prefill's temporary memory demand. our design exploits two observations prefill consumes historical data one layer at a time and decode can identify promising candidates before comparing their original indexer scores. during prefill leansparse streams layer histories through two reusable gpu buffers overlapping next-layer loading with ongoing model computation. during decode coarse-to-fine indexing searches compact representations and retrieves original indexer keys only for candidate refinement. separate indexer key and kv caches reuse data across generation steps. we implement leansparse in sglang and evaluate it on deepseek-v4-flash. at 950k context length leansparse supports 2.95× as many concurrent requests and achieves 2.14× decode throughput over hisparse. on multi-turn open-swe traces it reduces median time to first token from 21.6 to 0.6s and median session completion time by 17.7% relative to echo.

leansparse reduces both persistent decode memory and temporary prefill memory for native sparse-attention models. it streams prefill histories through two reusable gpu buffers and uses compact coarse-to-fine indexing to fetch original indexer keys only for candidate refinement with separate indexer and kv caches. implemented in sglang on deepseek-v4-flash it reports 2.95x concurrency and 2.14x decode throughput over hisparse at 950k context plus lower multi-turn latency in the evaluated traces.
leansparse同时处理原生稀疏注意力的解码常驻内存与预填充临时内存 预填充按层用两个gpu缓冲区交替加载历史 解码先用紧凑表示粗筛 再仅取候选的原始索引键精排 并分别缓存索引键与kv。其sglang实现基于deepseek-v4-flash 在950k上下文下相对hisparse支持2.95倍并发、达到2.14倍解码吞吐。分层流式加载与粗细两级检索可供超长行为历史服务设计参考。

sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse each query attends only a subset of the sequence chosen by a fixed pattern or in recent production llms learned per query. in deepseek sparse attention dsa the attention of deepseek-v3.2 and the glm-5 family every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. at long context this indexer scan not the sparse attention it feeds is where the decode time goes. but adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. this removes the dependency each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. the resulting multi-layer indexer mli needs no retraining and no new weights. its default realization changes no kernel running inside sglang's production decode graph an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on deepseek-v3.2. mli composes with indexcache the cross-layer reuse glm-5.2 ships as indexshare indexcache drops the indexer from some layers and mli hides the scan on the rest. we serve deepseek-v3.2 and glm-5 under indexcache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 the fraction of layers that keep an indexer and contexts 10k to 195k. at equal retention the composition decodes faster than indexcache up to 14.5% faster on deepseek-v3.2 and 9.8% on glm-5 at 1/2 and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4 largest where indexcache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. at retention 1/r it is faster still than indexcache at 1/ 2r while keeping twice the fresh selections at 128k it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4 above indexcache's 1.28x at 1/8. its longbench ruler and longbench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of indexcache's.

mli overlaps sparse-attention selection and computation by letting a layer attend to the previous indexer layer's selected tokens while its own indexer runs. it composes with indexcache's cross-layer reuse and needs no retraining or new weights for its default implementation. in sglang evaluations on deepseek-v3.2 and glm-5 equal-retention decode gains reach 14.5% and 9.8% respectively longbench and ruler quality stays within a few percentage points of indexcache. it trades selection freshness for overlap rather than proving exact equivalence.

mli利用相邻层选择token高度相似的特点 让当前层先使用上一索引层的候选做注意力计算 同时运行当前索引器 从而打断选择与计算的串行依赖。它可与indexcache跨层复用叠加 默认实现无需重新训练或新增权重。在deepseek-v3.2和glm-5的sglang评测中 同索引保留率下解码最多分别提速14.5%和9.8% longbench及ruler等质量与indexcache相差数个百分点 收益来自候选新鲜度与并行度的取舍。

in this work we study end-to-end fp4 reinforcement learning rl post-training for mixture-of-experts moe large language models. recent work on fp4 rl has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive fp4 baseline in the moe setting. we conduct an in-depth study to understand why. our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to moe because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. when an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply as measured by the pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities and router selection matching rates. building on this finding we propose moeresq a quantization-recovery recipe for moe rl post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. moeresq restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in fp4 rl for moe models.

moeresq studies quantization recovery for end-to-end fp4 reinforcement-learning post-training of moe models. discrete expert routing makes train–rollout alignment sensitive to applying recovery corrections on only one side the proposed recipe applies them symmetrically. the paper reports restored probability and routing alignment and a smaller accuracy gap to full precision. this is a transferable warning for low-precision sparse routing not a recommendation-system benchmark.
moeresq研究moe模型端到端fp4强化学习后训练中的量化恢复。离散专家选择使训练与采样两侧对校正不对称格外敏感 沿用只校正采样侧的稠密模型配方可能破坏概率与路由一致性 作者改为两侧对称校正 恢复一致性并缩小与全精度的精度差距。对低精度稀疏推荐模型的参考点是同时检查训练、推理与专家选择的一致性 论文自身评测对象是语言模型。

modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. on the one hand semantic ids sids give discrete models shared parameters and pretrained semantic structure but discretizing items into hard codes discards some information from the original content embeddings. on the other hand continuous models avoid quantization yet typically use flat item lookup tables with no explicit parameter tying across items. we ask whether a continuous recommender can introduce shared structure without making it a discrete bottleneck. we propose cap-mix a flow recommender that represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector. the assignments prototypes and item vectors are trained jointly and the soft representation is retained at inference. pretrained information is optional sid responsibilities can serve as a prior over assignments while a full content embedding can initialize the item-specific vector without changing the initial flat table. in matched comparisons on three datasets cap-mix improves over a flat table on the two sparse amazon datasets and yields a small gain on steam when trained without pretrained information. given only an offline sid it outperforms a hard table built from the same tokenizer by 4.45-14.90% in hr@5. given the full content embedding it matches or improves a strong flat table while hard assignments regress on the sparse amazon datasets. overall averaged across six benchmarks cap-mix improves hr@5 and ndcg@5 by 6.9% and 13.6% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each dataset and metric while delivering 1.4-161x the inference throughput of the discrete baselines in our experiments.

cap-mix gives continuous generative retrieval shared item structure without a hard discrete bottleneck. each item combines a soft mixture of shared prototypes with an item-specific vector assignments prototypes and vectors train jointly and remain soft at inference with optional semantic-id priors or content initialization. matched comparisons examine sparse amazon and steam settings. across six benchmarks the authors report average hr@5 and ndcg@5 gains of 6.9% and 13.6% over each metric's best evaluated baseline with throughput depending on the discrete baseline.
cap-mix用共享原型的软混合加物品专属向量来表示物品 让连续生成召回获得跨物品参数共享 同时保留推理时的软表示。分配权重、原型和物品向量联合训练 也可用语义id先验或内容向量初始化。论文通过稀疏amazon与steam上的对齐实验分析软结构的收益 并在六个基准上报告相对各数据集最佳所测基线的平均hr@5和ndcg@5提升为6.9%与13.6% 吞吐优势依比较的离散基线而变。

linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value gated deltanet-2 gdn-2 generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled full-rank erase and write gates. however we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels whereas value writes scale all channels so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. furthermore slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. guided by this analysis we introduce muir which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units we design a parallel update for stable efficient training. across 166m-1.34b parameters muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over gdn-2 and 2.5-3.6% over transformer raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points and improves extractive recall over gdn-2. at 1.34b muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall extrapolates 2 560x from its 4k training length to 10m-token streams without perplexity drift and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1m tokens with static readout. muir achieves these gains while matching gdn-2 throughput reaching its 100b-token validation loss 1.2x faster and training 2.7x faster than transformer at 32k.

muir addresses uneven sensitivity in linear-attention erase and write gates and interference from slow-decaying state rows. it combines low-rank gate projections a matched-filter readout and a numerically stable parallel update reallocating saved parameters to the feed-forward network. across 166m–1.34b models it reports 1.8–2.0% lower perplexity than gdn-2 while matching its throughput at 32k context training is 2.7x faster than transformer. its 1.34b model also extrapolates from 4k training sequences to 10m-token streams without perplexity drift. sensitivity-aware state updates offer a direction for long-history recommendation which is not evaluated here.

muir针对线性注意力中擦除与写入门的敏感度差异 以及慢衰减状态行主导读出的问题 采用低秩门投影、匹配滤波读出和数值稳定的并行更新 把省下的参数用于加宽前馈网络。在166m–1.34b模型上 相对gdn-2困惑度降低1.8%–2.0% 吞吐相当 32k上下文下训练速度为transformer的2.7倍。1.34b模型还能从4k训练长度外推到10m token流 未出现困惑度漂移。按敏感度分配状态更新容量可供长行为历史建模参考 论文未验证推荐任务。

we present ginger a state-of-the-art open-source c++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search anns . we developed ginger at google to push the speed and memory efficiency of graph search on large and high-dimensional embedding datasets. ginger surpasses existing anns libraries with regards to query throughput and indexing time while matching the memory footprint of the most space-efficient competitors. ginger builds upon recent advances in proximity graph construction pipnn and vector quantization turboquant . we introduce nested turboquant ntq a two-level quantizer which supports low precision graph navigation and high precision reranking in a single code. this representation achieves near floating point precision with 2.6× less memory. we also compress the size of our proximity graphs by up to 2.5× without impacting query throughput. we combine graph reordering with a new lossless compression codec called adaptivegap which builds upon streamvbyte. at 95% recall ginger speeds up query throughput by an average of 1.8× over each dataset's fastest competitor and by at least 2.3× over any single library. this lead grows to 2.9× over compact libraries on high-dimensional embeddings.

ginger improves the speed and memory use of graph-based approximate nearest-neighbor search. nested turboquant stores low-precision navigation and high-precision reranking information in one code while graph reordering and adaptivegap compress graph links. the quantized representation approaches floating-point precision with 2.6x less memory. at 95% recall query throughput averages 1.8x that of each dataset's fastest competing library. the combination of compact navigation and more precise reranking is directly relevant to large recommendation retrieval indexes the abstract does not specify benchmark hardware.
ginger优化图近邻检索的速度与内存占用。nested turboquant用同一份编码支持低精度图遍历和高精度重排 图重排序与adaptivegap再压缩邻接信息 其量化表示以约1/2.6的内存接近浮点精度。在95%召回率下 查询吞吐平均为各数据集最快对手的1.8倍。把粗检索与精重排所需信息合并存储 可供大规模推荐召回索引参考 摘要未交代测试硬件。

llm-based recommender systems increasingly generate chain-of-thought cot text before each item prediction to activate the llm's reasoning capacity costing tens to hundreds of extra tokens per recommendation at inference. we ask whether inference-time reasoning artifacts textual or latent can be replaced by training-time supervision alone without loss of accuracy. we propose latentrec a framework for llm-based generative recommendation that replaces inference-time reasoning artifacts with training-time per-step head supervision. latentrec has three components. a 2.5m-parameter continuous thought module iterates k latent reasoning steps over the llm's hidden state during training. soft token selection bridges the ~14x norm gap between hidden states and input embeddings. a per-step reasoning loss prl supervises every intermediate state through the llm's prediction head against the first token of the target semantic id. the trained llm retains this accuracy without the module at inference so the module can be discarded at deployment. on three amazon benchmarks latentrec improves hr@10 by 4.0-5.0% relative over a cot-distilled baseline at 18.3x lower latency batch=1 . per-step training supervision consistently improves accuracy across three datasets paid once at training rather than at every recommendation.

latentrec moves recommendation reasoning supervision into training to avoid generating extra reasoning tokens at inference. a 2.5m-parameter module iterates over the llm hidden state aligns hidden states with input embeddings and supervises each step against the first target semantic-id token. the module is discarded at deployment. on three amazon benchmarks hr@10 improves by 4.0–5.0% relative to a cot-distilled baseline with 18.3x lower latency at batch size 1. the useful design is training-only intermediate supervision the latency result does not establish industrial batched throughput.

latentrec把推荐推理监督放在训练阶段 避免推理时生成额外思维链token。它用一个2.5m参数模块迭代更新llm隐藏状态 对齐隐藏状态与输入嵌入 并用目标语义id的首个token监督每一步 部署时移除该模块。在三个amazon数据集上 相对cot蒸馏基线 hr@10提高4.0%–5.0% batch=1时延迟降至约1/18.3。可借鉴的是只在训练时加入中间步骤监督 这一延迟结果不等同于工业批量服务吞吐。

linear attention reduces the quadratic sequence-length complexity of softmax attention by maintaining fixed-size recurrent states. however these states scale quadratically with the representation dimension and require repeated data transfers during decoding creating a substantial gpu memory bottleneck. recent studies have revealed significant low-rank redundancy in recurrent states suggesting opportunities for more efficient representations. we introduce spare state projection for accelerated recurrent execution a training-free method that exploits this redundancy through fixed low-dimensional subspaces heterogeneous rank allocation and lightweight write compensation. by performing recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states spare reduces memory traffic without online decomposition or dense-state reconstruction. spare achieves 2.55x full-model decoding speedup 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel dram traffic and 3.31x lower peak gpu memory while preserving better associative-retrieval accuracy than structured pruning at matched memory budgets.

spare targets the memory traffic of linear attention's recurrent states whose size grows quadratically with representation width. without retraining it uses fixed low-dimensional subspaces heterogeneous ranks and write compensation to read and update compressed states directly avoiding online decomposition and dense reconstruction. the abstract reports 2.55x full-model decode speedup 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel dram traffic and 3.31x lower peak gpu memory but does not identify the speed baseline or hardware. associative retrieval is better than structured pruning at matched memory budgets. the mechanism offers a candidate approach for compact long-history states.

spare处理线性注意力递归状态随表示宽度平方增长、解码反复搬运状态的问题。它无需重新训练 用固定低维子空间、差异化秩分配和写入补偿直接读写压缩状态 省去在线分解与稠密状态重建。摘要报告整模型解码提速2.55倍、递归核dram流量降至约1/7.49、gpu峰值内存降至约1/3.31 但未说明速度基线和硬件。在相同内存预算下 其关联检索精度优于结构化剪枝 这一机制可作为长行为历史状态压缩的候选方案。

attention is a core building block of frontier models and often dominates compute-bound prefill at long context. fp8 matrix instructions offer twice the peak throughput of bf16 but they accelerate only matrix multiplication and the softmax between the two matrix multiplications of attention runs on vector units that fp8 does not accelerate. on the amd instinct mi355x the vendor's aiter kernels reach 39% of peak fp8 matrix throughput at 32k tokens compared with 49% in bf16. attention is also more numerically sensitive to quantization than feed-forward layers and unlike nvidia's hopper and blackwell gpus the mi355x does not track the completion of matrix instructions in hardware so overlapping the softmax with the matrix multiplications depends on instruction order. we present zyfa prefill kernels for the mi355x built on three techniques 1 computing each fp8 probability directly from its score with a multiply-add and an integer conversion instead of an exponential 2 a ping-pong schedule in which one group of threads computes its softmax while another executes its matrix multiplications and 3 scaling each block of probabilities up by a power of two before rounding and normalizing by the sum of the rounded probabilities. on attention inputs captured from three models and timed at sustained clock speeds zyfa achieves 1.16-1.76x the throughput of aiter. on the gaussian inputs of kernel benchmarks at 32k tokens it achieves 1.26-1.37x at head dimension 128 and 1.99x for deepseek-style multi-head latent attention. the sustained clock of the mi355x depends on operand values so throughput on random inputs does not reliably predict throughput on real model activations. at head dimension 128 zyfa's numerical error is within a few percent of that of composable kernel and triton and 62-78% lower than that of aiter's. the source code is available at https //github.com/zyphra/zyfa.

zyfa targets the softmax and scheduling bottlenecks that limit fp8 attention on amd mi355x. it combines direct score-to-fp8 probability conversion overlapping matrix multiplication with softmax and blockwise probability scaling before rounding. on activations captured from three models at sustained clock speeds its prefill kernels deliver 1.16–1.76x aiter throughput. at head dimension 128 numerical error is close to composable kernel and triton and lower than aiter. the paper also shows why random-input benchmarks can mispredict real-activation throughput on this hardware. this is a hardware-specific attention-kernel result not an end-to-end recommendation speedup.

zyfa针对amd mi355x上fp8注意力的softmax与调度瓶颈 直接把分数转换为fp8概率 让矩阵乘法与softmax交叠执行 并在舍入前按块缩放概率。在三个模型的真实激活、持续运行频率下 预填充核吞吐为aiter的1.16–1.76倍 head dimension为128时 数值误差接近composable kernel和triton 低于aiter。论文还指出该硬件的频率受操作数影响 随机输入跑分不能可靠预测真实吞吐。可借鉴的是硬件协同设计与评测方法 并非已经验证的推荐端到端加速。

generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating semantic ids sids where an rq-vae quantizes each item into a hierarchical sid sequence that the decoder generates level by level. we identify an overlooked bottleneck in this paradigm the semantic quantization gap sqg . quantization derives sids from rich continuous signals including codebook centroids local neighborhood geometry and level-wise entropy. however the decoder receives only discrete identifiers and loses the semantic structure that shaped them. this mismatch manifests in three ways a grounding gap where the decoder lacks semantic anchors when target-side information is limited a neighborhood gap where token-level supervision discards inter-item similarity and exacerbates exposure bias and a difficulty gap where computation is allocated uniformly despite generation difficulty diminishing with depth. to bridge the sqg we propose bridge. codebook-grounded latent reasoning injects frozen quantizer centroids as semantic anchors before sid generation. privileged ema self-distillation transfers neighborhood-aware knowledge from a teacher to an on-policy student preserving inter-item geometry while mitigating exposure bias. effort-aware recurrence allocates more computation to the challenging early levels and progressively reduces it with depth. across three amazon benchmarks bridge improves recall@10 and ndcg@10 by 10.9% and 9.7% on average over the strongest baseline up to 12.6% and 10.7% . in a one-week online a/b experiment on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform with 5% traffic bridge improves ecpm by 0.65%.

bridge addresses the semantic information lost when a generative recommender sees only discrete semantic ids. it supplies frozen codebook centroids as reasoning anchors distills neighborhood structure through a privileged ema teacher and allocates more recurrent computation to difficult early id levels. across three amazon benchmarks average recall@10 and ndcg@10 improve by 10.9% and 9.7% over the strongest baseline. a one-week 5%-traffic e-commerce advertising a/b test reports a 0.65% ecpm gain. the method suggests preserving quantizer geometry and varying compute by id depth the abstract gives no matched-budget efficiency result.

bridge处理生成推荐只接收离散语义id、丢失量化阶段连续语义信息的问题。它把冻结的码本质心作为推理锚点 用带额外信息的ema教师蒸馏邻域结构 并给较难的id前几层分配更多循环计算。在三个amazon数据集上 相对最强基线 recall@10和ndcg@10平均提高10.9%和9.7% 电商广告平台一周、5%流量的a/b测试报告ecpm提高0.65%。可借鉴的是保留量化几何信息并按id深度分配计算 摘要未给出等预算效率结论。

sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. however useful interactions differ in their precision requirements some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. we therefore introduce triattention which assigns query-key qk tiles to skipping 4-bit or 8-bit computation using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. to represent compactly we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries keeping policy storage independent of context length. offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. using these measurements a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. during prefill the selected boundaries generate precision-grouped traversals for a fused kernel that skips omitted tiles and combines contributions from both qk precisions into one normalized attention output. the quantized keys and values prepared during prefill are then reused in a compressed key-value kv cache for decoding reducing repeated reads of prompt data. experiments show that triattention achieves end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over the torch attention and 2.65x over the bf16 baseline. meanwhile triattention maintains quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. these results show how a compact retention-and-precision policy translates local sensitivities into attention computation and repeated kv-cache access. the implementation is https //github.com/hanzhizhang-ulrica/triattention.

triattention jointly chooses which attention tiles to retain and whether to compute them at 4 or 8 bits. two diagonal-distance boundaries per head encode the policy offline calibration and model-wide allocation select boundaries under a shared compute budget. a fused prefill kernel combines both precisions and decoding reuses the compressed kv cache. the abstract reports up to 2.65x end-to-end generation speedup over a bf16 baseline with comparable general and long-context task quality but does not specify the hardware or baseline implementation. joint retention and precision allocation could inform long-sequence serving beyond llms.
triattention联合决定哪些注意力块跳过、哪些用4位或8位计算。每个头只用两条对角距离边界描述策略 离线校准后在全模型共享计算预算下分配边界 融合预填充核合并两种精度的结果 解码复用压缩kv缓存。摘要报告相对bf16基线 端到端生成最多提速2.65倍 通用与长上下文任务质量相当 但未交代硬件和基线实现。联合分配保留范围与数值精度 可供其他长序列服务参考。

at context lengths of about 1m tokens dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding and training typically relies on long documents which become scarcer as the target length increases. most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens so their selection cost per query is o l at context length l hierarchical selection reduces it to o log l but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. we propose recsa recursive sparse attention which builds a tree over the kv cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. the keys come from one pooler per layer shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. each level above the tokens selects at most k candidates so each query has o log l selection cost and reads o log l entries the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. each entry's rope position is its index among the candidates of its level so at any length every relative distance stays within the range seen during training. initialized from qwen3-4b and trained on 0.62b tokens at the original model's 32k training length recsa outperforms all baselines on ruler at every length from 131k to 2m at 1m it scores 60.5 compared with 40.0 for the best baseline dense + dca. with our optimized kernels recsa is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64k to 2m at 524k on one h200 gpu it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.

recsa builds a tree over the kv cache and recursively selects candidates combining exact tokens with summaries of unselected subtrees in one softmax. a per-layer pooler shared across tree levels and level-relative positions keep selection and reads logarithmic in sequence length while supporting length extrapolation. starting from qwen3-4b training uses 0.62b tokens at 32k length. at 1m tokens ruler scores 60.5 versus 40.0 for the best baseline dense + dca. at 524k on one h200 prefill and decoding are 3.2x and 3.8x faster than dense attention. hierarchical retrieval offers a transferable long-history design without recommendation evaluation.

recsa在kv缓存上建树 逐层筛选候选 把精确token与未选子树的摘要放入同一个softmax。每个模型层的池化器供树内所有层级共享 配合树层内相对位置 使选择与读取成本随序列长度对数增长 并支持长度外推。它从qwen3-4b初始化 在32k长度下训练0.62b token 1m长度的ruler得分为60.5 最佳基线dense + dca为40.0。在单张h200、524k上下文下 相对稠密注意力 预填充与解码分别提速3.2倍和3.8倍。分层检索可供长行为历史建模参考 论文未评测推荐任务。

looped transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. we take the depth-memory view of residual connections and analyze which representation is stored after each block application and how later reads weight it. a full block output contains both its input and its new update so weighting that output also reweights the history already carried by the input. reading individual updates instead with the shared stack's input kept on a separate path gives separate controls over input strength total update weight and allocation across updates. the loopback transformer implements these controls geometric decay sets the total update weight and supplies a recency prior and attention learns how to allocate that weight. on climbmix loopback reaches lower validation loss than standard transformer baselines with 40-75% of their transformer parameters excluding token embeddings and the output head at reference scales from 191m to 3b with training tokens and executed depth matched. it also has higher mean accuracy over thirteen downstream tasks at 1.4b and 3b. at 191m 374m and 778m it has the lowest validation loss and the highest thirteen-task mean among the standard transformer and seven looped residual designs.

loopback separates the shared stack's input from individual residual updates avoiding the repeated reweighting of history carried inside full block outputs. geometric decay controls total update weight and recency while attention allocates weight across updates. on climbmix with training tokens and executed depth matched it reaches lower validation loss than standard transformers using 40–75% of their transformer parameters excluding embeddings and the output head at reference scales of 191m–3b. it also improves mean accuracy on 13 tasks at 1.4b and 3b. the result informs parameter-efficient recurrent depth not a demonstrated flop or latency reduction.

loopback把共享层堆栈的输入与各次残差更新分开保存 避免读取完整层输出时反复改变其中已有历史的权重。几何衰减控制总更新权重和近因偏好 注意力负责在不同更新间分配权重。在climbmix上 训练token数和实际执行深度匹配时 它以标准transformer 40%–75%的transformer参数达到更低验证损失 此参数口径不含嵌入与输出头 参考规模为191m–3b。1.4b和3b实验的13项任务平均准确率也更高。可借鉴的是循环深度的参数效率 不能据此推断flop或时延下降。

attention-ffn disaggregation afd separates attention from the experts of a mixture-of-experts moe model and has been reported to raise decode throughput over colocated serving. whether this advantage holds on rack-scale nvlink systems such as gb200 nvl72 remains unclear prior results were obtained on other hardware against narrower colocated baselines or with analytical models whereas production engines serve large moe models on these systems with wide expert parallelism wide ep . we build and tune fastafd an afd engine for gb200 nvl72 that overlaps the moe of one microbatch with the attention of the other and compare it against the best vllm wide ep setting. experiments show that afd has a throughput advantage of up to 1.17x over wide ep on qwen3 and 1.16x on qwen3.5 and matches it on minimax-m2.5. we derive an analytical model that predicts afd throughput within 3% using only profiles of colocated vllm telling whether switching to afd would pay off before deploying it. the model yields a concise insight afd's speedup factors into a batch gain larger batches since attention gpus hold no expert weights an overlap gain shorter steps since the moe runs on the expert gpus behind attention and a disaggregation cost the gpus given to experts . afd has the advantage when the two gains outweigh the cost. this view explains which models benefit from afd and shows that speculative decoding helps light-expert models most where the enlarged overlap gain outweighs the larger disaggregation cost and adds a further 8% to afd's advantage over wide ep. looking ahead serving the experts on accelerators that keep their weights in on-chip sram such as the groq lpx accelerators paired with vera rubin nvl72 would remove most of the disaggregation cost raising the ideal speedup to 2.48x with speculative decoding. fastafd is open source at https //github.com/hao-ai-lab/fastafd.

fastafd tests when separating attention and moe experts pays off on gb200 nvl72. it overlaps attention and expert computation across microbatches and compares against the best vllm wide-expert-parallel configuration. throughput gains reach 1.17x on qwen3 and 1.16x on qwen3.5 while minimax-m2.5 is matched. a model using colocated profiles predicts throughput within 3% and separates batch-size gains overlap gains and the gpu cost of disaggregation. this gives a hardware-specific decision framework for sparse-model serving the larger projected speedup with future sram-resident expert accelerators is not a measured result.

fastafd检验在gb200 nvl72上 把注意力与moe专家拆开部署是否划算。它让不同微批次的注意力与专家计算交叠 并与调优后的最佳vllm宽专家并行配置比较 qwen3和qwen3.5吞吐最多分别达到1.17倍和1.16倍 minimax-m2.5则相当。只用共置服务性能采样的模型 就能在3%误差内预测吞吐 并拆分批量增大、计算交叠和额外专家gpu的成本。它提供了依赖硬件的稀疏模型部署判断方法 未来sram驻留专家加速器的更大收益只是预测。

matrix optimizers such as muon update whole weight matrices which conflicts with the element- or row-wise sharding of data-parallel runtimes. once parameters are sharded as well matrix optimizers incur extra communication or repeated computation. we present dmuon a matrix-granular optimizer runtime for pytorch fsdp zero-2/3 and hsdp. dmuon assigns each matrix a unique owner which performs the newton--schulz ns iteration and optimizer update on the full matrix and balances the load across owners by computational cost. on hsdp ownership is global across replicas so the cluster keeps a single copy of gradients and optimizer state and updated parameters are published across nodes as soon as they are ready overlapping subsequent computation. this layout makes every collective sparse and variable in length so dmuon schedules these collectives as their data becomes ready and routes them along the cluster's two-level network. on up to 256 h100 gpus across three dense llms and two vla models dmuon matches or exceeds the training throughput of pytorch fsdp2 with adamw reaching 1.05× that of fsdp2 with adamw at the median on 256 gpus. the optimized parameter gathering and gradient reduction absorb the extra communication and computation a matrix optimizer requires. against a gather-then-replicate muon baseline dmuon's throughput is 2.1 times as high at the median.

dmuon reconciles whole-matrix optimization with sharded data-parallel training. each matrix has one cost-balanced owner for its optimizer update global ownership under hsdp avoids replicated optimizer work and state while readiness-driven collectives follow the network topology. across three dense llms and two vla models on up to 256 h100s it reports median throughput of 1.05x pytorch fsdp2 with adamw at 256 gpus and 2.1x a gather-then-replicate muon baseline. matrix-level ownership and communication scheduling could help scale matrix optimizers for recommendation but no recommendation or model-quality benefit is established here.

dmuon处理整矩阵优化器与分片数据并行之间的冲突。每个矩阵只交给一个按计算成本分配的owner更新 hsdp下跨副本统一所有权 避免重复优化计算和状态存储 再按数据就绪顺序与网络拓扑调度通信。实验覆盖三个稠密llm、两个vla模型 最多使用256张h100 256卡时吞吐中位数为pytorch fsdp2配adamw的1.05倍 相对先聚合再复制的muon基线为2.1倍。矩阵级任务分配可供推荐模型优化器扩展参考 但这里未验证推荐效果或模型质量收益。

synchronous moe reinforcement-learning post-training suffers from response-length imbalance. existing methods reduce request tails yet completed ranks remain bound to expert parallelism ep collectives and expert ownership. in a representative 16-accelerator qwen3-30b-a3b rollout this dummy run traps 32.83% of rank-time. adafloor converts this ep-coupled capacity into bounded leases for auxiliary work to improve system resource efficiency through rank-time reuse. historical prompt-tail prediction and a calibrated guard construct the kv-safe layout. adafloor then selects the floor-specific safe quorum schedule with the largest predicted release area. its runtime shrinks the ep group and leases detached ranks until full-world restoration. across three updated-policy seeds on deepscaler mathematical reasoning rollouts its capacity-oriented natural floor2 configuration with tailguard reduces vanilla's 29393.9 rank-seconds of dummy run by 96.15%. rollout shortening eliminates 18693.6 rank-seconds while coordinated exits convert another 9568.6 rank-seconds into reusable capacity leaving 1131.7 rank-seconds. for sidecar reuse its planned residency floor4 configuration without tailguard serves 3134 qwen3-8b gsm8k queries per epoch at 99.46% accuracy and incurs only a 2 to 3% primary throughput reduction against the same configuration with sidecar execution disabled. its latency-oriented planned residency floor4 configuration with tailguard reduces rollout time by 24.09% relative to vanilla and by 2.31% relative to lengthsort with tailguard. on public eurus-2-rl code rollouts with the same model and 16-rank topology adafloor reduces rollout time by 20.56% and dummy run by 89.13% while generated work and mean reward remain stable.

adafloor reclaims idle rank-time in synchronous moe rl rollouts by planning kv-safe layouts shrinking expert-parallel groups and leasing detached ranks for auxiliary work. different configurations target capacity sidecar reuse or latency on 16-rank qwen3-30b-a3b math rollouts capacity mode reduces dummy-run rank-time by 96.15% sidecar mode serves 3 134 qwen3-8b queries per epoch with a 2–3% primary-throughput cost against its own no-sidecar configuration latency mode cuts rollout time by 24.09% versus vanilla. public code rollouts show a 20.56% time reduction with stable work and reward. elastic resource reuse may inform uneven-length serving but these are distinct configurations and not recommendation results.

adafloor规划满足kv显存约束的布局 缩小专家并行组 并将退出的rank限时借给辅助任务 以回收同步moe强化学习rollout中的空闲占用时间。容量、旁路复用和延迟由不同配置优化 16-rank的qwen3-30b-a3b数学rollout中 容量配置将dummy run占用减少96.15% 旁路配置每轮处理3 134个qwen3-8b查询 相对同配置禁用旁路时主任务吞吐损失2–3% 延迟配置相对vanilla缩短24.09%的rollout时间。公开代码rollout中耗时减少20.56% 生成工作量和平均奖励保持稳定。弹性复用可供长短请求混合服务参考 但这些收益来自不同配置 也不是推荐实验。

generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. in local retail and food delivery candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. location weather and traffic reshape merchant and product supply so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. we study retrieval over an explicitly materialized request-time supply snapshot where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. our rtp-llm pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index overlaps cpu compilation with model prefill and shares the uploaded index across beams. legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities and constraint states follow selected beam parents. we formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. the implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. historical evidence covers t+1 daily-refresh catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. in one matched-beam daily-constraint case filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299 residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. a different-host comparison with 30 000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment while client measurements expose additional request costs. captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. these observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. they establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.

this retrieval pipeline constrains semantic-id generation to a request-time snapshot of serviceable local merchants. eligible ids are compiled into a compressed sparse row prefix index overlapped with model prefill and shared across beams while preserving original-model probabilities for legal expansions. a matched-beam daily-constraint case reduces filtered merchants from 170/299 to 29/299 remaining distance violations motivate request-specific constraints. a separate different-host test with 30 000 entries adds 0.6 ms of service-side latency excluding additional client costs. the implementation informs dynamic constrained retrieval but validity is snapshot-relative and compute savings at matched retrieval quality are not established.

这套召回流程按请求时刻可服务的本地商家快照约束语义id生成。它把合法id编译成压缩稀疏行前缀索引 与模型预填充交叠执行并跨beam共享 合法扩展仍保留原模型概率。一个beam配置匹配的日更约束案例中 事后被过滤的商家从170/299降至29/299 剩余距离违规促使约束进一步细化到请求级。另一个不同主机、3万条供给的测试报告服务端延迟增加0.6毫秒 尚有额外客户端成本。可借鉴的是动态约束召回的实现 合法性只相对该快照成立 论文未证明同检索质量下节省计算。

the full-attention layers of large language models llms make every generated token more expensive than the previous one slowing models down on long-context tasks. hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. we accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens a pinned prefix and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. the window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. across six hybrid models from three families from 4b to 397b parameters the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on qwen3.5-4b 1.20x/2.23x on qwen3.5-122b-a10b and 1.16x/2.06x on ornith-1.0-397b.

this method sparsifies the remaining full-attention layers in hybrid llms without retraining or changing weights. each layer retains a recent window a pinned prefix and a fixed budget of relevant context tokens with per-layer settings chosen by multi-objective search. across six models from three families spanning 4b–397b parameters selected configurations preserve baseline accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. at 256k context reported decoding speedups reach 2.22x on qwen3.5-4b 2.23x on qwen3.5-122b-a10b and 2.06x on ornith-1.0-397b. layer-specific sparse budgets offer a design to test for hybrid recommendation models not an established recommendation result.

该方法无需重新训练或修改权重 直接稀疏化混合llm中剩余的全注意力层。每层保留近期窗口、固定前缀和一定数量的相关历史token 再用多目标搜索选择各层预算。实验覆盖三个模型家族的六个模型 规模为4b–397b 所选配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持基线准确率。256k上下文下 qwen3.5-4b、qwen3.5-122b-a10b和ornith-1.0-397b解码最多分别提速2.22倍、2.23倍和2.06倍。逐层设置稀疏预算可在混合推荐模型中尝试 但论文没有推荐任务结果。

mixture-of-experts moe models have become prevailing yet their distributed deployment suffers from severe dynamic load imbalance due to the conflict between static expert placement and inherent routing dynamism. while host dram offers capacity to avoid static device storage for load balancing we identify existing offloading works fundamentally fail in distributed inference due to two overlooked challenges 1 coupled performance impacts of runtime host-to-device transfers due to load dynamism and shared pcie topology 2 system-level memory overhead incurred by dram usage at scale. in this paper we propose vexpert that shifts dram offloading paradigm from partial residency to full redundancy through virtualized expert storage. we pioneer the first systematic performance model that jointly captures h2d latency pcie contention and load imbalance building a lightweight allocator to dynamically map physical experts to virtual slots runtime. a novel disaggregated manager is designed to reduce memory overhead in multi-process environments. evaluated on deepseek-v3.1 within an 8-node h100 cluster vexpert improves load balance ratio by up to 55% and achieves 1.2× end-to-end speedup.

vexpert addresses the mismatch between static expert placement and dynamic moe routing. it keeps fully redundant expert storage in host dram virtualizes gpu expert slots and uses a performance model covering host-to-device transfers pcie contention and load imbalance to choose mappings. a separate manager reduces multiprocess host-memory overhead. on deepseek-v3.1 in an eight-node h100 cluster the system reports up to 55% improvement in its load-balance ratio and 1.2x end-to-end speedup. the design offers a systems approach to dynamic expert placement its recommendation applicability and behavior on other interconnects remain untested in the abstract.

vexpert处理静态专家放置跟不上moe动态路由的问题。它在主机dram中保存完整冗余专家 把gpu上的专家位置虚拟化 再用同时考虑h2d传输、pcie争用和负载不均的性能模型分配映射 独立管理器减少多进程主机内存开销。在8节点h100集群上运行deepseek-v3.1时 论文报告其负载均衡比指标最多改善55% 端到端提速1.2倍。动态专家放置的方法可供稀疏推荐系统参考 摘要未验证推荐任务或其他互连环境。

helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems yet the usual remedy boosting exposure of under-explored discovery content often backfires in production. we report ured unexposed recycling for efficient discovery a training-free recall-stage system serving taobao feed recommendation at alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. it rests on a production-validated insight naive boosting fails because it injects cold information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. items scored highly but never exposed signals industrial pipelines routinely discard form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. over a 30-day horizon ured aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage distributed aggregation and low-latency online serving adding under 1% latency via a single o 1 lookup per request with no model retraining. online a/b tests show +3.47% discovered categories and +8.47% content richness with engagement preserved completion video views rise significantly +2.62% and total views move positive +0.36% not significant . ablations confirm both design pillars are necessary a one-day window collapses the discovery gain to +0.55% not significant and random injection without score filtering yields no gain while trending negative on engagement -0.17% . across production recall channels ured reaches 13.9x the platform-average discovery rate 6.3x the strongest nearline baseline at engagement quality on par with the platform average. we share deployment details and lessons for practitioners facing the exploration-exploitation dilemma under tight resource constraints.

ured reuses high-scored but unexposed items instead of injecting poorly understood cold candidates for discovery. a 30-day pool feeds a training-free recall pipeline with one o 1 lookup per request and under 1% added latency. in taobao feed a/b tests discovered categories rise 3.47% and completed video views rise 2.62% the 0.36% total-view increase is not statistically significant. shortening the pool to one day or removing score filtering removes the reliable discovery gain. the system illustrates how existing ranking signals can support exploration without another model rather than demonstrating model-scaling gains.

ured回收高分但未曝光的商品 用这些已有较可靠排序信号的候选做兴趣发现 避免直接注入信息不足的冷候选。系统汇总30天候选 无需重新训练 每次请求只做一次o 1 查找 新增延迟低于1%。淘宝信息流a/b测试中 发现品类增加3.47% 完播量增加2.62% 总播放量增加0.36% 未达统计显著。把窗口缩到一天 或去掉分数过滤 都不再有可靠的发现收益。可借鉴的是用现有排序信号低成本补充探索 而不是模型规模扩展结论。

hyper-connections hc architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. in this work we systematically study the hc architecture to understand its components and identify simpler more efficient designs. we find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups either alone achieves performance comparable to mhc. we also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead even without mixing. these findings lead to simplehc which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. layer-specific gates share a group-entry state enabling batched reads and deferred writes scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. simplehc incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. it maintains performance comparable to mhc when scaling from 15b to 30b moe models exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training and remains stable under stress. we hope simplehc will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.

simplehc studies which hyper-connection components justify their training cost. it removes residual mixing while retaining learned read/write gates then shares memory access through batched reads and deferred writes with scalar corrections that preserve preceding update contributions. across 15b–30b moe models it maintains performance comparable to mhc at the largest tested scale end-to-end training takes only 2.4% longer than a vanilla residual baseline. it also reports smoother training gradients and stability under stress. separating useful residual-state structure from expensive memory access could guide deeper recommendation architectures which are not tested here.

simplehc研究hyper-connection中哪些结构值得付出训练开销。它移除残差混合 保留可学习的读写门 再通过批量读取、延后写回和标量校正共享内存访问 同时保留前序更新的贡献。在15b–30b moe模型上 效果与mhc相当 最大测试规模下 端到端训练耗时仅比普通残差基线多2.4% 并报告更平滑的梯度和压力测试稳定性。把有效的残差状态结构与昂贵的内存访问拆开优化 可供深层推荐架构参考 论文未验证这一迁移。

under expert parallelism mixture-of-experts moe layers pay all-to-all token dispatch grouped gemms and a combine step in every layer. in decode each rank holds only 1-256 tokens dispatch latency and weight traffic dominate while tensor-core utilization is inherently low. in fused operators such as deepgemm's mega moe dispatch and computation overlap only by sharing every sm dispatch warps compete with tma/mma and epilogue warps for registers shared memory and issue slots every phase shares one cta resource budget synchronization spans the whole sm array and every replay ends with a workspace-clean pass and a cross-rank barrier. we present gc-moe an open-source fp8/fp4 moe inference operator for nvidia hopper and blackwell gpus that uses cuda green contexts to split the device into a small communication partition and a large compute partition. each role gets its own kernel resource budget and synchronization domain so dispatch and gemm tune independently. a three-node cuda graph four on hopper with fused shared experts launches the dispatch and grouped-gemm kernels as concurrent roots a token-ring handshake starts computation on the first filled ring blocks and double-buffered receive counters remove the trailing cross-rank barrier between replays. the compute partition runs operand-swapped tcgen05 block-scaled mma on blackwell and register-a wgmma with in-register fp4 decoding on hopper with fused swiglu requantization and optional shared experts. on 8 h20 gpus gc-moe accelerates deepseek-v4.1-flash decode by 1.188x on average on both the routed and shared-expert suites peaks 1.296x and 1.353x on 8 b300 gpus it accelerates glm-5.2 and deepseek-v4.1-flash by 1.106x 1.123x with fused shared experts peak 1.209x beating mega moe at all 54 measured points at matched accuracy. gc-moe reserves only 20 of 148 sms on b300 for dispatch.

gc-moe separates expert-parallel dispatch and grouped gemm onto communication and compute partitions using cuda green contexts. independent kernels a token-ring handshake and double-buffered counters overlap work without the usual trailing cross-rank barrier. at matched accuracy the operator beats mega moe across all 54 measured points. on eight h20s reported deepseek-v4.1-flash decode speedup averages 1.188x in both routed and shared-expert suites on eight b300s glm-5.2 and deepseek-v4.1-flash average 1.106x or 1.123x with fused shared experts. this supports hardware-aware partitioning for sparse inference not a general recommendation throughput claim.

gc-moe用cuda green contexts把专家并行的token分发与分组gemm放到独立的通信区和计算区。两套核分别调优 通过token环握手和双缓冲计数器交叠执行 去掉回放末尾的跨卡屏障。在精度匹配时 它在54个测试点都快于mega moe 8张h20上 deepseek-v4.1-flash的路由专家与共享专家测试平均均提速1.188倍 8张b300上 glm-5.2和deepseek-v4.1-flash平均提速1.106倍 融合共享专家后为1.123倍。可借鉴的是稀疏推理的硬件分区方式 并非通用推荐吞吐结论。

in the near future language model pretraining will become bound by total data rather than total compute. such a regime requires revisiting scaling laws and scaling law theory. motivated by prior works that have found utility in ensembling we study how the number of training epochs and ensemble size jointly shape generalization when training data are fixed. in language-model experiments on fineweb logit averaging reduces late-training deterioration delays optimal stopping and can outperform wider or deeper single models at matched parameter-token budgets over a common training horizon. to analyze this interaction between data reuse and ensembling we derive a dynamical mean-field theory dmft for multi-epoch stochastic gradient descent in power-law random-feature ensembles tracking error correlations across epochs and models. ensembling reduces the prediction variance responsible for late-time growth in expected test error changing the optimal stopping time. we use these stopping times to derive compute-allocation laws at fixed data and individual model sizes. under this allocation ensemble size grows with compute at least as fast as training time per member while excess test loss above the limiting loss decreases as a power of compute.

this study asks how to allocate compute between repeated training and ensembling when data are fixed. fineweb language-model experiments show that logit averaging can reduce late-training deterioration and outperform wider or deeper single models at matched parameter-token budgets over a common training horizon. a dynamical mean-field theory for power-law random-feature ensembles links the benefit to reduced prediction variance and derives allocation laws at fixed data and individual model sizes. data-limited recommendation may benefit from testing this trade-off but the theoretical model is not a universal llm scaling law and inference cost is not matched by the stated training-budget comparison.

这项研究讨论数据固定时 新增计算该用于多轮训练还是集成。在fineweb语言模型实验中 logit平均能减轻训练后期退化 在相同训练区间、参数与token乘积预算匹配时 集成可优于更宽或更深的单模型。论文再用幂律随机特征集成的动态平均场理论 把收益联系到预测方差下降 并在固定数据量和单模型规模下推导计算分配规律。数据受限的推荐训练可以检验这一取舍 但该理论并非通用llm定律 训练预算匹配也不代表推理成本匹配。

expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. we compare removal freezing remaining-expert renormalization and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families with a base olmoe checkpoint as an additional comparison. we develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. with half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained and from 14 to 28 740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. task outcomes vary across evaluation types on olmoe gsm8k strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction supported by the olmoe experiments the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.

this study isolates how expert deactivation interacts with the router weighting rule used in training. it compares removal freezing remaining-expert renormalization and unnormalized rerouting on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four families plus a base olmoe model. with half the experts disabled retaining the training rule yields perplexity of 1.4–73x the intact baseline mismatches yield 14–28 740x. even matching the rule does not guarantee task quality olmoe gsm8k strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. expert compression therefore needs routing-scale and task-level checks not just expert importance rankings.

这项研究把专家停用的实现方式与训练时路由权重规则分开检查。在四个模型家族的五个指令微调checkpoint及一个基础olmoe模型上 它对同一批停用专家比较移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化和不归一化重路由。停用一半专家时 保留训练权重规则的困惑度为完整模型的1.4–73倍 规则错配时为14–28 740倍。但规则匹配也不保证任务效果 olmoe的gsm8k严格匹配准确率在四种实现下都降到零。压缩专家时应同时检查路由尺度和任务指标 不能只依赖专家重要性排名。

the end-to-end generative paradigm is revolutionizing advertising recommendation systems driving a shift from traditional cascaded architectures towards unified modeling. however practical deployment faces three core challenges the misalignment between interest objectives and business value the target-agnostic limitation of generative processes and the disconnection between generation and ranking stages. existing solutions often fall into a dilemma where single-stage fusion induces optimization tension while stage decoupling causes irreversible information loss. to address this we propose oneranker achieving architectural-level deep integration of generation and ranking. first we design a value-aware multi-task decoupling architecture. by leveraging task token sequences and causal mask we separate interest coverage and value optimization spaces within shared representations effectively alleviating target conflicts. second we construct a coarse-to-fine collaborative target awareness mechanism utilizing fake item tokens for implicit awareness during generation and a ranking decoder for explicit value alignment at the candidate level. finally we propose input-output dual-side consistency guarantees. through key/value pass-through mechanisms and distribution consistency dc constraint loss we achieve end-to-end collaborative optimization between generation and ranking. the full deployment on tencent's weixin channels advertising system has shown a significant improvement in key business metrics gmv - normal +1.34% providing a new paradigm with industrial feasibility for generative advertising recommendations.

oneranker jointly models candidate generation and ranking for advertising. task-token sequences and causal masks separate interest coverage from value optimization implicit target tokens an explicit ranking decoder shared key/value representations and a distribution-consistency loss connect the two stages. deployment on tencent weixin channels reports a 1.34% gmv-normal improvement. it offers a concrete design for unifying generation and value-aware ranking rather than optimizing two disconnected models.
oneranker 将广告候选生成与排序放进同一模型。任务 token 和因果掩码分开处理兴趣覆盖与商业价值 再通过隐式目标 token、显式排序解码器、键值表征传递和分布一致性损失连接两阶段。微信视频号广告部署报告 gmv-normal 提升 1.34%。这项设计可供生成式推荐与价值排序的联合建模参考。

re-ranking aims to present users with an ordered list that maximizes sequence-level utility. industrial deployments widely adopt the generator--evaluator framework where the generator proposes candidate sequences and the evaluator scores them to select the best one for display. the fidelity of the evaluator's utility estimates thus directly governs recommendation quality. however existing evaluators predominantly follow the independent behavior modeling ibm paradigm which simplifies the continuous user browsing journey into independent per-item predictions e.g. ctr . this oversimplification ignores two physical realities i a click can occur only after the item has been reached and impressed and ii items compete for finite user attention. as a result ibm produces systematically biased evaluations and suboptimal sequence selection. to address this we propose a joint behavior modeling jbm perspective that explicitly models the display \rightarrow impression \rightarrow click process to capture causal and competitive dependencies within a sequence. building on jbm we develop the impression-click evaluator ice a plug-and-play framework that i predicts a browsing-depth distribution to estimate per-position impression probabilities ii leverages predicted impressions to suppress spurious context from unexposed items during click modeling and iii introduces a click distribution matching objective to capture intra-sequence dependencies. extensive offline experiments across diverse backbones together with a 14-day online a/b test in the taobao app +0.70% clicks +3.67% revenue and full-traffic deployment validate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach.

ice evaluates candidate recommendation lists by modeling display impression and click jointly. it predicts browsing depth uses impression probabilities to reduce context from unseen items and matches the click distribution across the list. a 14-day taobao a/b test reports 0.70% more clicks and 3.67% more revenue. this improves the evaluator in a generator–evaluator reranking pipeline it addresses sequence utility rather than establishing a model-size scaling law.
ice 用 展示列表→用户实际看到→点击 的过程评估候选列表。它先预测浏览深度 再用曝光概率减弱未看到物品的干扰 并学习列表内的点击分布。淘宝 14 天线上实验报告点击量提升 0.70%、收入提升 3.67%。可借鉴点是改进生成器—评估器重排中的序列价值估计 论文没有建立模型规模的扩展规律。

semantic information can enrich the identifiers and structured fields used by recommender systems. semantic tokenization provides a structured representation of this information by converting llm-derived user profiles into discrete tokens. in the common two-stage pipeline the tokenizer is trained before the recommender. its token assignments are then treated as fixed input features during recommendation training. as a result the downstream recommender can learn how to use the assigned indices but it cannot revise the semantic partition that produced them. making this partition task-aware is difficult because nearest-code assignment is discrete and unconstrained adaptation may also distort the geometry learned during pretraining. moreover a fixed token depth exposes the same semantic resolution to every interaction. we thus propose optst optimizing semantic tokenization which makes a pretrained tokenizer responsive to downstream recommendation. to revise token assignments without directly updating the pretrained encoder or base codebooks optst learns a low-rank deformation whose drift is limited by an anchor regularizer. recommendation supervision reaches this transformation through a straight-through estimator while prediction retains hard nearest-code assignments. beyond adapting the assignments themselves optst selects an interaction-conditioned prefix to control how much residual detail is exposed to the recommender. experiments on four public datasets show that optst achieves the highest auc among conventional and llm-enhanced baselines. its improvements also persist across different recommendation backbones. these results establish task-aware semantic tokenization as an effective interface between llm-derived profiles and downstream recommendation models.

optst adapts semantic tokenization of llm-derived user profiles to downstream recommendation. a regularized low-rank transformation changes token assignments while keeping the pretrained encoder and base codebooks fixed a straight-through estimator supplies training gradients and an interaction-conditioned prefix selects semantic detail. it reports the highest auc among evaluated conventional and llm-enhanced baselines on four public datasets with gains across backbones. the transferable idea is a task-aware interface between profile semantics and recommendation features.
optst 让大模型用户画像的语义分词随推荐任务调整。它固定预训练编码器和基础码本 用受约束的低秩变换调整 token 分配 训练时通过直通估计器传递梯度 再按当前交互选择保留多少层语义细节。在四个公开数据集和多种推荐骨干上 方法取得优于所比较基线的 auc。它为语义画像与推荐特征之间的任务适配提供了具体接口。
