live-streaming advertising is an important monetization channel on short-video and e-commerce platforms where rapidly changing live content promoted products and user feedback impose strong freshness requirements on recommendation models. existing generative recommenders designed for static domains fail at three levels static semantic ids sid cannot track evolving live ads single-scale behavior modeling misses shifting intent preference optimization conflicts between fresh on-policy feedback and training stability. we propose tagr a generative recommendation framework with temporal adaptation at three levels live-ad tokenization user intent modeling and preference alignment. at the token level live semantic-collaborative id lsid periodically refreshes each active ad's sid based on its current live scene and promoted products while retaining a stable hierarchical token vocabulary for autoregressive generation. at the intent level intent-aware generation iag models live-room entry histories at multiple temporal granularities as the primary intent sequence keeps auxiliary behaviors as separate inputs and weights next-token prediction ntp using post-request intent evidence and business value. at the alignment level intermittent on-policy preference optimization iopo periodically samples fresh candidate groups from the current policy and performs behavior- and value-aligned preference updates interleaved with supervised ntp maintenance to preserve learned behavior distribution. deployed on a large-scale e-commerce live-stream advertising platform tagr improves live-room entry and shopping-cart click rates by 8.5% and 7.4% respectively and achieves a 16.1% revenue lift over the production baseline. these results demonstrate the effectiveness and industrial viability of temporally adaptive generative recommendation for live-stream advertising.

tagr adapts generative recommendation to rapidly changing live-stream ads at three levels refreshed semantic-collaborative item ids multi-timescale user-intent modeling and intermittent on-policy preference optimization interleaved with supervised training. a production deployment reports 8.5% higher live-room entry rate 7.4% higher shopping-cart click rate and 16.1% higher revenue versus its production baseline. the method illustrates how token freshness and optimization cadence can be coordinated in industrial generative recommendation.
tagr 针对直播广告的快速变化 同时调整物品标识、用户意图和训练反馈 定期更新语义协同 id 用多种时间尺度建模意图 并把新策略反馈的偏好优化与监督训练交替执行。线上部署相对原生产基线报告进房率提升 8.5%、购物车点击率提升 7.4%、收入提升 16.1%。可借鉴点是把 token 的更新速度与模型优化节奏一起设计。

recommender systems recsys are increasingly emphasizing scaling leveraging larger architectures and more interaction data to improve personalization. yet despite the optimizer's pivotal role in training modern recsys pipelines almost universally default to adam/adamw with limited scrutiny of whether these choices are truly optimal for recommendation. in this work we revisit optimizer design for scalable recommendation and introduce muonrec the first framework that brings the recently proposed muon optimizer to recsys training. muon performs orthogonalized momentum updates for 2d weight matrices via newton-schulz iteration promoting diverse update directions and improving optimization efficiency. we develop an open-source training recipe for recommendation models and evaluate it across both traditional sequential recommenders and modern generative recommenders. extensive experiments demonstrate that muonrec reduces converged training steps by an average of 32.4% while simultaneously improving final ranking quality. specifically muonrec yields consistent relative gains in ndcg@10 averaging 12.6% across all settings with particularly pronounced improvements in generative recommendation models. these results consistently outperform strong adam/adamw baselines positioning muon as a promising new optimizer standard for recsys training. our code is available.

muonrec studies optimizer choice for sequential and generative recommendation. it applies orthogonalized momentum updates to two-dimensional weight matrices via newton–schulz iteration and provides a recommendation training recipe. across the reported settings it reduces steps to convergence by 32.4% on average while improving ndcg@10 by 12.6% relative to adam/adamw baselines. these are convergence-step and ranking-quality results not equivalent wall-clock speedups they motivate checking optimizer efficiency when scaling recommender training.
muonrec 研究序列推荐和生成式推荐的优化器选择。它通过 newton–schulz 迭代 对二维权重矩阵的动量更新做正交化 并给出推荐训练配方。所报告设置相对 adam/adamw 平均减少 32.4% 的收敛步数 ndcg@10 平均相对提升 12.6%。这些结果衡量收敛步数和排序质量 不能直接换算为训练耗时收益 扩展推荐模型时值得把优化器纳入比较。

collaborative-filtering cf scores provide graded personalized rewards for training large language model llm recommenders through reinforcement learning. however these rewards can cause exposure collapse even though the cf model itself produces diverse top recommendations across users an llm optimized with its rewards concentrates on fewer items. we decompose each score into an item-mean component the item's average cf score across user histories and a residual component the current user's score deviation from the average. through controlled interventions we identify the item-mean component as a contributor to exposure collapse. accordingly we propose two reward corrections per-item centering removes each item's estimated mean score while per-item standardization further rescales the residual using its estimated standard deviation. experiments on two datasets with two identifier schemes show that both corrections substantially improve catalog coverage and exposure evenness. compared with training on the uncorrected cf reward our corrections increase the number of distinct items ranked first across users by up to 9.8× while maintaining comparable ranking accuracy. code is available at https //anonymous.4open.science/r/llm4rec-cf-bias-27ef/.

the study diagnoses exposure collapse when collaborative-filtering scores reward an llm recommender during reinforcement learning. it separates an item s average score across users from its user-specific residual then centers or standardizes the reward per item. controlled experiments on two datasets with two identifier schemes yield up to 9.8 times as many distinct top-ranked items as the uncorrected reward while retaining comparable ranking accuracy. the result offers a concrete reward-design check for generative recommendation rather than a model-scaling law or an industrial deployment result.
这项研究分析了用协同过滤分数奖励大模型推荐器时的曝光集中现象。它把物品跨用户的平均分与当前用户的个性化残差分开 再按物品对奖励做中心化或标准化。在两个数据集、两种物品标识方案的受控实验中 排名首位的不同物品数最高达到未修正奖励时的 9.8 倍 同时保持相近的排序准确性。其借鉴点是检查生成式推荐奖励中与用户无关的分量 论文没有建立模型扩展定律或报告工业部署。

embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. we propose a simple method that prepends trainable dump tokens to the input during embedding model training. the method keeps the model architecture pooling strategy and training loss unchanged while optimizing the added tokens through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. by introducing trainable prefix positions that interact with regular tokens during encoding dump tokens help reduce the influence of residual or uninformative token-level signals on the final retrieval representation. experiments on standard retrieval and long-context benchmarks show that our method consistently improves over finetuned baselines across encoder and decoder embedding models. further analysis shows that dump tokens alter token-level activation and attention patterns associated with low-information tokens. these results suggest that trainable prefix tokens provide a lightweight way to improve retrieval representations.

the method prepends trainable dump tokens during embedding-model training to reduce residual low-information token signals in the final retrieval representation. the backbone pooling and loss remain unchanged the added prefixes learn through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. tests on standard and long-context retrieval benchmarks improve over fine-tuned baselines for both encoder and decoder embedding models. the approach provides a lightweight retrieval-representation intervention rather than a scaling law or a demonstrated recommendation-system gain.
该方法在嵌入模型训练时加入可训练的 dump 前缀 token 减弱低信息量 token 的残余信号对最终检索向量的干扰。骨干结构、池化方式和损失保持不变 前缀通过原有对比检索目标学习。标准检索和长上下文检索实验中 encoder 与 decoder 嵌入模型均优于对应微调基线。它提供了轻量的检索表征修正方法 尚未建立扩展规律或验证推荐系统收益。

looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. by reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. while this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory each loop step still stores its own keys and values so the key-value kv cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. we observe that the kv cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. based on these observations we propose loopvq a kv cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. at 0.5 bits per element loopvq outperforms existing kv cache vector quantization methods for standard llms on general long chain-of-thought reasoning and long-context retrieval tasks with ouro and huginn models. its design is orthogonal to these methods and combined with tasq it retains much of the bf16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. we also implement loopvq in sglang where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32k-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to 4.3× and 6.1× on the 1.4b and 2.6b ouro models compared to the bf16 baseline.

loopvq addresses kv-cache growth in looped transformers by jointly vector-quantizing channels across loop steps and tuning codebooks to match full-precision outputs. on ouro and huginn it outperforms standard-model kv quantizers at 0.5 bits per element combining it with tasq retains much of bf16 accuracy at 0.25 bits. its sglang implementation nearly halves decode latency at 32k context and reports peak throughput gains up to 4.3×/6.1× on ouro 1.4b/2.6b relative to bf16. the design is relevant to the cache costs of recurrent-depth generation but recommendation performance is not evaluated.

loopvq 针对循环 transformer 的 kv 缓存随循环次数增长的问题 跨循环步骤联合向量量化缓存通道 并调整码本以匹配全精度输出。在 ouro 和 huginn 上 它以每元素 0.5 比特优于面向普通模型的 kv 量化方法 与 tasq 结合后 0.25 比特设置仍保留较多 bf16 精度。sglang 实现将 32k 上下文下的解码延迟近乎减半 ouro 1.4b/2.6b 的峰值吞吐最高分别达到 bf16 基线的 4.3/6.1 倍。它可供循环深度生成模型的缓存设计参考 尚未验证推荐任务效果。

looped transformers scale inference-time reasoning by repeatedly reusing a shared core increasing computation without increasing parameter count. serving prefilling and decoding with a uniform loop budget couples their costs. we present loopduet a phase-dependent depth and training-free serving approach that selects the two budgets jointly while preserving decoding depth at prefilling boundaries. our vllm implementation gathers tokens requiring further recurrence into compact batches turning the selected allocation into executable savings with existing weights and attention kernels. at runtime a queue-age controller adjusts prefilling depth to retain quality as demand changes. experiments on the full hotpotqa dataset with one a100-80gb demonstrate two benefits of this flexibility. first separate phase budgets improve the quality--throughput trade-off huginn delivers 19% more throughput than the fastest tested uniform setting meeting the same accuracy criterion while a higher-throughput operating point gains 6.04 em points over uniform depth eight at 97% of its throughput. second the same execution mechanism retains more quality under load on two evaluated olmo arrival traces adaptive prefilling gains 0.92--1.35 em points over the most accurate tested fixed-depth controls at the same 100% attainment of a one-second time-to-first-token target. together these results establish loopduet as a practical way to turn flexible model computation into higher serving capacity and better quality under load.

loopduet independently selects prefill and decode loop budgets for pretrained looped transformers compacts tokens needing further recurrence and adapts prefill depth using queue age. in a vllm evaluation on full hotpotqa with one a100-80gb huginn achieves 19% higher throughput than the fastest tested uniform-depth setting meeting the same accuracy criterion. two tested olmo arrival traces show better answer accuracy while all requests meet a one-second time-to-first-token target. these results concern the reported qa serving settings and motivate but do not validate phase-specific compute allocation for recommendation.

loopduet 为已有循环 transformer 分别选择预填充和解码的循环预算 把仍需循环的 token 压紧成批 并根据队列等待时间调整预填充深度。在单张 a100-80gb、完整 hotpotqa 的 vllm 实验中 huginn 相比满足同一准确率条件的最快已测统一深度设置 吞吐提高 19%。两条已测 olmo 到达流量轨迹中 所有请求满足一秒首 token 延迟目标的同时 答案准确性更高。这些问答服务结果可启发推荐中的分阶段算力分配 不能直接视为推荐收益。

we introduce dory1.0-4b a 4-billion-parameter looped latent-recurrent language model with elastic depth a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. dory1.0-4b is built on a normalized transformer ngpt backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers organized into an input block a shared recurrent block and an output block. at inference the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. we pre-trained dory1.0-4b on 6 trillion tokens. the first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in nvfp4 and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256k tokens. next we post-trained the model using supervised fine-tuning sft and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards rlvr with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. increasing the loop count improves accuracy with the largest gains on coding agentic and long-context benchmarks. with two or more loops dory1.0-4b outperforms larger models such as qwen3.5-9b gemma 4 12b and gemma 4 26b-a4b on average across 12 benchmarks. looping also makes dory1.0-4b more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks with four loops it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. to reduce memory during looping dory1.0-4b caches keys and values only from the last loop keeping its kv-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. we open-source the bf16 mxfp8 nvfp4 and gguf quantized checkpoints.

dory1.0-4b combines a normalized transformer backbone interleaved sliding-window/full attention and a shared recurrent block to vary inference depth from one checkpoint. training uses six trillion tokens followed by supervised and verifiable-reward post-training with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum. more loops improve the reported coding agentic and long-context results. keeping only the final loop s keys and values prevents kv-cache size from growing with loop count while retaining most reported accuracy gains. this supplies an elastic-depth and cache-management design for further study not evidence of recommendation performance.

dory1.0-4b 将 normalized transformer 骨干、交错的滑动窗口/完整注意力和共享循环块结合 使同一检查点适配不同推理深度。模型经过六万亿 token 预训练 再采用监督微调、可验证奖励强化学习和按难度分配循环次数的课程。增加循环改善了论文报告的代码、智能体和长上下文结果 仅保留最后一轮的 kv 使缓存不随循环次数增长 同时保留大部分已报告精度收益。这提供了弹性深度与缓存管理的具体设计 尚无推荐性能证据。

scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models but pre-ln architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution limiting the effective use of deep layers. while cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. we revisit cross-layer kv sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. beyond cache compression each kv reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source kv projections turning kv sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for kv representation geometry. we provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. motivated by this we propose depthgraft a hierarchical kv-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer kv from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. depthgraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers while preserving prefill early completion and reducing kv cache by roughly one third. experiments on dense and moe models from 0.5b to 16b parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both gqa and mla. notably on the 16b moe model depthgraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on mmlu-pro along with gains of 6.6% on cmmlu and 6.4% on c3. these results validate the potential of depthgraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. the project page is available at https //github.com/jianke0604/depthgraft.

depthgraft uses hierarchical cross-layer kv sharing to address depth-wise information dilution in pre-ln models. reconstructing deeper kv from stride-aligned shallow and middle layers creates non-local gradient paths to the source projections while retaining early completion of prefill and reducing the kv cache by roughly one third. experiments on 0.5b–16b dense and moe language models report downstream improvements under gqa and mla. the design links cross-layer representation learning with cache efficiency its benefit to deeper recommendation models remains to be tested.
depthgraft 用分层跨层 kv 共享缓解 pre-ln 模型随深度增加的信息稀释。它从按步距对齐的浅层和中层重建深层 kv 为源投影引入非局部梯度路径 同时保留预填充提前完成能力 并将 kv 缓存减少约三分之一。0.5b–16b 稠密和 moe 语言模型实验在 gqa、mla 设置下均报告下游改进。该设计把跨层表征学习与缓存效率联系起来 是否有利于更深的推荐模型仍需测试。

among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories 280 distinct embedding tables 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints 20/38 contain reachable input embeddings with norms below 10-6 compared with 0% of weight-tied models. such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while adamw weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. in tested transformer configurations non-initial positions or a bos token prevent this failure mode. in gated sequence models mamba gated deltanet xlstm a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude up to 35 . at zero input current-token readout factors silu gates or linear queries vanish suppressing historical-state readout. residual rms values can then fall below the square root of the rmsnorm floor across consecutive layers causing pre-rmsnorm to amplify backward gradients by up to 103 per layer. when a gradient entry exceeds 1.84 × 1019 fp32 global-norm clipping in pytorch hugging face trainer and fsdp2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. in telugu continual pretraining of nemotron-3-nano-4b this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. we propose two remedies. for released checkpoints groupclip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. for pretraining gatefloor silu z + δ δ\in 0.01 0.1 keeps the gate positive at zero input reducing near-zero gradients by 28 orders of magnitude in experiments up to 370m parameters with perplexity comparable to the baseline.

the paper traces a training failure in gated sequence models to near-zero input embeddings vanishing current-token readout can suppress history allowing repeated pre-rmsnorm amplification to produce extreme gradients and overflow fp32 global-norm clipping. groupclip isolates embedding clipping with a 64-bit or rescaled norm gatefloor prevents a zero-valued silu gate at zero input during pretraining. the reported language-model experiments show recovery of discarded updates and reduced gradient amplification. these checks may inform long-sequence model training but the failure and remedies have not been demonstrated in recommender systems.

论文追踪了门控序列模型的一类训练故障 接近零的输入嵌入使当前 token 的读出因子消失 削弱历史状态读出 随后连续 pre-rmsnorm 放大梯度 最终可能让 fp32 全局梯度范数裁剪溢出并丢弃整批更新。groupclip 将嵌入梯度单独裁剪 采用 64 位或重缩放范数 gatefloor 则在预训练时避免 silu 门在零输入处取零。语言模型实验报告恢复被丢弃的更新并减弱梯度放大。这些检查可供长序列模型训练参考 但尚未在推荐系统中验证。

linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models replacing the growing kv cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. however the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax transformers whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. in our analysis we differentiate between two targets. first extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. in controlled 1.3b parameter models we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. second intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from kv cache quantization. we instantiate our findings as lores a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. across qwen-3.5 9b nemotron-h 8b and kimi-linear 48b-a3b lores supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. we implement lores in vllm and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.

this study separates recurrent-model quantization into weights/activations outside the state and the repeatedly updated decode state. controlled 1.3b models show weaker residual outlier channels with decayed recurrences than with softmax attention. its lores pipeline groups scales along the value axis protects slowly decaying heads or channels with mixed precision and uses stochastic rounding to limit repeated-quantization error. experiments on qwen-3.5 9b nemotron-h 8b and kimi-linear 48b-a3b support robust 8-bit states with lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons and end-to-end vllm speedups. recommendation deployment remains to be tested.

论文把循环模型量化分为两部分 状态之外的权重与激活 以及解码时不断更新的循环状态。受控的 1.3b 模型比较显示 带衰减的循环结构比 softmax 注意力产生更弱的残差异常通道。lores 沿 value 轴分组设置尺度 为慢衰减头或通道保留较高精度 并用随机舍入限制反复量化的误差累积。在 qwen-3.5 9b、nemotron-h 8b 和 kimi-linear 48b-a3b 上 8 位状态较稳健 较短解码范围可使用更低有效精度 vllm 实现也报告端到端加速。其推荐部署效果仍需验证。

post-training quantization ptq reduces large language model llm deployment costs but preserving quality requires accounting for uneven weight sensitivity. uniform ptq uses one weight bit-width importance-aware ptq adjusts scales or reconstructs weights within that width and column-wise mixed precision retains selected columns at higher precision. however sensitivity varies within columns so whole-column retention also protects less sensitive weights while runtime outlier detection adds decoding overhead. we therefore introduce tilequant a training-free framework that assigns precision to hardware-aligned 2d weight tiles. offline calibration provides input-activation-aware scoring from forward statistics for lower calibration cost and gradient-informed scoring from loss sensitivity for stronger quality preservation. within each projection's retention budget the highest-scoring tiles remain at 16-bit and the rest use 8-bit. the resulting map guides reconstruction into compact weight buffers which the kernel reuses for native integer and 16-bit computation with local accumulation to reduce memory traffic. experiments show that tilequant reaches 2.66x the original model's generation throughput. across language modeling reasoning long-context retrieval and question answering it preserves quality and surpasses quantized and original models on multiple tasks. these results support selecting precision units that capture local sensitivity while enabling efficient hardware execution. the implementation is https //github.com/hanzhizhang-ulrica/tilequant

tilequant allocates post-training precision to hardware-aligned 2d weight tiles rather than whole columns. offline activation- or gradient-based sensitivity scoring selects tiles to retain at 16-bit while the remaining tiles use 8-bit. compact buffers and a mixed integer/16-bit kernel reduce memory traffic without runtime outlier detection. in the reported llama-3.2-3b test on an a100-40gb with batch size one generation throughput reaches 2.66× the original model separate evaluations cover language modeling reasoning retrieval and qa quality. its contribution is the joint choice of sensitivity granularity and execution layout gains for recommendation models are untested.

tilequant 以硬件对齐的二维权重 tile 分配后训练量化精度 避免为了少量敏感权重而整列保留高精度。离线校准根据激活统计或梯度敏感度选择保留 16 位的 tile 其余使用 8 位 再通过紧凑缓冲区和整数/16 位混合内核减少访存 无需运行时检测异常值。llama-3.2-3b 在 a100-40gb、批大小为一的测试中 生成吞吐达到原模型的 2.66 倍 质量评估另覆盖语言建模、推理、检索和问答。其借鉴点是联合设计敏感度粒度与执行布局 推荐模型收益尚待验证。

reinforcement learning rl post-training increasingly targets low-bit deployment with nvfp4 weight-and activation quantization w4a4 becoming the state-of-the-practice format. however integrating nvfp4 into rl degrades rollout quality and amplifies cross-engine training-inference mismatch tim destabilizing training. we show that these failures are concentrated rather than uniform - severely mismatched tail tokens concentrate in a few outlier sequences while policy weights remain largely intact and quantization error concentrates in a few high-variance activation channels. guided by this we present foursight an algorithm-system co-design with two targeted solutions tim-aware sequence filtering that excludes drifted trajectories from policy updates and sparse precision compensation that keeps only top-variance channels in bf16 while retaining native nvfp4 elsewhere. we further design a fused splicegemm kernel with specialized prefill and decode datapaths to minimize overhead. foursight sustains near-bf16 accuracy and strong fp4 deployment quality across models and engines while improving step-to-accuracy by 1.76-2.60x and staying within 2.3% of fp4 step time up to 120b-scale models.

foursight targets concentrated errors in nvfp4 w4a4 reinforcement-learning post-training it filters trajectories with severe training–inference mismatch and retains high-variance activation channels in bf16 while using native fp4 elsewhere. its fused splicegemm kernel separates prefill and decode paths. reported quality evaluations retain near-bf16 accuracy system evaluations extend to 120b-scale models with at most 2.3% additional step-time overhead over the uncompensated fp4 baseline. the approach offers a concrete way to investigate low-bit training mismatch its effectiveness in generative recommendation remains untested.

foursight 针对 nvfp4 w4a4 强化学习后训练中的集中误差 过滤训练与推理不一致严重的轨迹 把高方差激活通道保留为 bf16 其余使用原生 fp4 融合的 splicegemm 内核分别优化预填充与解码。质量评估报告接近 bf16 的准确性 系统评估覆盖最高至 120b 规模的模型 相对未补偿的 fp4 基线 单步耗时的额外开销不超过 2.3%。它为排查低比特训练不一致提供了具体方案 生成式推荐效果仍需验证。

generative recommendation has shown considerable potential in industrial recommendation systems. however the performance of existing generative methods is limited by several challenges. 1 semantic ids sids are treated as one-dimensional sequences overlooking the hierarchical dependencies among different layers. 2 next-token prediction used is unable to explicitly optimize session-wise recommendation. 3 although reinforcement learning has been applied to align generated recommendations with user preferences few existing methods explicitly optimize the ranking of positive items in session-wise recommendation. to address the above issues we propose redmall a generative recommender designed for large-scale e-commerce. firstly redmall constructs hierarchical sids through residual quantization over multimodal representations. secondly redmall introduces a lightweight sid encoder to explicitly model layer-wise dependencies in sids. moreover redmall incorporates sparse mixture-of-experts dual gated attention and multi-target prediction to scale model size enhance user interest representation and optimize session-wise recommendation. we further design an exposure-aware loss that treats exposed but unclicked items as negative feedback. to better align user preferences and list-wise ranking objectives we combine group relative policy optimization with an auxiliary lambdarank loss using both real user feedback and item ranking to guide optimization. experiments on four public datasets-amazon beauty amazon toys amazon food and movielens-1m---show that redmall outperforms the evaluated baselines across all reported recall and ndcg metrics. online a/b tests show improvements of 2.24% in advertiser value advv and 0.59% in click-through rate ctr for e-commerce advertising as well as gains of 1.08% in gmv and 0.95% in daily active buyers dab for e-commerce recommendations.

redmall combines hierarchical semantic ids with a lightweight id encoder sparse experts dual gated attention and multi-target prediction for large-scale e-commerce recommendation. exposure-aware training uses unclicked impressions as negative feedback group-relative policy optimization and an auxiliary lambdarank loss align generated lists with user feedback and item order. it outperforms the evaluated baselines on four public datasets. online tests report 2.24% higher advertiser value and 0.59% higher ctr for advertising plus 1.08% higher gmv for recommendations. it provides a concrete architecture and training recipe for scaling generative recommendation these gains belong to the reported deployment settings.

redmall 用分层语义 id 表示商品 再结合轻量 id 编码器、稀疏专家、双门控注意力和多目标预测扩展电商推荐。训练把曝光未点击作为负反馈 并结合组相对策略优化与 lambdarank 损失 让生成结果兼顾用户反馈和列表顺序。四个公开数据集上优于所比较基线 线上广告实验报告广告主价值提升 2.24%、ctr 提升 0.59% 推荐场景 gmv 提升 1.08%。它提供了生成式推荐扩模的架构与训练方案 收益限于论文所测部署条件。

large language models llms are attractive rerankers for recommendation. running an expensive model on every request is costly and for users with sparse interaction histories it often lowers quality. we present cascaderec a two-tier llm reranking cascade deployed in production at a large financial planning and analysis fp&a saas provider. it serves content recommendations to enterprise tenants on aws eks and gke. a lightweight tier-1 model reranks every request. a router escalates only the requests where extra inference-time compute is likely to help and sends them to a more expensive tier-2 procedure self-consistency sampling multi-path reasoning or a larger model . the system has run in a production a/b experiment for over a month. compared with uniform use of the expensive tier cascaderec has reduced inference cost by about 10% with minimal latency impact and no quality regression observed to date. tenant data cannot be released so we also evaluate the pipeline on public benchmarks movielens-1m and amazon-electronics . segment-level analysis with paired-bootstrap confidence intervals shows that uniform llm reranking lowers ndcg@10 for sparse-history users by up to 30% and its only statistically significant gain appears on the segment with the longest histories. escalating cold users can make the loss larger instead of repairing it. which segments benefit from escalation depends on the domain and this motivates the segment-gated rollout we use in production. we describe the deployment architecture the measured benefits and lessons learned including inter-tenant load imbalance as a driver for cascading and the handling of llm output-parsing failures at the serving layer.

cascaderec runs a lightweight llm reranker on every request and routes only promising requests to a more expensive model or reasoning procedure. a production a/b experiment lasting over a month reports about 10% lower inference cost than uniformly using the expensive tier with minimal latency impact and no observed quality regression so far. public movielens and amazon experiments show that extra llm computation can instead harm sparse-history users. the practical lesson for ranking compute allocation is to measure benefit by user segment and domain before escalation rather than treating more inference as uniformly helpful.
cascaderec 先用轻量大模型重排所有请求 只把预计能受益的请求交给更贵的模型或推理过程。持续一个多月的生产 a/b 实验中 相比统一使用昂贵层 推理成本约降 10% 延迟变化较小 暂未观察到质量退化。movielens 和 amazon 实验则发现 额外的大模型计算可能伤害历史稀疏用户。它为排序计算分配提供了具体做法 先按用户群和业务验证收益 再决定哪些请求值得升级推理。

search and recommendation at shopify require retrieving relevant products from a changing catalog of billions of products under strict latency constraints. we present sid-llm which casts both tasks as generating semantic ids short sequences of content-derived tokens representing products. we jointly pre-train sid-llm on catalog and behavioral data giving search and recommendation a shared representation and training objective. we show that reinforcement learning further improves judged search relevance. furthermore distillation from task-specific experts improves recommendation quality over joint supervised fine-tuning without a statistically detected loss in search quality. finally for efficient serving we pair multi-token prediction with a lightweight ranker improving retrieval quality over our autoregressive baseline while reducing latency. we evaluate sid-llm both as a standalone retriever and as a component of shopify's production search and recommendation systems. as a standalone search system sid-llm achieves quality comparable to shopify's existing multi-model search stack while meeting production latency requirements. integrating sid-llm into the search and recommendation stacks provides significant gains in both offline evaluations and online a/b tests. together these results demonstrate the practical value of semantic-id generation as a unified approach to product discovery at scale.

sid-llm unifies product search and recommendation as generation of short content-derived semantic ids over a changing catalog of billions of products. joint catalog-and-behavior pretraining supplies a shared representation reinforcement learning improves judged search relevance while task-expert distillation improves recommendation without a statistically detected search-quality loss. multi-token prediction with a lightweight ranker improves retrieval quality and latency over the autoregressive baseline. standalone search quality is comparable to the existing multi-model stack production integration reports offline and online gains. it offers an industrial example of sharing a generative backbone while addressing task interference and serving cost.

sid-llm 把搜索与推荐统一为生成商品语义 id 服务不断变化的数十亿商品目录。商品内容与行为数据联合预训练提供共享表示 强化学习改善搜索相关性 任务专家蒸馏提升推荐质量 且未检测到搜索质量的显著下降。服务端结合多 token 预测和轻量排序器 相比逐 token 生成基线改善检索质量与延迟。独立搜索质量接近现有多模型方案 接入生产系统后报告离线和线上收益 可借鉴其共享骨干、处理任务干扰并控制服务成本的做法。

generative recommendation aims to predict item identifiers from user interaction histories but explicit control over the properties of recommended items remains underexplored. a key challenge is to connect human-readable concepts to internal features whose interventions effectively change the recommended items. to address this we propose steerable generative recommender steergr a framework that uses sparse autoencoders for concept-level control in game discovery. steergr proceeds through three stages i concept definition and grounding for defining play concepts with an llm ii feature discovery and selection for discovering candidate features by their concept associations and selecting one by its steering effect and iii sparse feature intervention for amplifying or suppressing selected features to steer recommendations without retraining the recommender. extensive experiments with two industrial generative recommendation models on a real-world game dataset show that the selected features successfully steer recommendations toward or away from target concepts. we believe this work takes a first step to extend sae-based steering from llms to industrial generative recommendation.

steergr makes generative game recommendations controllable through sparse-autoencoder features. it first grounds human-readable play concepts then finds associated internal features and selects them by their measured steering effect. amplifying or suppressing selected features changes recommendations without retraining the recommender. experiments use two industrial generative models on a real game dataset and show movement toward or away from target concepts. this adds a concept-level control interface to a shared recommendation model it does not establish a scaling law or an online business lift.
steergr 用稀疏自编码器特征控制生成式游戏推荐。它先把可读的游戏概念与内容对应起来 再寻找相关内部特征 按实际引导效果选择干预对象 放大或抑制这些特征即可改变推荐 无需重新训练推荐模型。两个工业生成模型在真实游戏数据上的实验表明 推荐结果可以朝目标概念靠近或远离。可借鉴点是给共享推荐模型增加概念级控制接口 论文未建立扩展规律 也未证明线上业务收益。

latent reasoning in generative recommendation faces two practical barriers constructing teacher-generated chain-of-thought cot supervision is costly and recurrent hidden-state feedback requires a specialized execution loop. we revisit both the supervision source and the computation interface. a step-level diagnosis measures how recommendation cot supports next-item prediction and trace coherence. in the analyzed traces history analysis is the only step with positive mean contributions on both dimensions while later preference and intent steps have negative mean answer contributions. guided by this finding we propose phit prefilled history-informed thought tokens which learns intermediate states from semantic targets extracted directly from observed item histories. phit aggregates cached sparse item encodings to construct these targets and supervises the contextual states of distinct vocabulary thought tokens. all thought tokens are supplied together as ordinary input ids during a single causal prefill removing the need for recurrent final-state feedback. with supervised fine-tuning alone phit outperforms the compared baselines across four recommendation benchmarks. controlled ablations support the value of input-matched semantic supervision while cost measurements show fast target construction with training time comparable to the recommendation-only thought-token baseline.

phit reduces two costs of latent reasoning for recommendation teacher-generated chain-of-thought supervision and recurrent hidden-state feedback. it derives semantic targets directly from cached sparse item encodings in observed histories then supervises distinct thought-token states. all thought tokens enter a single causal prefill as ordinary input ids. supervised fine-tuning outperforms the compared baselines on four recommendation benchmarks with training time comparable to the recommendation-only thought-token baseline. the useful design choice is to align intermediate supervision with available history while retaining a conventional inference interface.
phit 针对推荐隐式推理的两项开销 生成教师思维链 以及循环回传隐藏状态。它直接聚合用户历史中缓存的稀疏商品编码 构造语义监督目标 不同思考 token 一次性作为普通输入进入因果预填充。仅用监督微调便在四个推荐基准上优于所比较方法 训练时间与只做推荐训练的思考 token 基线相近。它把中间监督对齐到已有历史信息 同时保留常规推理接口 可供低成本推理增强推荐参考。

multi-vector retrieval represents each query and document as a set of embeddings and scores relevance via fine-grained set-to-set interactions such as maxsim chamfer similarity . this expressiveness improves retrieval quality over single-vector representations but makes search substantially more expensive. existing systems address this challenge primarily through proxy representations or filter-and-rerank pipelines that reduce candidate generation to single-vector search. we study the complementary direction of building a native ivf-style index directly over multi-vector data. we introduce mv-ivf an inverted-file index for multi-vector retrieval built on mv-lloyd a new lloyd-style algorithm for clustering point clouds under a chamfer objective. our key observation is that once point clouds are assigned to clusters the center-update step reduces to standard single-vector clustering over the flattened embeddings in each cluster. this enables efficient construction of a hierarchical ivf tree with center point clouds at internal nodes. at query time mv-ivf performs best-first beam search over the tree to identify promising leaf clusters then scores the documents in those leaves. we further accelerate search using low-bit quantization query compression and cache-efficient batched search. we implement mv-ivf in mvsic an optimized c++ library and unified evaluation framework for multi-vector retrieval that includes several major approaches. across beir and lotte text retrieval benchmarks mv-ivf achieves strong latency--recall tradeoffs the best batched throughput frontiers and favorable build-time and index-size profiles. at 90% recall-10@10 mv-ivf achieves up to 8.03× lower single-query latency and up to 173.5× higher qps than the baselines demonstrating that native ivf-style indexing is practical and effective for scalable multi-vector retrieval.

mv-ivf builds an inverted-file index directly over multi-vector representations. its mv-lloyd clustering turns center updates into ordinary clustering over flattened embeddings producing a hierarchical tree of point-cloud centers. search traverses promising leaves with low-bit quantization query compression and cache-efficient batching reducing cost. on beir and lotte the reported comparisons show strong latency–recall and batched-throughput tradeoffs. the transferable idea is to index the multi-vector scoring structure itself rather than only using a single-vector proxy benefits for recommendation retrieval require separate validation.
mv-ivf 直接为多向量表示建立倒排索引。mv-lloyd 聚类把中心更新转成对展开后的向量做普通聚类 从而构建以向量集合为中心的层次树 查询优先访问有希望的叶节点 再配合低比特量化、查询压缩和批量访问减少开销。beir 与 lotte 实验报告较好的延迟—召回率和吞吐权衡。它为多兴趣、多向量召回提供了直接索引思路 但推荐场景收益仍需单独验证。

unified search and recommendation systems may update the same item vectors from both interaction streams. we study how repeated updates can increase an item vector's norm and affect retrieval under an unnormalized dot product. a cosine-only loss makes the output gradient perpendicular to the current item vector - tangent to its constant-norm sphere. training changes encoder parameters however so the realized item-vector movement need not remain tangent. we derive sufficient conditions under which it does every nonzero update then increases squared norm by its squared length. when the tasks share an item encoder sequential updates from both can accumulate in the same norm which raw-inner-product serving can expose for either task. this conditional result is not a theorem about joint sgd. controlled ablations test these conditions. on movielens 32m and amazon books accumulated tangent movement accompanies frequency-norm association and additional head-item exposure under raw-dot rather than normalized-item ranking. in a nonlinear tower combining a per-item id vector with a shared content encoding active item movement remains near-tangent. we separate its norm change into the id-update contribution and other output changes then use a matched training intervention that removes immediate norm growth caused by the id-row update. the intervention reduces norm-related exposure but also recommendation utility so it is diagnostic rather than a proposed mitigation. our logs are recommendation-only the formulation supplies a shared-representation audit while prevalence in joint traffic remains open.

this study identifies conditions under which cosine-loss updates increase item-vector norms and alter raw-dot-product retrieval exposure. it distinguishes output gradients from actual encoder-induced vector movement so the result is conditional rather than a general theorem about joint sgd. movielens 32m and amazon books ablations connect near-tangent movement popularity-related norm growth and additional head-item exposure. removing one norm-growth component also reduces recommendation utility. the work provides a diagnostic for shared search/recommendation representations not a proven mitigation experiments are recommendation-only leaving joint-traffic prevalence open.

论文分析余弦损失更新在什么条件下会增大商品向量范数 并影响原始内积召回的曝光。它区分输出梯度与编码器实际造成的向量移动 因此结论有明确条件 不能推广为联合 sgd 的一般定理。movielens 32m 与 amazon books 消融把近切向移动、热门商品范数增长和头部曝光联系起来 去掉一部分范数增长也降低了推荐效用。它提供共享搜索与推荐表示的诊断方法 而非已验证的修复方案 实验仅含推荐日志。

learned sparse embeddings are a powerful alternative to dense retrieval yet they have fallen behind single-vector and late interaction models. one reason for their limited adoption is that they are notoriously difficult to train generally requiring very tight conditions to converge. we present a recipe for training splade-like encoders on modern backbones and data that achieves a better efficiency-effectiveness trade-off. we discuss the role of logit distribution and its impact on the training stability and the final sparsity of the encoder. we also introduce a new per-position fan-out control - a hard cap on how many vocabulary dimensions each position may emit. we further apply a simple vocabulary merging strategy that removes redundant entries - such as case and word-boundary variants of the same word - which are common in cased bpe-based backbones. we apply our recipe to the lateon backbone and training data obtaining sparseup a sparse encoder that reaches 56.4 average ndcg@10 on beir-13 the highest we know of among public vocabulary-based sparse encoders below 150m parameters.

sparseup develops a training recipe for vocabulary-based sparse retrievers on modern backbones. it studies how logit distributions affect convergence and sparsity caps the number of vocabulary dimensions emitted at each position and merges redundant vocabulary variants. applied to the lateon backbone and training data it reports 56.4 average ndcg@10 on beir-13 for an encoder below 150m parameters. for scalable retrieval the useful connection is between stable training explicit emission sparsity and index cost the reported evidence concerns text retrieval rather than recommendation ranking.
sparseup 改进现代骨干上的词表稀疏检索训练 分析 logit 分布对收敛和稀疏度的影响 限制每个位置能激活的词表维度数 并合并大小写、词边界等冗余词项。应用于 lateon 骨干与训练数据后 低于 150m 参数的编码器在 beir-13 上达到平均 56.4 ndcg@10。可借鉴点是把训练稳定性、显式稀疏约束与索引成本一起设计 现有证据来自文本检索 尚非推荐排序实验。

recommendation systems often enter a new serving window before enough outcomes are available to retrain the deployed model. we study this regime with 0.05-1.0% target feedback a range that spans our stress tests while keeping supervision far below the degrees of freedom of the source recommender. at this scale existing fine-tuning and meta-learning methods still estimate target-specific updates from extremely sparse feedback leaving the update direction weakly identified. sage-pair instead transfers a source-supported residual correction space and only calibrates this space using target outcomes. we introduce sage-pair a staged adapter that pretrains a low-dimensional global residual on an adjacent source period and adds a soft router over residual experts conditioned on source user profiles. target feedback then calibrates this residual state rather than relearning the recommender. on a locked test split of kuaisar-v2 sage-pair full achieves a 1.77% relative improvement in ndcg@10 while a core-protocol comparison shows a further 0.25% gain from routed experts beyond source-pretrained pair. matched source-pretrained lora and adapter-tuning baselines remain near the source model supporting the need for a different adaptation space. thus sage-pair improves ranking quality with millisecond-scale adaptation and inference costs. sparse-feedback adaptation is fundamentally governed by the identifiability of the update space rather than by label count alone. source pretraining supplies estimable correction directions for scarce labels while user-conditioned routing contributes a consistent differentiated cross-user correction on top of the global correction. our code is available at this https url.

sage-pair adapts a recommender to a new serving window with only 0.05–1.0% target feedback. it pretrains a low-dimensional residual correction on an adjacent source period and adds user-conditioned routing over residual experts scarce target outcomes calibrate this existing correction space. on a locked kuaisar-v2 test split the full method reports a 1.77% relative ndcg@10 gain over target-only pair. a separate core-protocol comparison isolates a further 0.25% gain from routed experts. it suggests reducing adaptation degrees of freedom before spending scarce labels with evidence limited to the evaluated protocol.

sage-pair 面向新服务时段只有 0.05%–1.0% 目标反馈的推荐适配。它先在相邻源时段预训练低维残差修正 再按用户特征路由到残差专家 少量目标反馈只校准已有修正空间。在固定的 kuaisar-v2 测试集上 完整方法相对仅用目标数据的 pair ndcg@10 提升 1.77% 另一套核心协议对比中 专家路由比源预训练 pair 再提升 0.25%。其启发是先限制适配自由度 再使用稀缺反馈 结论限于所测协议。

attention is a major scalability bottleneck in large language models llms with its computational cost and key-value kv memory traffic becoming increasingly prohibitive as context length grows. sparse attention addresses this bottleneck by restricting each query to a subset of the context but its effectiveness hinges on identifying relevant regions both cheaply and reliably. existing training-free methods primarily rely on runtime relevance estimates with selection dimensionality and granularity typically governed by fixed heuristics rather than the intrinsic interaction structure of pretrained attention heads. we take a different perspective the query-key operator of each pretrained head defines a characteristic response structure that determines the resolution needed for sparse selection both across feature directions and across context tokens. building on this insight we propose head-adaptive sparse attention hasa a training-free sparse attention framework that jointly adapts selection resolution along these two dimensions. along the feature dimension the singular spectrum of each head's query-key operator determines an effective rank yielding a compact head-specific response space. along the sequence dimension neighboring regions are progressively merged according to the directional coherence of their token responses in this same space while heterogeneous regions remain separate. exact attention is then computed using the original full-dimensional kv states of the selected regions. hasa captures 88.1% of dense-attention mass and compared with unique a strong recent sparse-attention baseline improves accuracy by up to 3.47 and 2.57 points on ruler and longbench-pro respectively and accelerates self-attention by up to 1.32x while achieving up to 14.07x speedup over dense attention.

hasa makes training-free sparse attention selection depend on each pretrained head s query-key interaction structure. the operator s singular spectrum determines a compact response space while neighboring sequence regions are merged according to response coherence. attention then uses the original full-dimensional keys and values for selected regions. the paper reports improved long-context benchmark accuracy and attention speed relative to a recent sparse baseline. its practical contribution is joint control of feature-space selection cost and sequence granularity rather than a fixed token-selection heuristic. applying this design to long user histories or ranking models still requires recommendation-specific evaluation.
hasa 根据预训练注意力头的查询—键交互结构选择稀疏计算范围 用算子的奇异值谱确定紧凑响应空间 再按响应方向的一致性合并相邻序列区域 最终仍用选中区域的完整键值计算注意力。论文在长上下文基准上报告了相对近期稀疏方法的精度与注意力加速收益。主要价值是同时调整特征选择维度和序列粒度 减少固定选择规则的局限。能否用于长行为序列或排序模型 仍需推荐实验验证。

quantization-aware training qat is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models llms but training with adamw keeps two dense fp32 states for every weight matrix. we find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as galore and ldadam degrade substantially in qat. a considerable part of the qat momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. we further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. based on these observations we propose resqadam. it keeps a single bf16 momentum applies adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. we evaluate resqadam with two from-scratch qat methods and three qat fine-tuning pipelines with weights quantized down to 2 bits. it reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to adamw stays close to adamw in most settings and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.

resqadam targets the optimizer-state cost of quantization-aware training. it retains one bf16 momentum tensor applies adam updates within a low-dimensional principal subspace and preserves information outside that subspace through a normalized residual-sign update. this addresses the loss of useful momentum caused by repeatedly discarding low-rank projection residuals. across from-scratch and fine-tuning qat pipelines including weights down to two bits the authors report 71–74% lower optimizer-state memory than adamw with less than 2% training-throughput reduction. the memory accounting excludes embeddings and the output head these are optimizer-state savings not total training-memory savings. benefits for large recommendation models remain untested.

resqadam 面向量化感知训练的优化器显存开销 保留一份 bf16 动量 在低维主子空间内执行 adam 更新 并用归一化残差符号补回投影外的信息 避免低秩方法反复丢弃有效动量。论文覆盖从头训练和微调式量化 最低至二比特权重 报告相对 adamw 减少 71%–74% 的优化器状态显存 训练吞吐下降低于 2%。显存统计不含嵌入与输出头 该数字不等于总训练显存降幅 大规模推荐模型上的收益仍待验证。

we show that the transformer's recurrent successors --- such as selective state-space models ssms receptance weighted key value rwkv and retentive network retnet --- can be characterized as infinite-impulse-response iir systems. the zero--pole geometries of these iir systems characterize the temporal modes they can represent. however to trade parallelism the algebraic structures of the parameterizations of these recurrent systems often give rise to poles constrained to the real axis thereby inducing an architectural bias in their recurrent dynamics. to unify these recurrent architectures and eliminate their pole geometry bias inspired by the lattice--ladder realization of general iir systems we present mira modal iir recurrent architecture a unified family of linear-time recurrent architectures for building large language models llms with a highly parallel algebraic structure. each mira block realizes a higher-order iir system that represents temporal modes from token streams through a lattice--ladder structure followed by a feed-forward network ffn . this realization enables the model to represent the temporal modes associated with both real and complex-conjugate poles. we pretrain mira-s a 12-layer small-scale llm with 0.14b parameters composed entirely of mira blocks. throughout the pretraining mira-s achieves lower perplexity than strong recurrent baselines exhibits stronger context-window generalization beyond the training length and attains higher throughput with a dedicated cuda kernel.

mira approaches recurrent language modeling as an infinite-impulse-response system. its lattice–ladder realization supports temporal modes associated with both real and complex-conjugate poles avoiding the real-axis restriction of several recurrent parameterizations while retaining linear-time sequence processing and parallel computation. the authors pretrain a 12-layer 0.14b-parameter mira-s model and report lower perplexity better context-length generalization and higher throughput than recurrent baselines with a dedicated cuda kernel. this suggests an alternative sequence-mixing design for long behavioral histories but the evidence is small-scale language modeling rather than industrial recommendation or large-model scaling.

mira 将循环语言模型视为无限冲激响应系统 用格型—梯形结构同时表达实极点和复共轭极点对应的时间模式 缓解部分循环参数化只能覆盖实轴极点的限制 并保留线性时间处理与并行计算能力。论文预训练了 12 层、0.14b 参数的 mira-s 报告困惑度、上下文长度外推及专用 cuda 内核吞吐优于循环基线。它为长行为序列提供了另一种混合结构 但证据仍限于小规模语言模型 尚未验证工业推荐或更大模型扩展。

large-language-model decode attention streams the key-value kv cache for every generated token. packing that cache into 2-bit or 4-bit quantized integers reduces memory traffic but does not automatically translate into latency saving. existing 2-bit fused kernels reach under 31%/15% of peak hbm throughput on h100/b200. converting each value and applying its scale and offset before feeding tensor cores is a major bottleneck because instruction-issue throughput is scarce on modern gpus. instead of applying scale and offset to each kv value foscar uses affine folding to apply them to the other operand or the output of decode-attention matrix products depending on the quantization scheme token-wise or channel-wise . this reduces scale-and-offset operations by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving the dequantized attention output in exact arithmetic. foscar also uses bit manipulation to feed kv operands to tensor cores efficiently requiring only 1 and 0.19 alu instructions per int2 element on h100 and b200 respectively. finally foscar builds warp-specialized gpu pipelines for hopper h100 and blackwell b200 using wgmma and tcgen05. on h100 foscar int2 and int4 kernels achieve geo-mean speedups of 3.36× and 2.83× over flashinfer bf16 and 2.03× and 1.71× over tensorrt-llm fp8. on b200 the corresponding int2 and int4 speedups are 2.67× and 2.30× over flashinfer bf16 1.48× and 1.28× over tensorrt-llm fp8 and 1.16× and 1.00× over tensorrt-llm nvfp4. we integrate foscar into sglang to benchmark serving efficiency. on long-context serving workloads foscar increases peak aggregate throughput by up to 170% and 341% over 2-bit and 16-bit baselines respectively. we open-source foscar as a kernel library at this https url.

foscar accelerates decode attention over two- and four-bit kv caches by moving quantization scales and offsets into the other matrix operand or the output rather than dequantizing each element separately. this affine folding reduces instruction overhead while preserving the dequantized result in exact arithmetic. hardware-specific pipelines target hopper and blackwell gpus and an sglang integration evaluates long-context serving. the distinction between kernel speed and end-to-end throughput matters when interpreting its gains. the technique is relevant to bandwidth-limited generative recommendation serving but recommendation-specific quantization quality and serving performance remain untested.
foscar 针对二比特、四比特 kv 缓存解码 把量化尺度和偏移折叠到矩阵乘法的另一操作数或输出 减少逐元素反量化的指令开销 在精确算术下保持反量化后的计算结果。实现分别优化 hopper、blackwell 流水线 并接入 sglang 测试长上下文服务。评估时应区分内核加速与端到端吞吐。它对带宽受限的生成式推荐服务有参考价值 但现有实验没有验证推荐负载的速度或低比特质量。

the key-value kv cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context llm serving. while 4-bit microscaling formats nvfp4 mxfp4 shrink the cache and run attention on fp4 tensor cores a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration existing fp4 kv systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. we present bitdecoding-fp4 an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native fp4 kv decoding. we mitigate three error sources dual-residual query quantization splits queries into two fp4 tensors cutting query logit error from 60% to 1% underflow-aware probability scaling prevents e4m3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero and outlier-aware key quantization combines static smoothing hadamard rotation and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. at the system level we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query mma on paged kv caches. across dense and moe models with gqa and mla bitdecoding-fp4 stays within 0.5 points of bf16 kv accuracy with nvfp4 1 point with mxfp4 and tracks bf16 kv in rl training rollouts. in end-to-end serving on nvidia b300 with qwen3-4b and qwen3-30b-a3b it delivers 2.4-3.0× higher peak serving throughput than bf16 kv. the implementation is available at this https url.

bitdecoding-fp4 co-designs quantization and gpu kernels for native fp4 kv-cache decoding. it separates queries into two fp4 residual components rescales attention probabilities to avoid underflow and suppresses key outliers through smoothing rotation and scale search. a fused transposed-softmax implementation supports paged caches. the paper evaluates dense and moe models with gqa and mla and reports close-to-bf16 quality b300 serving experiments on two qwen3 models show higher peak throughput. these hardware- and workload-specific results suggest techniques for low-bit generative recommendation but do not demonstrate recommendation accuracy or serving gains.

bitdecoding-fp4 联合设计量化方法与 gpu 内核 把查询拆成两份 fp4 残差 缩放注意力概率以避免下溢 并结合平滑、旋转和尺度搜索处理键向量离群值 融合的转置 softmax 支持分页缓存。论文覆盖采用 gqa、mla 的稠密和 moe 模型 报告接近 bf16 的质量 并在 b300 上用两款 qwen3 模型验证峰值服务吞吐提升。这些结果受硬件与负载条件约束 生成式推荐的准确率及服务收益尚待验证。

private personalised language models must run on local consumer devices where large frontier models cannot fit and retaining long contexts is non-trivial. sequential memory---the key-value kv cache---grows linearly with context length quickly dwarfing the model itself for qwen3-1.7b-base 200 000 retained entries require 21 gib 6.6 times more than the model weights. yet the kv-cache compression methods we measured fail beyond moderate compression ratios. we introduce transformer-fsq addressing extreme kv-cache compression by replacing standard key and value projections with a finite scalar quantisation bottleneck. our cache stores a packed vector of discrete integer codes per token with no per-token quantisation metadata. converting a pretrained transformer trains only these projections on 0.25 tokens per original parameter. we evaluate transformer-fsq against five baseline families on models from 0.6b to 8b parameters. on long-context retrieval ruler from 12× to 97.5× transformer-fsq is the most accurate method we evaluate across scales. a fused triton kernel decodes directly from the integer codes with baselines given their authors' kernels where available it decodes at 1.01× 95% interval 0.98--1.05 the throughput of native sdpa attention on the uncompressed qwen3-8b-base at 32× and 1.54× at 97.5×. extreme kv-cache compression is therefore a practical way to extend how much context a fixed device can hold.

transformer-fsq replaces standard key and value projections with a finite-scalar-quantization bottleneck. each cached token is stored as packed integer codes without per-token quantization metadata and adapting a pretrained model trains only those projections. a fused triton kernel consumes the compressed codes directly. experiments across 0.6b–8b language models examine extreme compression and long-context retrieval with strong accuracy relative to evaluated compression baselines. the contribution is extending retained context under a fixed memory budget not uniformly accelerating every configuration. applying the approach to persistent user histories would require projection adaptation and recommendation-specific quality checks.
transformer-fsq 用有限标量量化瓶颈替换键和值投影 将每个缓存位置保存为打包整数编码 不再存储逐位置量化元数据 转换预训练模型时只训练这些投影 融合 triton 内核直接读取压缩编码。论文在 0.6b–8b 语言模型上评估极高压缩率和长上下文检索 相对所测压缩基线保持较好精度。其重点是在固定显存下保留更多上下文 并非所有配置都更快。用于长期用户历史仍需投影适配与推荐质量验证。

the context lengths of large language models llms are rapidly increasing in real-world applications such as agentic systems and retrieval-augmented generation rag . to accelerate llm inference in these scenarios reusing position-independent key-value kv caches across requests has emerged as a promising approach. this technique typically relies on recomputing a selected subset of tokens to restore cross-chunk interactions. however existing solutions suffer from critical limitations in both algorithmic efficiency and system deployment. algorithmically they overlook the distribution of kv cache deviations leading to either high token-selection overhead or degraded generation quality. at the system level the reliance on custom llm execution flows for recomputation complicates deployment and prevents seamless integration with highly optimized inference engines. in this paper we propose daric distribution-aware recomputation for independent kv cache reuse a novel kv cache reuse method based on system-algorithm co-design. at its core daric introduces a distribution-aware token selection strategy that adaptively schedules token recomputation based on empirical kv deviation patterns striking an optimal balance between generation quality and computational efficiency. moreover daric is built on a lightweight system architecture that enables independent kv cache generation and recomputation with minimal integration overhead fully preserving existing system-level optimizations of standard inference engines. comprehensive experiments across various datasets and llms demonstrate that daric consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods achieving a 1.1×--4.5× speedup in time-to-first-token ttft with negligible loss in generation quality. code is available at this https url.

daric reuses position-independent kv caches while selectively recomputing tokens to restore interactions between cached chunks. its selection rule follows observed distributions of cache deviations balancing recomputation overhead against generation quality. a lightweight system design aims to preserve existing inference-engine optimizations rather than requiring a separate execution path. across the evaluated language models and datasets the paper reports faster time to first token with little quality loss. reusing shared content or user-history segments could be useful for generative recommendation but the applicable sharing patterns cache-management costs and recommendation quality have not been established.
daric 复用与位置无关的 kv 缓存 并选择性重算部分 token 恢复缓存片段之间的交互。选择规则依据观测到的缓存偏差分布 权衡重算开销与生成质量 轻量系统设计尽量保留现有推理引擎优化 避免另建执行流程。论文在所测语言模型和数据集上报告首 token 延迟下降、质量损失较小。该方法可启发共享内容或用户历史片段的复用 但哪些推荐请求能有效共享、缓存管理成本多大、质量是否稳定 仍需专门验证。

equal load does not mean equal decode latency in prefill-decode pd disaggregated mixture-of-experts moe serving. in bandwidth-bound decode more distinct experts mean more weight loads and higher latency. we present eldr a lossless expert-locality-aware decode router. prefill signatures predict decode expert usage. balanced $k$-means fits per-decoder centroids with background refitting. locality-band routing selects the least-loaded worker among close matches. a block-granular cache keeps signatures exact under prefix caching. we evaluate eldr in vllm on up to 40 gpus. across three moe models on 12 public task benchmarks and multilingual wildchat it reduces median time-per-output-token tpot by 5.4-14.5% on average across request rates and up to 17.8% over the best of four load-balancing baselines preserving model outputs and token-to-expert assignments.

eldr routes decode requests by expert locality in prefill–decode-disaggregated moe serving. prefill signatures predict later expert use balanced clustering builds worker profiles and a locality-band policy chooses a lightly loaded worker among close matches. a block-granular signature cache supports prefix reuse. in vllm experiments using up to 40 gpus the method lowers median time per output token while preserving model outputs and token-to-expert assignments. this is a serving-layer placement improvement not a change to the model router. its usefulness for sparse recommendation models depends on comparable workload structure and remains unverified.

eldr 在预填充与解码分离的 moe 服务中按专家局部性分配请求 用预填充签名预测后续专家使用 通过均衡聚类建立节点画像 再从相近节点中选择负载较低者 块级签名缓存支持前缀复用。论文在最多 40 张 gpu 的 vllm 实验中降低输出 token 的中位耗时 并保持模型输出及 token—专家分配不变。改动发生在服务请求放置层 不是模型内部路由 稀疏推荐模型能否受益 取决于负载结构 仍待验证。

linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. the hard part is not just what to forget but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value and kimi delta attention kda sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. but the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to control two different things how much old content to erase on the key side and how much new content to commit on the value side. we introduce gated deltanet-2 which generalizes both gated deltanet and kda by inheriting adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay while addressing their shared limitation the scalar tie between erasing and writing. gated delta rule-2 separates these roles with a channel-wise erase gate b_t and a channel-wise write gate w_t reducing to kda when both gates collapse to the same scalar and to gated deltanet when the decay also collapses. we derive a fast-weight update view a chunkwise wy algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors and a gate-aware backward pass that preserves efficient parallel training. at 1.3b parameters trained on 100b fineweb-edu tokens gated deltanet-2 achieves the strongest overall results among mamba-2 gated deltanet kda and mamba-3 variants across language modeling commonsense reasoning and retrieval. its advantage is most pronounced on long-context ruler needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks where it improves the evaluated multi-key retrieval setting and remains strong in both recurrent and hybrid settings. code is available at this https url.

gated deltanet-2 separates the channel-wise gates that erase old associations and write new values in a linear-attention recurrent state. it retains adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay while providing a chunkwise wy algorithm and gate-aware backward pass for parallel training. at 1.3b parameters trained on 100b fineweb-edu tokens the paper compares language modeling commonsense reasoning and retrieval against recurrent baselines with particular gains on long-context retrieval. the design offers a concrete memory-update mechanism for exploring long user sequences. its recommendation accuracy and throughput on industrial ranking workloads remain untested.
gated deltanet-2 将线性注意力循环状态中擦除旧关联、写入新值的通道级门控分开 同时保留自适应遗忘和通道衰减 并给出分块 wy 算法与门控感知反传以支持并行训练。论文在 1.3b 参数、100b fineweb-edu token 条件下比较语言建模、常识推理和检索 长上下文检索收益较突出。该设计为长期用户序列提供了具体的记忆更新机制 但推荐准确率及工业排序负载下的吞吐尚未验证。

large recommendation models lrms improve recommendation performance by scaling behavior sequence length model capacity and training compute. however the return on investment roi of continued scaling deteriorates as marginal gains diminish and long-sequence encoding costs rise especially when this computation is repeatedly executed by distinct models for diverse recommendation stages and business scenarios. to address this issue we propose seplrm a recommendation foundation model rfm paradigm that identifies reusable sequence encoding and reorganizes multiple end-to-end e2e lrms into one rfm and multiple independently optimized vertical models vms . the rfm adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and exports its final-layer encoder state as the shared key-value kv cache that is independent of downstream task-offered candidates. unlike candidate-specific logits or aggregated user embeddings the kv cache preserves fine-grained behavioral information. separation at this native kv interface also allows each vm to construct candidate-conditioned queries while retaining the same query-kv interaction as its e2e counterpart enabling high-fidelity capability transfer. to ensure both transfer effectiveness and system efficiency we co-design cache compression the training and serving workflows and lg-store a distributed storage system for kv caches. experiments on three large-scale datasets show that seplrm achieves state-of-the-art offline performance with a transfer rate of approximately 100%. it also demonstrates strong transferability across model iterations recommendation stages and business scenarios. deployment in two large-scale industrial scenarios substantially improves the roi of sequence scaling and delivers consistent gains in online a/b tests at bytedance.

seplrm avoids repeatedly encoding long behavior histories in separate recommendation stages and scenarios. a shared encoder-decoder foundation model exports candidate-independent fine-grained key-value states independently optimized vertical models query that cache with candidate-conditioned queries. cache compression training/serving workflows and a distributed cache store are co-designed. the authors report approximately 100% capability transfer on three large-scale datasets and online gains in two bytedance scenarios. the useful scaling idea is to amortize sequence encoding across downstream models while preserving candidate-specific interaction rather than transfer only an aggregated user embedding.
seplrm 把多个推荐阶段、业务场景反复执行的长历史编码集中到一个基座模型。基座输出与候选无关的细粒度键值缓存 各下游模型再用候选相关的查询读取 并配套设计缓存压缩、训练服务流程和分布式存储。作者在三个大规模数据集上报告约 100% 的能力迁移率 并在字节跳动两个场景中取得线上收益。对扩模的借鉴是 共享昂贵的历史编码 同时保留候选与历史的细粒度交互 而不只传递一个汇总用户向量。

generative recommendation gr is moving industrial recommender systems recsys from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. this shift promises higher recommendation quality but makes serving substantially harder each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. gr not only creates structural mismatches with conventional recsys pipelines but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of llm serving stacks making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. we present recogem our production gr serving system. recogem uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move gr-specific serving responsibilities such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates to a dedicated runtime. its execution engine exploits gr's short token sequences large candidate populations and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention candidate selection and execution planning. recogem has been deployed for over nine months across our production lines serving applications with hundreds of millions of users and supporting more than ten gr model families. on our onemodel production workloads recogem reaches over 1 000 qps per serving instance with p99 latency below 35 ms and a 2.88× throughput improvement over representative baselines.

recogem separates a generative-recommendation runtime which manages candidate transitions and live artifact updates from an execution engine optimized for short decoding sequences large candidate sets and predictable step shapes. the authors report more than nine months of production deployment across over ten model families. on onemodel workloads a serving instance exceeds 1 000 qps with p99 latency below 35 ms and 2.88× the throughput of representative baselines. it offers a concrete systems design for scaling generative recommendation without assuming that conventional ranking or llm serving stacks fit its workload.

recogem 将候选状态转移、在线产物更新交给专用运行时 执行引擎则针对生成式推荐的短解码序列、大候选集合和较稳定的步骤形状优化注意力、候选选择与执行计划。作者报告系统已生产部署超过九个月、支持十余类模型 在 onemodel 工作负载上 单实例超过 1 000 qps p99 延迟低于 35 毫秒 吞吐量为代表性基线的 2.88 倍。它展示了生成式推荐扩展服务能力时 如何围绕自身负载特点设计执行系统。

click-through rate ctr prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. large language models llms offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. injecting a full-scale llm into a ctr pipeline is however prohibitively expensive at inference time existing llm-enhanced ctr methods avoid this cost by caching llm outputs offline rather than serving the llm online. we propose a resource-efficient pipeline slimfm that makes online llm-based semantic modeling practical 1 dependency-aware structured pruning compresses llama3-8b by 44% to a 4.5b-parameter backbone 2 lora-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts 3 a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional ctr model. across four datasets and six ctr backbones slimfm retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing llm-enhanced baselines.

slimfm makes online llm-derived semantic features more affordable for ctr prediction. it structurally prunes llama3-8b to 4.5b parameters uses field-aware lora tuning to produce semantic embeddings and fuses those embeddings into a conventional ctr model s feature interactions. across four datasets and six ctr backbones the authors report retaining over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy and up to 3.4× faster inference than the compared llm-enhanced baselines. the compression-and-fusion recipe offers a way to trade semantic-model capacity against online ranking cost.

slimfm 用压缩和特征融合降低 ctr 预测在线调用语言模型的成本 将 llama3-8b 结构化剪枝至 4.5b 参数 用面向字段的 lora 微调生成语义向量 再融入常规 ctr 模型的特征交互。作者在四个数据集、六种 ctr 骨干上报告保留未压缩模型超过 99% 的准确性 较所比较的语言模型增强基线实现最高 3.4 倍推理加速。可借鉴的是压缩语义骨干与下游交互模块的联合设计 以权衡语义模型容量与在线排序成本。

a generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence a semantic id and recommends by generating those tokens. some generative recommenders including the uber eats search engine we are building write a whole results page stores with their menu items in one decoding pass. every semantic id on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search such as a store that delivers to the user's location and that is not already on the page. each item must also belong to the store above it. a trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. we call this constraint legit for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item trie and every generated page passes an independent catalog check. on one nvidia b200 gpu with one or two requests per decode step a direct implementation that walks the trie on the gpu makes each token about 5 times as slow as unconstrained decoding. across 36 implementations hardware counters and ablations are consistent with kernel launches and cpu-gpu waits as the source of this slowdown. our fastest implementation walks the trie on the cpu while the gpu runs the model needs no custom kernel and cuts time per output token by 65.9 percent against the direct gpu implementation to about 1.7 times the unconstrained cost. this implementation is also the fastest on a page layout that puts each item before its store.
