legit enforces request-dependent eligibility non-repetition and store-item relationships while a generative recommender produces a heterogeneous results page. depth-first numbering of identifier-trie leaves turns constraints into range lookups. in tests on one b200 gpu with one or two requests per decoding step overlapping cpu trie traversal with gpu model execution reduces time per output token by 65.9% relative to direct gpu traversal to about 1.7× unconstrained decoding cost. it illustrates how host-device scheduling can make exact changing candidate constraints cheaper the reported benefit is specific to the tested workload.

legit 在生成 店铺+商品 整页结果时 实时约束候选资格、去重和商品所属店铺。它对标识前缀树的叶子做深度优先编号 把约束转为区间查询。在单张 b200、每个解码步骤一至两个请求的测试中 让 cpu 遍历前缀树并与 gpu 模型计算重叠 较直接在 gpu 上遍历减少 65.9% 的每词元耗时 总成本约为无约束解码的 1.7 倍。它说明精确候选约束的服务成本可通过主机与设备调度降低 收益范围仍限于文中测试负载。

advances in large language models and semantic ids sids have brought generative retrieval gr into industrial applications. these systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. a catalog trie ensures sid validity but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. we propose routingtrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. routingtrie maintains one shared sid trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using dense bitset or sparse list. we derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. during decoding field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. experiments on shoptrie our configurable synthetic benchmark demonstrate compact storage and efficient cpu and gpu probing across diverse metadata distributions. in a production replay routingtrie raises hit@100 from 67.5% to 96.1% a gain of 28.6 percentage points with only 1.1 ms latency increase. we will release the shoptrie generator benchmark scripts and routingtrie cpu and triton gpu implementations to support reproducibility.

routingtrie applies metadata constraints before generative retrieval selects its beam avoiding wasted generation and too few valid results from post-filtering. it shares one semantic-id trie and chooses dense bitsets or sparse lists for per-field indexes using a storage cost model. probes mask candidate edges during decoding. experiments cover synthetic metadata distributions and a production replay where hit@100 rises from 67.5% to 96.1% with 1.1 ms additional latency. it provides a serving design for scalable constrained retrieval replay evidence is distinct from an online a/b test.

routingtrie 在生成式召回选择束搜索候选之前检查元数据约束 减少生成后再过滤带来的浪费和有效候选不足。它共享一棵语义 id 前缀树 并依据存储成本为各字段选择稠密位图或稀疏列表 在解码时屏蔽不符合条件的分支。除合成数据实验外 生产流量回放中的 hit@100 从 67.5% 提升到 96.1% 延迟增加 1.1 毫秒。可借鉴的是把约束索引接入生成路径 流量回放结果不能等同于线上 a/b 测试。

high-precision text reranking is a critical component in modern search recommendation and agentic retrieval-augmented generation rag systems. we present yuanbao-reranker a family of general-purpose dense rerankers spanning 0.6b 4b and 8b parameter scales built upon the qwen3 backbone. to construct diverse and reliable ranking supervision at scale we pair answer-first and query-type-guided document-grounded synthesis with a three-stage curation funnel that verifies positive support eliminates semantic redundancy and enforces balanced source-by-length quotas. for each curated pair we screen real retrieval pools with a teacher score margin to filter out potential false negatives and sample hard medium and moderate negative tiers yielding 2.75m $1 3$ ranking groups. we train the models by jointly optimizing pointwise relevance cross-entropy and a bounded minimum-gap hinge objective over both positive--negative and negative--negative pairs. this formulation transfers fine-grained teacher preferences across candidate tiers without over-constraining well-separated predictions supporting both cross-scale and same-scale distillation followed by layerwise adaptive model merging. across five comprehensive benchmarks spanning chinese cmteb-r multilingual mmteb-r english beir long-document mldr and code mteb-code retrieval yuanbao-reranker consistently leads every parameter tier the 0.6b variant reaches 70.96 avg. to surpass 1b--4b active-parameter baselines the 4b variant reaches 73.63 avg. to outperform the 8b teacher 72.68 and the 8b variant achieves a state-of-the-art 74.21 avg. with substantial gains generalizing across distinct first-stage retrievers.

yuanbao-reranker combines document-grounded synthetic supervision quality filtering and teacher-margin negative selection to train 0.6b 4b and 8b dense rerankers. a joint pointwise and bounded pairwise loss transfers preferences across candidate tiers followed by adaptive layer merging. across five text-retrieval benchmark groups the authors report strong results at every tested scale including a 4b model outperforming its 8b teacher on the aggregate score. its relevance to ctr scaling is a data-curation and distillation recipe for smaller ranking models the reported evaluations concern text retrieval rather than ctr prediction.

yuanbao-reranker 结合基于文档生成的监督数据、质量筛选和教师分数差引导的负样本选择 训练 0.6b、4b、8b 三档稠密重排模型。联合点式损失与有界成对损失传递不同候选层级间的偏好 再进行自适应分层模型合并。作者在五组文本检索基准上报告各档模型的较强表现 其中 4b 模型的汇总得分超过 8b 教师。对 ctr 扩模可借鉴数据筛选与小模型蒸馏方法 但这些结果来自文本检索 尚非 ctr 预测验证。

generative recommendation models represent items as sequences of discrete tokens known as semantic ids. existing approaches derive these identifiers using residual or hierarchical vector quantization assuming that tokens carry independent semantic meaning across quantization levels. revisiting this assumption we argue that semantic ids should behave as hierarchical paths where each token's meaning is conditioned on its prefix. this highlights a mismatch between conventional fixed-codebook quantization and the hierarchical structure implicitly learned by generative recommenders. motivated by this insight we propose adaptive silhouette tree ast a top-down divisive clustering method that constructs semantic ids as paths within a tree structure. unlike prior methods with fixed branching factors ast dynamically determines the number of branches at each node by maximizing the silhouette coefficient enabling finer partitions in dense regions and compact groupings in homogeneous ones. we further introduce constrained variants that enforce minimum probability mass during splitting to improve supervision for long-tail items. extensive experiments on five amazon review datasets of varying sizes and domains show that ast significantly outperforms strong baselines. these results demonstrate that aligning semantic id construction with the inherent hierarchical structure of generative recommenders leads to more effective recommendations.

adaptive silhouette tree constructs semantic ids as hierarchical paths whose tokens depend on their prefixes. instead of a fixed branching factor top-down clustering selects each node s branching count using the silhouette coefficient constrained variants maintain minimum probability mass to strengthen long-tail supervision. the authors report improvements over strong baselines on five amazon review datasets. the transferable design insight is to adapt identifier capacity to local item structure before scaling a generative recommender rather than assume fixed-codebook quantization matches every region of the catalog.
adaptive silhouette tree 将语义 id 构造成逐层路径 让每个词元的含义依赖此前的前缀。自顶向下聚类依据轮廓系数选择各节点的分支数量 而非固定分叉数 受约束版本还要求分支具有最小概率质量 改善长尾监督。作者在五个 amazon review 数据集上报告优于较强基线。对生成式推荐可借鉴的是先让标识容量适应商品空间的局部结构 再扩展模型 而不假设固定码本划分适合所有区域。

user sequence modeling is widely used in recommendation and advertising. search ranking presents an additional challenge the current query expresses immediate intent while a candidate product determines which parts of a user's long-term history are relevant. we present a production sequence framework for sponsored-product ranking that augments recent behavior with two retrieval channels over long-term history candidate-nearest-neighbor retrieval and query-nearest-neighbor retrieval. the selected actions are encoded together with dedicated query and candidate context tokens while candidate-aware early fusion injects the candidate into every history token. offline ablations show that dual retrieval improves major ranking metrics relative to the production baseline. in an online a/b test on sponsored-product search traffic the model increased ctr attributed conversion rate and orders per impression.

this sponsored-product ranking framework supplements recent actions with long-term history retrieved through two channels nearest neighbors of the current query and of the candidate product. dedicated query/candidate tokens and candidate-aware early fusion condition the selected behavior sequence. offline ablations improve ranking metrics over the production baseline and an online a/b test increases ctr attributed conversion rate and orders per impression. it offers a practical way to select relevant portions of long histories before applying a more expressive ranking model.
这项商品广告排序方法用两条检索通道补充近期行为 分别寻找与当前查询、候选商品相近的长期历史。选出的行为与专用查询、候选词元一起编码 并在早期融合阶段把候选信息注入每个历史词元。离线消融优于生产基线 线上 a/b 测试提升 ctr、归因转化率和每次曝光订单数。它为长历史提供了实用的相关片段选择方法 再由表达能力更强的排序模型处理这些片段。

on-demand delivery platforms such as doordash and uber eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. adapting it to this setting however poses three challenges. first existing semantic ids encode geography only as a soft signal so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. second user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. third the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. to address the challenges we propose ts-gear a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery 1 geo-semantic id splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter 2 query-geo target attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key 3 gmpo group marginal policy optimization rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within grpo avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. deployed online with a lightweight 0.1b backbone ts-gear serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of taobao shangou consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both hitrate and geographic validity and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.

ts-gear addresses delivery-range validity and set-level value in generative ad retrieval. geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes make reachability part of the identifier target query-and-location-conditioned attention selects user-history signals while group marginal policy optimization discourages redundant candidates through group rewards. the authors report deployment of a 0.1b model on over 150 million daily taobao shangou queries with ad impressions and revenue increasing by 3.8% and 4.2%. it is a concrete industrial recipe for building location constraints and candidate-set value into generative retrieval.
ts-gear 面向配送范围受限的生成式广告召回 用地理前缀与语义后缀编码商家 让可配送性进入预测目标 用查询和位置共同引导历史行为注意力 再以组级奖励和边际优势减少候选重复。作者报告 0.1b 模型已在淘宝闪购承接每日超过 1.5 亿查询 广告曝光和收入分别提升 3.8% 与 4.2%。它为工业生成式召回提供了将地理约束、候选集合价值接入模型训练的方法。

e-commerce catalogs increasingly live in lakehouse tables apache iceberg metadata over parquet files in object storage. product search however still runs on copies of that catalog in a lexical engine and a vector database each with its own ingestion pipeline schema staleness window and bill. we show that search applications can be hosted directly on the data lake with the lakehouse table as the single system of record. we extend apache pinot a real-time olap engine that already serves iceberg tables in place with bm25 relevance scoring over its lucene text index corpus-wide term statistics so that scores are comparable across files and reciprocal rank fusion in plain sql a real-time table fed by a stream can sit behind the same table merged by the broker. on the amazon esci benchmark 1.2m us products 22 458 test queries hybrid search served from the lake matches exact retrieval ndcg@10 .361 . the lake table is queryable 149 s after its files are registered and a lake commit is searchable in 3.8 s close to indexing directly into a search engine. on a brand-sorted lake of 277m products 0.8 tb one 16-vcpu node answers brand-scoped vector bm25 and client-fused hybrid searches in 6.5-9 ms p50 sustains 1 100 vector and 635 bm25 searches per second at under 180 ms p99 and makes a commit searchable in 4.3 s. search adds only its indexes no copy of the catalog no sync pipeline and no second schema which cuts storage rebuild time and the operational work of keeping copies consistent.

this system serves lexical vector and filtered product search directly from iceberg/parquet lakehouse data through apache pinot adding bm25 statistics and rank fusion without copying the catalog into separate search databases. it matches the reported exact-retrieval quality on amazon esci and evaluates a 277-million-product brand-sorted lake on one 16-vcpu node. its scaling value is reduced duplication and synchronization work alongside measured search latency and data freshness. the large-lake latency figures concern brand-scoped queries not unrestricted search over every product.

这项系统工作通过 apache pinot 直接在 iceberg/parquet 数据湖上提供词法、向量和带过滤条件的商品搜索 补充 bm25 统计与排序融合 无需把完整目录复制到独立检索数据库。它在 amazon esci 上达到文中精确检索的质量 并用单台 16 核虚拟 cpu 节点评估包含 2.77 亿商品、按品牌排序的数据湖。扩展价值在于减少数据副本与同步工作 同时测量搜索时延和数据新鲜度 大规模实验的低延迟结果针对品牌范围内查询 不代表全目录无约束搜索。

training large dense and mixture-of-experts moe rerankers is constrained by gpu memory and distributed-execution efficiency which has kept academic reranker research largely on dense models. tevatron trains rerankers through the hugging face trainer with deepspeed and pytorch fsdp1 a stack that stalls on three fronts deepspeed zero-2 has a known gradient-gathering failure on this path fsdp1 full sharding is memory-safe but throughput-bound and neither offers the expert parallelism ep that moe training needs. we present tevatron 3.0 which integrates megatron-core as a reranker training backend while preserving tevatron's data processing evaluation pipeline and hugging face checkpoint format. for full-parameter dense 8b training megatron matches fsdp1 on beir-15 ndcg@10 with approximately 4% lower epoch time and twice the peak gpu memory under matched data-parallel and recomputation settings and approximately 22% lower epoch time in its recommended configuration it supports both lora and full-parameter fine-tuning. expert parallelism makes it possible to train a 30b-parameter moe reranker qwen3-30b-a3b on two nodes. a controlled study of architecture lora and distillation on beir-15 with three first-stage retrievers and hugging face and vllm serving shows that the moe reranker matches dense-8b quality at less than half the activated parameters and at higher inference throughput. we open-source the framework and trained checkpoints.

tevatron 3.0 adds megatron-core as a reranker training backend while retaining existing data/evaluation pipelines and checkpoint format. expert parallelism enables training of a 30b moe reranker on two nodes. a controlled beir-15 study reports dense-8b-level quality with less than half the activated parameters and higher inference throughput. dense-8b training trades roughly twice the peak memory for approximately 4% lower epoch time under matched settings or about 22% in the recommended configuration. the lesson for scalable ranking is to evaluate training and serving trade-offs jointly rather than equate sparsity with automatic efficiency.

tevatron 3.0 将 megatron-core 接入重排训练 保留原有数据、评估流程和检查点格式 并通过专家并行在两个节点上训练 30b moe 重排模型。beir-15 受控实验中 moe 以不到一半的激活参数达到稠密 8b 模型的质量 推理吞吐更高。稠密 8b 的匹配设置则以约两倍峰值显存换取约 4% 的单轮训练耗时下降 推荐配置下约减少 22%。对排序扩展的启示是联合评估训练与服务代价 不能把稀疏参数直接等同于效率收益。

a single model scale challenges the flexibility of a production retrieval system some settings need it faster others need a smaller index and the right trade-off changes with the workload. in the context of information retrieval ir a transformer-based model can be made smaller in three ways --- using fewer layers passing fewer tokens through the upper layers or producing a shorter embedding --- and each way saves a different resource. these options have been studied in isolation each as its own method with its own code and training setup which makes them hard to combine or adapt to a new model. in this work we present tevatron-elastic to bring all three under one unified abstraction a single object names any size the model can run at and a short schedule lists the sizes to train. training then produces one checkpoint that serves all of those sizes and at deployment the user has the liberty to pick any of them. the same abstraction covers both retrievers and rerankers and both encoder and decoder models as it works through interfaces that hugging face transformers already expose adding a new backbone can be a configuration change rather than a model rewrite. prior methods --- matryoshka embeddings early exit 2d matryoshka starbucks and layerwise token compression ltc --- become special cases of our unified abstraction. with tevatron-elastic we also propose a new elastic algorithm matryoshka~ltc mltc to jointly train several token-compression ratios in one retriever checkpoint. to validate our framework we train 20 checkpoints across three backbones and two tasks the quality curves are smooth full-point quality remains close to that of models trained for a single size and a controlled study confirms the wall-clock speedups. we release the framework and all checkpoints to support elastic retrieval research.

tevatron-elastic trains one retriever or reranker checkpoint to support multiple layer counts upper-layer token budgets and embedding dimensions. a shared configuration/schedule abstraction covers existing elastic methods and a new matryoshka token-compression variant across encoder and decoder backbones. tests of 20 checkpoints on three backbones and two tasks report smooth quality trade-offs full-size quality close to single-size training and measured wall-clock gains. it provides a practical approach to adapting ranking cost to deployment budgets without maintaining a separate model for every operating point.

tevatron-elastic 让同一个召回或重排检查点支持不同层数、高层词元预算和向量维度 用统一的配置与训练日程表达这些运行规模。框架覆盖编码器、解码器和多种已有弹性方法 并提出联合训练多个词元压缩率的变体。在三个骨干、两项任务的二十个检查点实验中 作者报告平滑的质量权衡、接近单规模训练的完整模型质量 以及实际运行耗时收益。它为按部署预算调整排序成本提供了方法 不必为每个运行档位维护独立模型。

modern recommendation systems on social media platforms such as meta must model complex social relationships including friendships group memberships and creator interactions alongside massive and heterogeneous content such as text and video. traditional recommendation models however often omit these signals or treat them independently lacking the reasoning capability to integrate multi-relational context for fine-grained personalization. we present connectionmind a production-ready recommendation framework that tightly integrates the social network structure with large language models llms to enable scalable interpretable and reasoning-aware personalization in meta. connectionmind constructs a heterogeneous graph connecting users items friends groups and creator pages and formulates recommendation as a graph reasoning problem discovering personalized paths from users to candidate items. an llm-based policy is employed to reason over these graph structures and guide recommendation decisions. to train the system at scale connectionmind adopts a two-stage learning strategy. we first perform supervised fine-tuning sft on large-scale user-item interaction trajectories to initialize the reasoning policy followed by end-to-end reinforcement learning rl to refine the model's ability to reason over social graphs for personalized recommendation. extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of connectionmind compared to representative baselines. more importantly connectionmind has been deployed in meta's large-scale recommendation pipeline and has been evaluated through online a/b tests achieving a 0.43% improvement in video watch time. these results demonstrate measurable real-world impact in a production recommendation system.

connectionmind models users items friends groups and creator pages as a heterogeneous graph and uses an llm policy to reason over paths from users to candidate items. supervised learning on interaction trajectories initializes the policy before reinforcement-learning refinement. the authors report gains over representative baselines and a 0.43% video-watch-time improvement in a meta production a/b test. its relevance is integrating social-graph structure into reasoning-based recommendation at production scale with staged policy training providing a concrete implementation path.
connectionmind 将用户、物品、好友、群组和创作者页面组织为异构图 由语言模型策略推理从用户到候选物品的路径。系统先用交互轨迹监督微调 再通过强化学习调整策略。作者报告优于代表性基线 并在 meta 生产 a/b 测试中使视频观看时长提升 0.43%。可借鉴的是把社交图结构接入生产规模的推荐推理 并通过分阶段策略训练实现这一过程。

integrating recall and pre-ranking in e-commerce search requires candidate generation to account for relevance personalization and business value before final ranking. to this end we present varg a generative retrieval system for tmall app search that directly admits generated item candidates to the existing final ranker. varg-id constructs semantic prefixes using rq-vae enhances search relevance through bidirectional query-item contrastive learning and combines these prefixes with a value-ordered third token to provide fine-grained item addresses and a business-value prior. three-stage supervised fine-tuning progressively learns item-to-identifier mappings query-semantic retrieval and personalized retrieval. personalized model training combines value-aware and hierarchy-aligned supervision with expanded user context and uses local ordinal supervision lo-sft to learn the local within-cluster ordering encoded by the third token. prefix-grpo combines gated rewards based on output legality user behavior ranker advantage and search relevance with prefix-aware token weighting to align candidate generation with business value and ranking objectives. coordinated daily product and model updates preserve existing item addresses while incorporating new products and behavioral feedback. offline experiments on tens of millions of products validate identifier stability and demonstrate gains in retrieval quality and head-level value recall from sft strategies and prefix-grpo over their respective baselines. in a 14-day online a/b test covering 20% of search traffic varg directly admits generated candidates to the final ranker and improves gmv by 1.45% per-user ipv by 0.22% and pctr by 0.31%. online shopping-guide query evaluations further show that varg maintains competitive relevance with a smaller candidate quota.

varg generates candidates directly for an existing final ranker in tmall search. semantic prefixes plus a value-ordered final token encode item addresses staged supervised training and prefix-aware group-relative optimization align generation with relevance personalization and business value. daily item/model updates preserve existing addresses. the authors report a 14-day a/b test on 20% of traffic with 1.45% higher gmv 0.22% higher per-user ipv and 0.31% higher pctr. it illustrates how ranking-aligned generative retrieval can retain stable identifiers as the product catalog changes.

varg 在天猫搜索中直接为既有精排模型生成候选。语义前缀与按价值排序的末级词元共同编码商品地址 分阶段监督训练和前缀感知的组相对优化将生成结果对齐相关性、个性化与商业价值 每日商品和模型更新保持已有地址稳定。作者在覆盖 20% 流量、持续十四天的 a/b 测试中报告 gmv、每用户 ipv、pctr 分别提升 1.45%、0.22%、0.31%。它展示了与排序目标对齐的生成式召回 如何在商品目录持续变化时保持标识稳定。

recent recommendation agents recagents offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active user-side paradigm where generative agents autonomously perceive web platforms reason over user preferences and execute decisions. however existing recagents still suffer from two critical limitations brittle item perception based on noisy item pages and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. to address these challenges we propose a recommendation-agent framework termed remem that combines ocr-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. instead of parsing raw html remem observes item-page screenshots and uses an ocr tool to produce structured textual evidence for the reasoning backbone. to support long-horizon preference modeling remem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential update strategy that maintains a bounded textual memory while processing histories longer than the backbone context window with fixed chunk and memory budgets the number of update calls grows linearly with history length. this design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. to train the dynamic memory updater we further develop a multi-memory grpo variant whose reward combines recommendation-specific information with final-task metrics. experiments on three amazon-derived datasets and a controlled post-retrieval protocol show an average relative improvement of 7.58% over the strongest reported baseline across searching ranking and judging tasks.

remem combines screenshot/ocr-based item perception with a bounded textual memory that updates sequentially over chunks of long recommendation histories. with fixed chunk and memory budgets update calls grow linearly with history length. a multi-memory group-relative policy optimization variant trains the updater using recommendation-specific and end-task rewards. on three amazon-derived datasets under a controlled post-retrieval protocol the authors report an average relative 7.58% gain over the strongest reported baseline across search ranking and judging. it offers a bounded-memory history-processing idea with results limited to that experimental protocol.

remem 用截图和 ocr 提取商品页面证据 并将长推荐历史分块处理 逐步更新一个有界的文本记忆。在固定块大小与记忆预算下 更新调用次数随历史长度线性增长 多记忆组相对策略优化结合推荐信息和最终任务奖励训练更新器。作者在三个 amazon 派生数据集、受控的召回后评估协议下 报告搜索、排序和判断任务相对最强已报告基线平均提升 7.58%。可借鉴的是有界记忆的长历史处理方式 结论范围仍限于该实验协议。

post-layernorm transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. while prior research has focused on stabilising post-layernorm by improving conditioning at initialisation stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates forcing additional compromises. in the decoder-only settings we study existing post-layernorm methods fail to outperform strong pre-layernorm baselines. we propose kitenorm a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. this approach is motivated by a bound on the layernorm jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. kitenorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. across decoder-only transformers up to 1.3b parameters kitenorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates with scaling laws favouring kitenorm across depth width batch size and training budget. ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.

kitenorm addresses the difficulty of scaling post-layernorm transformers by controlling hidden-state variance throughout training. it combines residual scaling variance regularization and separately learnable scales for skip and residual branches. experiments on decoder-only models up to 1.3b parameters report improved stability and favorable scaling across depth width batch size and training budget. this offers a concrete normalization recipe to investigate in deeper ctr architectures recommendation gains have not been established.
kitenorm 通过约束隐藏状态方差 改善 post-layernorm transformer 随深度增加而出现的训练不稳定。方法结合残差缩放、方差正则 以及跳连和残差分支各自可学习的尺度。在最高 13 亿参数的解码器模型上 论文报告了稳定性改善 并比较了深度、宽度、批量和训练预算的扩展趋势。它可为更深的 ctr 架构提供归一化方案 但尚未验证推荐任务收益。

query-key normalization qk-norm is widely adopted in modern large language models to control the growth of attention logits and improve training stability. however query and key norms are not merely sources of instability. the query norm controls the sharpness of the attention distribution while the key norm determines how strongly a token attracts different queries. these norms therefore carry token-specific information about attention selectivity and token importance. by normalizing both qk-norm suppresses this information. this raises a natural question can we control query-key representations without discarding their sensitivity to magnitude to address this question we propose qk-map a magnitude-aware projection for constructing queries and keys. rather than removing magnitude through normalization qk-map transforms the input representation using multiple learnable frequencies so that changes in magnitude are encoded as bounded phase patterns. this allows magnitude to be represented through phase and direction rather than vector length alone. its periodic features have a fixed norm while remaining sensitive to magnitude changes separating magnitude encoding from norm growth. multiple frequencies further help distinguish magnitudes and reduce periodic ambiguity. experiments across model scales from 190m to 7b parameters show that qk-map achieves lower training and validation loss than both standard attention and qk-norm. further analyses show that qk-map preserves sensitivity to input scale assigns less attention to the first token and produces stronger attention contrast for relevant evidence in synthetic long-context tests. these results demonstrate that query-key scale can be effectively controlled without sacrificing token-specific magnitude information.

qk-map controls query-key scale without discarding token-specific magnitude information. multiple learnable frequencies encode changes in magnitude as bounded phase patterns keeping periodic features at fixed norm while preserving scale sensitivity. models from 190m to 7b parameters achieve lower training and validation loss than standard attention and qk-norm with additional synthetic long-context evidence. the design suggests an alternative to normalizing away query/key magnitudes in scalable ranking transformers transfer to recommendation remains untested.
qk-map 用多个可学习频率 把查询与键的幅值变化编码为有界相位模式 使周期特征保持固定范数 同时保留输入尺度信息。论文在 1.9 亿至 70 亿参数模型上得到低于标准注意力和 qk-norm 的训练、验证损失 并做了合成长上下文测试。它为扩展排序 transformer 提供了保留查询、键幅值信息的另一种设计 推荐场景仍需验证。

activation sparsity can reduce ffn weight traffic during single-user llm decoding but active channels must be identified early enough to avoid fetching unused weights. in pretrained swiglu models training-free routing with the native gate performs substantially worse than routing with the up activation at high sparsity. we show that this ordering reverses after sparsity-aware training. based on this insight we introduce sga-sparse which converts pretrained swiglu llms into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by training the existing gate projection directly as a top-k router. sga-sparse updates all model parameters end-to-end while preserving the original swiglu activation and introducing no auxiliary router parameters. after approximately 30b training tokens llama models from 1b to 8b achieve uniform per-token 75-85% ffn channel sparsity while remaining within 0.2-2.7 pp of their original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy. because post-training quantization degrades sparsity-trained checkpoints we further study two complementary quantization-aware training qat recipes continued-qat largely recovers performance at 4-bit weight quantization while joint-qat performs better for the more aggressive sub-4-bit target. to compare activation sparsity with dense low-bit quantization we translate the sparsity-induced reduction in weight traffic into an equivalent bit-width. under this unified weight-traffic metric our 2.5- and 1.5-bit-equivalent models establish a new accuracy-traffic pareto frontier the 2.5-bit-equivalent models match dense 3-bit qat accuracy while the 1.5-bit-equivalent models approach dense 2-bit models and outperform dense ternary models by 1.3 pp on average. these results establish native-gate training as a practical approach for combining high ffn sparsity with low-bit weights.

sga-sparse trains the existing swiglu gate as a fixed-budget top-k router updating all model parameters without adding a separate router. after about 30b training tokens 1b-8b llama models retain 75-85% ffn channel sparsity with a 0.2-2.7 percentage-point average zero-shot accuracy gap to their dense checkpoints. quantization-aware training helps combine sparsity with low-bit weights. the work informs sparse ranking-model ffns but its bit-equivalent comparison measures weight traffic not realized end-to-end latency.

sga-sparse 直接把已有 swiglu 门控训练为固定预算的 top-k 路由器 不增加独立路由参数 并端到端更新模型。约 300 亿训练 token 后 10 亿至 80 亿参数 llama 模型达到 75%–85% 的 ffn 通道稀疏度 平均零样本准确率与原密集模型相差 0.2–2.7 个百分点 量化感知训练进一步帮助结合低比特权重。方法可供稀疏排序模型参考 但文中的等效比特比较衡量权重流量 不等于实测端到端延迟。

sparse attention accelerates long-context decoding by reading a subset of the kv cache but existing methods are open-loop the kernel commits to its selection with no signal indicating whether enough attention mass was preserved and no recovery path when it was not. the needed signal already exists inside the kernel. the fraction of softmax mass on the selected tokens which we call coverage satisfies an exact algebraic equality with per-step output error and serves a dual role as the acceptance criterion and the interpolation weight for recovery. coverage-verified sparse attention cvsa turns coverage into a training-free closed-loop verify-then-correct decode loop that accepts high-coverage drafts and recovers only the heads that fall short with no sampling no draft model and no speculative-decoding infrastructure. quality varies by only 0.14 points across the threshold sweep budget and scheduling ablations characterize the deployed operating point. on longbench at 7b and 70b cvsa comes within 1.13 points of dense attention statistically matching it at 70b and it loses 0.8 points on ruler measured median decode-step speedup reaches 6.21× at 128k context.

coverage-verified sparse attention adds a verify-and-correct loop to long-context decoding. it uses the softmax mass covered by selected tokens to decide whether to accept sparse attention and how to recover deficient heads. evaluations at 7b and 70b parameters report near-dense benchmark quality and a maximum measured median decode-step speedup of 6.21x at 128k context. this suggests quality-aware compute allocation for long behavior sequences the reported results are from language-model decoding rather than recommendation.
cvsa 在长上下文解码中加入 核验后修正 用所选 token 覆盖的 softmax 质量判断是否接受稀疏注意力 并只修复覆盖不足的注意力头。论文在 70 亿和 700 亿参数模型上报告了接近密集注意力的基准质量 128k 上下文下实测中位解码步加速最高为 6.21 倍。其质量感知计算分配可供长行为序列建模参考 但这些收益来自语言模型解码实验。

long-context applications long-lived agents and multi-agent systems require large language models llms to process and retain extensive information. in these settings the kv cache can exceed gpu high-bandwidth memory hbm capacity necessitating offloading to host memory where cpu-to-gpu transfers can dominate inference latency. while kv cache compression can reduce data movement query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging if not impossible. we introduce verkv a hybrid approach that provides \epsilon δ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. verkv maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the gpu together with a token-level sketch of the full kv cache while retaining the complete cache in cpu memory. we introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure poissoncomp to select the pivotal tokens. at inference time our proposed kvfetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. if the estimate satisfies a user-specified \epsilon δ tolerance inference proceeds without accessing host memory. otherwise verkv performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the cpu refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. thus verkv enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing cpu-to-gpu transfers. we show that poissoncomp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to kv cache compression. combined with kvfetch it achieves near-dense performance 90-100% of dense quality at 32k context length averaged over ruler and loft using qwen3-4b qwen3.5-9b and ministral-3-8b while reducing the gpu memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping cpu-to-gpu memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token depending on the model.

verkv keeps pivotal tokens and a compact sketch on the gpu while retaining the complete kv cache in host memory. it estimates attention error for each query and fetches additional tokens only when the configured error tolerance is not met. on three language models at 32k context evaluations averaged over ruler and loft retain 90-100% of dense quality while reducing gpu cache memory by 8-32x. query-dependent verification is relevant to long-sequence serving though the recommendation setting and its transfer costs require separate evaluation.

verkv 在 gpu 上保留关键 token 和紧凑摘要 在主机内存中保留完整 kv 缓存。每次查询先估计注意力误差 只有不满足设定容差时才补取更多 token。在三个语言模型、32k 上下文的 ruler 与 loft 平均结果中 它保留了密集模型 90%–100% 的质量 并把 gpu 缓存内存降至原来的 1/8–1/32。按查询核验再取数的方式可用于长序列服务设计 推荐效果和传输成本需另测。

indexer-topk which computes scores and selects the top-k candidates is a key primitive in long-context sparse attention for large language models vector retrieval for recommendation systems and vector databases. however existing gpu-based indexer-topk kernels like deepseek sparse attention dsa typically separate scoring from selection and materialize the full score matrix in high-bandwidth memory. this strategy is inefficient for large score matrices such as those encountered in long-context sparse attention due to excessive global-memory traffic costly synchronization and prohibitive memory overhead. in this study motivated by the curse of dimensionality we observe that sparse attention scores exhibit a score concentration phenomenon with scores falling within a narrow range. based on this observation we propose litetopk a sample-filter-select framework that estimates query-data score ranges from a small subset of the data. it uses these estimates to filter scores as they are computed materializes only the candidates that pass the filter and selects from the surviving candidates. in particular we develop two implementations of litetopk. the first uses a conservative threshold estimate while the second pairs a predicted threshold with a fallback strategy. building on litetopk we further propose litedsa which reuses overlapping key/value entries across neighboring queries to accelerate attention computation. we integrate litetopk into vllm sglang and megatron-lm. our evaluation on eight b200 gpus demonstrates prefill speedups of up to 1.49× across glm-5.2 deepseek-v4-flash and hy-4-preview at a context length of 1m tokens without compromising model capabilities.

litetopk fuses score computation with candidate filtering to avoid materializing a full score matrix before top-k selection. small samples estimate a score threshold the two implementations use conservative filtering or a predicted threshold with fallback. litedsa additionally reuses overlapping keys and values across nearby queries. integration into vllm sglang and megatron-lm reports up to 1.49x prefill speedup at 1m context on eight b200 gpus. the shared indexer-topk primitive makes this directly relevant to recommendation retrieval without establishing recommendation-specific speedups.

litetopk 用小样本估计分数阈值 在计算分数时同步过滤候选 避免先将完整分数矩阵写入显存再做 top-k。两种实现分别采用保守阈值或带回退的预测阈值 litedsa 还复用相邻查询重叠的键和值。论文接入 vllm、sglang 和 megatron-lm 在八张 b200、百万 token 上下文下报告最高 1.49 倍的预填充加速。indexer-topk 同样用于推荐向量检索 但论文未直接给出推荐场景加速收益。

offloading model state to host memory and streaming layer weights let a single multi-gpu node train large mixture-of-experts moe models. gpu memory then becomes a performance budget shared by resident expert state retained activations and execution worksets. the best allocation depends on the expert execution path batch size and sequence length. we present oom offload-optimized moe a full-parameter moe training system that co-designs expert execution and memory allocation. for expert-parallel execution oom updates resident experts on their owning gpus and jointly plans state residency and moe activation retention according to pipeline dependencies. for local execution oom bounds gpu worksets through dependency-aware partitioning in hybrid models it also retains attention results on the host to avoid costly recomputation and selectively regenerates layer boundaries through cheaper layers to make room. calibrated cost models guide joint configuration within gpu and host budgets to minimize step time oom selects among the configured paths through short executions. on four h100s oom trains with 1m-token contexts whereas fsdp2 zero-offload and megatrain exhaust gpu memory at 512k. it also trains a 122b-parameter moe model on which all three exhaust host memory. on four 24 gb rtx 4090s it trains 512k-token contexts and 1 024 1k-token sequences per step without gradient accumulation. across matched-global-batch comparisons oom delivers 1.58x and 4.08x geometric-mean up to 2.14x and 7.77x throughput over cpu-offloaded fsdp2 on the two platforms while using the least host memory among the evaluated systems -- as little as 1/3.0 of fsdp2's.

oom jointly plans expert execution resident model state retained activations and temporary worksets for cpu-offloaded moe training. cost models and short trial executions select configurations under gpu and host-memory budgets. on four h100s it separately demonstrates training with 1m-token contexts and training a 122b-parameter moe matched-batch comparisons show geometric-mean throughput gains over cpu-offloaded fsdp2 on h100 and rtx 4090 platforms. the resource-allocation design can inform sparse recommendation training but the evaluated workloads are language models.

oom 联合规划 cpu 卸载式 moe 训练中的专家执行、常驻模型状态、保留激活和临时工作区 用成本模型和短试跑选择满足显存、主机内存预算的配置。它在四张 h100 上分别展示了百万 token 上下文训练和 1220 亿参数 moe 训练 并在 h100、rtx 4090 平台的同批量比较中提高了相对 cpu 卸载 fsdp2 的几何平均吞吐。资源分配思路可供稀疏推荐训练参考 已验证工作负载仍是语言模型。

mixture-of-experts moe inference with expert parallelism ep relies on all-to-all communication making computation-communication overlap strategies critical for achieving high performance. however no strategy is universally optimal. across 103 production configurations varying input lengths and four hardware platforms we observe that the fastest strategy shifts based on model shape ep degree input length and hardware. since no strategy dominates more than 80.6% of configurations configuration-aware selection is necessary. in this work we propose overlapadvisor which models overlap stages using two granularities to capture computation-communication dependencies. overlapadvisor builds a unified performance model accounting for deviations from peak compute memory and communication performance across workloads and hardware. this model enables launch-time configuration-aware strategy selection within two serving engines. we conduct experiments on four moe models 30b-235b against three baselines utilizing sglang and vllm. at the kernel level overlapadvisor achieves 1.16x average and 1.59x maximum speedups with a prediction mape of 3.3%-15.9%. in sglang and vllm it improves end-to-end throughput up to 31.7%. its granularity-guided optimizations further achieve median speedups of 1.10x for deepep-v1 and 1.22x for flashmoe.

overlapadvisor models compute-communication dependencies at two granularities to select an overlap strategy for expert-parallel moe serving. the preferred strategy changes with model shape expert-parallel degree input length and hardware so selection happens at engine launch rather than relying on one fixed strategy. tests of four 30b-235b models on four platforms report up to 31.7% end-to-end throughput improvement in sglang and vllm. this is a useful systems design for distributed sparse recommendation with transfer gains still unmeasured.
overlapadvisor 用两种粒度建模计算与通信依赖 在引擎启动时为专家并行 moe 选择重叠策略。最佳策略会随模型形状、专家并行度、输入长度和硬件改变 不能固定使用同一方案。论文在四个平台、四个 300 亿至 2350 亿参数模型上测试 sglang 和 vllm 的端到端吞吐提升最高为 31.7%。这种按配置选择策略的设计可供分布式稀疏推荐参考 迁移收益尚未测量。

modern mixture-of-experts moe inference is constrained by gpu memory. this constraint is mitigated by expert offloading which stores part of the model's weight in host memory and executes on demand. though moe architecture has computation sparsity more gpus are needed for serving increasingly larger frontier models. however existing expert offloading systems overlook this need and fail to scale performance with additional gpus. we present adaoffload a general and efficient multi-gpu hybrid expert execution framework that effectively handles heterogeneous hardware and workloads. we co-design gpu-cpu parallelism and gpu-cpu co-execution for decode and prefill with online workload observation that adapts to different hardware workload and batch size heterogeneity. we evaluated adaoffload on five different platforms with varying gpu capability l4 pro6000 b200 number of gpus cpu capability and numa topology on three different frontier open-weight models 284b to 753b . adaoffload achieves 1.9× to 15.5× throughput speedups across different models over state-of-the-art systems.

adaoffload combines gpu-cpu parallelism and co-execution for moe prefill and decoding adapting online to hardware batch sizes and workload differences. unlike offloading policies tied to one device it targets scaling across multiple gpus and heterogeneous numa configurations. evaluations on five platforms and three 284b-753b open-weight models report 1.9-15.5x throughput speedups over the compared systems. its placement and scheduling ideas are transferable to memory-limited sparse ranking models these are not ctr measurements.
adaoffload 在 moe 预填充和解码中结合 gpu-cpu 并行与协同执行 根据在线观测适配硬件、批量和工作负载差异 并考虑多 gpu 与不同 numa 拓扑。论文在五个平台、三个 2840 亿至 7530 亿参数开放权重模型上报告了相对所比较系统 1.9–15.5 倍的吞吐加速。其放置与调度思路可供受内存限制的稀疏排序模型参考 这些数值并非 ctr 实验结果。

weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. we introduce macaq an mxfp4 w4a4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. macaq applies a per-channel scale and a block-hadamard transform online to each layer's activations while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. to improve over round-to-nearest quantization we introduce flip-refinement a hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual fp4 codes to adjacent representable values. despite executing the activation transforms at inference time macaq adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure mxfp4 on qwen3-32b in vllm. macaq reaches lower perplexity than duquant++ and mr-gptq and already matches their best perplexity on llama-3-8b in 11 times less quantization time. we further apply macaq without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122b parameter model in 64 minutes using only 32.5gb gpu ram.

macaq performs mxfp4 weight-activation post-training quantization independently for each linear layer retaining activation transforms at inference while absorbing inverse transforms into weights. a hessian-aware coordinate-descent step refines fp4 codes and the layer-local design enables streaming quantization. it matches the compared methods best llama-3-8b perplexity with 11x less quantization time and reports 2.3% transform overhead on qwen3-32b in vllm. this offers a practical low-memory conversion path for large ranking models pending task-specific quality validation.
macaq 对每个线性层独立做 mxfp4 权重与激活量化 推理时保留激活变换 将对应逆变换吸收到权重中 再用 hessian 感知坐标下降细化 fp4 编码。逐层处理支持流式量化。论文以约十一分之一的量化时间达到对比方法在 llama-3-8b 上的最佳困惑度 并在 vllm 的 qwen3-32b 上测得 2.3% 的变换开销。这为大型排序模型提供了低内存转换路线 任务质量仍需验证。

low-precision pretraining is usually judged by validation loss. we ask whether matching loss also means learning rare facts as efficiently. we train transformers from scratch with emulated 4-bit matrix multiplications on synthetic biographies with controlled exposure counts on their own and mixed into web text. nvfp4 needs 1.32× and 1.52× as many exposures as bf16 to match its recall while validation loss differs by only 0.5% and 2% and 1.26× and 1.30× when both models are evaluated with bf16 matrix multiplications. under our primary readout the exposure cost is about 1.2× at matched loss. zero-mean gradient noise reproduces the cost of quantizing only the backward pass which barely moves the loss. in a controlled experiment at twice the nvfp4 error noise fed only to adam's second-moment estimate acts like a lower learning rate and its cost fades whereas noise in the update lowers its signal-to-noise ratio and carries about two thirds of the cost through the end of training. raising the learning rate to offset the smaller average step does not recover the cost either for this noise or for nvfp4. gradient statistics of bf16 checkpoints rank the costs of formats partial quantizations and noise controls without fitting spearman 0.96 . we suggest measuring rare-fact acquisition alongside loss when evaluating low-precision recipes.

this study asks whether similar validation loss guarantees similar rare-fact acquisition under low-precision pretraining. transformers trained with emulated fp4 matrix operations on controlled synthetic biographies require more exposures to match bf16 recall including when mixed with web text. gradient-noise controls link much of the cost to reduced update signal-to-noise rather than merely smaller average steps. the findings motivate evaluating long-tail learning separately from aggregate loss when scaling low-precision recommendation training the evidence is synthetic language-model learning not recommendation.
这项研究检查 低精度预训练的验证损失接近 是否意味着稀有事实也能以同样速度学会。在可控合成人物资料及其与网页文本的混合实验中 使用仿真 fp4 矩阵运算的 transformer 需要更多重复曝光才能达到 bf16 的记忆水平。梯度噪声对照把较多代价归因于更新信噪比降低 而不只是平均步长变小。它提醒低精度推荐训练单独评估长尾学习 不只看总体损失 现有证据来自合成语言模型任务。

self-attention has become the standard for modern sequence modeling enabling transformers to model long-range dependencies across a wide range of modalities. despite these advances its quadratic cost with respect to sequence length remains a significant computational bottleneck. recent work addresses this limitation by introducing linear variants of self-attention namely with kernel approximations of the softmax operator. however their first-order aggregation restricts expressivity and struggles to capture higher-order structure. we propose linear stochastic attention lisa a linear attention plug-in module that enables higher-order token interactions via a stochastic diffusion process based on truncated random walks. lisa incorporates adaptive locality favoring semantically similar neighbors to preserve fine-grained structures while maintaining stable and efficient training. we conduct extensive experiments on classification semantic segmentation and object detection tasks and show improved results over state-of-the-art methods.

lisa extends linear attention beyond first-order token aggregation through stochastic diffusion based on truncated random walks while favoring semantically similar neighbors to retain local detail. experiments cover image classification semantic segmentation and object detection and report improvements over the compared methods. its higher-order token mixing is a candidate design for efficient long-sequence ranking but recommendation performance has not been tested.
lisa 用截断随机游走构造随机扩散 使线性注意力能表达高阶令牌交互 同时优先保留语义相近邻居的信息。论文在图像分类、语义分割和目标检测上报告了相对所比较方法的改善。其高阶令牌混合方式可供高效长序列排序参考 但尚未验证推荐任务效果。

expert-parallel mixture-of-experts moe layers run at the pace of the most loaded gpu and a few hot experts carry most of the excess load. replicating them at every moe layer balances the load only if their weights arrive within the layer and broadcasting from the owner is the bottleneck point-to-point copies overload it and baseline broadcasts pay latency or bandwidth overheads. we present iser-moe in-switch expert replication for moe built in tensorrt-llm which multicasts hot experts through the nvlink switch to fixed gpu groups so each byte leaves its owner once. a gpu scheduler assigns hot experts to groups per layer and a multi-port broadcast spreads the injection over the group's ports both overlapped with the shared expert. in trace replay the scheduler removed 98-99% of the excess load in prefill serving of deepseek-v4-pro throughput rose 17.4% on a math benchmark and 7.2% on agentic prompts.

iser-moe replicates hot experts through nvlink-switch multicast to balance expert-parallel inference without repeatedly sending each expert's weights from its owner. a gpu scheduler assigns hot experts to fixed groups while multi-port broadcasts overlap with shared-expert computation. trace replay removes 98–99% of excess load deepseek-v4-pro prefill throughput improves by 17.4% on a math benchmark and 7.2% on agentic prompts. dynamic replication and communication overlap could inform large moe recommendation serving but the results concern language-model inference.

iser-moe通过nvlink交换机组播复制热门专家 避免权重持有者反复发送同一份数据 以缓解专家并行推理的负载不均。gpu调度器将热门专家分配到固定组 多端口广播再与共享专家计算重叠。轨迹回放中消除了98–99%的超额负载 deepseek-v4-pro的prefill吞吐在数学基准和智能体提示上分别提高17.4%和7.2%。动态复制与通信重叠可供大规模moe推荐服务参考 但实验对象是语言模型推理。

expert offloading enables large mixture-of-experts moe language models to run locally but conventional batching stalls the gpu while missing experts are fetched. a popular remedy known as prefetching is to predict what experts will be needed soon and fetch them using idle link bandwidth. imprecise prediction however wastes bandwidth and gpu memory on fetching unnecessary experts. our key finding is that prefetching can be harmful when there is an expert cache in gpu memory. this is because as the cache includes more necessary experts expert prediction becomes less precise. our key insight is that proper request scheduling beats prefetching. building on this insight we present bevy an moe inference system based on runahead inference for concurrent requests. a request whose experts are available can run ahead to later layers while other requests wait for fetches revealing the experts it needs next. bevy can then fetch the missing experts so identified while computing ready requests overlapping computation and fetching without predicting expert selections. running requests separately however repeats reads of shared weights in gpu memory and increases compute time. to limit this cost bevy's self-balancing scheduler batches ready requests at each layer and prioritizes lagging requests adapting their grouping as expert availability changes. across two local platforms bevy delivers up to 3.46× the decode throughput of this http url and up to 1.55× that of the fastest prefetching baseline.

bevy replaces speculative expert prefetching with runahead scheduling across concurrent offloaded-moe requests. ready requests advance to reveal their actual next experts while other requests wait for transfers a self-balancing scheduler batches ready requests and prioritizes lagging ones to limit repeated weight reads. on two local platforms decode throughput reaches up to 3.46x llama.cpp and 1.55x the fastest prefetching baseline. the transferable idea is to hide expert-transfer latency through request scheduling these are language-model results rather than recommendation measurements.
bevy用并发请求的超前执行调度替代预测式专家预取。所需专家已就绪的请求先运行 暴露后续真正需要的专家 其他请求则等待传输 自平衡调度器将就绪请求成批执行并优先照顾落后请求 减少重复读取共享权重的开销。在两个本地平台上 解码吞吐最高达到llama.cpp的3.46倍、最快预取基线的1.55倍。可迁移的是通过请求调度掩盖专家传输延迟的思路 实验并非推荐任务。

in speculative decoding parallel drafters such as dflash make drafting cheap so target verification dominates each round. a central choice is the verification length the number of tokens that the target processes in each round. verifying more draft tokens can accept more of them but work after the first rejection is wasted. for hybrid target models that combine gated deltanet gdn and mixture-of-experts moe layers verification time grows much faster with this length than for dense models. in a single-request profile of qwen3.6-35b-a3b with dflash it grew by 71% from length 4 to 16 almost entirely in gdn and moe layers compared with 4%-6% for a dense qwen3-4b target. each gdn layer must update a recurrent state at every token and recover it at the end of the accepted prefix. the moe cost depends on the experts that the tokens activate which are known only once verification runs. we present hybridspec which selects the verification length on the gpu from draft-side acceptance estimates and measured target latency. verification then runs this length plus one extra token up to the first moe router before any expert runs. there a lightweight routing correction uses the observed expert assignments to decide whether to keep that token. the rest of verification runs only on the selected tokens. block-parallel gdn kernels avoid storing a state after every token and reconstruct the accepted state of every gdn layer in one launch. in isolated benchmarks at verification lengths 4 to 16 with every draft token accepted these kernels including accepted-state reconstruction are 1.54×-4.04× faster than the default kernels. with three gdn-moe target models in single-request greedy decoding hybridspec is 1.75×-1.88× faster than autoregressive decoding and 1.30×-1.33× faster than dflash.

hybridspec adapts speculative-decoding verification length to hybrid gated deltanet–moe targets using draft acceptance estimates and measured target latency. a correction at the first moe router accounts for actual expert assignments and block-parallel gdn kernels reconstruct accepted-prefix states without retaining every intermediate state. across three hybrid targets in single-request greedy decoding it reports 1.75–1.88x autoregressive speed and 1.30–1.33x dflash. its cost-aware scheduling and state-reconstruction ideas may inform hybrid sequence-model serving the gains do not establish batched or recommendation throughput.

hybridspec面向gated deltanet与moe混合模型 用草稿接受率估计和实测目标模型延迟调整投机解码的验证长度。在首个moe路由器处再根据实际专家分配修正长度 块并行gdn内核则重建已接受前缀的状态 无需保留每个中间状态。三个混合模型的单请求贪心解码实验中 速度为自回归解码的1.75–1.88倍、dflash的1.30–1.33倍。成本感知调度和状态重建可供混合序列模型服务参考 不能据此推断批量推理或推荐吞吐。

mixture-of-experts moe training is often not stationary the data mixture changes at curriculum boundaries when a model is continually pretrained into a new domain or when the corpus is refreshed. routing is learned against the current mixture so each such change disrupts the per-expert load the router had converged to and existing balancing methods have only been evaluated on stationary data. we rethink load balancing as a feedback control problem in which the deviation of each expert's load from its fair share is the control error and the per-expert routing bias is the control input and define a family of controllers the pid-balancer from the proportional integral and derivative terms of classical pid control. two widely used methods belong to this family the auxiliary balancing loss behaves like a proportional controller and the loss-free bias update is an integral controller acting on the sign of the error. reading the router as a static map with a one-step delay we show that the integral term is the only one that both removes persistent imbalance and averages out the step-to-step fluctuation of the measured load whereas the proportional and derivative terms pass or amplify that fluctuation into the routing bias. we therefore adopt pid i the pure-integral member of the family with a single gain. two settings are evaluated i training an olmoe backbone from scratch with 16 to 64 experts per layer through a mid-run mixture switch and ii continual pretraining of the released olmoe-1b-7b on a new corpus. pid i holds balance before the shift and restores it more tightly afterwards than either the auxiliary loss or loss-free balancing at comparable perplexity.

pid-balancer treats moe load imbalance as a feedback-control error and expert routing biases as control inputs. its analysis favors a pure-integral controller that removes persistent imbalance while averaging noisy load measurements rather than proportional or derivative terms that pass or amplify fluctuations. in olmoe training with a mid-run data-mixture switch and continual pretraining on a new corpus this controller restores tighter balance than auxiliary-loss or loss-free balancing at comparable perplexity. it offers a mechanism to examine under shifting recommendation traffic without demonstrating recommendation gains.
pid-balancer将moe专家负载偏差视作反馈控制误差 将路由偏置视作控制输入。分析支持纯积分控制器 它既消除持续失衡 也平滑负载测量噪声 而比例项和微分项会传递或放大波动。在中途切换数据混合的olmoe训练及新语料持续预训练中 纯积分方案以相近困惑度实现了比辅助损失或无损失均衡更紧的负载平衡。该机制值得在推荐流量分布变化时检验 但论文未证明推荐效果提升。

mixture-of-experts moe enables multimodal large language models mllms to scale capacity efficiently but expert parameters dominate memory even though only a few experts are activated per token they account for over 90% of model size in modern moe-mllms e.g. 54 gb out of about 58 gb in bf16 for internvl3.5-30b-a3b and qwen3-vl-30b-a3b . expert pruning has emerged as an effective compression strategy but existing methods aggregate importance uniformly across tokens ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles for vision versus language processing. to address this we propose maep modality-aware expert pruning a training-free framework that decomposes expert importance by modality in a single forward pass. maep introduces 1 delta-h output \delta h a redistribution-aware metric measuring the moe output change when an expert is removed and 2 low-attention vision tokens as a vision-side pruning signal that is dataset-stable its expert-importance ranking remains stable across different datasets. text-side importance serves as a preservation signal while vision-side importance serves as a pruning signal and experts are ranked globally across layers. experiments on three moe-based mllms across multimodal and text benchmarks show that maep outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on the majority of multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text-only tasks reducing the bf16 expert weight footprint by about 27 gb about 47% of total memory so that the full weight footprint of an approximately 58 gb model fits within a single 40 gb gpu. code is available at this https url.

maep prunes multimodal moe experts without training by separating their vision and text importance in one forward pass. it combines a redistribution-aware output-change metric with low-attention vision-token signals preserving text-important experts while ranking pruning candidates globally across layers. across three multimodal moe models it beats modality-agnostic baselines on most multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text tasks reducing bf16 expert weights by about 27 gb so an approximately 58 gb weight footprint fits on a 40 gb gpu. modality-aware capacity allocation may inform multimodal recommendation but no ctr benefit or full runtime-memory guarantee is established.

maep无需训练 在一次前向计算中拆分多模态moe专家的视觉与文本重要性。它结合考虑重分配的输出变化指标和低注意力视觉token信号 保留文本侧重要专家 并跨层统一排序裁剪候选。在三个多模态moe模型上 多数多模态基准优于不区分模态的裁剪基线 文本任务保持竞争力 bf16专家权重减少约27 gb 使原约58 gb的完整权重可装入40 gb gpu。模态感知容量分配可供多模态推荐参考 但这不等于ctr收益或完整运行时显存保证。

researchers and engineers improve recommendation systems by performing a/b experiments with new model architectures optimization methods and data features. however running full-scale experiments e.g. full-model training with online data for every feature change is prohibitively computationally intensive while the result from a single small-scale experiment is often misleading. to address this challenge we show that modern recommendation models exhibit feature-invariant scaling the change of a model's performance follows a predictable scaling-law even when different feature changes are applied to the baseline model. we introduce an efficient method that exploits scaling-laws and uses statistical inference to predict with confidence intervals the full-scale effect of an a/b experiment in recommendation systems. this enables practitioners to efficiently filter out neutral or regressive feature changes with only small-scale experimentation. we validate our method on three distinct recommendation model families---wukong hstu and llm-based recommendation models---across more than 40 architectural optimization and data changes. our method accurately distinguishes beneficial feature changes from neutral and regressive ones while using only a fraction of the compute required for full-scale evaluation. it also identifies several changes that improve hstu's state-of-the-art performance on movielens-20m. our results demonstrate that scaling laws can be practically exploited to make compute-efficient decisions for improving industrial-scale recommendation systems.

the paper predicts the full-scale effect of a recommendation-model change from several small experiments with confidence intervals. its feature-invariant scaling approach covers architecture optimizer and data changes across wukong hstu and llm-based recommenders. more than 40 changes are evaluated enabling neutral or regressive candidates to be filtered at a fraction of full-scale compute. this offers a practical way to allocate experimentation budgets the reported prediction evidence should not be read as a measured online business lift.
这项工作用多组小规模实验预测推荐模型改动在完整规模下的效果 并给出置信区间。方法利用不同改动下相对效果的扩展规律 覆盖 wukong、hstu 和大模型推荐器的架构、优化器及数据变化。论文评估了 40 多项改动 可用较少计算筛掉无效或退化候选 帮助分配扩模实验预算 这些预测结果不等于已验证的线上业务收益。

looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters yet caching full-context key-value kv states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. we design a looped causal encoder-decoder ced that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise kv growth addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global kv. we find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global kv representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. furthermore training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's kv cache. compounding cross-layer and cross-round kv sharing the resulting looped ced matches an unlooped ced's minimal memory footprint and recovers 86-93% of a looped transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global kv. to test serving at production scale we loop the 552b-parameter deepseek-v4.1-flash for 8 rounds on one 4xgb200 node with per-layer and per-round kv the loop cannot fit a single 128k-token request whereas looped ced holds 36.8x less kv per token fits 38 such requests as many as the unlooped model and serves 3.6x higher throughput on 8k-token prompts.

looped ced places recurrent computation in the encoder of a causal encoder-decoder where a few layers create the global key-value cache. stochastic recurrence training allows rounds to share the final round s cache avoiding cache growth with recurrent depth. language-modeling experiments and a deepseek-v4.1-flash serving analysis examine the quality-memory tradeoff. the design suggests a way to deepen computation over long histories under a fixed cache budget recommendation quality remains untested.
looped ced 在因果编码器—解码器的编码端重复计算 由少数层生成全局键值缓存。随机循环深度训练使各轮共享最后一轮缓存 避免缓存随循环次数增长。论文通过语言建模实验和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 服务分析考察质量与显存的权衡。它为固定缓存预算下增加长历史计算深度提供了思路 推荐效果仍需验证。

serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires kv-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other data parallelism replicates model weights limiting kv capacity tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's kv-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes and decode context parallelism dcp recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. we observe that during decode dense layers and attention scale differently dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single nvlink domain whereas attention cost grows with every active request's kv cache. we present decode token parallelism tknp a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. tknp distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. the active node holding a block executes its projections and mlp for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident kv cache. this extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights only current-token activations cross the network dense all-reduces remain within nvlink and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. implemented in vllm and evaluated on llama 3.1 405b and nemotron-4 340b on up to 64 h100 gpus tknp improves completion throughput for long-context high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7× over dcp and by up to 2.06× over data parallelism at matched gpu count.

decode token parallelism separates model-weight placement from request-specific attention and key-value cache ownership. layers are balanced across nodes while each request s attention and cache stay local only token activations cross nodes. experiments on llama-3.1-405b and nemotron-4-340b use up to 64 h100 gpus and compare completion throughput at matched gpu counts. local cache ownership may inform large generative recommenders although the reported gains are from language-model serving.
decode token parallelism 将模型权重放置与请求的注意力、键值缓存归属分开 各节点分担模型层 每个请求的注意力和缓存留在本地 跨节点只传递 token 激活。实验使用最多 64 张 h100 在相同 gpu 数量下比较 llama-3.1-405b 和 nemotron-4-340b 的完成吞吐。缓存就地处理可供大型生成式推荐服务参考 现有收益来自语言模型负载。

expert parallelism ep shards the experts of a mixture-of-experts moe layer across gpus so every moe layer requires two all-to-all communications namely dispatch and combine. compared with training inference processes relatively few tokens per gpu at a time and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens rather than data movement dominate the latency. we present nvlinkonesided a one-sided ep all-to-all for gpus within a single nvlink domain. each source rank pushes its tokens without first exchanging metadata into rank-major buffers on the target gpus and the grouped gemms read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. we provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires namely fence and sentinel for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. on blackwell gpus nvlinkonesided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0× faster than deepep with the largest speedups at small batch sizes. the resulting moe layer is up to 2.4× faster than deepep with deepgemm. it even outperforms the fused deepgemm megamoe at up to 128 tokens per gpu making it still competitive for decoding. we expose nvlinkonesided through a modular interface so that it is agnostic to the activation quantization format decoupled from the moe compute backend and easy to integrate into inference frameworks.

nvlinkonesided sends routed tokens directly into buffers organized by source rank and lets grouped matrix multiplication consume them in place. this removes metadata exchange and extra copies before expert computation. separate synchronization modes target throughput and latency. blackwell experiments report faster dispatch combine and moe-layer execution than evaluated baselines especially for small batches. the idea is relevant to sparse recommendation serving but its gains depend on the nvlink hardware and routing workload.
nvlinkonesided 将路由后的 token 直接写入按来源节点组织的缓冲区 让专家矩阵乘法原地读取 省去元数据交换和额外搬运。两种同步方式分别面向吞吐与延迟。blackwell 实验显示 分发、合并及 moe 层执行快于所测基线 小批量下尤为明显。它可启发稀疏推荐服务优化 收益取决于 nvlink 硬件和路由负载。

in mixture-of-experts moe models the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. to clarify these differing accounts we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using routing-aware magnitude profiling ramp a measure developed for this analysis. using mixed-domain calibration data we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain compared with 15-24% across domains. to understand how this organization evolves during training we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open moe families. neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. building on these neuron-level perspectives we further introduce ramp-based pruning rampr to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. at 75% neuron retention rampr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. at 50% retention our pruning method can reduce resident gpu memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. our code is available at this https url

ramp measures neuron contributions weighted by expert routing to study specialization inside moe models. domain-associated neuron sets extend across expert boundaries and neuron rankings can change even when expert rankings remain stable. rampr uses this finer view to prune neurons across experts. evaluations on six models examine quality resident memory and prefill throughput at different retention levels. neuron-level capacity allocation could inform sparse recommenders but no recommendation result is established.
ramp 用专家路由权重加权神经元贡献 观察 moe 内部的领域分工。相关神经元可以跨越专家边界 专家重要性排名稳定时 内部神经元排名仍可能变化。rampr 据此跨专家裁剪神经元 并在六个模型上比较不同保留比例下的质量、常驻显存和预填充吞吐。这种更细粒度的容量分配可供稀疏推荐模型参考 尚无推荐实验结论。

reusing key--value kv caches across language model updates could avoid repeated computation of shared context but changes in model weights raise a fundamental question about what these caches preserve. we investigate direct cache reuse across four model updates with a detailed study of deepseek-v4-flash to flash-0731. our central finding is that caches can retain useful task information without faithfully reproducing the updated model's behavior. retrieval accuracy varies substantially across updates ranging from near-native performance to large losses. with source caches already available reuse achieves median time-to-first-token speedups of 2.10--5.08× on three longer-prefix qa benchmarks. to characterize the behavioral differences behind these outcomes we introduce functional cache divergence which compares next-token distributions under reused and native caches. direct kv cache reuse better preserves native model behavior in natural-text continuation whereas compatibility degrades with increasing prefix length in single-token retrieval tasks. answer-margin analyses help explain how correct retrieval decisions survive substantial internal state changes. yet even agreement on the first generated token does not ensure agreement in answer content or stopping behavior. these findings establish task utility and fidelity to native inference as distinct criteria for evaluating cross-version kv cache reuse.

this study tests whether an old model s key-value cache remains useful after a model update. across four updates utility and fidelity behave differently reused caches can reduce time to first token on some question-answering tasks when caches already exist yet cause large retrieval losses in other settings. functional cache divergence compares next-token distributions to diagnose incompatibility. the work suggests checking cached-history compatibility during model refreshes rather than assuming reuse is safe recommendation workloads are not evaluated.
论文研究模型更新后能否继续使用旧模型的键值缓存。四次更新的实验表明 可用性与结果一致性并不相同 已有缓存可在部分问答任务中缩短首 token 等待 但在另一些检索设置中造成明显损失。作者用下一 token 分布的差异诊断缓存兼容性。对推荐系统的启发是 更新模型时应检验历史缓存是否仍适用 论文尚未评估推荐负载。

dual-batch overlap dbo hides mixture-of-experts moe communication behind another microbatch's computation but only after dispatch send releases the gpu. the time dispatch send holds the gpu therefore stays exposed while network progress after release can be hidden. we evaluate three research configurations built on nccl-ep that target this exposed communication time gpi in which the gpu constructs gpu-friendly descriptors gfds and submits them to nic-accessible memory for transport gpi-mc which describes moe token fan-out in one gfd and gdaki free flow which moves send progression to a host thread. on a gb300 nvl72 system all three approaches reduce dispatch-send time relative to default gdaki over most operating points in the evaluated parameter sweep. an experiment that inserts a gpu delay between dispatch send and receive shows that offload increases the in-flight interval. depending on the configuration 32 to 512 microseconds of computation or other independent work between send and receive hides the deferred progress leaving less exposed time than default gdaki. in disaggregated vllm serving with dbo these approaches lower median tpot by 15-25% relative to nccl-ep default gdaki and by 16-42% relative to deepep v1.
