the paper offloads moe dispatch progression so gpu resources can be released earlier and communication can overlap another microbatch s computation. three nccl-ep research configurations move work toward network-interface or host-side progression. gb300 nvl72 experiments examine the computation window needed to hide communication and report lower median time per output token in vllm. this is a concrete communication-computation overlap technique for sparse-model serving with results tied to the evaluated hardware and batching conditions.
这项工作将 moe 分发通信的推进工作移交给网卡或主机 使 gpu 更早释放资源 再用另一微批次的计算覆盖通信时间。作者实现了三种 nccl-ep 研究配置 在 gb300 nvl72 上测量隐藏通信所需的计算窗口 并在 vllm 中观察到输出 token 中位耗时下降。它提供了稀疏模型服务中重叠通信与计算的具体做法 收益受硬件和批处理条件约束。

deepseek sparse attention dsa reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. however its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. notably the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill gpu time at long context lengths. to address this bottleneck we propose adindex an adaptive and distillation-driven indexing method for token-level sparse attention. adindex integrates three key components i a layer-wise calibration strategy that adaptively accommodates cross-query retrieval overlap motivated by our observation of pronounced inter-layer heterogeneity ii a group-level distillation scheme that leverages this heterogeneity to efficiently train adaptive layer-wise group indexers capturing salient retrieval signals from individual queries and iii a low-latency inference strategy that reduces repeated full-prefix scans through token bank sharing within query groups while retaining query-specific refinement. experiments on deepseek-v3.2 and glm-5.1 demonstrate that adindex preserves near-lossless task performance on longbench longbench v2 and ruler while delivering substantial efficiency gains over standard dsa including prefill and decoding kernel speedups of up to 6.22x and 3.40x respectively at a context length of 256k across the layer-wise reuse configurations as well as an end-to-end serving speedup of 1.54x at a context length of 128k.

adindex reduces sparse-attention indexing cost by calibrating query overlap per layer distilling group-level indexers and sharing candidate token banks with query-specific refinement. experiments on deepseek-v3.2 and glm-5.1 evaluate long-context quality and serving speed. kernel acceleration is larger than the reported end-to-end improvement so the two should be distinguished. sharing indexing work may help long-sequence generative recommendation but its recommendation accuracy and serving benefit have not been tested.
adindex 先校准各层查询对历史位置的重合程度 再蒸馏分组索引器 共享候选 token 集合并按查询细化 减少稀疏注意力的索引开销。论文在 deepseek-v3.2 和 glm-5.1 上评估长上下文质量与服务速度 内核加速幅度大于端到端收益。共享索引计算可供长序列生成式推荐借鉴 推荐准确率和实际服务收益仍需测试。

language-model agents increasingly run on workstations with a few consumer gpus where large mixture-of-experts moe models keep part of their experts in host memory. with existing cpu-gpu engines these agents get fast prefill or fast decode not both this http url's expert cache skips forward passes of more than 32 tokens to keep the experts of decode cached so an agent waits 2.1-2.8 s after each tool output whereas its default layer placement shortens this wait but is 1.5-1.6× slower in decode. our key insight is that a short prefill touches too many distinct experts to upload yet sends 84% of its expert activations routes to a stable set of experts that fits in gpu memory. we present ostinato a cpu-gpu moe inference engine that computes these experts on the gpus in every forward pass without changing what the model computes. short prefills split their routes leaving fewer than one of a token's six routed experts per layer to the cpu long prefills upload each distinct cold expert once and each decode step runs as one fixed-shape cuda graph per gpu. on real coding and customer-service agent sessions with deepseek-v4-flash on four rtx 4090d gpus ostinato is the fastest engine in both phases and finishes every session sooner than all six baselines. against this http url and ktransformers it cuts the median wait after a tool output by 22-55% and finishes sessions 1.4-2.5× sooner.

ostinato keeps frequently used experts resident on gpus while offloading other moe work to cpus. it adapts execution to short and long prefills and uses fixed cuda graphs for decoding. deepseek-v4-flash agent-session experiments on four rtx 4090d gpus report shorter waits after tool outputs and faster session completion than evaluated cpu-gpu baselines without changing model outputs. the execution design may inform limited-memory sparse recommendation deployments although recommendation workloads were not studied.
ostinato 让常用专家驻留 gpu 其余 moe 计算由 cpu 协作承担 它分别处理短、长预填充 并用固定 cuda 图执行解码。在四张 rtx 4090d 上运行 deepseek-v4-flash 的智能体会话实验中 相比所测 cpu–gpu 基线 工具返回后的等待和会话完成时间缩短 模型输出保持不变。这种执行方式可供显存受限的稀疏推荐部署参考 尚未验证推荐负载。

in expert-parallel mixture-of-experts serving a layer finishes only when the most loaded gpu of its group does. token routing shifts at every decode step and concentrates on a few experts so most of the group's reserved gpu time waits on stragglers. recovering that time means re-deciding at every layer of every decode step how each replicated expert's tokens divide between its copies. the exact linear-program solvers that make this decision optimally take longer than many of the layers they serve and their working set outgrows gpu shared memory at deployment scale. we introduce relief a bidirectional pairwise relaxation that makes the linear program unnecessary coming within a fraction of a point of the per-step optimum in a few passes of integer halving over the token counts. we build and measure three deployments cuda kernels on the serving gpu the same verified engine on an fpga over pcie and a fixed-function block beside the accelerator. on decode routing from three open moe families relief holds the balance near the per-step optimum at every group size and layer time measured. scored as effective utilization relative to that optimum the kernel alone matches or exceeds every deployable scheme at every group size from the hundred-microsecond layer on. the on-die engine widens that lead at every point recovering up to 37.3 percentage points over the deployed static placement while adding 0.02% of a current accelerator's transistors.

relief balances token assignments across replicated experts at every decoding step. a pairwise integer-halving relaxation avoids solving an expensive optimization problem online and the paper evaluates gpu fpga and on-die implementations. its reported utilization improvements concern expert-parallel execution and should not be equated with end-to-end throughput gains. the method offers a hardware-oriented approach to per-step load balancing that could be tested in sparse recommendation serving.
relief 在每个解码步骤重新平衡复制专家之间的 token 分配 用成对整数减半的松弛方法减少在线求解开销 并评估 gpu、fpga 和片上实现。论文报告的利用率改善针对专家并行执行 不能直接当作端到端吞吐提升。它为稀疏推荐服务提供了逐步负载均衡的硬件实现思路。

low-precision matrix throughput on modern gpus is growing far faster than vector-arithmetic throughput. attention therefore cannot realize the available gemm performance because softmax has become the pipeline bottleneck. we introduce fused-softmax attention a training-free algorithm that reformulates and approximates softmax to fold its dominant operations into the attention gemms moving work from vector units to matrix cores. implemented for the amd cdna 4 architecture our mxfp8 mxfp6 and mxfp4 kernels reach approximately 3.0 4.0 and 4.6 pflop/s on an amd instinct mi355x gpu yielding speedups of 2.1× 2.8× and 3.2× over the bf16 attention. importantly the additional error introduced by fused-softmax remains below the error floor set by quantizing the gemm operands. on wan2.2-t2v-a14b a hybrid mxfp6/4 schedule delivers up to 2.05× end-to-end speedup while preserving the visual quality of the outputs. the kernels ship in amd's open-source aiter library and they powered amd's mlperf inference v6.1 wan2.2 submission which ran 1.7× faster than amd's previous-round result on the same hardware. our results show that redesigning softmax to utilize the matrix pipeline enables attention to capitalize on continued growth in low-precision matrix throughput.

fused-softmax redesigns approximate softmax for quantized attention so more work runs on matrix cores instead of vector units. amd cdna 4 kernels cover mxfp8 mxfp6 and mxfp4 with additional approximation error below the tested operand-quantization error. wan2.2 video-generation experiments provide an end-to-end evaluation alongside kernel benchmarks. the system illustrates how low-bit attention requires joint arithmetic and kernel design gains on recommendation models remain unverified.
fused-softmax 为量化注意力重新设计近似 softmax 将更多运算从向量单元转移到矩阵核心。amd cdna 4 实现覆盖 mxfp8、mxfp6 和 mxfp4 所测附加近似误差小于操作数量化误差 除内核测试外 论文还用 wan2.2 视频生成评估端到端效果。它说明低比特注意力需要协同设计算法与内核 推荐模型上的收益仍待验证。

in large language model llm serving systems the key-value kv cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory hbm capacity wall and results in low concurrency. offloading the kv cache to host dynamic random-access memory dram frees hbm space and raises concurrency but the additional cache management and host-to-device h2d load overhead inflates inference latency higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. we present flashoffloading a host-dram-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the kv cache in both the prefill and decode phases. flashoffloading builds rolling hbm cache for prefill a hot cache for decode a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead and a compute--load overlapped kernel optimizing kv offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token tpot service-level objective slo . in experiments deploying glm-5.2 with multi-token prediction mtp3 speculative decoding on an ascend910c prefill--decode pd -disaggregated platform flashoffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38 × and decode throughput by up to 1.91 × under a 30 ms tpot constraint. flashoffloading is integrated into an open-source serving framework this https url.

flashoffloading stores the complete key-value cache in host dram while using gpu or accelerator memory for a rolling working set. it overlaps bulk transfers during prefill and fetches sparse-index-selected entries during decode reducing lookup and transfer overhead. glm-5.2 experiments on ascend 910c examine both phases under a latency target. the design may support longer recommendation histories under limited device memory but the reported speedups are specific to the evaluated language-model system.
flashoffloading 将完整键值缓存放在主机 dram 设备显存只保留滚动工作集 预填充时重叠批量传输与计算 解码时只读取稀疏索引选中的位置 减少查找和搬运开销。论文在昇腾 910c 上用 glm-5.2 评估延迟目标下的两阶段性能。该设计可启发有限显存下的长历史服务 现有加速结果属于所测语言模型系统。

banks now train foundation models on ordered sequences of customer events such as transactions app sessions and authorizations. deployed such a model predicts forward in time often for customers and merchants absent from training yet each is evaluated on private data so no two can be compared. public benchmarks for such sequences rarely test a period the model has not seen recommendation studies usually hold out each user's last events instead. we present intent interaction novelty and transfer evaluation for next-action prediction a public benchmark that scores a model in seven cells defined by whether the user the period and the target item appeared in training. an audit of 59 public dataset families retains five datasets the most common defect is the lack of a calendar timestamp that orders events. no date lies within the time span of all five datasets so each is split at its own cutoff chosen by one rule fixed before any model is evaluated. summed over the datasets every cell holds at least 111 769 users. in reference results the cell determines the best model a transformer leads on seen items after the cutoff but scores zero on new items a variant that embeds item metadata helps mainly on microlens and repeating the user's last item leads on new items in four of five datasets. this parameter-free control also shows that on three datasets most of the score lost after the cutoff reflects changed behavior rather than the model. the pipeline the cutoff rule and the per-cell user counts are publicly available.

intent evaluates next-action models across seven cells separating seen and unseen users past and future periods and seen and new target items. it audits 59 public dataset families and retains five with usable global timelines and sufficient coverage. reference results change substantially by cell a transformer leads on seen future items but fails on new items where repeating the last item wins on four datasets. the benchmark helps distinguish sequence-model scaling from split artifacts and changes in user behavior.
intent 将下一行为预测划分为七种测试情形 分别区分已见与新用户、过去与未来时段、已见与新目标商品。它审查 59 个公开数据集系列 保留五个具备可用全局时间线和足够覆盖的数据集。不同情形下模型排名明显变化 transformer 在未来已见商品上领先 却无法预测新商品 重复上一商品的简单方法在四个数据集的新商品测试中领先。这有助于区分序列扩模收益、数据切分影响和用户行为变化。

approximate nearest-neighbor search on gpus serves retrieval-augmented generation recommendation and deduplication over datasets of up to billions of vectors. the fastest gpu indexes at high recall such as cagra walk proximity graphs in chained rounds each of which waits for the distances of the previous one. high recall therefore costs many dependent rounds per query. our insight is to spend the hbm of the gpus on precomputed neighbor lists so that a query reads its candidates in one parallel step instead of a chain of rounds. this paper turns the above insight into a gpu vector search system namely octex which holds hundreds of randomly projected copies of the dataset in gpu memory. every copy rounds its vectors to the nearest points of a regular grid whose cells are nearly round and stores for every populated cell the list of vectors nearest to its center. a query reads the lists of its cells in all copies at once and then in a fixed number of waves the precomputed neighbor lists of its best hits. octex ranks the union of all hits by an int8 sketch before one exact rerank. octex runs the whole search of a batch as cuda graphs over all gpus of a server and places every part of its index in hbm or host memory by its access frequency. on four h100 gpus at recall 0.95 to 0.995 octex outperforms cagra by 2.0x to 46.4x on seven datasets of up to one hundred million vectors and by 1.46x to 2.05x on the one billion vectors of deep1b and sift1b whose indexes it builds in 44 to 47 minutes. octex also outperforms ggnn pathweaver flowann and the cuvs inverted file indexes ivf-pq and ivf-rabitq by 5.4x to 343x.

octex trades index memory and preprocessing for parallel vector search. multiple random projections map vectors into lattice cells with precomputed neighbor lists queries read candidate lists in parallel rank their union with an int8 sketch and perform one exact rerank. four-h100 experiments include billion-vector datasets and compare throughput at high recall against graph and inverted-file indexes. it offers a retrieval-stage scaling option when the index-memory budget is large enough without establishing downstream recommendation gains.
octex 用索引内存和预处理换取并行向量搜索 多组随机投影将向量映射到格点单元 提前保存邻居列表 查询并行读取候选 用 int8 简化表示排序 最后精确重排一次。四张 h100 的实验覆盖十亿向量数据集 并在高召回率下比较图索引和倒排索引的吞吐。它适合探索内存预算充足时的召回扩展方案 尚未证明下游推荐收益。
